Bedroll: +2 SL Endurance against Cold Exposure while resting (page 170).

Candle: Lights 2 yards.

Feinkopf Lamp: Candle-strength safety light; flares in firedamp, which explodes after 1d10 Rounds of lamp exposure.

Grappling Hook: With rope, permits climbing otherwise unscalable surfaces.

Instrument: Listed values suit medium instruments such as mandolin, coach horn or small drum. Small instruments cost half and have 0 Encumbrance; large instruments cost double and have 2 Encumbrance.

Lamp Oil: Fuels a torch for 1 hour, lantern for 4 hours or Davrich lamp for 8 hours.

Lantern: Lights 10 yards. Storm Lantern resists wind and may be shuttered or aimed over 90°; lights 10 yards normally, 20 when directed.

Tent: Standard size sleeps four closely; small sleeps 2 for half price and 1 Encumbrance; large sleeps 8 for double price and 4 Encumbrance.

Torch: Lights 10 yards and counts as Improvised Weapon; Critical Hits also cause 1 Ablaze.

description:1fbd30b93dbcff9d7f8c3b77.name: Difficulty Table
description:1fbd30b93dbcff9d7f8c3b77.text:
| Difficulty | Test Modifier | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Very Easy | +6 SL | Notice an obvious detail or jump a narrow gap. |
| Easy | +4 SL | Sharpen a familiar blade. |
| Average | +2 SL | Find relevant material quickly in a readable book. |
| Challenging | +0 | Ordinary melee or ranged attacks, or climbing a stone wall. |
| Difficult | −1 SL | Recall an obscure fact about a historical noble. |
| Hard | −2 SL | Swim against a flooded sewer’s flow. |
| Very Hard | −3 SL | Persuade a witch hunter of a serious error. |

Unspecified Difficulty defaults to Challenging (+0 SL), as do most Combat Tests.

description:63d75d27e6a7d4c4aeea05d3.name: Ablaze
description:63d75d27e6a7d4c4aeea05d3.text: At Round end, take 1d10 Damage plus 1 per additional Ablaze, reduced by TB and the AP of the least protected location. Reaching 0 Wounds causes a Body Critical Wound. Normally affects flammable creatures, although some magical/divine effects bypass this restriction. A successful Athletics Test removes 1 Ablaze plus 1 per SL beyond the first; the GM sets Difficulty for the circumstances.

description:9b9af64aba960f209dbe0c2c.name: Besmirched
description:9b9af64aba960f209dbe0c2c.text: While thoroughly fouled, suffer Disadvantage on every Fellowship Test until cleaned. This Condition does not stack.

description:4be73b0680c322f93b951a3c.name: Bleeding
description:4be73b0680c322f93b951a3c.text: At Round end, lose 1 Wound per Bleeding, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, replace this loss with a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test each Round end; failure causes Unconscious. If Unconscious, Bleeding and at 0 Wounds, also roll 1d10 each Round end: a result no higher than your Bleeding count kills you; 10 removes 1 Bleeding. You cannot awaken while any remain. Each recovered Wound removes 1 Bleeding. Challenging (+0 SL) Heal removes Intelligence Bonus + SL Bleeding. A Bandage removes 1 without a Test, costing an Action or accompanying a Heal Test even if that Test fails.

description:bc88e861f7e50f9bf71f7e6c.name: Blinded
description:bc88e861f7e50f9bf71f7e6c.text: Cannot perform tasks requiring sight, including reading and Ranged Attacks. Melee Attacks and other strongly sight-dependent Tests, such as Climb/Ride, have Disadvantage. Melee attackers gain Advantage unless also Blinded. Normally remove 1 Blinded at your Turn's end; poison/injury causes may last longer.

description:52ba30eff90477c9a1f7fffa.name: Broken
description:52ba30eff90477c9a1f7fffa.text: Use Move and Action to Flee until hidden from all enemies, then your Action may improve concealment. Tests unrelated to running/hiding suffer −1 SL. While Engaged, cannot rally. Otherwise, a successful Cool Test at Round end removes 1 Broken plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Spending a full Round hidden from every enemy also removes 1 Broken.

description:7274526e01cf504744b2ce46.name: Deafened
description:7274526e01cf504744b2ce46.text: Cannot hear or understand speech unless Lip Reading is usable. Every minute (6 Rounds), attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; success removes 1 Deafened plus 1 per SL beyond the first.

description:70eef02467a81c21f0315576.name: Entangled
description:70eef02467a81c21f0315576.text:
Cannot Move; movement-related actions, including Grappling, suffer −1 SL. Spend an Action on Opposed Strength against the restraint: winning removes 1 Entangled plus 1 per SL beyond the first. For restraints without Strength, use the material value below.

| Material | Strength |
| --- | --- |
| Wool | 10 |
| Twine | 25 |
| Rope | 45 |
| Manacles | 65 |
| Heavy Iron Chain | 105 |

description:4067aae68e56ba4870f114cb.name: Fatigued
description:4067aae68e56ba4870f114cb.text: All Tests suffer −1 SL. Rest, a Prayer or a Spell can remove Fatigued. Rest depends on the cause: hard labour, forced marches or poison normally require a night's sleep; strenuous fighting, Frenzy or Stunned may need only minutes. Fatigued from Overburdened, disease, exposure or another ongoing effect ends when its cause ends.

description:e3095362060cd0c05f731475.name: Poisoned
description:e3095362060cd0c05f731475.text: Suffer −1 SL to all Tests and lose 1 Wound at Round end, ignoring TB/AP. At 0 Wounds, healing is impossible until all Poisoned are removed. If Unconscious, Test Endurance every TB Rounds or die. At each Round's end, successful Endurance removes 1 Poisoned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Successful Heal by you or another removes the same amount. Endurance is normally Challenging (+0 SL), but the poison/venom sets the applicable Endurance/Heal Difficulty. Removing the last Poisoned gives 1 Fatigued.

description:1dbd38ed657c0550ac135081.name: Prone
description:1dbd38ed657c0550ac135081.text: Your Move may only stand you up or crawl at half normal Walking pace in yards. Movement-related Tests have Disadvantage; melee attackers gain Advantage. Does not stack; standing removes Prone.

description:2dc6a456175e30063b33b505.name: Stunned
description:2dc6a456175e30063b33b505.text: Movement is halved and all Tests suffer −1 SL. At Round end, successful Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance removes 1 Stunned plus 1 per SL beyond the first. Removing the last gives 1 Fatigued if none is already present. More Stunned than TB makes you Unconscious.

description:28c9769f8be202bc904085c6.name: Surprised
description:28c9769f8be202bc904085c6.text: No Action or Move; cannot defend Opposed Tests. Melee attackers gain +2 SL. Does not stack. Ends at Round end or after the first attempt to attack you.

description:a3343f006612c2c5ac35143e.name: Unconscious
description:a3343f006612c2c5ac35143e.text: You are Helpless, unaware and unable to act. Does not stack; becoming Unconscious removes all Stunned. Ordinary sleep usually ends after a few hours and may be interrupted. If another Condition/circumstance caused it, awaken when that cause ends. Spending Fortune to remove Unconscious without fixing its cause makes you Unconscious again at Round end.

description:16ad792d9b4c56d24166b90f.name: Durable
description:16ad792d9b4c56d24166b90f.text: Withstand Damage equal to the Durable rating before suffering item-damage penalties. Against instant breakage, save on 1d10 of 9+; each further purchase improves the save by 1 (Durable 3 saves on 7+). Repeat purchases are allowed.

description:9a08d2c7fca8f732d1ecb170.name: Fine
description:9a08d2c7fca8f732d1ecb170.text: An indicator of craftsmanship and social standing. Repeat purchases increase how impressive the item appears.

description:9f932b74d524f9fee96ea62c.name: Practical
description:9f932b74d524f9fee96ea62c.text: A failed Test using the item gains +1 SL. On armour, reduce each wearing penalty by one level, such as −3 SL becoming −2 SL.

description:4404a410d18eb2e50a4517e9.name: Bulky
description:4404a410d18eb2e50a4517e9.text: Add 1 Encumbrance. Bulky armour/clothing still has Enc 1 when worn. This Flaw normally cannot apply to small trinkets.

description:0c1bb7dfd4ecd07a9bc5f534.name: Shoddy
description:0c1bb7dfd4ecd07a9bc5f534.text: Breaks on a failed Test using the item when the roll is a double. Shoddy armour breaks when a protected location sustains any Critical Hit.

description:ae246708a51d2e48e41055d4.name: Ugly
description:ae246708a51d2e48e41055d4.text: Draws unfavourable attention; relevant Fellowship Tests may suffer −1 SL.

description:72c5ce15ffdec21b0fb16958.name: Unreliable
description:72c5ce15ffdec21b0fb16958.text: A failed Test using the item suffers −1 SL. Double the wearing penalties of Unreliable armour.

description:1f5edca7af917b8c23db39ec.name: Blackpowder
description:1f5edca7af917b8c23db39ec.text: Anyone targeted must pass the printed Average (+20) Psychology Test or gain 1 Broken, even when the shot misses.

description:943d0be25879d5397bdaa5d8.name: Blast (Rating)
description:943d0be25879d5397bdaa5d8.text: Affects everyone in a Rating-yard diameter and normally cannot be Opposed. Inflicts Weapon Damage and its Conditions, without SL Damage. Damaging still permits Damage from the units die.

description:c1aa71c08bb02f0547cd418a.name: Damaging
description:c1aa71c08bb02f0547cd418a.text: On a successful hit, use the higher of SL or the units die for the attack's Damage contribution. Undamaging overrides Damaging if both would apply.

description:854c2882c5a5c2edf132fad5.name: Defensive
description:854c2882c5a5c2edf132fad5.text: Gain +1 SL to Melee Tests opposing incoming attacks. Benefit from only one Defensive Quality at a time. Unbalanced overrides Defensive.

description:9eeda7ad9aed3231e09ea2d2.name: Fast
description:9eeda7ad9aed3231e09ea2d2.text: Add 20 to combat initiative only when attacking with this weapon. Using it for two-weapon fighting removes Fast.

description:4c439e1a5920f95dac4ad3e8.name: Hack
description:4c439e1a5920f95dac4ad3e8.text: On a hit, damage a struck armour piece or shield by 1 before resolving Damage against the wearer.

description:8204fc376a067bbcc17a5323.name: Impale
description:8204fc376a067bbcc17a5323.text: Successful combat attack rolls that are doubles or divisible by 10 cause a Critical Hit. A ranged Impale Critical leaves its ammunition embedded: arrows/bolts need successful Challenging (+0 SL) Heal to remove; bullets require a surgeon (Surgery Talent). Each unremoved arrow or bullet prevents recovery of 1 Wound.

description:a24b2183d408ee153b9c4eaa.name: Inflict (Condition)
description:a24b2183d408ee153b9c4eaa.text: A hit applies the named Condition, using any listed Strength/Difficulty. While Entangling someone, the weapon cannot be used otherwise; you may release them whenever you choose.

description:70dc216306cd476996523bd1.name: Magical
description:70dc216306cd476996523bd1.text: Can harm targets immune to non-magical attacks.

description:3b8e255250e37b9475b76259.name: Parry
description:3b8e255250e37b9475b76259.text: Defending with this weapon ignores the usual −2 SL off-hand penalty. When dual wielding, if the first attack hits, a second attack made with the Parry weapon is Unopposed.

description:6e965d3fecf870bd3e73c5ee.name: Dangerous
description:6e965d3fecf870bd3e73c5ee.text: A failed Test containing a 9 on either die causes a Fumble.

description:4c0cc897aa76615599e6f61a.name: Imprecise
description:4c0cc897aa76615599e6f61a.text: Attacks with the weapon suffer −1 SL.

description:580ce2b14832a95b71713372.name: Pistol
description:580ce2b14832a95b71713372.text: May attack in melee without range modifiers; the attack can be Opposed like a melee attack.

description:15abb08e800261b83f1f3356.name: Precise
description:15abb08e800261b83f1f3356.text: Successful attacks gain +1 SL. Imprecise overrides Precise if both would apply.

description:59d8b848bb5de1ba50f75810.name: Pummel
description:59d8b848bb5de1ba50f75810.text: A Head hit that deals Wounds equal to the target's TB gives it 1 Stunned.

description:2b9598ab0686adab9f71d326.name: Reload (Rating)
description:2b9598ab0686adab9f71d326.text: After firing, spend Rating Actions reloading before firing again. A Repeater with shots remaining needs 1 fewer reload Action.

description:257ee6571481f176bb8d5117.name: Repeater (Rating)
description:257ee6571481f176bb8d5117.text: Holds Rating shots and reloads automatically between shots. Once empty, complete the weapon's normal full reload.

description:be102001c8c83042877eccf4.name: Trap Blade
description:be102001c8c83042877eccf4.text: When defending against a bladed weapon, a Critical may trap the blade instead of causing a Critical Hit; you must be at least the opponent's Size. The opponent drops the trapped blade. With Disarm, spend the printed Advantage to catch it in a free hand. Optionally Test Very Hard (−30) Strength, adding your Melee Test's SL: success breaks the blade unless Unbreakable.

description:62d098104ffc69196acda9b9.name: Unbalanced
description:62d098104ffc69196acda9b9.text: Defending with this weapon suffers −1 SL.

description:86a3cc7cee54b128e6ce57a4.name: Unbreakable
description:86a3cc7cee54b128e6ce57a4.text: Under nearly all circumstances, resists breaking, corrosion and loss of its edge.

description:764c98be233a1983d87dc40a.name: Undamaging
description:764c98be233a1983d87dc40a.text: Double AP against the weapon. Successful combat hits have no automatic minimum 1 Wound. For any Critical Wound it causes, roll twice and use the lower result.

description:487b3bd6ffdc7a7fc9bfb364.name: Wrap
description:487b3bd6ffdc7a7fc9bfb364.text: Melee Tests opposing its attacks suffer −1 SL.

description:3679f78b92c4e41a32869dcb.name: Flexible
description:3679f78b92c4e41a32869dcb.text: May be layered under non-Flexible armour; both layers provide their benefits.

description:c59afcf75d72ee3a8ea712ab.name: Impenetrable
description:c59afcf75d72ee3a8ea712ab.text: Disregard Critical Hits generated by an odd to-hit roll, such as 11 or 33.

description:85091c49bbc6c1cac60e9392.name: Partial
description:85091c49bbc6c1cac60e9392.text: An even Hit Location roll bypasses this armour's AP.

description:273d1717923d289131bd4ff2.name: Shield
description:273d1717923d289131bd4ff2.text: When opposing with Dodge or Melee, gain +1 SL (not cumulative with Defensive) and apply shield AP if hit. A shield with at least 2 AP permits Dodge against ranged attacks at any range. Only one shield provides benefits. A strapped/slung shield protects Head, Body and off Arm only, while allowing a two-handed polearm; a buckler allows an Enc 0 weapon in the off hand. Attacking with a shield uses Improvised Weapon rules, Personal Reach and Defensive; it then stops providing shield benefits until your next turn begins.

description:4ecd05ddc294fd77f0e6e930.name: Weakpoints
description:4ecd05ddc294fd77f0e6e930.text: An Impale weapon's Critical Hit bypasses this armour's AP.

description:abc2652b1d26ba8b92aa364a.name: Animosity (Target)
description:abc2652b1d26ba8b92aa364a.text: Fellowship-based Tests with the target group have Disadvantage. On meeting them, pass Psychology or insult, denigrate or attack; after doing so, you can temporarily tolerate their presence. Fear/Terror takes precedence: you need not confront a target you fear.

description:e656823bdfb944824f135679.name: Fear (Rating)
description:e656823bdfb944824f135679.text: Against unfamiliar hostile Fear sources, make one Extended Psychology roll each Round, targeting accumulated SL equal to the highest Fear Rating present. Success overcomes every source of that Rating or lower. Known allies do not trigger the Test. While affected, gain no Momentum; the feared source's Melee Attacks against you have Advantage.

description:3a26ac2c018e6ad93eac9b2e.name: Frenzy
description:3a26ac2c018e6ad93eac9b2e.text: On your Turn, a successful Willpower Test enters Frenzy. Gain immunity to other Psychology, one extra Melee Attack as a Free Action each Round, and +1 Damage to all Melee Attacks. Move/Action may only advance the goal of reaching and attacking the nearest foe. Frenzy ends when nearby foes are bested, or you become Stunned/Unconscious; immediately gain 1 Fatigued.

description:93284ff0368e25f2ec4d6c3b.name: Hatred (Target)
description:93284ff0368e25f2ec4d6c3b.text: Social interaction with the target group is impossible. On meeting them, pass Psychology or attempt their destruction by the quickest, deadliest means. Slaying/driving them off restores control; otherwise, another Psychology Test may restrain you at each Round's end after the first. Whether controlled or not, gain +1 SL to Melee/Ranged against them and ignore their Intimidate/Fear, but not Terror.

description:347f5cc5a598d7cca5d113ac.name: Terror (Rating)
description:347f5cc5a598d7cca5d113ac.text: First encountering a non-allied Terror source requires Psychology, using the highest Rating present. Success prevents further Terror effects that encounter. Failure gives Broken equal to Rating plus 1 per negative SL beyond the first. After resolving the Test, the source also causes Fear at the same Rating.

description:b280f1bea536f5f8f0f208a3.name: Animal Care
description:b280f1bea536f5f8f0f208a3.text: At least one Advance maintains animal health in ordinary conditions without a Test. Test to diagnose illness, treat disease or heal injury; treatment details are on p. 171.

description:e8026305739070d781289b0e.name: Animal Training
description:e8026305739070d781289b0e.text: Train a particular animal type through the Animal Training Endeavour (p. 196). Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Dog, Hawk, Horse and Pigeon.

description:7dd4d2071eb59949f425b0f8.name: Art
description:7dd4d2071eb59949f425b0f8.text: Produce artwork in your chosen medium; more SL improves quality. Large/complex pieces may require an Extended Test. Listed specialisations: Drawing, Engraving, Mosaics, Painting, Sculpture, Tattooing, Weaving and Writing.

description:c3c2a71e294060f0a2ff27a7.name: Athletics
description:c3c2a71e294060f0a2ff27a7.text: Covers running, jumping and general physical movement or exertion.

description:e88d3b36dc237a04a6c79ffb.name: Bribery
description:e88d3b36dc237a04a6c79ffb.text: Locate people open to bribery, or Test to assess whether a specific person can be bribed and estimate their price.

description:76137744888f855619c99b02.name: Channelling
description:76137744888f855619c99b02.text: Gather and control Winds of Magic using the magic system (Chapter 8). Listed specialisations include Aqshy, Azyr, Chamon, Dhar, Ghur, Ghyran, Hysh, Magick, Shyish and Ulgu.

description:6b52ff908716f6185af3e06c.name: Charm
description:6b52ff908716f6185af3e06c.text: Encourage favourable consideration of you, your views or proposed actions. Success earns consideration, not automatic obedience.

description:7ce6a85ca7e1bcae15c3bb21.name: Charm Animal
description:7ce6a85ca7e1bcae15c3bb21.text: Befriend, calm or subdue an animal, including persuading it to stop threatening you or accept a distraction.

description:84a7c9d9be846bea157a3b40.name: Climb
description:84a7c9d9be846bea157a3b40.text: Ascend steep or vertical surfaces. May also be used against exceptionally large opponents; see combat movement on p. 162.

description:89ad12fb0b5f5d2d2d9d96f7.name: Consume Alcohol
description:89ad12fb0b5f5d2d2d9d96f7.text: Resist intoxication and loss of judgement/consciousness; also useful in displays of drinking endurance.

description:bc087cb382ee9f369f5c4e67.name: Cool
description:bc087cb382ee9f369f5c4e67.text: Stay composed under pressure, resist Fear, maintain resolve and oppose Charm, Intimidate or other Psychology effects (p. 183).

description:fd28133dd331b51efe650266.name: Dodge
description:fd28133dd331b51efe650266.text: Evade hazards or attacks by moving out of their path; commonly used to oppose attacks and avoid combat Damage.

description:c24525faf3171ccbcc718dee.name: Drive
description:c24525faf3171ccbcc718dee.text: Control road vehicles, including carts, coaches and unusual engineered vehicles.

description:daf3aa8f10ecc3be56b6c334.name: Endurance
description:daf3aa8f10ecc3be56b6c334.text: Withstand deprivation, prolonged effort and hostile environments. Also resists/removes Conditions (p. 184) and assists Wound recovery (p. 170).

description:97a65c162d9a6d73e5d1f3b0.name: Entertain
description:97a65c162d9a6d73e5d1f3b0.text: Perform for an audience with Acting, Comedy, Singing or Storytelling.

description:3103478df8913ab9eeb8e46e.name: Evaluate
description:3103478df8913ab9eeb8e46e.text: Appraise unusual goods, identify forgeries and detect flaws. Ordinary familiar items' approximate worth does not require this Skill.

description:75b178bdfab10d500aa3fcde.name: Gamble
description:75b178bdfab10d500aa3fcde.text: Assess wagers and play games of chance. Cheating uses the separate procedure on p. 135.

description:da734a42483441369e387d15.name: Gossip
description:da734a42483441369e387d15.text: Gather useful news or circulate rumours, typically where people gather.

description:a546b284b577a3bfb978d088.name: Haggle
description:a546b284b577a3bfb978d088.text: Negotiate a better bargain, usually through Opposed Haggle (p. 131).

description:1c89bc5609765e4ccf23596f.name: Heal
description:1c89bc5609765e4ccf23596f.text: A successful Test can identify illness, treat disease, restore Wounds or stop Bleeding. Illness, injury and treatment procedures appear on p. 172.

description:ded5956228f013645f2e0d04.name: Intimidate
description:ded5956228f013645f2e0d04.text: Pressure or frighten thinking creatures through explicit or implied threats.

description:2d24e815f6f71301e0a18ec3.name: Intuition
description:2d24e815f6f71301e0a18ec3.text: Read people and surroundings to detect lies, concealed information or signs that something is wrong.

description:5ff6809f6f0b3bb49e101113.name: Language
description:5ff6809f6f0b3bb49e101113.text: Learn a non-native language. One Advance permits communication; complex discussion may still require a Test. Four Advances grant fluency without Tests. Examples include Bretonnian, Reikspiel and Wastelander; see p. 149.

description:e5b064613ce32c427f533050.name: Leadership
description:e5b064613ce32c427f533050.text: Direct others and command respect in combat, emergencies or social hierarchies.

description:98222d84ba83d427cdf74642.name: Lore
description:98222d84ba83d427cdf74642.text: Recall knowledge in a studied or experienced subject. Routine facts need no Test; unusual/obscure information does. Listed specialisations: Engineering, Geology, Heraldry, History, Law, Local*, Magic, Metallurgy, Science and Theology.

description:ff161dec6d140e87e28aeef1.name: Melee
description:ff161dec6d140e87e28aeef1.text: Fight with a specific close-combat weapon group. Lacking the correct specialisation usually penalises use (Chapter 11). Listed groups: Basic, Brawling, Cavalry, Fencing, Flail, Parry, Polearm and Two-handed.

description:9aab627a09ea44d55865aa68.name: Navigation
description:9aab627a09ea44d55865aa68.text: Find routes across wilderness or sea using landmarks, stars, maps or charts.

description:83a2bb9fa4f78c49fe2de230.name: Outdoor Survival
description:83a2bb9fa4f78c49fe2de230.text: Live off the land: hunt, fish, forage, build shelter/fire, read approaching weather and recognise animal traces, including with few tools.

description:3f3b20a19ce9ba66c6056bc8.name: Perception
description:3f3b20a19ce9ba66c6056bc8.text: Notice things through any available sense, including magical or non-human senses.

description:88ad53bf91222e6acb09a9f5.name: Perform
description:88ad53bf91222e6acb09a9f5.text: Entertain people close enough to watch through a successful physical performance. Listed specialisations: Acrobatics, Clowning, Dancing, Firebreathing, Juggling, Miming and Rope Walking.

description:f837e3d1cb90ec54a655ee6e.name: Pick Lock
description:f837e3d1cb90ec54a655ee6e.text: Understand locking mechanisms and open them without the proper key; lock complexity varies.

description:ddf0fe6c07de90e4d5702283.name: Play
description:ddf0fe6c07de90e4d5702283.text: A successful instrumental performance entertains listeners within hearing range. Listed specialisations: Bagpipe, Lute, Harpsichord, Horn and Violin.

description:55468be80b24a07b4473e897.name: Pray
description:55468be80b24a07b4473e897.text: Communicate with or petition a deity; divine-intervention procedures use Chapter 7.

description:8285388f4f5f69eff9613a77.name: Ranged
description:8285388f4f5f69eff9613a77.text: Use a particular missile-weapon group. Missing the required specialisation incurs the weapon-use penalties in Chapter 11. Listed groups: Blackpowder, Bow, Crossbow, Engineering, Entangling, Explosives, Sling and Throwing.

description:dd9118e45a7ffd1ff40435a1.name: Research
description:dd9118e45a7ffd1ff40435a1.text: Find useful, often obscure information in libraries or similar collections. Requires Read/Write; research guidance is on p. 150.

description:f38dc9fa0f334cc827200e73.name: Ride
description:f38dc9fa0f334cc827200e73.text: Ride animals within a chosen group. Horse also covers mules, donkeys and similar mounts. Listed specialisations: Demigryph, Griffon, Horse and Pegasus. Mounted combat is on p. 168.

description:9b983f2ec77632cd276bf5b3.name: Row
description:9b983f2ec77632cd276bf5b3.text: Propel a boat with oars. Tests are normally reserved for difficult conditions, races, rapids or urgent escapes.

description:dc29444c8ba6a6ab2837ef75.name: Sail
description:dc29444c8ba6a6ab2837ef75.text: Handle a sailing vessel, including ropes, steering and wind judgement, alone or within a crew. Commanding a trained crew instead uses Leadership.

description:f929b27b3f2811a08c9ca3c0.name: Secret Signs
description:f929b27b3f2811a08c9ca3c0.text: Read and leave concealed group-specific messages or warnings. Listed specialisations: Grey Order, Guild (Any One), Ranger, Scout, Thief and Vagabond.

description:e3d341c4d37c6dffe138fb6c.name: Set Trap
description:e3d341c4d37c6dffe138fb6c.text: Prepare or disarm traps, from simple snares to complex mechanisms.

description:7b7ba89a0f78d7ab287e3421.name: Sleight of Hand
description:7b7ba89a0f78d7ab287e3421.text: Pick pockets, conceal small objects, perform hand tricks or cheat at games. Usually Opposed by the target's Perception.

description:d7aa7dafaf12a93b24344844.name: Stealth
description:d7aa7dafaf12a93b24344844.text: Avoid notice through concealment, quiet movement or blending in. Listed specialisations: Rural, Underground and Urban.

description:a5353e607c549842fdae2845.name: Swim
description:a5353e607c549842fdae2845.text: Having this Skill permits ordinary swimming without a Test. Difficult currents, racing or escaping danger require Tests.

description:bcbf7317b6b93d0c3937efe3.name: Track
description:bcbf7317b6b93d0c3937efe3.text: Find and follow another's trail, or conceal your own.

description:02d7818d3af2bf6cf3140f53.name: Trade
description:02d7818d3af2bf6cf3140f53.text: Practise a craft/service and understand its associated knowledge. Listed specialisations: Apothecary, Calligrapher, Chandler, Carpenter, Cook, Embalmer, Engineer, Herbalist, Shipwright, Smith and Tanner.

description:17230ae1e87af7cf5a266f32.name: Sea Dragon Cloak
description:17230ae1e87af7cf5a266f32.text: Worn with other armour, grants Body +2 AP with Partial. Reptilian slime maintains it; without treatment it disintegrates over one week, while fresh slime restores it. Price, Encumbrance and Availability are unspecified, so it is acquired equipment only.

description:7aa26b6bfb575e9a2d99f15c.name: Sea Dragon Cloak
description:7aa26b6bfb575e9a2d99f15c.text: Druchii Reaver Captains, Chief Mates and Corsairs may wear this over other armour for Body +2 AP with Partial. Maintain it with reptilian slime: without treatment it disintegrates over one week; applying slime restores it.

description:e5ea74453dc6885f1a96ec04.name: Reaper bolt thrower
description:e5ea74453dc6885f1a96ec04.text: Sea of Claws p. 100 Ballista profile, with Salvo (6).

description:7321ef48474c9269c70936d7.name: Ravenship
description:7321ef48474c9269c70936d7.text:
| Ship name | Crew | Sail M (C) | Oar M (C) | Man | Size | T | W | Carries | Traits and Upgrades |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ravenship | 65 | 10 (18) | 4 (30) | +1 SL | 50 | 75 | 180 | 350 | Armoured, Flying Jib |

description:e5ac3576c825938f826df72f.name: Arnzipal’s Black Horror
description:e5ac3576c825938f826df72f.text: Everyone in the area must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Strength or suffer 3 Wounds. A Fumble requires spending a Fate Point to avoid being dragged into the Aethyr and killed. Each Turn, the vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards randomly; use Winds of Magic pp. 20–21 if available, or another random direction method.

description:38359bd069669e702af20fab.name: Doombolt
description:38359bd069669e702af20fab.text: A Damage +8 magic missile. An optional Hard (−2 SL) Language (Magick) Test adds +4 Damage on success; failure instead triggers a Major Miscast roll.

description:9857a54272253b0fcb1aed60.name: Shroud of Despair
description:9857a54272253b0fcb1aed60.text: Targets in the area gain 1 Fatigued Condition per casting SL. Each must also pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain a Broken Condition.

description:638df284dc2272e70ef581f0.name: Word of Pain
description:638df284dc2272e70ef581f0.text: Each target in the area Tests Difficult (−1 SL) Cool, subtracting the casting SL from their result. On failure, reduce their Melee and Ranged Test results by that same SL.

description:8a0721d0c2f206346ed32edd.name: Reaper
description:8a0721d0c2f206346ed32edd.text: Use Sea of Claws p. 100’s naval Ballista with Salvo (6), following Corsairs p. 10. Acquired/reference equipment only; no retail price is supplied.

description:3c4ddeefb2ddcd9d24ed496b.name: Ranald
description:3c4ddeefb2ddcd9d24ed496b.text: Each of Ranald’s four aspects grants Charisma, Conscience, Finesse, Fortune, Protection and Wit. Aspect priests use their separate Miracle lists (pp. 18–19, 24–25). General priests may also learn Bamboozle, Perfect Empathy, Talk Your Way Out and Unremembered Face (p. 13).

description:a7c2d9d77988405d03fe8ef3.name: Thief
description:a7c2d9d77988405d03fe8ef3.text: Fifth Edition Thief already replaces Strike to Stun with Fast Hands; this option grants no additional Talent or slot.

description:40a4c2ce7698b492ca4bdc2f.name: Ranald
description:40a4c2ce7698b492ca4bdc2f.text: Each of Ranald’s four aspects grants Charisma, Conscience, Finesse, Fortune, Protection and Wit. Aspect priests use their separate Miracle lists (pp. 18–19, 24–25). General priests may also learn Bamboozle, Perfect Empathy, Talk Your Way Out and Unremembered Face (p. 13).

description:74f9a09a7c53de28b387ec3e.name: Bag of Tarrabeth Seed
description:74f9a09a7c53de28b387ec3e.text: Leave the bag on your trail to distract tracking dogs. Each dog within 5 yards makes an Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test. Failure delays pursuit for D10 rounds; Astounding Failure (−6 SL or less) makes it abandon the original trail.

description:58a5587f34b6b0b90e82ee4e.name: Bag of Soot
description:58a5587f34b6b0b90e82ee4e.text: Coat clothes, gear and exposed skin with soot to darken and dull them. In darkness, sight-based Perception Tests to spot you or identify your appearance suffer −1 SL.

description:d7907aeeed64332763cc61d3.name: Caltrops (12)
description:d7907aeeed64332763cc61d3.text: Spend an Action to scatter 12 caltrops across a 2-yard-diameter area. Entering requires a Hard (−2 SL) Athletics Test, or Average (+2 SL) if aware of them and walking. Failure causes a Damage D10 hit to a random leg and one Surprised Condition.

description:7a95f2760fc11fecd65dcb4f.name: Crampons (2)
description:7a95f2760fc11fecd65dcb4f.text: While worn: Climb Tests gain +2 SL on rock or wood and +1 SL on rope. Outside climbing, Athletics and Agility Tests suffer −1 SL; Stealth and all other movement Tests suffer −2 SL.

description:bd03f6d1f5eb8fdad781ee0e.name: Glass Cutter
description:bd03f6d1f5eb8fdad781ee0e.text: Cut or bore glass with an Average (+2 SL) Art (Engraving) Test. Results (p. 33): +1 or more cuts safely; +0 cuts with normal breaking-glass noise; −0 bores a hole but deals Damage 3 to the primary hand; −1 or less shatters the pane noisily and deals Damage 3 to that hand.

description:5dd43545050a2fe62317f7b5.name: Periscope
description:5dd43545050a2fe62317f7b5.text: Make sight-based Perception Tests around corners or over obstacles while your body stays hidden or in cover.

description:beb0151b6ebd42b05eb6e9d5.name: Smoke Bomb
description:beb0151b6ebd42b05eb6e9d5.text: Throw as an incendiary. Smoke fills a large room or an outdoor area 10 yards across for 2D10 Rounds, doubled indoors. You cannot see through it; visibility inside is 1 yard. The air is unbreathable: characters inside test for Suffocation under Fourth Edition core p. 181.

description:dff541151e5a1ce3b7c5e0e6.name: Thin Jimmy
description:dff541151e5a1ce3b7c5e0e6.text: Open a bolted door or a door with a keyed lock, excluding padlocks, with a Hard (−2 SL) Sleight of Hand Test. Results (p. 33): +1 or more opens it without damage and permits relocking; +0 opens it but visibly breaks the mechanism or bolt; −0 leaves it shut; −1 or less also makes scraping audible in adjoining rooms.

description:ce90469d6f40bd8b27878b30.name: Telescopic Pole
description:ce90469d6f40bd8b27878b30.text: Extends from a hooked cane to twelve feet. Use Dexterity to manipulate objects within 4 yards, with −2 SL on every Test using the pole.

description:032de98f061c953a1062015e.name: Hunter’s Garb
description:032de98f061c953a1062015e.text: Grants +2 SL to Stealth Tests in the terrain its camouflage matches.

description:7ca37d69b35822f0e456a98f.name: Hochland Lockhund
description:7ca37d69b35822f0e456a98f.text: Hunting animal listed in the Animals and Equipment table. Profiles and training are on pp. 133–134.

description:7595cf384abbf85681699b93.text: Hunting animal listed in the Animals and Equipment table. Profiles and training are on pp. 133–134.

description:8d27ad3774ce6e811a6c059a.name: Grootscher Marsh Hound
description:8d27ad3774ce6e811a6c059a.text: Hunting animal listed in the Animals and Equipment table. Profiles and training are on pp. 133–134.

description:d1d31e873ce8067353f94625.name: Dove Hawk
description:d1d31e873ce8067353f94625.text: Hunting animal listed in the Animals and Equipment table. Profiles and training are on pp. 133–134.

description:463f69e9d85288d34a305edf.name: Arabyan Redhawk
description:463f69e9d85288d34a305edf.text: Hunting animal listed in the Animals and Equipment table. Profiles and training are on pp. 133–134.

description:a7bde24ed490432494cfa150.name: Pickpocket Success Table
description:a7bde24ed490432494cfa150.text:
| Pickpocket’s SL | Result |
| --- | --- |
| +1 or more | Take the item without the victim noticing. |
| Success but no SL | Take the item; within D10 Rounds the victim notices and publicly calls out the theft. |
| Fail but no SL | Take nothing; the victim does not notice the attempt. |
| -1 or less | Take nothing; the victim notices the attempt. |

description:7cfcbe69b8b2e707864a89e2.name: Incriminating Artefact
description:7cfcbe69b8b2e707864a89e2.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Chunk of Warpstone: Lead-lined case; Moderate Corrupting Influence, worth 3 GC. |
| 3 to 4 | Silver Badge: Proscribed cult or god symbol, potentially illegal to possess; worth 6/8 to a suitable buyer. |
| 5 | Seditionary Tract: Revolutionary political pamphlet. |
| 6 | Mysterious Document: A ciphered secret, potentially spy notes or a murder contract. |
| 7 to 9 | Laughing Powder: D10 doses of Ranald's Delight (WFRP page 306), worth 18/– each. |
| 10 to 12 | Hot Item: Stolen or dishonestly obtained sapphire ring, worth 5/–. |
| 13 to 15 | Silver Badge: Violent gang insignia, worth 6/8; displaying it may provoke fear or hatred. |
| 16 to 17 | Bone Relic: Possible trophy or necromantic component. |
| 18 | Mysterious Vial: Unidentified liquid, possibly spirits or a potion (Winds of Magic page 154). |
| 19 | Wayshard: Gem holding dead Elven essence, useful for navigation. Elves distrust outsiders holding one but may reward its return. |
| 20 | Vial of Black Lotus: 2 Blade Venom doses (WFRP page 306). |

description:191592a3280e41d46e48aab5.name: The Contents Of A Purse
description:191592a3280e41d46e48aab5.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Something Incriminating: Roll Incriminating Artefact for a valuable but dangerous possession. |
| 3 to 4 | Moths: Empty purse. |
| 5 to 6 | Out of Pocket: One coin of the victim’s Status denomination. |
| 7 | Set of Bone Dice: Worth 10d. |
| 8 to 9 | Taffeta Handkerchief: Worth 1/–; D10 of 5 or more makes it monogrammed. |
| 10 to 12 | Payday: Twice the victim’s normal money. |
| 13 | Silver Ring with Griffon Decoration: Worth 3/–. |
| 14 | Silk Handerkerchief: Worth 3/6; D10 of 5 or more makes it monogrammed. |
| 15 | Leather Gloves: Worth 4/–. |
| 16 | Ruby Ring: Silver ring with red gem, worth 5/–. |
| 17 | Silver Hammer Badge: Sigmarite badge worth 6/8. |
| 18 | Big Spender: Coins equal to twice the owner’s Status, plus d10 more coins. |
| 19 | Bottle of Perfume: Silver-stoppered bottle worth 10/–. |
| 20 | String of Miraglianese Pearls: Tilean pearl necklace worth 10/–. |

description:711a437daffdea87dd7b0010.name: Victim Quirk Table
description:711a437daffdea87dd7b0010.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Already Acquainted: The GM determines prior familiarity. Hard (-20) Perception notices recognition. |
| 3 | Uncanny Ability: A supernatural ability complicates theft, such as Psychometry (Winds of Magic page 47), divination or spellcasting. |
| 4 | Friends in Low Places: Criminal contacts or protectors may retaliate for the theft. |
| 5 | Amputated Part: Lost or unusable part; d10: 1–3 Leg, 4–6 Arm, 7–8 Eyes, 9 Tongue, 10 Ears. |
| 6 | Dummy Purse: Contains two pennies; larger coins are concealed elsewhere. On an additional D10 of 1, it contains a poisoned needle: taking it causes Poisoned unless Challenging (+0) Perception succeeds. |
| 7 | Unsuspecting: Perception suffers -1 SL. |
| 8 | Intoxicated: Roll Stinking Drunk (WFRP page 121) or apply Weirdroot (page 306). |
| 9 | Veteran: Add Elite (WFRP page 339). |
| 10 | Tough Customer: Add Brute (WFRP page 338). |
| 11 | Cautious: Give one Fortune Point usable to reroll one Test preventing a crime against them. |
| 12 | Quick Witted: Add Clever (WFRP page 338). |
| 13 | Feeling Peaky: Has early Itching Pox (WFRP page 187); Average (+20) Perception notices blisters before close approach. |
| 14 | Future Patron: May later offer employment, crucial help or information. |
| 15 | This One’s Jittery: Perception gains +1 SL. |
| 16 | Cutpurse: Also a thief and may steal from the pickpocket. |
| 17 | Friends in High Places: Powerful connections can make them useful to exploit but also support retaliation. |
| 18 | Vengeful: Devotes substantial resources to identifying and punishing thieves; this may be the default for Dwarfs. |
| 19 | Diseased: Has early Black Plague (WFRP page 186) and fleas. Challenging (+0) Perception notices symptoms before approach, avoiding a contraction Test. |
| 20 | Mutant: A concealed mutation may become apparent during theft. D10 (WFRP page 184): 1–2 Animalistic Legs, 3–4 Corpulent, 5–6 Emaciated, 7–8 Extra Leg Joints, 9–10 Patchy Feathers. |

description:a369a7e7487b92b305798ce2.name: Endeavour Complications
description:a369a7e7487b92b305798ce2.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Ranaldans Take Note: Local Ranaldans may become allies if their code is respected, or deceive and prank you if offended. |
| 2 | Drawing the Heat: Verenan investigators may pursue you; otherwise apply Under Suspicion before determining other events next downtime. |
| 3 – 4 | Barred: The GM chooses at least one shop or lodging that refuses entry because of your theft reputation; clustered venues may ban you together. |
| 5 – 6 | Lucky Find: Receive normal income and roll Contents of a Purse once (page 28). |
| 7 – 8 | A Favour Owed: Someone knowing your crimes may demand a Minor Favour for silence. |
| 9 | Kingpin Takes Notice: A crime lord demands your service under threat (Organised Crime, page 57). |
| 10 | Rich Pickings: Receive normal income and roll Contents of a Purse twice (page 28). |

description:31da40a415eb58854f7f2694.name: The Income Endeavour
description:31da40a415eb58854f7f2694.text: Thief, Pickpocket and Burglar Characters taking Income may either receive normal money only, or also roll the accompanying Endeavour Complications table.

description:ece9936caab6d212f04ddc92.name: Tools Of The Trade
description:ece9936caab6d212f04ddc92.text:
Trade Tools (Thief) typically include Chisel, Hammer, Lock Picks, Tweezers and key-impression Wax. The specialised items below are separate purchases. Prices and Availability are approximate; discreet custom manufacture can increase cost and scarcity, while open purchase may invite suspicion.

| Item | Cost | Enc | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bag of Tarrabeth Seed | –/6 | 0 | Scarce |
| Bag of Soot | –/2 | 0 | Common |
| Caltrops (12) | 2/– | 0 | Rare |
| Crampons (2) | 1 GC | 1 | Exotic |
| Glass Cutter | 1 GC | 0 | Exotic |
| Periscope | 2 GC | 1 | Exotic |
| Smoke Bomb | 1 GC | 0 | Exotic |
| Telescopic Pole | 3 GC | 1 | Exotic |
| Thin Jimmy | 2 GC | 0 | Exotic |

description:174e5547a1c4635a11fd736e.name: Glass Cutting Success Table
description:174e5547a1c4635a11fd736e.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +1 or more | Open a hole or small glass section without complications. |
| +0 | Open a hole or small section, audible as a normally broken window. |
| -0 | Open a hole or small section; take a Damage 3 hit to the primary hand. |
| -1 or less | Shatter the window with normal breaking noise; take a Damage 3 hit to the primary hand. |

description:0df50887183ca131befbb1b8.name: Steel Mummit Success Table
description:0df50887183ca131befbb1b8.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +1 or more | Open the lock without damaging it or the bolt; it can be relocked. |
| +0 | Open but ruin the mechanism or bolt; users notice repairs are needed. |
| -0 | Do not open the lock. |
| -1 or less | Do not open the lock; loud scraping is audible from adjacent rooms. |

description:dd2e0b6405d3387d0e082bf1.name: Crypt Complications
description:dd2e0b6405d3387d0e082bf1.text:
| 2D10 | You Unearth… |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Stake: An ash stake impales the corpse. Very Easy (+60) Lore (Undead) identifies its anti-Vampire purpose; the GM determines removal consequences. |
| 3 | Papers: No corpse; documents may reveal GM-chosen secrets or misconduct. |
| 4 – 6 | Mass Grave: Test for Black Plague exposure (WFRP page 186). |
| 7 – 9 | Fine Clothing: Jacket worth 9/- and clothes worth 5/-. |
| 10 – 12 | Pennies: Two burial pennies. Taking them may disturb the spirit and is considered abhorrent. |
| 13 – 15 | Rich Grave Goods: Coat worth 1 GC, fine clothes worth 10/-, gold rings worth 4 GC. |
| 16 – 18 | Ghouls: Disturb two feeding Ghouls; no valuables remain. |
| 19 | Sumptuous Grave Goods: Robes worth 4 GC, clothing worth 2 GC and jewellery worth 10 GC. |
| 20 | Notable Person: As Sumptuous Grave Goods; Hard (-20) Lore (Heraldry) identifies a notable local who recently vanished. |
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Presumptive Interment: The buried person is alive, incapacitated by stupor or catalepsy, and may react ambivalently to rescue by a corpse thief. |
| 3 | Stirring Cadaver: Corruption or a nearby magical miscast may animate it as a Zombie. |
| 4 – 7 | Suffuse with Shyish: Second Sight sees Shyish around it. Successful Lore of Death casting within 8 yards gains +1 SL; this bonus applies once regardless of nearby sources. |
| 8 – 14 | Familiar Face: Anyone who knew the person readily recognises the well-preserved corpse. |
| 15 – 17 | Bloated Corpse: Rapid decomposition makes it unsuitable for customers wanting fresh bodies. |
| 18 – 19 | Ransacked Remains: Internal organs are missing; unsuitable if the buyer requires them. |
| 20 | Stirring Spirit: The dead person may haunt you as a Ghost until the body receives respectful burial. |

description:51de86525bf07e3d0d4dae29.name: Endeavour Complications
description:51de86525bf07e3d0d4dae29.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Haunted: Until next downtime, encountered Ethereal Undead also gain Hatred (Your Character). |
| 2 | Shyish: Second Sight perceives Shyish around you until next downtime; it gives no casting effect. |
| 3 – 4 | Creepy Customer: A discreet prospective employer contacts you; the GM secretly rolls Creepy Customer. All Grave Robber clients demand secrecy. |
| 5 – 6 | Lucky Find: Receive normal income and roll Crypt Complications once (page 35), applying loot only. |
| 7 – 8 | A Favour Owed: Someone knowing your crimes may demand a Major Favour for silence. |
| 9 | Bad Dreams: Until next downtime, the GM may require Challenging (+0) Cool once every other week; failure causes Fatigued. |
| 10 | Rich Pickings: Receive normal income and roll Crypt Complications twice (page 35), applying loot only. |

description:b5568ee11f3397597ce6c578.name: The Income Endeavour
description:b5568ee11f3397597ce6c578.text: Grave Robbers taking Income may receive normal money alone or also roll the accompanying Endeavour Complications table.

description:a3ec4b08e1d4804542622139.name: Creepy Customer Table
description:a3ec4b08e1d4804542622139.text:
| 2D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Necrarch Vampire: A powerful necromantic Vampire approaches through a servant. |
| 3 – 4 | Cannibal Fiend: A potential Ghoul or someone feeding Ghouls. |
| 5 – 6 | Necromancer: Needs corpses for magical practice. |
| 7 – 9 | Intriguer: Wants a body for political manipulation or a false murder charge. |
| 10 – 12 | Corrupt Physician: Buys only fresh undamaged bodies for anatomical study. |
| 13 – 15 | Dubious Scholar: An academic studying anatomy. |
| 16 – 17 | Fugitive: Needs a body to fake a death for themselves, family or client. |
| 18 – 19 | Mad Mage: Possibly an Amethyst Wizard gathering Shyish, a Gold Wizard collecting alchemical parts or a Witch seeking ritual ingredients. |
| 20 | Daemonologist: Uses body parts for lesser daemonic bargains despite preferring living sacrifices. |

description:342b999d52920199c90e1788.name: Endeavour Complications
description:342b999d52920199c90e1788.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Refunds Sought: Pass Difficult (-10) Haggle or lose half your earnings. |
| 2 | Unsafe House: The Watch considers raiding your storage or sales venue. Unless resolved, apply Under Suspicion before other events next downtime. |
| 3 – 4 | Hot Item: Former owners hunt an item you handled; the GM decides whether their search affects future adventures. |
| 5 – 6 | Rumour: The GM supplies an opportunity or scam rumour, possibly using page 40’s Underworld Rumours. |
| 7 – 8 | Contraband: Optionally buy Drugs and Poisons (WFRP page 306) at one-quarter normal price; Spit costing 1 GC 5/– becomes 12/6. |
| 9 | Hidden Finds: Receive normal income and roll Contents of a Purse twice (page 28) for concealed valuables. |
| 10 | Cursed Item: Handling a malign artefact exposes you to a Moderate corrupting influence. |

description:c80be9d75efa6a2a90631553.name: The Income Endeavour
description:c80be9d75efa6a2a90631553.text: Bawd, Charlatan and Fence Characters taking Income may receive money normally or roll the accompanying complications. Most outcomes preserve earnings, but some reduce them.

description:8549b40158fd7395d0ca5ce5.name: Endeavour Complications
description:8549b40158fd7395d0ca5ce5.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Major Favour Owed: An indiscretion leaves you owing the affected person a Major Favour. |
| 2 | Blackmail: A letter demands 2 Gold Crowns by next downtime to conceal compromising information. The GM determines its credibility, payment and investigation. |
| 3 – 4 | Friend in a Low Place: Help a criminal Fence sell contraband by next downtime for a possible profit share. |
| 5 – 6 | Rumour: The GM supplies a new opportunity or untried local scam, with examples on page 40. |
| 7 – 8 | A Favour Owed: An offended customer may demand a Major Favour. |
| 9 | Contact: Contact Endeavour Tests gain +1 SL this downtime. |
| 10 | Friend in a High Place: Successfully hosting an important visitor’s underworld excursion establishes a friendly acquaintance. |
