description:3f28648099478d26cdedd025.name: Black Market
description:3f28648099478d26cdedd025.text: For illicit purchases, make Challenging (+0) Haggle. Success locates the item at a price increased by twice its usual value. Fences and Bawds may instead sell illicit goods: Challenging (+0) Haggle yields half standard value, increased by 10% for every additional 2 SL.

description:ebcaf3d1ae41784ac8ce9b77.name: Criminal Endeavours
description:ebcaf3d1ae41784ac8ce9b77.text: Any Character may take these between-adventure Endeavours to prepare resources for theft or assassination.

description:38f8ffeb13bc2f651c4d4aae.name: Gambling Den
description:38f8ffeb13bc2f651c4d4aae.text: Cannot follow Banking. Choose a gambling activity and stake, then make Hard (-20) Gamble. Success returns the stake plus one stake per +SL. Failure loses the stake and incurs a further stake of debt per -SL.

description:e3c9b63481a3db07571bae63.name: Plant Identities
description:e3c9b63481a3db07571bae63.text: Choose and spend time establishing a false identity. If its Status exceeds yours, pay your full Income Endeavour earnings per Status level. Pass Difficult (-10) Entertain (Acting) to gain +2 SL to Charm and Performance as that identity during the next adventure. If you lack Secret Identity, also count as having it next adventure, provided that adventure occurs in the region where the identity was established. Impersonating a famous person should make the Test substantially harder.

description:cec5e95f12bc828bd21c4ddb.name: Whisper Campaign
description:cec5e95f12bc828bd21c4ddb.text: Choose a rumour and target, then make Hard (-20) Charm. Success spreads the rumour locally, raising or lowering the target’s Status by one level for a week. Each additional +2 SL lets you add a detail. Each -2 SL of failure makes people believe the opposite, potentially raising a target’s Status when you intended to lower it. Impressive Failure or worse also gives you a reputation for gossip.

description:e91a0efc171d371806fee922.name: New Endeavour: Establishing A Contact
description:e91a0efc171d371806fee922.text: Between adventures, use this Endeavour to establish a Contact in consultation with the GM.

description:b789e720d59d2456130b9ceb.name: Contact Quality Table
description:b789e720d59d2456130b9ceb.text:
| D10 | Quality of Service | Quality of Relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Dreadful: Unreliable information, fragile tools, poor sales, uncomfortable or insecure hiding places and possible arrest. A defined profile suffers -2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 25. | Chilly: Serves grudgingly and will identify you under interrogation to protect themselves. |
| 2 – 3 | Poor: Mostly accurate but incomplete information and mediocre equipment; forgeries withstand casual inspection only. The Watch may be suspicious. A defined profile suffers -2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 35. | Iffy: Generally useful but occasionally unreliable, without personal affection. |
| 4 – 7 | Fair: Broadly accurate information, decent fencing prices and forgeries surviving ordinary inspection. | Average: Dependable but unwilling to take personal risks for you. |
| 8 – 9 | Superior: Comprehensive information, premium fencing prices and forgeries surviving close inspection. A defined profile gains +1 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 55. | Good: Friendly and may volunteer help. |
| 10 | Awesome: Accurate information including unsolicited relevant details, superior equipment and secure comfortable hiding places. A defined profile gains +2 SL to Tests; otherwise Test at 65. | Solid: Always tries to help and never betrays you willingly. |

The GM rolls or selects service and relationship qualities appropriate to the Contact. Each additional Establish a Contact Endeavour improves Relationship one row, such as Iffy to Average.

description:02c9f6317e99d22c41900c22.name: Contact Development Table
description:02c9f6317e99d22c41900c22.text:
The GM checks each Contact every three months and each downtime. Proactive support may allow the GM to ignore negative results.

| D100 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 01 – 33 | Things are Quiet: No significant change. |
| 34 – 39 | Lying Low: Leaves their residence to evade rivals or authorities; likely remains in the same city or province but must be located. |
| 34 – 39 | Complacency: Reduce Quality of Service by 1 level. |
| 40 – 44 | Gang Takeover: Pressured into a gang, rival gang or splinter faction; may recommend you as associates depending on Relationship. |
| 45 – 48 | Dubious Customer: Takes a GM-chosen objectionable client, potentially a rival criminal, extremist, dark magician or hostile Species. |
| 49 – 54 | Hard Times: May ask you for a loan. |
| 55 – 59 | Sick: Contracts Itching Pox and may remain contagious for d10 weeks. |
| 60 – 64 | Corrupting Influence: Exposed to a moderate Corruption source. |
| 65 – 69 | Stake Out: The Watch or a rival gang monitors them; meeting has a 33% chance of detection. |
| 70 – 73 | Religious Conversion: Remains a rogue but adopts a changed criminal philosophy, potentially Ranaldan, revolutionary or darker. |
| 74 – 78 | Out of Sight…: Without contact since the last roll, Relationship worsens one step, such as Good to Average. |
| 79 – 83 | Jailed: Imprisoned for 2d10 months. |
| 84 – 89 | On a Learning Curve: Improve Quality of Service one row, such as Fair to Superior. |
| 90 – 93 | Pastures New: Moves to another settlement; may leave directions with Secret Signs or acquaintances, or vanish. |
| 94 – 97 | Going Straight: Seeks lawful work. A Good relationship may persuade them to help, but requires convincing. |
| 98 – 00 | Embroiled in Violence: Suffers a random Critical Injury in an assault; may die. |

description:b99760cfd87db3c121d8e33c.name: New Endeavours
description:b99760cfd87db3c121d8e33c.text: A gang boss must be in the gang’s location to take Build Gang, Organising Crime or Maintain Influence. Moving to a different city requires establishing a new criminal organisation.

description:aa0c0b634203cf199834cb99.name: Criminal Enterprises
description:aa0c0b634203cf199834cb99.text:
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Organisation Level | Cost to Grow | Muscle | Resources | Influence | Legal Trouble |
| 1 | 10/– | 2 Racketeers | 2/– | Clerk, Guild Journeyman | Watchman |
| 2 | 1 GC | D10 Racketeers | 4/– | Junior Official, Guildsman | Watch Sergeant |
| 3 | 10 GC | 2D10 Racketeers | 1 GC | City Official, Guild Master | Watch Captain |
| 4 | 100 GC | 4D10 Racketeers | 4 GC | Senior Official, Guild Chairman | Judge |

description:ebd0af8a793d3c49e4bb33fe.name: Criminal Enterprise Perks
description:ebd0af8a793d3c49e4bb33fe.text:
|  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Organisation Level | Facilitate Links to Contacts: | News and Rumours | Will Help Fence: | Provide Lawyers for Memebers Accused of: |
| 1 | Bawd, Racketeer | Plans of Public Areas | Goods of a value of up to 10 GC per Month | Trivial and Moderate Crimes |
| 2 | Bawd, Charlatan, Fence, Racketeer | Schedules of Watch Patrols | Goods of a value of up to 20 GC per Month | Trivial and Moderate Crimes |
| 3 | Bawd, Charlatan, Fence, Forger, Racketeer | Plans of Sewers and Notable Buildings | Goods of a value of up to 40 GC per Month | Trivial, Moderate and Serious Crimes |
| 4 | All Contacts | Copied Keys, Friendly Insiders | Goods of a value of up to 80 GC per Month | All Crimes |

description:ef7bc2480f6ab8c3caa70ebe.name: Watch Presence
description:ef7bc2480f6ab8c3caa70ebe.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 – 2 | Attention Elsewhere: No nearby Watch; a raised alarm takes at least 20 minutes to bring a patrol. |
| 3 – 5 | Round the Block: Patrol a few streets away; alarm response takes at least 20 Rounds. |
| 6 – 8 | Patrol in the Vicinity: Within 100 yards. Public crimes may be spotted with Opposed Very Hard (-30) Perception/Stealth; alarm response takes 10 Rounds. |
| 9 | Patrol Nearby: Within 50 yards. Public crimes may be spotted with Opposed Difficult (-10) Perception/Stealth; alarm response takes 5 Rounds. |
| 10 | Patrol Present: On the street or immediately outside. Visible crimes may be spotted with Opposed Average (+20) Perception/Stealth; alarms receive immediate response. |

description:37cdd9f103bc685df01dc326.name: Endeavours in Gaol
description:37cdd9f103bc685df01dc326.text: In gaol, Change Career permits only Agitator, Charlatan, Fence, Forger, Racketeer, Protagonist, Thief or Smuggler. Training permits only their Skills; Unusual Learning permits only their Talents. Pay tutors with a Major Favour instead of money. Study a Mark works normally, representing information obtained from prisoners.

description:abe6a410ef67d469b64d2ab0.name: Bribery Skill Test Table
description:abe6a410ef67d469b64d2ab0.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +1 or more | Learn the target’s Integrity and Price. |
| +0 | Learn the target’s Integrity only. |
| -0 | Learn nothing about willingness to accept. |
| -1 or less | Learn nothing; the target realises you are attempting bribery. |

description:b96eae9f16e6f93d8cb09a08.name: New Endeavour: Gaol Break
description:b96eae9f16e6f93d8cb09a08.text: GM permission required; some prisons cannot be escaped. One Character attempts it; assistants spend their own Endeavours. Use Stealth or Sleight of Hand: watch-post cell, Challenging (+0); Moderate Crimes, Extended Challenging (+0), 5 SL; Serious Crimes, Extended Difficult (-10), 7 SL; Heinous Crimes, Extended Hard (-20), 10 SL. Complete within five Rounds to free the prisoner. Failure may merely end the attempt; Impressive Failure or worse may cause assistants’ arrest. On discovery, the escapee is declared an Outlaw; recognised assistants may also be outlawed.

description:0bf8a3262df191de265f0acb.name: Willingness To Take A Bribe
description:0bf8a3262df191de265f0acb.text:
| D10 | Integrity | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 – 2 | Incorruptable | Does not take bribes |
| 3 – 8 | Pliable | Trivial: Status Moderate: Status times 3 Serious: Status times 5 Henious: Will not take bribes |
| 9 – 10 | Venal | Trivial: Status Moderate: Status times 2 Serious: Status times 4 Henious: Status times 10 |

Examples: Pliable Silver 1 accepting a Trivial theft bribe may charge 1D10 Shillings. Venal Silver 3 overlooking Serious damage may charge 3D10 × 4 = 12D10 Shillings.

description:209761af3b63f4f5f43585d3.name: Outlaw Income Endeavour Complications
description:209761af3b63f4f5f43585d3.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Bandit Casualty: A fellow Outlaw is hurt or killed. No effect for Brigands or Outlaws; an Outlaw Chief or Bandit King instead has a henchman hurt, captured or killed. |
| 2 | Dangerous Neighbours: A hostile patrol approaches camp; resolve it or relocate before further Income Endeavours. |
| 3 – 4 | Fugitive in the Woods: Receive Income but spend all remaining downtime hiding; no other Endeavours this period. |
| 5 – 6 | Lucky Find: Normal income plus one Contents of a Purse roll (page 28). |
| 7 – 8 | Bandit King Takes Notice: A local Bandit King demands favours or money and may attack unauthorised gangs if unpaid. |
| 9 | Bounty Hunter: Confront a hunter seeking you dead or alive before next downtime. The GM may include them in the next adventure or resolve a solo encounter before downtime events. |
| 10 | Stand and Deliver: Normal income plus two Contents of a Purse rolls (page 28). |

description:8475b2056379df9749f1b532.name: The Income Endeavour
description:8475b2056379df9749f1b532.text: Outlaws taking Income may receive normal money only, or also roll the accompanying complications for consequences of banditry.

description:f83eb0c0374a03a337a2e38f.name: Outlaw Traits
description:f83eb0c0374a03a337a2e38f.text:
| d10 | Personality | Motive | Crime |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Furtive: Reserved, private and solitary. | Basic Survival: Shelter, food and refuge from law. | Contempt of Court: Missed trial; reroll for the original offence. |
| 2 | Idealistic: Outspoken but impractical. | Wealth: Acquire saleable valuables. | Tax Evasion: Unpaid noble or municipal taxes. |
| 3 | Charming: Sociable to obtain favours. | Excitement: Danger, pursuit and escape. | Debt Evasion: Unpaid bank, business or lender debts. |
| 4 | Conniving: Schemes against fellow bandits. | Freedom: Travel without obligations. | Theft: Robbery over 50 GC or repeated minor theft. |
| 5 | Resourceful: Practical solutions and outside contacts. | Camaraderie: Escape loneliness through companionship. | Murder: Deliberate killing; repeats mean multiple murders. |
| 6 | Loyal: Reports misconduct; potential lieutenant. | Wantonness: Drink, drugs, vandalism or sexual indulgence. | Arson: Building fires; repeats mean serial arson. |
| 7 | Paranoid: Constantly distrustful and armed. | Notoriety: Become locally or regionally infamous. | Major Blasphemy: Speech or acts provoking divine wrath. |
| 8 | Selfish: Unreliable, disobedient and disputes shares. | Vindication: Obtain pardon or punish accusers and authorities. | Heresy: Public falsehood about gods or clergy for personal gain. |
| 9 | Uncouth: Offensive behaviour causes civilian trouble. | Aspirant Chief: Replace the chief or found a band. | Perversion: Corrupt acts such as bodysnatching, abduction or cannibalism. |
| 10 | Violent: Easily angered and excessively forceful. | Dark Secret: Concealed mutant, witch, heretic, necromancer or sorcerer. | Mark of Chaos: Physical mutation or signs of witchcraft. |

description:b721c685d5d414d3c91be485.name: Outlaw Chief Traits
description:b721c685d5d414d3c91be485.text:
| d10 | Reputation | Goal | Outlaw Band |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cautious: Avoids well-armed targets and plans thoroughly. | Retirement: Earn enough to quit crime. | Petty Hooligans: Inexperienced and easily scattered. |
| 2 | Daring: Takes daylight risks against difficult targets. | Avoid Capture: Evade law; die rather than surrender. | Squabbling Crooks: Internal disputes undermine cohesion. |
| 3 | Elusive: Concealed mobile camps and easy escapes. | Grand Larceny: Undertake only major thefts. | Sneaky Brigands: Ambushes, decoys and secret signs. |
| 4 | Connected: Noble protection grants legal immunity. | Organised Crime: Develop smuggling, extortion or fraud. | Jolly Companions: Close friends enjoying camaraderie. |
| 5 | Popular: Supported by bandits, peasants or officials. | Political Resistance: Oppose nobles and incite revolt. | Fearsome Raiders: Burn farms, loot and seize hostages. |
| 6 | Extravagant: Spends loot on luxury and celebrations. | Build Camp: Expand a fortified forest settlement. | Gentleman Robbers: Nonviolent theft from wealthy travellers. |
| 7 | Reckless: Leaves evidence and exposes followers to arrest. | Legendary Status: Establish a lasting reputation. | Shady Hoodlums: Survey victims around taverns. |
| 8 | Disciplined: Strict rules and careful loot control. | Rule Fiefdom: Replace a Bandit King or claim territory. | Crafty Swindlers: False identities and confidence tricks. |
| 9 | Ruthless: Murders and executes followers as examples. | Spread Mayhem: Enjoy victims’ fear and disrupted peace. | Roving Marauders: Rob travellers throughout the wilderness. |
| 10 | Dark Bargain: Sorcery or Chaos deals; the band is a cult. | Dark Purpose: Seek divine favour or necromantic immortality. | Hardened Cutthroats: Murder witnesses. |

description:94bde70ea4d76e38d0c98b0b.name: Bounty Hunter Warrants
description:94bde70ea4d76e38d0c98b0b.text:
| d10 | Warrant Agent | Outlaw Crimes | Reward Conditions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Town Bailiff: Directs the watch and answers to the issuing noble. | Fraudster: Usually low danger but difficult identification. | Interrogation; alive; 5 GC. |
| 2 | Verenan Judge: Personally issues warrants and hires reputable hunters. | Murderer: Dangerous and difficult to capture alive. | Public example; dead or alive; 5 GC. |
| 3 | Town Magistrate: Council member issuing the warrant personally. | Robber: Recognisable, elusive and usually aided by accomplices. | Trial for moderate crimes; alive; 5 GC. |
| 4 | Local Noble: Pursues a nearby offence. | Con Artist: Usually low danger; multiple disguises possible. | Trial for serious crimes; alive; 8 GC. |
| 5 | Visiting Noble: Pursues an offence committed abroad. | Burglar: Elusive, difficult to capture and adept at escape. | Trial for heinous crimes; alive; 10 GC. |
| 6 | Roadwarden Captain: Posts notices for the issuing judge or noble. | Arsonist: Leaves clues; possible political or unstable motives. | Escaped punishment for moderate crimes; dead or alive; 8 GC. |
| 7 | Riverwarden Captain: Posts notices for the issuing judge or noble. | Poacher: May oppose a noble and evade pursuit in wilderness. | Escaped punishment for serious crimes; dead or alive; 10 GC. |
| 8 | Watch Captain: Posts notices for bailiff or council. | Heretic: Possible former cleric with followers. | Escaped punishment for heinous crimes; dead or alive; 15 GC. |
| 9 | Bounty Hunter General: Guild or independent subcontract. | Mutant: Recognisable; may hide among other mutants. | Imfamous Outlaw Chief; dead or alive; 40 GC. |
| 10 | High Priest: Temple judge issuing the warrant personally. | Cultist: Possible witch or sorcerer, elusive and aided. | Notorious Bandit King; dead or alive; 80 GC. |

description:f28365d1cb01225f4c5af7cd.name: Weather Table
description:f28365d1cb01225f4c5af7cd.text:
Roll independently for each weather column. Change weather at GM discretion, normally once daily. Summer is unmodified; add 2 in spring or autumn, 4 in winter, and another 2 for colder climates or high altitude.

|  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1D10 Roll | Temperature | Precipitation | Visibility | Wind |
| 1 | Sweltering | None | Clear | Still |
| 2 | Hot | None | Clear | Light |
| 3–5 | Comfortable | None | Clear | Medium |
| 6–8 | Comfortable | Light | Mist | Strong |
| 9–10 | Chilly | Heavy | Thick Fog | Very Strong |
| 11 | Chilly | Very Heavy | Mist | Medium |
| 13 | Bitter | Heavy | Mist | Light |
| 14+ | Bitter | None | Clear | Still |

Chilly: Without warm clothing, pass Challenging Endurance (+0) or suffer Cold Exposure (WFRP page 181). Without a good campfire, Test again overnight.

Bitter: Test Cold Exposure at least once, or twice with inadequate gear. Test again overnight without excellent shelter and fire. Gloves are required; wearing them imposes -2 SL on Dexterity tasks.

Undead and Constructs ignore temperature penalties.

description:f03865c320e5074f6accc49f.name: Wilderness Travel Events Table 1 - Light Woodland, Hills, And Temperate Plains
description:f03865c320e5074f6accc49f.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Pathway Blocked: Unless flight or engineering crosses the impassable lake, river or gorge, add two journey stages to detour. |
| 2 | Barrow: Easy (+40) Lore (History) or Lore (Local) recognises the burial hill and stones; use Ancient Tomb (page 121). |
| 3 | Monolith: Find a standing stone or circle; use Monoliths (page 120). |
| 4 | Ruin: Find old buildings; use Ruins (page 119). |
| 5 | Ailing Animal: Randomly choose an accompanying animal. Hard (-20) Animal Care avoids effects; failure applies Festering Wound penalties (WFRP page 187). A repeat for that animal kills it. |
| 6 | Worn Out Item: Randomly select a Character and Trapping. Hard (-20) Trade (Carpenter, Leather Worker, Tailor, or Smith) prevents damage; otherwise metal gains Shoddy and leather, canvas or wood breaks apart. |
| 7 | Fellow Travellers: Approach or avoid 4–6 Pedlars or Villagers. Use Victim Quirk (page 29) for behaviour and Outlaw profiles (page 103). |
| 8 | Spring: Refill water as a successful Water Endeavour without a Test. |
| 9 | Animals Encountered: Six wolves or two bears forage nearby; unlikely to attack a group, but may follow and attack isolated people or animals. |
| 10 | Enemies Encountered: 4–6 enemies, such as Goblins, Ungors or Outlaws (page 103). |

description:26499892c0449c04d1803792.name: Wilderness Travel Events Table 2 - Mountains
description:26499892c0449c04d1803792.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1–5 | Wilderness Event: Roll Wilderness Travel Events Table 1 - Light Woodland, Hills and Temperate Plains. |
| 6 | Mountain Sickness: Fail Challenging (+0) Endurance to immediately suffer Malaise and Nausea until exposure ends or a Test succeeds. Ogres, Dwarfs and altitude-adapted animals are exempt. |
| 7 | Scree Slope: Detour adds two stages; crossing requires Challenging (+0) Athletics for each traveller. Failure causes a D10-yard fall. Quadrupeds gain +2 SL. |
| 8 | Blizzard: Temperature Bitter, Precipitation Very Heavy, Visibility Thick Fog, Wind Very Strong (page 114). Reroll weather after the stage. |
| 9 | Beast Lair: A Griffon, Manticore, Pegasus or Wyvern lair. 1 D10: 1–3 home with Territorial, attacks within 50 yards; 4–5 starving, S and T −20, all other Characteristics −10, Wounds −3D10; 6–7 home, fights to death; 8–9 absent with 3% return chance each round; 10 absent. Roll Ancient Tomb loot twice (page 121). |
| 10 | Enemies Encountered: A small group, such as Orcs, Goblins, Outlaws or two Stone Trolls. |

description:6e66d3f331310690d2398841.name: Wilderness Travel Events Table 3 - Deep Forest
description:6e66d3f331310690d2398841.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1–5 | Wilderness Event: Roll Wilderness Travel Events Table 1 - Light Woodland, Hills and Temperate Plains. |
| 6 | Bloodsedge Grove: Easy (+40) Lore (Herbs) or Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival identifies it for avoidance. Optionally use Lustria’s Grasping Creeper Vine. Otherwise cross 3D10 Yards, testing Hard (-20) Dodge each Round; every failure inflicts Damage 5 to a random location. |
| 7 | Herbs: Easy (+40) Lore (Herbs) identifies valuable plants, such as core Weirdroot or Moonflower, or Enemy in Shadows Companion herbs. |
| 8 | Spites: Use Salzenmund Spite rules if available; otherwise each Character gains Fatigued from disturbed sleep until successful Recuperate. |
| 9 | Spiders: 4–6 Giant Spiders, one Large and most Small, attack to entangle and fight to death. |
| 10 | Enemies Encountered: A small group, such as Forest Goblins, Gors and Ungors, or Outlaws. |

description:15c7558edf334a4095be34e0.name: Wilderness Travel Events Table 4 - Wetlands
description:15c7558edf334a4095be34e0.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1–5 | Wilderness Event: Roll Wilderness Travel Events Table 1 - Light Woodland, Hills and Temperate Plains. |
| 6 | Swamp Fever: Contracted through leech or slug bites after failed Challenging (+0) Endurance. Incubation 1d5 days; duration 1d10 days; Malaise, Fever and Flux (Moderate). |
| 7 | Quick Mud: Detour adds two stages. To cross, each Character and animal makes Extended Challenging (+0) Strength, 15 SL. A Fumble requires Suffocation (WFRP page 181) and restarts escape progress. Only those already clear may assist others. |
| 8 | Foul Air: Cross a 2d10-yard gas pocket, testing Average (+20) Endurance each turn to avoid Consume Alcohol-style impairment (WFRP page 121). If unconscious inside, die in TB rounds unless rescued. Spend a Resilience point to escape. Outside, Test Average (+20) Endurance every 5 minutes; success removes effects without a hangover. |
| 9 | Beast Lair: Find a monstrous creature’s lair. |
| 10 | Enemies Encountered: A small group, such as six Goblins, two River Trolls or three Fimir. |

description:0be40ca02b3657b30c5ce582.name: Ruin Table
description:0be40ca02b3657b30c5ce582.text:
| 2D10 | Features |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | Witch’s Lair: The GM sets abilities, with at least Channelling and Language (Magick) 35+4d10, 4 Petty Spells and 4 Witchcraft Spells. Cautious rather than necessarily hostile, but readily defends against undiplomatic visitors. |
| 3 | Ruined Trading Post: Extended Challenging (+0) Perception, 15 SL, discovers coins and trinkets worth 1D10 GC. |
| 4–5 | Frontier Outpost: An insular settlement exploiting local resources or seeking refuge; unusual religious or political beliefs are possible. Visitors usually receive distant formality rather than hostility. |
| 6–7 | Snotlings: 2D10 hide by day, then creep into nearby camps to steal food and valuables by night. When confronted, they cannot be reasoned with and fight for survival. Their den holds 5D10 Silver Shillings of valuables. |
| 8–14 | Rubble: No notable find. |
| 15–16 | Sound Structure: A usable shelter grants +5 SL to Make Camp here. |
| 17–18 | Bandit Camp: 6–8 Outlaws; roll Ancient Tomb loot twice (page 121). |
| 19 | Trolls: Three inhabit the ruin. 1 D10: 1–3 home and hostile unless fed an Average-or-larger creature; 4–5 starving, S and T −20, all other Characteristics −10, Wounds −3D10; 6–7 home and fight to death; 8–9 absent, 3% return chance per round; 10 absent. Roll Ancient Tomb loot twice (page 121). |
| 20 | Wizard’s Tower: A secluded Wizard, potentially concealing forbidden practices, may offer work obtaining supplies. The GM chooses College and abilities, with at least Channelling and Language (Magick) 35+4d10, 4 Petty Spells and 4 Lore Spells. |

description:eb71d0f5fd6b87b8375e2c67.name: Monolith Table
description:eb71d0f5fd6b87b8375e2c67.text:
| D10 | Features |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Simple Marker: Ordinary ancient boundary or ritual stone. |
| 4–5 | Beastman Herdstone: Within 20 yards, Dark Magic and Chaos Lore casters gain +1 SL to Casting and Channelling. Minor Corruption exposure source. Each evening, 10% chance of a Beastman Shaman with D10 Gor and Ungor followers arriving for rites; they resent interference. See Winds of Magic. |
| 6 | Ogham Circle: Within 20 yards, Life and Hedgecraft casters gain +1 SL Casting and Channelling. See Winds of Magic. |
| 7–8 | Elven Waystone: D10: 1 Light, 2 Metal, 3 Life, 4 Heavens, 5 Shadows, 6 Death, 7 Fire, 8 Beasts, 9 roll two Lores, 10 roll three Lores. Within 20 yards, matching casters gain +1 SL Casting and Channelling. See Winds of Magic. |
| 9 | Grave Marker: A nearby entrance leads to Ancient Tomb (page 121). |
| 10 | Orc Totem: Each evening, 10% chance of D10 Orcs and Goblins arriving to celebrate; add a Shaman if using Tribes and Tribulations. They attack Characters at the site. |

description:3c6b2c70f597aa1d1ade44a1.name: Ancient Tomb Table
description:3c6b2c70f597aa1d1ade44a1.text:
| D10 | Entrance | Inhabitants | Loot | Features |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Open Doorway | None | None | None |
| 2 | Open Doorway | D10 Goblins | None | None |
| 3 | Doorway Buried: Hard (-20) Perception to find. | Bandits | Golden Ornaments, 2 GC. | Forsaken by Morr: Tomb Undead gain Regenerate. |
| 4 | Reinforced Oak Door: Pick Lock 4 SL; Toughness 50; Wounds 20. | Tomb Robbers | Golden Ornaments, 1D10 GC. | Sarcophagus: Contains all valuables. |
| 5 | Reinforced Oak Door: Pick Lock 5 SL; Toughness 50; Wounds 20. | Necromancer | Ancient coins, 2D10 GC. | Submerged Chamber: Extended Hard (-20) Swim, 15 SL, reaches loot. |
| 6 | Wrought Iron Gate: Pick Lock 4 SL; Toughness 60; Wounds 25. | Ghost or Spectre | Ancient coins, 2D10 GC. | Giant Rats: Six attack intruders. |
| 7 | Wrought Iron Gate: Pick Lock 5 SL; Toughness 60; Wounds 25. | Ghost or Spectre | Historically interesting rusted weapons and armour without commercial value. | Freezing Air: Immediately Test Cold Exposure on entry (WFRP page 181). |
| 8 | Stone Covering: Extended Hard (-20) Strength, 10 SL, to move; Fumbles cause Fatigued. | D10 Skeletons | Bulky statue or ornament, 3D10 GC and 4 Enc. | Rockfall Trap: Each Character makes Challenging (+0) Perception; the first failure takes 1d10 Head Damage, reduced by Armour Points and Toughness. |
| 9 | Stone Covering: Extended Hard (-20) Strength, 10 SL, to move; Fumbles cause Fatigued. | D10 Skeletons and a Banshee | 4 spears, 4 swords and 4 shields; archaic, preserved and Fine. | Yellow Mould: Easy (+20) Lore (Plants) or Challenging (+0) Lore (Herbs) detects it; Average (+20) Stealth avoids triggering. If disturbed, a 5-yard spore cloud lasts 1d10 Rounds. Occupants pass Average (+20) Endurance or gain 1 Blinded plus 1 per –SL; each Round inside also costs 1 Wound. |
| 10 | Heavy Stone Covering: Extended Very Hard (-30) Strength, 15 SL, to move; Fumbles cause Fatigued. | D10 Skeletons and a Cairn Wraith | Magical weapon (Archives of the Empire Volume 2) or D10 potions (Winds of Magic). | Labyrinthine Passageways: Extended Challenging (+0) Navigation, 20 SL, reaches the burial chamber. Fumbles return you to the entrance and reset progress. |

description:93557fda83d55d594543098b.name: Endeavours
description:93557fda83d55d594543098b.text: Normally each journey stage permits one Travel Endeavour en route and one Camp Endeavour afterwards. Other duties may prevent either at GM discretion. Doing both requires Hard (-20) Endurance; failure gives Fatigued. Peaceful uninterrupted sleep should allow recovery by morning.

description:6a4b34597dfaeff2447ca09a.name: Factors Impacting Endeavours
description:6a4b34597dfaeff2447ca09a.text: Apply weather, terrain and GM-chosen situational modifiers (pages 114 and 124), including wet clothing, hunger, thirst or extreme conditions. One Character may combine Map with Navigate at -1 SL to both, or any two of Water, Hunt, Forage and Scout at -1 SL each.

description:af524f53d374b00bfd3ddb3d.name: Journey Endeavours
description:af524f53d374b00bfd3ddb3d.text: Journey Endeavours operate separately from downtime Endeavours (WFRP page 195); their restrictions generally do not transfer and one type normally cannot substitute for the other. Planning is a party preparation before departure. Each Character may take Travel during each stage, though some require everyone. Camp follows completion of a stage. The extracted Camp definition is incomplete; consult the cited source.

description:07745251224213473673a4e4.name: Planning Endeavour
description:07745251224213473673a4e4.text:
With preparation time and access to prior travellers’ charts, journals or advice, each Character may attempt Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival or Research. Spend each SL during the journey to require a Travel Event reroll, accepting the second result, or reroll a Journey or Camp Endeavour Test.

| JOURNEY ENDEAVOURS Planning Endeavour | JOURNEY ENDEAVOURS Planning Endeavour |
| --- | --- |
| Travel Endeavours | Camp Endeavours |
| Forage | Cook |
| Haste | Journal |
| Hunt/Fish | Make Camp |
| Map | Map |
| Navigate | Navigate |
| Scout | Recuperate |
| Track | Trap |
| Water | Watch |

description:0c121c5788472ef1176fd369.name: List Of Common Shortfalls
description:0c121c5788472ef1176fd369.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| The Party Lack... | Consequence |
| Food | Use Hunt, Fish or Forage during travel, or Trap in camp, to avoid Starvation. |
| Cooked Food | Use Cook or Test for Galloping Trots. |
| Adequate Shelter | Use Make Camp to avoid Heat or Cold Exposure and overnight Healing penalties. |
| Water | Use Water to avoid Thirst. |
| Rest and Recuperation | Take Recuperate to address Fatigued Conditions or Wounds. |

description:4703f61ad81ecff6ee986a8a.name: Terrain Table
description:4703f61ad81ecff6ee986a8a.text:
Suggested Endeavour modifiers follow. Equipment or magic may remove relevant obstacles: sky or landmark access can remove Deep Forest Navigation penalties; a suitable cave can remove exposed-mountain Make Camp penalties.

|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Terrain Table | Navigation | Water | Foraging | Hunt/Fish | Make Camp | Watch |
| Light Woodland | – | – | +1 SL | +1 SL/– | +2 SL | – |
| Hills | – | -1 SL | -1 SL | –/– | – | +1 SL |
| Deep forest | -2 SL | -1 SL | +1 SL | -1 SL/– | +1 SL | -1 SL |
| Temperate Plains | +1 SL | – | – | +1 SL/– | -1 SL | +1 SL |
| Wetland | – | +2 SL | -1 SL | –/+1 SL | -1 SL | +1 SL |
| Mountains | – | – | -2 SL | -1 SL/-2 SL | -1 SL | – |

Existing food removes any need to Hunt or Forage. Heat, cold, thirst and starvation rules are on WFRP page 181.

description:36bcf1eee982b4fd62413d26.name: Factors Impacting Navigate Endeavours
description:36bcf1eee982b4fd62413d26.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Factor | Result |
| Undertaking the Navigate Endeavour as a Double Endeavour | +1 SL |
| Terrain | See page 124 |
| Weather | See page 114 |
| Navigator familiar with area | +3 SL |
| Lost | -3 SL |
| Adequate Map or Journal of area or route, or advice from locals | +1 SL |
| Quality Map or Journal of area or route, or advice from locals | +3 SL |
| Misleading Map or Journal of area or route, or advice from locals | -1 to -3 SL |
| Map Endeavour carried out successfully during previous Stage | +1 SL |
| Navigator possesses Trade Tools (Navigator) | +2 SL |
| Unobscured view of clear skies | +1 SL |
|  |  |

description:0ce82d9ea0c0aada8867862b.name: Forage Endeavour
description:0ce82d9ea0c0aada8867862b.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival, Lore (Herbs) or a similar Test to gather natural food. Each SL feeds one person for one day. A Fumble may produce tainted or misidentified food; anyone eating it gains Poisoned. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

description:fd67ba1bc55b97a997cacb75.name: Haste Endeavour
description:fd67ba1bc55b97a997cacb75.text: Double distance for the stage. Everyone must take Haste to remain together, preventing other Travel Endeavours. Each traveller passes Challenging (+0) Endurance or starts Camp with Fatigued.

description:1411cce5e72d3d82a0181303.name: Hunt (or Fish) Endeavour
description:1411cce5e72d3d82a0181303.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival; each SL feeds two people for a day. Apply normal Hunter’s Eye or Fisherman bonuses in Light Woodland, Hills, Deep Forest, Temperate Plains and Wetland. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

description:54e0d086029c8a5c0d3bd19a.name: Navigate Endeavour
description:54e0d086029c8a5c0d3bd19a.text: Each stage requires at least one navigator to make Challenging (+0) Navigation, unless using a local guide. Following a guide makes the party dependent on their route; independent checks remain possible. Double Endeavour devotes both Travel and Camp to navigation, granting +1 SL but preventing other Endeavours.

description:d936ed09e5308e30ea1c3b6e.name: Navigation Endeavour Outcomes
description:d936ed09e5308e30ea1c3b6e.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +3 or more | Find a shortcut: reduce remaining journey Stages by one. |
| +0 to +2 | Complete the current Stage on course. |
| -0 to -2 | Add one Stage; generate a Travel Event for the next Stage. |
| -3 or less | Add one Stage and a next-Stage Travel Event. Future Navigate suffers -3 SL until a Navigate Endeavour succeeds. |

description:79dd2430361495befb44eed1.name: Cook Endeavour
description:79dd2430361495befb44eed1.text: Cook fresh gathered or hunted food to avoid Galloping Trots contraction Tests. Usually make Average (+20) Trade (Cook) or Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival. Success produces a meal, with quality reflected by SL. Failure spoils one person-day of food per failure level; preparing extra food can offset losses. On Critical Failure, the GM may roll Cooking Critical Failure.

description:de9c0c01e11296fdef133f38.name: Cooking Critical Failure Table
description:de9c0c01e11296fdef133f38.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1-3 | Disgusting: Pass Average (+20) Endurance to eat the barely edible food. |
| 4-5 | Spoiled: All food is unusable; find and prepare replacements. |
| 6-7 | Burned: All food is unusable; nearby enemies can clearly see its smoke. |
| 8 | Food Poisoning: Eaters gain Poisoned Conditions equal to the cooking Test’s failure level. |
| 9 | The Bloody Flux: Fail Easy (+40) Endurance and contract Bloody Flux (WFRP page 186). |
| 10 | Galloping Trots: Fail Average (+20) Endurance and contract Galloping Trots (WFRP page 187). |

description:e7f2dcb262e11180fb58b9fe.name: Map Endeavour
description:e7f2dcb262e11180fb58b9fe.text: Test Average (+20) Trade (Cartography) or Challenging (+0) Art (Drawing) at every journey stage to create a useful map. Success also grants +1 SL to next stage’s Navigate. Usually a Travel Endeavour; Double Endeavour uses Travel and Camp, blocks other Endeavours and grants +1 SL. A basic map may sell for 3 shillings per stage covered; SL above the minimum doubles this. An established reputation for accuracy may command more.

description:2a31360c84c527f0c85d8e6b.name: Scout Endeavour
description:2a31360c84c527f0c85d8e6b.text: Make Challenging (+0) Perception. Success warns of adverse Travel Events. A threat avoidable by changing route may be bypassed by adding two Stages.

description:f3d07f071f45a60d55efdac4.name: Track Endeavour
description:f3d07f071f45a60d55efdac4.text: Follow a quarry with Average (+20) Tracking if they are unaware or leave their trail unconcealed. An aware quarry may oppose with Stealth (Rural). After failure, retrace to the last reliable location for another attempt once you realise the trail is lost.

description:935ac09972e2d7fc38128c11.name: Water Endeavour
description:935ac09972e2d7fc38128c11.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival to refill the whole expedition’s water. Critical Failure may produce contamination, detectable with Challenging (+0) Perception. Drinking contaminated water requires a Bloody Flux contraction Test (WFRP page 186).

description:5273e89b2e4dbb21b4dc36f0.name: Journal Endeavour
description:5273e89b2e4dbb21b4dc36f0.text: Requires Read/Write. Keep an expedition account useful for records or later travellers. The GM may assess writing quality and errors with Average (+20) Art (Writing) for an engaging narrative, or Language (Any) for a factual account. This has little direct effect on the current expedition.

description:0f94b8820af63c14d0a58a47.name: Make Camp Endeavour
description:0f94b8820af63c14d0a58a47.text: Make Challenging (+0) Outdoor Survival to establish shelter. Success allows restful sleep and protects against Heat or Cold Exposure in sweltering or chilly conditions. Overnight Healing normally uses Average (+20) Endurance, but a makeshift camp makes it Challenging; Critical Success restores Average. Failure prevents restful sleep. A Fumble lets the GM add a serious flaw, such as damaged equipment, flooding or predators.

description:7b1f053d1d586aad040a506f.name: Recuperate Endeavour
description:7b1f053d1d586aad040a506f.text: Spend a day resting in an established camp in suitable conditions to recover from exertion, Fatigued Conditions and injuries. Gaining Fatigued or exerting yourself significantly spoils Recuperate. Other party members may perform Camp Endeavours while you rest.

description:998e85fdab273214d006edbf.name: Trap Endeavour
description:998e85fdab273214d006edbf.text: Camp only. Make Challenging (+0) Set Trap; each SL provides one person-day of food by morning. Critical Success may double this; a Fumble may attract a large predator. Use Cook before eating to avoid Galloping Trots risk.

description:bf6db329d603925f242f4adc.name: Watch Endeavour
description:bf6db329d603925f242f4adc.text: Keep watch for some or all of the night. You may add Watch to Travel and Camp, but gain an extra Fatigued during the watch. Three hours or less leaves enough sleep to remove fatigue; longer watches do not. Starting watch while Fatigued requires Average (+20) Willpower to avoid falling asleep.

description:bb1ebd80215e031d411b5cb3.name: Hunting As Endeavour
description:bb1ebd80215e031d411b5cb3.text: Travel hunting normally gathers small game (page 125). Larger game uses the terrain and Difficulties on page 124; hounds and hawks may assist. Hunting as a downtime General Endeavour (WFRP page 196) permits three Tests with cumulative results.

description:f2d953c29c49f9327b63acfc.text:

description:2fc724b79535948da9eebd55.text:

| Hochland Lockhund | 2GC | - | Common |

| Arabyan Redhawk | 25GC | 1 | Exotic |

Hunter’s Garb: +2 SL to Stealth in the terrain its camouflage matches.

description:5c84471d30ff93a15aafa303.name: Hunting Considerations
description:5c84471d30ff93a15aafa303.text:
Use these terrain suggestions and Outdoor Survival Difficulties for Hunting.

| Item | Terrain | Test Difficulty |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Badger, Chicken, Grouse, Rabbit, Rat | Deep Forest, Hills, Light Woodland, Temperate Plains | Challenging (+0) |
| Beaver | Deep Forest, Light Woodland, Wetlands | Challenging (+0) |
| Mountain Goat | Hills, Mountains | Difficult (-10) |
| Wild Boar | Deep Forest, Light Woodland | Difficult (-10) |
| Wolf | Deep Forest, Hills, Light Woodland, Temperate Plains | Difficult (-10) |
| Bear | Any | Hard (-20) |
| Small Deer | Deep Forest, Hills, Light Woodland, Temperate Plains | Hard (-20) |
| Large Deer | Deep Forest, Hills, Light Woodland, Temperate Plains | Very Hard (-30) |

description:d14ff3e1a53e1f7e5ef496b4.name: Charlatan Income Endeavour Complications
description:d14ff3e1a53e1f7e5ef496b4.text:
| D10 | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Ranaldans Take Note: Followers of Ranald the Deceiver may cooperate if you follow their code; otherwise they may steal from or deceive you. |
| 2 | Tragic Customer: A customer’s reliance on false promises causes a GM-determined tragedy; friends may seek redress if they identify you. |
| 3 – 4 | Fanatical Customer: A convinced devotee follows and praises you. The GM determines whether this attracts customers or unwanted notice. |
| 5 – 6 | Rumour: The GM supplies an opportunity or scam untried locally; see page 40. |
| 7 – 8 | Long Con: Earn nothing now. If you take Income next downtime and succeed, earn D10 times normal income. |
| 9 | Potential Confederate: Optionally hire a thief for distractions; pay a shilling retainer at each later downtime’s start. Future Income rolls 1D10: 1 to 9 earns 20% more; 10 loses all earnings when they abscond. |
| 10 | Kingpin Takes Notice: An underworld boss demands cooperation and may obstruct you if refused (Organised Crime, page 57). |

description:2d58162940f782c0f4bd25bb.name: Distant Sounds
description:2d58162940f782c0f4bd25bb.text: Listen clearly to a specific known target or noise anywhere in range, including behind walls or in sealed rooms. You must know the target’s location. You may also whisper to them.

description:82764571f8688b648f35b03c.name: Long Reach
description:82764571f8688b648f35b03c.text: Extend your reach by the Range with invisible arms. You can grasp or manipulate objects, hold a ladder or ledge, lift up to 2 Enc, and make Sleight of Hand Tests.

description:34a636a10867ad45e5a47776.name: Lose the Loot
description:34a636a10867ad45e5a47776.text: Touch illicitly acquired goods to sense who and where will buy them at a decent price. In a large town or city, this points to the nearest Fence. The GM decides their attitude, but with no Sin Points they should at least trade with you.

description:9f6e7a819fb805204a383fa6.name: Silence Reigns
description:9f6e7a819fb805204a383fa6.text: Everyone in the area hears only ordinary background noise; footsteps, barking and other sudden sounds are concealed.

description:99586225c0b2f67ba57dc2fc.name: Poor Man’s Face
description:99586225c0b2f67ba57dc2fc.text: Valuables carried on you are hidden with Ranald for the duration; searches find worthless substitutes. Each hour an object remains hidden gives a 1% chance that Ranald keeps a valuable permanently.

description:d53bd8c495c6e151b734909e.name: Talk Your Way Out
description:d53bd8c495c6e151b734909e.text: Gain a single +8 SL bonus to a Charm Test made to talk your way out of being caught red-handed.

description:1cc76e3b60ba688e0fd9d65b.name: The Heat Is Off
description:1cc76e3b60ba688e0fd9d65b.text: After a crime, people and authorities overlook you for the next few hours and struggle to recall your presence. Subtract 3 when calculating watch presence using the patrol rules (p. 92). Fellowship-based Tests against Fel take −3 SL because others cannot concentrate on you. Attempting another crime ends the Miracle.

description:b179233b23b17293ce4744c4.name: Bountiful Fortune
description:b179233b23b17293ce4744c4.text: Each chosen companion may reverse the percentile dice on their next Test. The benefit expires if unused within Fellowship Bonus Rounds.

description:b811368183801552a112d98f.name: Crisis of Confidence
description:b811368183801552a112d98f.text: Choose someone in range about to attempt a voluntary Fellowship-based Test. They abandon the attempt. If they must make the Test regardless of choice, it instead takes −20.

description:73626dde5962c8423b2b8a2f.name: Force the Hand of Chance
description:73626dde5962c8423b2b8a2f.text: Gain +1 SL on a specified Test. You may repeatedly roll 1d10, adding another +1 SL for each result of 6 or less and stopping whenever you choose. Any result of 7 or more removes every bonus gained and gives −1 SL on the original Test instead.

description:4cf7342484d1e02bf8a671c7.name: Perfect Empathy
description:4cf7342484d1e02bf8a671c7.text: While speaking with someone, understand their meaning, intentions and current thoughts perfectly, regardless of language.

description:ac89f8a338bb56717e7c0e0d.name: The Gamemaster
description:ac89f8a338bb56717e7c0e0d.text: On observing a game, sport or similar pastime, learn its rules and best strategies. If it depends on mental skill rather than chance or physical prowess, competing Tests gain +4 SL. When the Miracle ends, you retain only the rules.

description:60c088343931bb53f4f5b179.name: Up the Stakes
description:60c088343931bb53f4f5b179.text: Make a Test normally. Success becomes an Astounding Success; failure becomes an Impressive Failure.

description:f1c53b0efcac1ba48478dbcf.name: A Suitable Sucker
description:f1c53b0efcac1ba48478dbcf.text: For the duration, you may reroll results on the Contents of a Purse (p. 28) and Victim Quirk (p. 29) tables. A chosen reroll must be accepted.

description:4b15adf9e08e67ad22605f19.name: Bamboozle
description:4b15adf9e08e67ad22605f19.text: A Human-sized creature failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool follows your directions for its next round. You cannot order direct self-harm, though indirect harm is possible. Undead and Daemonic creatures are immune.

description:c386fd69f61da780abf4450c.name: One Almighty Lie
description:c386fd69f61da780abf4450c.text: Tell and roleplay an outrageous lie, then invoke the Miracle. If the Pray Test succeeds, add its SL to d10 and apply that total as bonus SL on your Charm Test. The GM may award further SL for an entertaining, implausible lie.

description:4dfbadc5d1d4f134b16004b1.name: Ranald’s Mischief
description:4dfbadc5d1d4f134b16004b1.text: For an Opposed Test against one adversary, temporarily match two of your Characteristics to theirs. Roll twice on this d10 table, rerolling duplicates: 1–2 Weapon Skill; 3–4 Intelligence; 5–6 Fellowship; 7–8 Initiative; 9–0 any Characteristic of your choice.

description:6ea62bab19b3a4c28c084cfe.name: Unremembered Face
description:6ea62bab19b3a4c28c084cfe.text: Each creature you meet must pass Hard (−2 SL) Cool to recall more than two facts about your appearance. You choose those two facts.

description:daca8c2e9d05ef3b607af5c7.name: Back At You
description:daca8c2e9d05ef3b607af5c7.text: Choose a combat in range in which you are not participating. Compare its participants’ S, T and WS; the one higher in at least two is stronger. While the Miracle lasts, Wounds that participant inflicts in one attack may be added to the next Damage the weaker participant inflicts on them.

description:e56e479e6768dfac98e09c7d.name: Class War
description:e56e479e6768dfac98e09c7d.text: A Gold Tier target suffers Curse of Ill-Fortune (Fourth Edition core p. 255) for one day per level of Gold Standing, plus one day per Pray SL. Habitual adherence to Ranald’s strictures prevents the curse.

description:0632cae44fe7001888f53176.name: Free Your Mind
description:0632cae44fe7001888f53176.text: You or a chosen target automatically resist Charm and Leadership Tests made by someone of higher Status than that target.

description:24e443f09a87ac51c4455119.name: Moment of Clarity
description:24e443f09a87ac51c4455119.text: Gain Immunity to Psychology for the duration.

description:a8bbce2328386d65e6696f56.name: Rally Round
description:a8bbce2328386d65e6696f56.text: Allies in the area gain +2 SL to Endurance and Cool Tests, plus another +1 SL per 10 people in the crowd. Silver and Gold Status characters receive no benefit.

description:da55e4421cfc4298c5185cf0.name: Under my Protection
description:da55e4421cfc4298c5185cf0.text: Choose an authority figure who has threatened or persecuted a particular victim. From their next sleep, the target has nightmares and must Test Challenging (+0 SL) Cool each morning or gain a Fatigued Condition. Treating their victims kindly or otherwise making amends ends the dreams.

description:3f5afb63b8aa964db8dede22.name: Auroch’s Heart
description:3f5afb63b8aa964db8dede22.text: The target adds your Fellowship Bonus as SL to all Toughness Tests for the duration.

description:0f6e9fc0e840bebd14a63525.name: Earthshudder
description:0f6e9fc0e840bebd14a63525.text: Within Fellowship Bonus yards of a chosen point, targets must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Athletics or gain Prone. Constructed structures in the area take d10 + SL damage.

description:460adb56a0a17af9da1eb382.name: Nature’s Repast
description:460adb56a0a17af9da1eb382.text: Touch up to six individual meals made from wild foraged or hunted food. Each eater can go four days before needing an Endurance Test against starvation. The quantity of food and number of people it feeds do not increase.

description:2a40753e09987d4c8f203dd3.name: Pax of Taal
description:2a40753e09987d4c8f203dd3.text: Natural animals with Intelligence 25 or less in the area become peaceful and attack nothing, including prey and each other. Bipedal and Chaos-twisted creatures are excluded. Attacking affected animals ends the effect on them.

description:7c6c90c846f6fde31bf3ccf8.name: Rending Paw
description:7c6c90c846f6fde31bf3ccf8.text: You or one ally gain +20 Strength for the duration.

description:6e047e339d18d32a1dff3b66.name: River’s Blessing
description:6e047e339d18d32a1dff3b66.text: For the duration, gain +4 SL on Swim Tests and move through water at your full Movement rate rather than half. This has no effect in salt water.

description:a217064bf1823369520fa4dd.name: Wild Wind
description:a217064bf1823369520fa4dd.text: You are unaffected. Other targets in the area take −2 SL on WS and Agi Tests and must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Toughness each round or gain Prone. Ranged attacks cannot be made within the area; only gunpowder and artillery weapons may attack into it.

description:52d8968f03e58aa0a87d9574.name: Wilderness Way
description:52d8968f03e58aa0a87d9574.text: Invoke before a journey period using Chapter 7, Pathfinding (p. 112). Record Pray SL as rerolls available for Planning, Travel or Camp Endeavour results during that journey period. An encounter removes unused rerolls. You may invoke again before the next journey stage.

description:fd14afc32bf4a058817fec59.name: longbeard
description:fd14afc32bf4a058817fec59.text: Adaptation warning: user-approved creation adaptation: starting Fate and Fortune each decrease by 1; minimum age 120, subject to the GM. For social Tests with Dwarfs, Brass/Silver counts as Gold 1 and Gold gains one Standing; Earnings are unaffected. Retain the printed +10 to avoid/remove Conditions as a situational reference. The zero-Fate Resilience/Resolve fallback is deferred to character management.

description:f5fde3388733b1529d29dc99.name: Dwarf Handgun (2H)
description:f5fde3388733b1529d29dc99.text: Ammunition modifiers are included in the profile and do not apply again. Misfire occurs only on 00.

description:95e15a77f191d3916585aaa5.name: Dwarf Pistol
description:95e15a77f191d3916585aaa5.text: Ammunition modifiers are included in the profile and do not apply again. Misfire occurs only on 00.

description:ad31c2df4d4a5336847d0c8f.name: Dwarf Crossbow (2H)
description:ad31c2df4d4a5336847d0c8f.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:19f1724b645796f03d55b225.name: Drakegun (2H)
description:19f1724b645796f03d55b225.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:d99ee98aa1792262fbd7727c.name: Drakefire Pistol
description:d99ee98aa1792262fbd7727c.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:74a0f1eef6f23f3a20c6b8f7.name: Repeating Dwarf Handgun (2H)
description:74a0f1eef6f23f3a20c6b8f7.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:0821941ca873ad2391326096.name: Grudge-raker (2H)
description:0821941ca873ad2391326096.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Salvo 2 (p. 92): fire one or more shots before reloading; shots after the first incur cumulative −10 Ranged Test penalties. Each Reload restores one Salvo, up to two. An 00 Misfire causes hits equal to remaining Salvo, minimum one. Numeric modifiers remain references.

description:b14ad7296b43c4ee1da7679f.name: Blasting Charge
description:b14ad7296b43c4ee1da7679f.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:9e705bf3b4c4783223378d81.name: Cinderblast Bomb
description:9e705bf3b4c4783223378d81.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:47611383b36b9beba6c0b289.name: Dwarf Throwing Axe
description:47611383b36b9beba6c0b289.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:80d87c2ee140e706c658750c.name: Drakefire Shots (12)
description:80d87c2ee140e706c658750c.text: Price and pack quantity are supplied; Encumbrance is unspecified.

description:28eb31613560f9a94f202a57.name: Trollhammer Torpedo (one torpedo)
description:28eb31613560f9a94f202a57.text: Alternate Drakegun load: Range 40, Damage +14, Blackpowder, Dangerous, Impact, Reload 6; also causes Ablaze. This is a loaded-weapon profile, not an independently fired handheld weapon.

description:c90d4ab81b71005046667d7b.name: Battle Standard
description:c90d4ab81b71005046667d7b.text: Protection Runes reach 12 yards when used with this standard; it grants no rune.

description:8725bd235543cb0b3f81ac7a.name: Reckoner’s Log
description:8725bd235543cb0b3f81ac7a.text: A stone-tablet record. The parchment alternative has Enc 1 but no separate price, so has no invented shop profile.

description:7cb6aac17bff0f70aab6bc5d.name: Gromril Breastplate
description:7cb6aac17bff0f70aab6bc5d.text: Reference only: Dwarfs do not sell gromril. Minimum material value is 1280 GC.

description:93efc8e81a73a97a401bd785.name: Gromril Open Helm
description:93efc8e81a73a97a401bd785.text: Reference only: Dwarfs do not sell gromril. Minimum material value is 256 GC. Retain printed −10% Perception as a reference, without automatic SL conversion.

description:e29cbaa8689f9827106ee201.text: Reference only: Dwarfs do not sell gromril. Minimum material value is 1024 GC.

description:782bd086be42abfa9c94f155.name: Gromril Plate Leggings
description:782bd086be42abfa9c94f155.text: Reference only: Dwarfs do not sell gromril. Minimum material value is 1280 GC. Retain printed −10 Stealth as a reference, without automatic SL conversion.

description:270529f197f11a1c2b34c27b.name: Gromril Helm
description:270529f197f11a1c2b34c27b.text: Reference only: Dwarfs do not sell gromril. Minimum material value is 384 GC. Retain printed −20% Perception as a reference, without automatic SL conversion.

description:f32df82b18a0a249631c4694.name: Miner’s Helm
description:f32df82b18a0a249631c4694.text: Dwarf armour. Retain printed −10% Perception as a reference, without automatic SL conversion.

description:fdc2931ead53616024002eb3.name: Shield Platform
description:fdc2931ead53616024002eb3.text: Dwarf clans do not sell this item; reference only. Material value: 15 GC. Bearer and activation effects are deferred.

description:b3c9345d725971d8c590c745.text: Dwarf clans do not sell this item; reference only. Material value: 25 GC. Bearer and activation effects are deferred.

description:d14635e2b6fcab9adb9eae0b.text: Dwarf clans do not sell this item; reference only. Material value: 1000 GC. Bearer and activation effects are deferred.

description:c2a188bfe27d35d683c5865e.name: Suggested Restitution For Grudges
description:c2a188bfe27d35d683c5865e.text:
| Type of Grudge | Suggested Restitution |
| --- | --- |
| Insult to personal honour, such as accusations of lying or poor craft | Equally public apology; compensation for lost earnings |
| Insult to ancestral honour or dead kin | Public apology, gold, and actions restoring the ancestor’s honour |
| Theft, defective goods or damaged property | Full repayment, extra gold for the insult, and repair or replacement labour |
| Injury from defective machinery or a fight | Equivalent injury or gold for lost earnings |
| Failure to fulfil an oath, including protection or courage | Apology and compensation by the offender’s clan; possible exile or Slayer Oath |
| Death, torture, violation, attempted murder or deliberate mutilation of you or kin, including beard cutting | Offender’s death as a Blood Grudge; Dwarfs may choose the Slayer Oath as a merciful alternative |
| Deliberate oathbreaking, including refusal of a lord’s summons or killing kin | Offender’s death as a Blood Grudge, with the same possible Slayer Oath leniency |

description:97e8290004b7bce4cb831c8c.name: Crewed (Rating)
description:97e8290004b7bce4cb831c8c.text: Requires Rating crew, each possessing the appropriate Ranged Skill. Only one fires each Round; others may move/reload it on their Turns. Misfires affect every crew member at a random Hit Location instead of the Primary Arm. Any crew shortage doubles Reload; being short by at least 2 also adds Imprecise, and at least 3 adds Dangerous. Each duplicate Flaw instead gives a printed −10 to Ranged Tests.

description:c0515187ae800070f99dfbb5.name: Salvo (Rating)
description:c0515187ae800070f99dfbb5.text: Holds Rating shots. Fire one or several, reducing remaining Salvo by the shots used. Each missile after the first suffers a cumulative printed −10 to its Ranged Test. Reload Rating gives the SL needed to restore 1 Salvo; never exceed profile capacity. A Dwarf Salvo weapon misfiring on 00 inflicts hits on its crew equal to remaining Salvo, minimum 1.

description:599b413b3841ef76b4c00015.name: Spread (Rating)
description:599b413b3841ef76b4c00015.text: Point Blank: one target, +Rating Damage. Short–Long: target plus the next Rating closest visible creatures; no pair may be more than Rating yards apart. Extreme: the same multiple targets, but −Rating Damage.
