description:8e183ab2d5539d97b8c6fe5b.name: Runic Flaws Table
description:8e183ab2d5539d97b8c6fe5b.text:
| 1d10 | Runic Flaw |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Works for one minute, then destroys its item and every rune on it. |
| 2–3 | Works for one minute, then loses power and is destroyed; forge it again from scratch. |
| 4–5 | Works until the adventure ends, then fades; forge it again from scratch. |
| 6–8 | Deals 1 Damage to its item immediately and another 1 Damage at each adventure’s start. |
| 9–10 | Each activation requires the bearer to spend 1 Fortune point. |

description:7c5fd245bcaf60c101590dd4.name: Rune of Cleaving
description:7c5fd245bcaf60c101590dd4.text: Each Rune of Cleaving adds +1 Damage to this weapon.

description:cbf0e5267ad26b89cac6b95b.name: Rune of Retribution
description:cbf0e5267ad26b89cac6b95b.text: For Critical Wounds this weapon causes, you may add +20 per Rune of Retribution to the Critical Wound table roll.

description:f529b3709d23498ee2322588.name: Rune of Cutting
description:f529b3709d23498ee2322588.text: Successful hits with this weapon may ignore 2 armour AP per Rune of Cutting.

description:9b24fab0aa07f1f6878c809b.name: Rune of Daunting
description:9b24fab0aa07f1f6878c809b.text: Drawing this weapon grants Fear with a Rating equal to its Runes of Daunting. If you already have Fear, add +1 to its Rating per rune.

description:08c54095527657c01a76d674.name: Rune of Fire
description:08c54095527657c01a76d674.text: Drawing the weapon lights its blade, illuminating 20 yards. Enemies it damages gain one Ablaze Condition. With two or three Runes of Fire, it can also make Ballistic Skill ranged attacks at Willpower Bonus Range with Blast 4: these cause no Damage but give one Ablaze Condition per rune.

description:8c31ee878a1b510394faada7.name: Rune of Fury
description:8c31ee878a1b510394faada7.text: While wielding this weapon, gain one Dual Wielder level per Rune of Fury, even beyond the Talent’s normal maximum.

description:bcb234e113c5de4f431ba62c.name: Grudge Rune
description:bcb234e113c5de4f431ba62c.text: Choose an enemy against whom you hold a Blood Grudge (p. 84). Each Grudge Rune gives this weapon +10 to hit and +1 Damage against that enemy. If the target dies, choose a new Blood Grudge enemy at the adventure’s end.

description:83574abd7ab1a58921aabc37.name: Rune of Might
description:83574abd7ab1a58921aabc37.text: Against a target larger than you, each Rune of Might adds +3 Damage to this weapon.

description:c107add5434f12025894e058.name: Rune of Speed
description:c107add5434f12025894e058.text: Carrying this weapon in combat grants +10 Initiative per Rune of Speed.

description:6ddbd331ff2c4a5886e0f83f.name: Rune of Striking
description:6ddbd331ff2c4a5886e0f83f.text: Attacks with this weapon gain +10 to its matching Melee specialisation per Rune of Striking. The bonus does not apply to another weapon, including a similar weapon held in your other hand.

description:3ff9f7f5d95bfa33036491cb.name: Master Rune of Alaric the Mad
description:3ff9f7f5d95bfa33036491cb.text: This weapon’s attacks ignore the target’s armour AP, Qualities and every other benefit of that armour.

description:ffff0704244bca4d7ec58a75.name: Master Rune of Breaking
description:ffff0704244bca4d7ec58a75.text: Destroy an opponent’s magic weapon used in a Melee Test when this weapon successfully attacks against their Melee opposition, or successfully Opposes their attack with Melee.

description:43170df04bc5e1cc3f9a19e2.name: Master Rune of Flight
description:43170df04bc5e1cc3f9a19e2.text: Use this as a Thrown ranged weapon with Range SB×3 and Accurate. After dealing Damage, it returns to your hand.

description:d4f0c2cc1c82ff8f9825f9c4.name: Master Rune of Skalf Blackhammer
description:d4f0c2cc1c82ff8f9825f9c4.text: Every successful attack with this weapon scores a Critical.

description:90ffe6af3a79a9fba1250457.name: Master Rune of the Slayer
description:90ffe6af3a79a9fba1250457.text: Choose an enemy type, such as Daemons, Undead, Dragons, Goblins or Elves. When this weapon attacks that type, you may Reverse the attack Test and its Critical Wound table rolls.

description:3d91dfb9b20cbee0de133fbb.name: Master Rune of Snorri Spangelhelm
description:3d91dfb9b20cbee0de133fbb.text: A failed Melee Test with this weapon becomes a success at 0 SL. An opponent can still defeat the attack by scoring more SL on the Opposed Test.

description:2fc6cf156b3995d4c356e0e3.name: Master Rune of Haste
description:2fc6cf156b3995d4c356e0e3.text: Grants Fast, with a −30 penalty to Melee defence Tests against this weapon instead of −10.

description:a6740f2e69d9a41b9221da78.name: Rune of Force
description:a6740f2e69d9a41b9221da78.text: While wearing the armour, a successful charging Melee attack adds Damage equal to your highest location AP for each Rune of Impact.

description:7f634a73fc57b88bff6f658c.name: Rune of Fortitude
description:7f634a73fc57b88bff6f658c.text: Wearing the armour grants +10 Toughness per Rune of Fortitude.

description:48bee4537adf23d1a478930a.name: Rune of Iron
description:48bee4537adf23d1a478930a.text: Wearing the armour grants +2 Wounds per Rune of Iron. Remove these Wounds when taking it off; this may cause a Critical Wound if you are badly injured.

description:dcb73f1955ea2a6abbf49d0e.name: Rune of Resistance
description:dcb73f1955ea2a6abbf49d0e.text: While wearing the armour, gain +10 per Rune of Resistance on Tests to Oppose incoming Melee attacks.

description:abddb56b7f0f019158537885.name: Rune of Shielding
description:abddb56b7f0f019158537885.text: While wearing the armour, reduce Damage from incoming ranged attacks and spells by 2 per Rune of Shielding. Damage reduced to 0 or less causes no Wound loss.

description:d70ae2b860e959627c59cdf0.name: Rune of Stone
description:d70ae2b860e959627c59cdf0.text: Each Rune of Stone adds +1 armour AP. Armour bearing only Runes of Stone is exempt from the Rule of Pride and works even within 100 yards of an identical suit.

description:d184f6559523e9353b9029a2.name: Master Rune of Adamant
description:d184f6559523e9353b9029a2.text: While wearing the armour, you may Reverse a Critical Wound table roll made when you suffer a Critical Wound.

description:a3d6d8113c506369020be507.name: Master Rune of Gromril
description:a3d6d8113c506369020be507.text: Removes Weakpoints. Only a Runic Flaw (p. 126) can Damage this armour; Talents and effects such as Penetrating cannot reduce its AP. Effects that bypass armour and directly cause Wounds still work.

description:bcabd37984c5e68168e9c533.name: Master Rune of Steel
description:bcabd37984c5e68168e9c533.text: While wearing the armour, lose at most 10 Wounds from each instance of Damage.

description:15c61a2f6de648a3b29e36d4.name: Rune of Clear Sight
description:15c61a2f6de648a3b29e36d4.text: Hold the talisman to your eye to ignore penalties from non-magical fog, mist, smoke or similar vapours. Two Runes of Clear Seeing also pierce magical vapours and permit clear sight in complete darkness.

description:6af18c3ee8d1ea0b89bbd328.name: Rune of Truth
description:6af18c3ee8d1ea0b89bbd328.text: Touch the talisman to a fake, forgery, counterfeit or deliberately devalued item and it shines. Two Runes of Disclosure also expose magical illusions or copies; three show the bearer exactly how the deception was made.

description:ca43c3cce1c196218990d1d8.name: Rune of Far Sight
description:ca43c3cce1c196218990d1d8.text: Hold the talisman to your eye to see clearly up to one mile away. Two Runes of Farseeing extend this to two miles; three extend it to four.

description:cce41f1af12a291606e8cbbc.name: Rune of the Furnace
description:cce41f1af12a291606e8cbbc.text: While worn, prevents Ablaze and heat exposure, and reduces incoming fire or flaming-attack Damage by 4 per Rune of the Furnace.

description:3401776bf2fe02e0991d19e2.name: Rune of Luck
description:3401776bf2fe02e0991d19e2.text: While worn, grants one Fortune point per Rune of Luck, even above normal maximum Fortune. Remove those points when taking it off, minimum 0 Fortune. They cannot return until the next session.

description:e3840beb8b0757e64ccba28e.name: Rune of Restoration
description:e3840beb8b0757e64ccba28e.text: After a good night’s sleep wearing it, recover Toughness Bonus Wounds per Rune of Restoration.

description:c7c10c6531a8e651035a9580.name: Rune of Spellbreaking
description:c7c10c6531a8e651035a9580.text: While wearing it, activate a Rune of Spellbreaking before a Magic Resistance Willpower Test to count as rolling 01. Each rune can activate once per adventure.

description:095a1270c8950a8d2ab318dc.name: Rune of Spelleating
description:095a1270c8950a8d2ab318dc.text: After you dispel a spell with Magic Resistance while wearing it, its caster cannot attempt that spell for your Willpower Bonus in Rounds. Two Runes of Spelleating change this to hours; three change it to weeks.

description:f11e06e84d9ab8ba191d264d.name: Rune of Warding
description:f11e06e84d9ab8ba191d264d.text: While worn, lets you impose −10 per Rune of Warding on attacks or spellcasting Tests targeting you.

description:09e785bc86e825fc7798f82c.name: Master Rune of Balance
description:09e785bc86e825fc7798f82c.text: While worn, when an enemy you can see casts a spell, you may Reverse their Spellcasting Test, or your Opposed Willpower Test if within Magic Resistance range.

description:2d6f0939220f78df6ebbc1ca.name: Master Rune of Industry
description:2d6f0939220f78df6ebbc1ca.text: While worn, allows one extra Endeavour between adventures.

description:072b06d190ea2209f42390b3.name: Master Rune of Kingship
description:072b06d190ea2209f42390b3.text: While worn, allows you to Reverse Charm, Intimidate or Leadership Tests targeting a Dwarf or a group mostly made up of Dwarfs.

description:115fdb9a5b6d7219987bc73f.name: Master Rune of Passage
description:115fdb9a5b6d7219987bc73f.text: While worn and moving at walking pace or slower, lets you pass through fixed solid objects, including trees, stone and metal cages. You cannot pass through animals or Undead, or finish a Move inside a solid object.

description:1888883f2a7ef2bef558e79a.name: Master Rune of Spite
description:1888883f2a7ef2bef558e79a.text: When a Melee attack damages you, its attacker immediately takes 2d10 Damage to a random location, reduced normally by Toughness Bonus and AP.

description:d253681906039f23d7fdd8b1.name: Rune of Alarm
description:d253681906039f23d7fdd8b1.text: A Small or larger creature entering range triggers a loud alarm. Two Runes of Alarm can instead play a recorded sentence; three can instead send a recorded telepathic message any distance to the crafter or their nearest living descendant.

description:1b865b772ba91c9c2bddc47f.name: Rune of Battle
description:1b865b772ba91c9c2bddc47f.text: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum per Rune of Battle.

description:74daff453f323110904a38d7.name: Rune of Courage
description:74daff453f323110904a38d7.text: Affected allies gain +10 to Psychology Tests per Rune of Courage.

description:84625e654927cd0542800fcd.name: Rune of Discovery
description:84625e654927cd0542800fcd.text: The crafter selects one metal or gem per Rune of Discovery, such as gold, diamond, gromril, iron ore, obsinite, ithilmar or brightstone. The item shines when a selected material is within range.

description:01dfab30eb25abaca497f814.name: Rune of Enemy Detection
description:01dfab30eb25abaca497f814.text: Define a creature category or description per rune, from Skaven or obvious Chaos worshippers to one-eyed red-haired women. The rune glows crimson when a clear match enters range.

description:193e4447ba6dc98df9c42b14.name: Rune of Locking
description:193e4447ba6dc98df9c42b14.text: Locks in range cannot be picked or forced except by magic or their key. Two Runes of Locking also block magic. Three block the key too, allowing only the crafter or nearest living descendant to open them at will. Breaking the protected chest or door still bypasses the lock.

description:2f7f301681696d5b231ad343.name: Rune of Purification
description:2f7f301681696d5b231ad343.text: Affected allies gain +20 per Rune of Purification on Tests against toxins in air or water.

description:00a255a2b3e7b2636cc1cca8.name: Rune of Retribution
description:00a255a2b3e7b2636cc1cca8.text: Desecrating a body in range, including theft from the dead or necromantic casting, immediately gives the offender one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Retribution.

description:f3a4e3d3cff0bc60ee4ec9c6.name: Rune of Sanctuary
description:f3a4e3d3cff0bc60ee4ec9c6.text: Affected allies gain +10 per Rune of Sanctuary to Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to dispel.

description:bd6bd18cb869e98c2d7125b4.name: Rune of Slowness
description:bd6bd18cb869e98c2d7125b4.text: An enemy Running to Engage an affected ally loses 4 yards of Run distance per Rune of Slowness, to a minimum of its Walk distance.

description:5de742c1cae6dcea8657b0ed.name: Rune of Verminkill
description:5de742c1cae6dcea8657b0ed.text: Rodents, Skaven and rat-based creatures such as Rat Ogres lose 2 Wounds per Rune of Verminkill upon entering range or starting a Turn there. Ignore Toughness Bonus and AP.

description:5262e8bc6cbeae81e05fa24f.name: Master Rune of Expel Chaos
description:5262e8bc6cbeae81e05fa24f.text: Affected allies may Reverse Tests against corruption, Tests to avoid mutations from Corruption, and rolls on Physical or Mental Corruption Tables. When engaged with a Daemonic enemy with Unstable, count the ally as having +2 Momentum when calculating Unstable Wound loss.

description:d99b542bdaa08f925716c49d.name: Master Rune of Grimnir
description:d99b542bdaa08f925716c49d.text: You may Reverse enemy Ranged attack Tests targeting affected allies.

description:c93d63be83a6fb1b6deac2c7.name: Master Rune of Grungni
description:c93d63be83a6fb1b6deac2c7.text: You may Reverse enemy spellcasting Tests targeting affected allies.

description:4a4ac5a92b1a0b40e12afb4c.name: Master Rune of Stromni Redbeard
description:4a4ac5a92b1a0b40e12afb4c.text: Affected allies start combat with one Momentum. This rune’s range doubles to 12 yards, or 24 yards on a battle standard.

description:ced1c5e4a480c9b518b4f96f.name: Master Rune of Valaya
description:ced1c5e4a480c9b518b4f96f.text: Affected allies may Reverse Magic Resistance Willpower Tests to Oppose casting. Magic Resistance has no range limit for them: they may Oppose spells against any visible target and dispel persistent spells as well as incoming spells.

description:feabb2d10cea6f16892e19c6.name: Rune of Accuracy
description:feabb2d10cea6f16892e19c6.text: This weapon gains +10 to hit per Rune of Accuracy.

description:2ceae9c14c1222168766d25a.name: Rune of Burning
description:2ceae9c14c1222168766d25a.text: A hit from this weapon gives one Ablaze Condition per Rune of Burning.

description:d2b2b8ffb64d10806c59bdf8.name: Rune of Forging
description:d2b2b8ffb64d10806c59bdf8.text: The crew may activate a Rune of Forging to cancel a Fumble, Misfire or both when using this weapon. Each rune works once per adventure.

description:ac8545042cf94b7ed6f3ff8a.name: Rune of Penetrating
description:ac8545042cf94b7ed6f3ff8a.text: Each Rune of Penetrating adds +2 Damage to this weapon.

description:1425311946adae03ed82b4a7.name: Rune of Reloading
description:1425311946adae03ed82b4a7.text: Reduce this weapon’s Reload Rating by 2 per Rune of Reloading. At 0 or below, remove Reload. A Salvo weapon retains a minimum Reload Rating of 1.

description:367c2426d2450232d76296d6.name: Rune of Seeking
description:367c2426d2450232d76296d6.text: Against flying enemies, this weapon gains +20 to hit per Rune of Seeking.

description:550d0bc94db58189d0784631.name: Rune of the Stalwart
description:550d0bc94db58189d0784631.text: Dwarfs crewing this weapon start combat with one Momentum per Rune of the Stalwart. Leaving the crew or becoming Engaged removes this extra Momentum.

description:a65aee496abefe1a5766ddbf.name: Rune of the Valiant
description:a65aee496abefe1a5766ddbf.text: Dwarfs crewing this weapon gain +10 Willpower per Rune of the Valiant.

description:71a9b25edc83812849d43ade.name: Master Rune of Defence
description:71a9b25edc83812849d43ade.text: The crew always has hard cover: Ranged attacks against them suffer −30.

description:def82b8406e1db1b20b2bae0.name: Master Rune of Disguise
description:def82b8406e1db1b20b2bae0.text: Enemies cannot see this weapon until it fires, after which it stays visible for the combat. Its crew remains visible and moving it still makes noise.

description:af8dd5d1cc33b604f869bb36.name: Master Rune of Immolation
description:af8dd5d1cc33b604f869bb36.text: Any Dwarf in the crew may activate this as a Free Action, destroying the weapon. Every creature within 6 yards suffers Damage 15 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP. Survivors gain Ablaze.

description:c02cdbb1ee2fe79f354c1ed1.name: Master Rune of Skewering
description:c02cdbb1ee2fe79f354c1ed1.text: Once per adventure, activate before a Ranged attack roll with this weapon to count as rolling 01. A successful attack also scores a Critical and can strike any chosen location.

description:b265277402715b9eb57448ac.name: Rune of Hearth and Home
description:b265277402715b9eb57448ac.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Until the next Round ends, Dwarfs within 25 yards may count as rolling 01 on Cool Tests.

description:dfa5ecd9daefcea98255eef7.name: Rune of Oath and Steel
description:dfa5ecd9daefcea98255eef7.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Dwarfs within 25 yards gain +2 AP to worn armour until the next Round ends.

description:17696c16fb0980fba14b6074.name: Rune of Wrath and Ruin
description:17696c16fb0980fba14b6074.text: Requires an Anvil of Doom and a Hard (−2 SL) Runesmithing Action (p. 132). Each enemy within 25 yards takes Damage 12 to a random location, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP.

description:238c1a9edb298956c8ff3d8c.name: Lore (Runes)
description:238c1a9edb298956c8ff3d8c.text: Covers identifying runes and understanding their history, materials and effects. Learned through oral teaching from the Runesmiths Guild, never from books.

description:6f4fbce42b056afe176d3ea4.name: Runesmithing
description:6f4fbce42b056afe176d3ea4.text: Forge, reactivate or deactivate magical runes. Merely learning a rune grants no item; rune crafting remains outside character creation.

description:8c382504952cdc9bfaeb5ac1.name: Sail (Skycraft)
description:8c382504952cdc9bfaeb5ac1.text: Operate flying machines using this Advanced Skill. Take-off/landing require Average (+2 SL) Tests. Skycraft and ordinary Sail do not unlock one another; situational operations are not automated.

description:3336573b2246fd6a017b17ff.name: Ancestral Grudge
description:3336573b2246fd6a017b17ff.text: Choose a culture or faction, such as Orcs, Goblins, Skaven, Trolls or Khorne Daemons, and enter an unfulfillable Blood Grudge against it in your Book of Grudges (p. 33). Each significant victory, including destruction, recovery of stolen property or many kills, grants 50 XP. Each purchase targets a different faction. The GM may increase rewards for narrower targets: for example, 75 XP for a particular Goblin tribe or 100 XP for a particular Human family.

description:137f047a9c37a27dcba3160a.name: Bludgeoner
description:137f047a9c37a27dcba3160a.text: Winning an Opposed Test to activate Pummel causes one extra Stunned Condition per Bludgeoner level. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:b3f0eebd5f0ad171c21de574.name: Crew Commander
description:b3f0eebd5f0ad171c21de574.text: As an Action, pass a Challenging (0 SL) Leadership Test to aid a crew within earshot using a Crewed weapon. For its next attack with that weapon, crew members may use your Ranged Skill. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:bb360a726568e22a73d77494.name: Demolisher
description:bb360a726568e22a73d77494.text: Activating Hack adds +1 Damage per Demolisher level against the struck armour or shield. Against enemies in cover with a Hack weapon, treat hard cover as medium, medium as soft and soft as no cover. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:aa7cc424e0f46402b2d7915c.name: Dragon Belcher
description:aa7cc424e0f46402b2d7915c.text: When you fire a Blackpowder weapon, each targeted enemy failing its Cool Test gains one additional Broken Condition per Dragon Belcher level.

description:200b615ebf31da988e90ca3d.name: Entrenchment
description:200b615ebf31da988e90ca3d.text: While you occupy soft cover, attacks against you are Hard (−2 SL) rather than Difficult (−1 SL). In medium cover, they are Very Hard (−3 SL) rather than Hard (−2 SL). Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:86384de32f23c49d2c36ab7f.name: Forgefire
description:86384de32f23c49d2c36ab7f.text: While you are Engaged, melee weapons held by you or allies within Willpower Bonus yards gain Penetrating. An already Penetrating weapon instead ignores one more point of non-metal armour.

description:57a55803a4b8f08bb5e44080.name: Glorious Demise
description:57a55803a4b8f08bb5e44080.text: Gaining Unconscious lets you interrupt turn order for an immediate Melee attack as a Free Action before becoming incapacitated. Gaining Stunned lets you spend one Fortune point for an immediate Free Action Melee attack. Your next Turn proceeds normally; if still Stunned, you cannot take an Action.

description:6bd11d748fcbaddfb6f444d5.name: Harpooner
description:6bd11d748fcbaddfb6f444d5.text: On a Crossbow Critical Hit, you may add +10 per Harpooner level to the Critical Hit table roll, maximum 00. Each Crossbow bolt lodged by Impale also reduces the target’s Movement by 1, minimum 1.

description:828c1e60b0b4bd16138fbc1d.name: Kingsguard
description:828c1e60b0b4bd16138fbc1d.text: Enemy attacks against allies within 2 yards suffer −10 per Kingsguard level. This never protects you and does not apply while you have any Condition.

description:ef380211ab13b551949f2c24.name: Liquid Fortification
description:ef380211ab13b551949f2c24.text: After an alcoholic drink, gain +10 Strength and Toughness, including immediately for that drink’s Consume Alcohol Test regardless of its result. The bonus lasts one hour after your last drink. Further drinks extend it without increasing either bonus above +10. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:ce99d58e5fe1a97e7162eb34.name: Long Memory
description:ce99d58e5fe1a97e7162eb34.text: Perfectly recall the time, date, place, visible faces and exact spoken commitments at significant events you participated in during the campaign. Events before the campaign may require an Intelligence Test based on elapsed time, from Easy (+4 SL) for months to Hard (−2 SL) for a century. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:c25d0453f7245479e30c9870.name: Magic Defiance
description:c25d0453f7245479e30c9870.text: You may Reverse Tests required by a spell’s effects and Magic Resistance Tests to dispel magic. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:7af5379259be4eb909f75860.name: Master Rune Magic
description:7af5379259be4eb909f75860.text: Each purchase teaches one master rune from pp. 127–131, restricted to any runic forms named by this Talent. Forge it through the Forge Rune Endeavour (full rules p. 121). The first purchase also teaches all three Doom Runes (p. 132). Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:f465cce24b7ffb5d6bb2e40e.name: Maverick
description:f465cce24b7ffb5d6bb2e40e.text: Ignore the −20 penalty to Ranged attacks while using the Flight Trait. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:8f64c6fcb90fe23f694184dd.name: Rune Magic
description:8f64c6fcb90fe23f694184dd.text: Each purchase teaches one non-master rune from pp. 127–131. Obey any specified runic form or exact rune restriction. Inscribe it through the Forge Rune Endeavour. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:4742dd2d8653ff67a9582dd1.name: Short Fuse
description:4742dd2d8653ff67a9582dd1.text: Explosive weapons you use gain +1 Blast Rating per Short Fuse level.

description:9f4aa6d888c94abb759acb94.name: Tireless
description:9f4aa6d888c94abb759acb94.text: When applying Fatigued penalties, ignore one Fatigued Condition plus one per Tireless level. For example, four Conditions with two levels leave one effective Condition and a −10 penalty to all Tests.

description:12c2f9c24f5a5ca617d7deb1.name: Underminer
description:12c2f9c24f5a5ca617d7deb1.text: Attacking while Prone or otherwise beneath your target carries no penalty, and enemies receive no attack bonus against you for being Prone. Gain an extra +20 to hit a Surprised enemy when emerging from a tunnel, pit or other concealed position below it. Legacy: approved Fourth Edition adaptation retains printed limits and effects, without the old per-rank Test SL bonus. Situational, combat and campaign effects are references.

description:115cbf356a9c700da641183c.name: Whirlwind of Death
description:115cbf356a9c700da641183c.text: As an Action, spend one Fortune to make a Melee attack against every creature Engaged with you. The GM selects one enemy to Oppose. On success, apply the same normally calculated Damage to the same Hit Location on all Engaged creatures. No Criticals apply, but enemies reduced to 0 Wounds suffer Critical Wounds normally. You cannot combine other special attack options. Dual Wielder permits Reversing this Melee Test when wielding two weapons.

description:296df4b1a8644d54907704fd.name: Dwarf Handgun (2H)
description:296df4b1a8644d54907704fd.text: Ammunition modifiers are included in the profile and do not apply again. Misfire occurs only on 00.

description:15a60c3439f82124ff30e5e5.name: Dwarf Pistol
description:15a60c3439f82124ff30e5e5.text: Ammunition modifiers are included in the profile and do not apply again. Misfire occurs only on 00.

description:57ef2525219f200cf068c1c9.name: Dwarf Crossbow (2H)
description:57ef2525219f200cf068c1c9.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:01b64b2dba6f7c999da16f76.name: Drakegun (2H)
description:01b64b2dba6f7c999da16f76.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:13253009afb5480ff081b795.name: Drakefire Pistol
description:13253009afb5480ff081b795.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:1442602633cad1e9642c1b4b.name: Repeating Dwarf Handgun (2H)
description:1442602633cad1e9642c1b4b.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:18dced14de68448fbeb69887.name: Grudge-raker (2H)
description:18dced14de68448fbeb69887.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Salvo 2 (p. 92): fire one or more shots before reloading; shots after the first incur cumulative −10 Ranged Test penalties. Each Reload restores one Salvo, up to two. An 00 Misfire causes hits equal to remaining Salvo, minimum one. Numeric modifiers remain references.

description:3718b4fe16148e0adde69705.name: Blasting Charge
description:3718b4fe16148e0adde69705.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again. Affected targets also gain Ablaze.

description:aa06f67f9ff2d928e19e15e2.name: Cinderblast Bomb
description:aa06f67f9ff2d928e19e15e2.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:1bb3eb3a809450c7dd2924cb.name: Dwarf Throwing Axe
description:1bb3eb3a809450c7dd2924cb.text: The profile includes ammunition modifiers; do not add them again.

description:670795f78083dfd40eadcb95.name: Sea Guard
description:670795f78083dfd40eadcb95.text: Use ungrouped core Animal Care for level 1’s Swiftfeather Roc training. Use ungrouped core Sail at levels 1, 2 and 3 for Bloodhawk, Falconship, Hawkship or Dragonship training.

description:095caa44eda4766a5b51b0a5.name: Merchant Adventurer
description:095caa44eda4766a5b51b0a5.text: Level 1’s Sail (Any) uses ungrouped core Sail.

description:84f1dadda03db3f83cfc4d62.name: Mage
description:84f1dadda03db3f83cfc4d62.text: Supports Mage levels 1–4. User decisions defer level 5 Archmage and all three Elf priest branches. Student Mage requires four of this guide’s six Petty spells. Additional Colour Lores require 10 individual Channelling points and four qualifying spells, with a WP Bonus limit; High Magic adds pp. 79–83’s requirements.

description:fcb0bed1032952a15b282b71.name: Unending Malice
description:fcb0bed1032952a15b282b71.text: Tests intended to harm another gain +1 SL; all other Tests suffer −1 SL.

description:677cd643dfa041ed8e05f38d.name: Unholy Rage
description:677cd643dfa041ed8e05f38d.text: Gain +10 Weapon Skill and become subject to Frenzy Psychology.

description:d2ffbd1e7090a9fe3b0252f2.text: Create a major artistic or scholarly work whose reputation will endure for centuries.

description:d0fc1e59016f986affd0fbc7.text: Defeat the Dark Elves permanently by persuading Ulthuan to strengthen its armies.

description:0ee0d4e8953a4e36c63fcc92.text: Make a chosen kingdom Ulthuan's leading realm, whether rebuilding a ruined land such as Yvresse or sustaining an established power such as Eataine.

description:7114bb90ef6e99400b358f11.text: Restore High Elf overseas dominions and persuade Ulthuan to expand its fleets.

description:f43772f301d986b2efb5ba4c.text: Prevent Ulthuan from spending its lives and wealth on alliances with Humans or Dwarfs.

description:cec6b7ce5c2cffcb827d09d3.text: Explore distant, remote lands and witness sights no Elf has seen before.

description:b5aa2de0c4d57b7647af6487.text: Find deep mutual understanding through enduring friendship or love.

description:49ab73e3bbb3dc0591cda60f.text: Teach a philosophy that improves future lives: moral reform, ending suffering or encouraging pleasure.

description:00b031cd360370664cc916fc.text: Acquire the wealth and influence needed to keep family, friends or neighbours safe and comfortable.

description:c28b5f0ec8913565308c02b4.text: Achieve emotional self-mastery and inner peace.

description:b073bde7e1e9dc2da98f62d0.text: Ulthuan burns in war while a king and general unite and a Dragon rises: Morvael and Mentheus's story. It may urge suitable delegation, warn that a friend is endangered or foretell personal disaster.

description:87508d86398e28a174416009.text: Two armoured powers battle in the heavens; one falls and the victor exults, recalling Khaine's defeat of Vaul. It may warn of failed revenge or a trap.

description:638b2094a21ae044b108d261.text: As Oeric's lifelong apprentice, you watch him sculpt an Elf maiden in white marble. Possible meanings include perilous temptation, recovering a loss or beginning a masterwork.

description:d8af5e3c75647fc5a165d908.text: Anlec's storm-battered towers glow with green witchfire as harpies circle above ice-cold waves. It may reveal a dangerous building or enemies secretly preparing an assault.

description:8b315bbccfff8268a2447388.text: You tumble through the Great Vortex while mages remain calm within the Winds. It may demand a great sacrifice to prevent disaster or signal a major, hazardous undertaking.

description:2b829900d946d8189aff39a0.text: The well-travelled Malerion befriends High King Snorri Whitebeard before seeking the Phoenix Throne. This may predict either a valuable new friendship or betrayal by someone close.

description:d387ef9f941decb35f658d6b.text: Khaine rages after his treasures are stolen and hidden in the mortal world, beyond the gods' reach. It may warn of losing a precious possession, suggest recovering a stolen/lost item, reveal changed loyalties or caution against a lover's manipulation.

description:ddbb5ab328126aa0ae53eaa3.text: An admiral orders a dragonship to ram a floating fortress amid dark seas and drifting ice. Bold action may win a great victory, but consolidating recent gains may be necessary before risking overextension.

description:735ec086c7a59d7ccc352e36.text: Flamespyre Phoenixes rise from white stone pillars, calling through flaming wings. It may promise reinvention, renewed purpose or escape from death.

description:af02cf66beff7aee29db15b5.text: An ancient Dragon briefly wakes, finds the world too cold and returns to sleep. It may condemn ignoring a growing threat for comfort, or indicate that conditions are wrong for a desired action.

description:adf7ac61c98a51a0a826e424.name: Greatsword of Hoeth
description:adf7ac61c98a51a0a826e424.text: Two-handed sword with Durable 3 and Fine 3, tailored to one Swordmaster. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32). Reference value: 2000 GC. Unique items are unavailable through ordinary shopping.

description:cdbb6dcf8c14baa407f983ae.name: Ithilmar Breastplate
description:cdbb6dcf8c14baa407f983ae.text: Uses core Plate layering and penalties. Printed worn penalty: −10 Stealth; no additional Perception penalty. Carried rather than worn: minimum Enc 1. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32). Reference value: 1280GC. Unique items are unavailable through ordinary shopping.

description:05785d1ccbec8bda63484672.text: The source table leaves AP blank; protection and full penalties are unresolved. Durable 2, Fine 4, Impenetrable, Weakpoints. Nobility restriction: p. 61. Price applies only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32). Reference value: 1536 GC. Unique items are unavailable through ordinary shopping.

description:1ebdf718c06223d071138686.name: White Lion Cloak
description:1ebdf718c06223d071138686.text: Fine 2, Partial. In Chrace, wearing it is vulgar unless you personally hunted and killed its White Lion (p. 35). Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:cbd17a3e8ef0ec0b1c5146e1.name: Heartleaf (1 halm)
description:cbd17a3e8ef0ec0b1c5146e1.text: Burning this attracts a Dragon and removes one Fatigued Condition if it inhales the fumes; it need not cooperate. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:59efd2d0a67a077717f4721b.name: Narinocha Wine, bottle
description:59efd2d0a67a077717f4721b.text: Drinking requires a Challenging (+0 SL) Consume Alcohol Test. Failure uses ordinary alcohol rules; Elves replace Stinking Drunk with the printed Narinocha d10 table. That table and Yenlui effects remain play references. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:0a2078258126171d39f5df86.name: Sunroot Extract, vial
description:0a2078258126171d39f5df86.text: Ten doses per vial. A dose mixed with spring water grants the printed +20 to Tests against contracting disease for one week (p. 37); reference only. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:2c5024fcb03608b5402e2141.name: Viridescent Palliative, vial
description:2c5024fcb03608b5402e2141.text: For 12 hours, one dose prevents Frenzy, balances Yenlui, suppresses Dream/Obsession bonuses and penalties, allows failed Cool Tests against Fear/Terror to be rerolled, and suppresses Prejudice, Animosity and Hatred (p. 37). Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:23ff7ee5ad8b46d80caa2cb3.name: Aethyrolabe
description:23ff7ee5ad8b46d80caa2cb3.text: A Challenging (+0 SL) Lore (Magic) Test detects nearby concentrations of Winds; a Hard (−2 SL) Test locates the closest concentration of a chosen Wind. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:e906a4b1999c6020c18078b7.name: Flamespyre Phoenix Feather
description:e906a4b1999c6020c18078b7.text: For roughly one year, lights as a lantern and ignites materials as a torch. Arrange safe transport. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:b24dd57eedea61ff9467355f.name: Frostheart Phoenix Feather
description:b24dd57eedea61ff9467355f.text: For roughly one year, gives candle-level light and cools as a block of ice. Arrange safe transport. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:2c57b29e2c73f951401e9a6e.name: Staff of Nightelm
description:2c57b29e2c73f951401e9a6e.text: While carried, provides the Magic Resistance 3 Trait against Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic and Chaos Lore spells. It grants neither a Talent nor general passive bonuses. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:9c1aa67a6ebe5b8ed501e2bf.name: Staff of the Eternal Grove
description:9c1aa67a6ebe5b8ed501e2bf.text: Crafting this wood suffers −4 SL. Finished bows and polearms gain Durable 4. The purchase provides raw staff wood rather than a finished weapon. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:55b80907eed5f7e6737e44ed.name: Wayshard
description:55b80907eed5f7e6737e44ed.text: A Challenging (+0 SL) Pray Test finds the direction of the closest waystone; the shard also assists Yenlui meditation. Buyers must be trusted to safeguard it. Prices apply only at High Elf markets/outposts (p. 32).

description:8a2e32990091fcf8e6f47841.text: Select an enclave and an ancestral Ulthuan kingdom as background; neither grants the kingdom’s starting Skills or Talents. Uncouth Uranai reduces Standing by 1 only with Elves from Caledor, Ellyrion, Avelorn or Saphery, without changing general displayed Status.

* Ithilmar and Dragon Armour otherwise use Plate rules, including −10 Stealth while worn. Carried Ithilmar Plate has minimum Enc 1. Ithilmar may also form scale, chain or horse barding; it is always Unique and costs 128 times the ordinary equivalent, or seven doublings. Examples: a 1 GC Mail Coif costs 128 GC, and 8 GC Plate Bracers cost 1024 GC.

Dragon Armour is Plate only. It prevents Ablaze when the protected location is hit; full coverage also prevents location-independent Ablaze, while partial coverage does not. Against any heat-based attack, including Fire Breath and Fire Lore, Dragon Armour cannot be bypassed by armour-ignoring effects and doubles its AP. Other heat protection is at GM discretion. It does not stop suffocation, poisonous fumes, blinding smoke, extreme heat exposure or prolonged intense heat. Dragon Armour is always Unique and costs 1024 times the ordinary equivalent, or ten doublings: a 3 GC Helm costs 3072 GC and a 10 GC Breastplate costs 10240 GC. In Chrace, a White Lion Cloak is considered vulgar unless its wearer hunted and killed that lion.

Heartleaf: burning it immediately attracts any awakened Dragon that sees or smells it. Inhaling its fumes removes 1 Fatigued Condition. A Dragon used to cooperating with Elves may understand the summons but can resent disrespect, frivolous requests or actions against its interests; wild or hostile Dragons need not respond favourably.

Narinocha: each glass requires a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test. Failure uses normal alcohol effects, but Elves replace Stinking Drunk results with the Narinocha table.

description:f8cc88c45d53d25cd57ba564.name: Narinocha Wine
description:f8cc88c45d53d25cd57ba564.text:
| 1d10 | Effect of Narinocha |
| --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Reassuring Mirage: Yenlui (Light); −1 SL to Perception until sober. |
| 3–4 | Disquieting Illusion: Yenlui (Dark); −1 SL to Perception until sober. |
| 5–6 | Kaleidoscopic Confusion: −4 SL to Perception until sober. |
| 7–8 | Vision of the Annuliis: Yenlui (Balanced). |
| 9 | Dream of Bucolic Avelorn: Yenlui (Dark); −2 SL to Perception until sober. |
| 10 | Nightmare of Mirai: Yenlui (Dark); −2 SL to Perception until sober. |

description:e0a3aecc1b350f73e6cfde66.name: Enchanted Items
description:e0a3aecc1b350f73e6cfde66.text:
| Item | Cost | Enc | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ENCHANTED ITEMS |  |  |  |
| Aethyrolabe | 350 GC | 1 | Exotic |
| Flamespyre Phoenix Feather | 300 GC | 0 | Exotic |
| Frostheart Phoenix Feather | 400 GC | 0 | Exotic |
| Staff of Nightelm | 500 GC | 1 | Exotic |
| Staff of the Eternal Grove | 350 GC | 1 | Rare |
| Wayshard | 700 GC | 0 | Rare |

Aethyrolabe: a Challenging (+0) Lore (Magic) Test reveals relative Wind concentrations; Hard (−20) finds the nearest concentration of one chosen Wind. Flamespyre Phoenix Feather: burns for about one year, lighting as a lantern and igniting as a torch. Frostheart Phoenix Feather: stays cold for about one year, lighting as a candle and refrigerating as an ice brick. Safe feather transport is the buyer’s responsibility. Staff of Nightelm: against Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic or Chaos Lore spells, the bearer counts as having Magic Resistance 3; it can form a polearm shaft. Eternal Grove wood: crafting suffers −4 SL; bows and polearms made from it gain Durable 4. Wayshard: sold only to trusted protectors, aids Yenlui meditation (p. 46), and a Challenging (+0) Pray Test reveals the nearest waystone’s direction.

description:3071db10970eaa02abb45b6b.name: Factors Influencing Yenlui
description:3071db10970eaa02abb45b6b.text:

| Extreme indulgence | Shift towards Dark |
| Gain a Corruption point | Shift towards Dark |
| Exceptional kindness | Shift towards Light |
| Avoid pleasure | Shift towards Light |
| Deep meditation with a Wayshard or at a Cadai shrine | Shift towards Light |

description:2fd8c6973e9d4fe6224df05b.name: Example Obsessions
description:2fd8c6973e9d4fe6224df05b.text:
| 1d10 | Obsession |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Create an enduring artistic or scholarly masterwork. |
| 2 | Defeat the Dark Elves permanently by strengthening Ulthuan’s army. |
| 3 | Make one Ulthuan kingdom paramount, whether rebuilding Yvresse or sustaining a realm such as Eataine. |
| 4 | Restore High Elf dominions overseas by expanding Ulthuan’s fleets. |
| 5 | Keep Ulthuan’s people and wealth out of alliances with Humans or Dwarfs. |
| 6 | Explore distant regions to see what no Elf has seen. |
| 7 | Find lasting love or a deep friendship with someone who truly understands you. |
| 8 | Teach a philosophy that improves future lives, whether through morality, ending suffering or encouraging pleasure. |
| 9 | Acquire wealth and influence to protect family, friends or neighbours. |
| 10 | Master your emotions and nature to achieve inner peace. |

description:23d371b26374cedf5fb08b27.name: Example Dreams
description:23d371b26374cedf5fb08b27.text:
| 1d10 | Dream |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | War-torn Ulthuan; Morvael and Mentheus clasp hands as a Dragon flies. May urge delegation, warn of danger to a friend, or foretell disaster. |
| 2 | Khaine defeats Vaul in a heavenly duel. May warn that revenge will fail or someone is setting a trap. |
| 3 | As Oeric’s lifelong servant, you watch him carve a marble maiden. May suggest dangerous temptation, recovery of something lost, or making a masterwork. |
| 4 | Storms, harpies and green witchfire surround Anlec. May warn of a perilous building or enemies secretly gathering strength. |
| 5 | The Great Vortex tosses you among serene mages. May demand sacrifice to prevent disaster or the undertaking of a dangerous great work. |
| 6 | Malerion and Snorri Whitebeard greet each other as friends before the Phoenix Throne claim. May promise a valuable friendship or warn of betrayal by someone close. |
| 7 | The Bloody-handed God rages over treasures hidden in the mortal world where gods cannot enter. May foretell theft, loss, rediscovery, changing loyalties or a lover’s manipulation. |
| 8 | An admiral orders his dragonship to ram a floating fortress amid an icy sea. May call for bold action to win, or caution against advancing before securing recent gains. |
| 9 | Flamespyre Phoenixes rise from pale stone pillars. May offer reinvention, renewed purpose or escape from death. |
| 10 | An ancient Dragon finds the world too cold and returns to sleep. May warn against ignoring a growing threat for comfort, or indicate circumstances do not favour a planned action. |

description:4963733b58f047530bd3f877.name: The Madness Of Khaine
description:4963733b58f047530bd3f877.text:
| 1d100 | Mental Corruption |
| --- | --- |
| 01-20 | Hollow Heart |
| 21-40 | Profane Urgency |
| 41-60 | Thrill Hunter |
| 61-74 | Tortured Visions |
| 75-89 | Unending Malice |
| 90-00 | Unholy Rage |

Agree portrayal with the GM. After the customary scrutiny at 16, these traits usually remain within ordinary, if extreme, Elven personality; commoners may not know their ancestry or have been examined. Revealing Aenarion ancestry can provoke hostility, cult persecution, admiration or recruitment into schemes.

Each week, pass Hard (−20) Cool or shift towards Yenlui (Light). |

description:a1afb0cf57eb6728b24d80ec.name: Cadai Meditation
description:a1afb0cf57eb6728b24d80ec.text: Each day, meditate for at least one hour, then pass an Average (+20) Pray Test to set Yenlui to Light.

description:a826b7878baa9267c20e716d.name: Mind over Body
description:a826b7878baa9267c20e716d.text: Max: 3. After at least twenty minutes of quiet meditation, pass a Challenging (+0) Pray Test for benefits lasting 1d10 + SLd10 hours. Level 1: gain Painless and no pain-caused Conditions. Level 2: perceive shapes mentally, including fine detail in crafted objects but no colours, expressions or other fine details; Trade (Smith) has no blindness penalty, and Blinded cannot affect you even from magic or gods. Level 3: spend Resolve to ignore Critical Wound penalties on Extended Tests, including Crafting Endeavours.

description:3ee8d3cb6b1d591b652370be.name: Eye of the Storm
description:3ee8d3cb6b1d591b652370be.text: Max: 3. Meditate quietly for at least twenty minutes, then pass a Challenging (+0) Pray Test for 1d10 + SLd10 hours of benefits. Level 1: distractions cannot interrupt Channelling. Level 2: recover Fatigued Conditions in half the GM’s normal time (WFRP p. 169), and ignore their Channelling and Casting penalties. Level 3: modify each Weather-table die by +1 or −1 (Sea of Claws p. 106; Deft Steps Light Fingers p. 114).
