description:4b89b59f630e6f14b09a555c.name: Sanctuary of the Mind
description:4b89b59f630e6f14b09a555c.text: Max: 3. Meditate quietly for at least twenty minutes, then pass a Challenging (+0) Pray Test for benefits lasting 1d10 + SLd10 hours. Level 1: spellcasting cannot give you Corruption points. Level 2: add +1 SL to Research Tests. Level 3: ignore negative Yenlui State modifiers (p. 47). Hoeth’s Loremasters travel freely to seek knowledge, with access to institutional information and support; their duties can involve Asur politics.

description:8074672c0cf8b2d6e7ef24fa.name: Common Forms Of Leverage
description:8074672c0cf8b2d6e7ef24fa.text:
| 1d100 | Skill Test Leverage Factors Bonus |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01 to 03 | Bribery | Target owes debts | +1 SL |
| 04 to 10 | Charm | Target seeking to prove themself open and friendly | +1 SL |
| 11 to 12 | Entertain (Acting or Storytelling) | Target enjoys spotting allegories in works of fiction | +1 SL |
| 13 to 17 | Gossip | Target likes to speak rather than listen | +1 SL |
| 18 to 20 | Intimidate | Target unsure of how to handle conflict | +1 SL |
| 21 to 24 | Leadership | Target eager to support the efforts of leaders | +1 SL |
| 25 to 27 | Bribery | Target is facing reduced circumstances | +1 SL |
| 28 to 34 | Charm | Target is open to flattery | +1 SL |
| 35 to 36 | Entertain (Acting or Storytelling) | Target looking for distraction | +1 SL |
| 37 to 41 | Gossip | Target seeks to keep abreast of the latest fashions | +1 SL |
| 41 to 43 | Intimidate | Target is physically cowardly | +1 SL |
| 44 to 47 | Leadership | Target looking for inspiration | +1 SL |
| 48 to 50 | Bribery | Target seeking to back a venture | +2 SL |
| 51 to 57 | Charm | Target looking for a friend | +2 SL |
| 58 to 59 | Entertain (Acting or Storytelling) | Target is open to novel experiences | +2 SL |
| 60 to 64 | Gossip | Target seeks the approval of others or to find out if others disapprove of them | +2 SL |
| 65 to 67 | Intimidate | Target hiding shameful secrets | +2 SL |
| 68 to 71 | Leadership | Target looking for someone to emulate | +2 SL |
| 72 to 74 | Bribery | Target is greedy for wealth | +3 SL |
| 75 to 81 | Charm | Target wishes to be reassured that they are desirable | +3 SL |
| 82 to 83 | Entertain (Acting or Storytelling) | Target seeking to prove themself cultured and open-minded | +3 SL |
| 84 to 88 | Gossip | Target enjoys gossip for its own sake | +3 SL |
| 89 to 91 | Intimidate | Target in fear for friends or family | +3 SL |
| 92 to 96 | Leadership | Target lost in life with no calling of their own | +3 SL |
| 97 to 00 | Charm | Target is as vain as Atharti | +4 SL |

Choose Leverage to fit the target’s personality and situation, or select/roll from this table. After observing a target, a Hard (−20) Combined Intuition/Perception Test or Difficult (−10) Gossip Test can identify suitable Leverage. The GM may instead make selected factors irritating or uninteresting, reversing their SL bonus into a penalty. Even normally favourable Leverage can backfire with the target’s current mood: +1 SL becomes −1 SL.

description:2bb0658322dcb33064a701ec.name: Discovering Leverage Table
description:2bb0658322dcb33064a701ec.text:
| SL | Perception/Intuition Results | Gossip Results |
| --- | --- | --- |
| +6 or more | Identify factors and strength; no unexpected reaction. | Identify factors and strength; no unexpected reaction. |
| +4 to +5 | Identify factors and strength; 5% unexpected reaction chance. | Identify factors and strength; 5% unexpected reaction chance. |
| +2 to +3 | Identify factors; 10% unexpected reaction chance. | Identify factors; 10% unexpected reaction chance. |
| +0 to +1 | Gain a hint of factors; 15% unexpected reaction chance. | Gain a hint of factors; 15% unexpected reaction chance. |
| −0 to −3 | No effect. | No effect. |
| −4 or less | Target deduces manipulation; Intrigue fails. | Target hears of manipulation; Intrigue fails. |

Example: +4 SL identifies a target’s respect for inspirational commanders. A Leadership Persuasion Test gains +1 SL, with a 5% chance of an unexpected reaction instead changing it to −1 SL.

description:d6c8ad4c6480055da1ee2e21.name: Intrigue Endeavour
description:d6c8ad4c6480055da1ee2e21.text: During downtime, an Intrigue Endeavour uses the normal targets, Agendas, Persuasion Tests and Complications. The GM may allow Intuition for Leverage only when a particular social event offers time to study the target. Social Arenas need not apply unless the target’s attendance at relevant places or celebrations is predictable; for example, a resident Asuryan priest can reasonably be found at Lothern’s shrine.

description:07074673969331be1b4137f1.name: Intrigue Development Table
description:07074673969331be1b4137f1.text:
|  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SL | Minor Challenge | Moderate Challenge | Major Challenge |
| +6 or more | The Target adopts the Agenda as a Lasting Priority. | The Target adopts the Agenda as a Fleeting Interest. From now on the Intrigue is treated as a Minor Challenge. | Target is sympathetic to the Agenda, and voices support for it when others mention it, but does not adopt it. From now on, the Intrigue is treated as a Moderate Challenge. |
| +4 to +5 | The Target adopts the Agenda as a Solid Commitment. | The Target is sympathetic to the Agenda, and voices support for it, when others mention it but does not adopt it. From now on, the Intrigue is treated as a Minor Challenge. | From now on the Intrigue is treated as a Moderate Challenge. |
| +2 to +3 | The Target adopts the Agenda as a Fleeting Interest. | From now on, the Intrigue is treated as a Minor Challenge. | From now on, the Intrigue is treated as a Moderate Challenge. |
| +0 to +1 | The Target is sympathetic to the Agenda, and voices support for it when others mention it but does not adopt it. | From now on, the Intrigue is treated as a Minor Challenge. | The Target considers the issue without coming to a conclusion. Future Persuasion Tests benefit from +1 SL. |
| -0 to -1 | The Target is unaffected. | The Target is unaffected. | The Target is unaffected. |
| -2 to -3 | From now on, the Intrigue becomes a Moderate Challenge. | From now on, the Intrigue becomes a Major Challenge. | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. |
| -4 to -5 | From now on, the Intrigue becomes a Major Challenge. | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. |
| -6 or less | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. | The Target realises that the Intriguer is trying to manipulate them, and to what end. |

description:2fbcd2ff349108935458a509.name: Target Suspects Table
description:2fbcd2ff349108935458a509.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Result |
| +4 or more | Intriguer can intuit how the Target feels about the Agenda, how wholeheartedly they have adopted it, and whether the Intrigue can be concluded. |
| +0 to +3 | Intriguer can intuit whether or not the Target is feeling well-disposed towards the Agenda. |
| -0 to -3 | Intriguer intuits nothing. |
| -4 or less | Intriguer intuits nothing and the Target can intuit that they are up to something. |

To judge immediately whether an Agenda has been adopted and how firmly, observe the target and make an Opposed Intuition Test. This risks raising suspicion.

description:0b110e3016662ce7f4ee6f84.name: Bless Arrow
description:0b110e3016662ce7f4ee6f84.text: Make one non-magical arrow magical and add +1 Damage.

description:8be13d57f3168a2cd61bf79e.name: Calm
description:8be13d57f3168a2cd61bf79e.text: Touch the target and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship to remove their Prejudice, Animosity, Fear and Frenzy effects.

description:0c43ebca9b33c9dcb5ce0769.name: Greenfinger
description:0c43ebca9b33c9dcb5ce0769.text: Touched living plants grow at their natural rates to full size and productivity even in poor conditions. Touched dead plants return within one day to their former living state.

description:48ff1cfd7255016628dea7c5.name: Identify Disease
description:48ff1cfd7255016628dea7c5.text: Learn the names and effects of all diseases affecting a person, animal or plant.

description:ae20e4b7a861c063137fe55f.name: Remove Dirt
description:ae20e4b7a861c063137fe55f.text: Touch an object, person or animal to remove its dirt completely. On a surface, clean a circle Willpower Bonus yards across.

description:464803386ad5e8d4073310d2.name: Reveal Magic
description:464803386ad5e8d4073310d2.text: Magical objects and creatures in range glow visibly, even when hidden. Wizards count only if affected by a spell. Elven Arcane spells require every relevant Arcane Magic (Lore) Talent and the ability to channel every listed Wind before purchase. Channel them using your least proficient Channelling Skill, applying the least favourable abundance or scarcity modifier among their Winds.

description:1bfd429e9fac5be8bf609b8c.name: Enchant Plant
description:1bfd429e9fac5be8bf609b8c.text: Winds: Ghyran, Chamon. Give a non-magical plant one permanent, dispellable enchantment: Hardy resists poor light, dry soil and adverse temperatures; Nourishing halves the Encumbrance of edible produce needed for food; Vessel allows binding a Lesser Daemon, Minor Elemental or soul as into a Power Stone. A plant can carry only one enchantment.

description:dd9fb220eb95dc7ff62f2f33.name: Lesser Banishment
description:dd9fb220eb95dc7ff62f2f33.text: Winds: Hysh, Shyish. Win an Opposed Willpower/Cool Test to banish a Ghost, Spectre, Lesser Daemon or Daemonic Beast to its original spirit realm or Realm of Chaos. Wraiths, Greater Daemons and other powerful entities are unaffected. Banishment causes no Damage or destruction, and the target can be summoned again.

description:595e792b85cfa092f2a17716.name: Magic Alarm
description:595e792b85cfa092f2a17716.text: Winds: Azyr, Ulgu. Monitor a chosen area. Any creature or spirit of Tiny Size or larger entering it alerts you at any distance, waking you immediately if asleep. Learn their exact number but not their types.

description:7511a56b5c55f710579f1aab.name: Masking the Mind
description:7511a56b5c55f710579f1aab.text: Winds: Shyish, Ulgu. Intuition Tests against you and Casting Tests targeting you with mind-reading or scrying are Very Hard (−3 SL). You can be forced to speak, but not to speak truthfully.

description:6c90b66f173b9f238c73b8c0.name: Purify Body
description:6c90b66f173b9f238c73b8c0.text: Winds: Ghyran, Hysh. Pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance to remove one disease or poison from another creature. A Fumble gives you that disease or poison.

description:810da94bb5000af740ed7951.name: Speak with Animal
description:810da94bb5000af740ed7951.text: Winds: Azyr, Ghur. Speak with an animal in a language others cannot understand. Anyone knowing Anoqeyån may understand with Average (+2 SL) Language (Magick). The animal is not charmed; you may use Charm rather than Charm Animal when speaking to it. Its Intelligence limits the conversation’s complexity.

description:11ca8d6b4e93d5ab88395229.name: Voice of Iron
description:11ca8d6b4e93d5ab88395229.text: Winds: Aqshy, Chamon. Normal speech and shouting carry three times their usual distance, unaffected by barriers or competing noise. Gain +10 on Intimidation and Leadership Tests. Hostile listeners may negate that bonus by noticing the unnatural voice with Difficult (−1 SL) Perception. Whispers gain no effect.

description:cf8ad5ca994aeff0a7b13249.name: Zone of Comfort
description:cf8ad5ca994aeff0a7b13249.text: Winds: Aqshy, Ghur. Creatures with both Swarm and Size (Tiny or Little) cannot attack you. Ignore Cold and Heat Exposure (WFRP p. 181), and reduce Damage from cold or heat attacks by 1.

description:e0759ff3b852fd72fadd8ade.name: Apotheosis
description:e0759ff3b852fd72fadd8ade.text: The target heals Willpower Bonus Wounds and gains Fear 1 temporarily. Overcasting: each +3 SL adds Willpower Bonus Wounds healed; +6 SL also heals a Critical Wound on Challenging (+0 SL) Fellowship; +10 SL resurrects the target at full Wounds with its normal appearance and abilities and a magical halo. It dies after Willpower Bonus minutes or if Apotheosis is Dispelled, and cannot be revived again. Gain Yenlui (Dark).

description:78a2e306b97e1dfcb9f832c5.name: Arcane Unforging
description:78a2e306b97e1dfcb9f832c5.text: Deal 1 Damage to the body per 2 AP worn across all Hit Locations, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring AP. On Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling, also destroy one random carried magic item. Overcasting: each +1 SL destroys 1 random worn AP after Damage; +3 SL and Average (+2 SL) Dexterity reveal all carried magic items and let you choose which to destroy; +8 SL increases Damage to 1 per AP.

description:f9da30e4876bad1f9fe067f6.name: Coruscation of Finreir
description:f9da30e4876bad1f9fe067f6.text: Gain Flight (Agility) (WFRP p. 339) and 5 AP everywhere, using the higher of these AP or worn armour at each location. Overcasting can create an Arcane Fulcrum (Winds of Magic p. 198) granting casters within Willpower Bonus yards +1–5 SL (1d10 /2) to Casting, rerolled each Round. +5 SL creates a Warp Rift within Willpower Bonus yards in terrain or mid-air; it is a Malignant Influence (WFRP p. 236), and you lose −3 Yenlui. +8 SL creates a Magic Portal in solid terrain within that range; it is more stable and augments only one chosen Colour Lore and High Magic.

description:6b6bd1623ac31af3d7c3b9a3.name: Curse of Arrow Attraction
description:6b6bd1623ac31af3d7c3b9a3.text: Shooters may reroll missed missile attacks against affected targets, including magical ammunition and war machines but excluding magic missiles. Overcasting: +4 SL removes shield AP and Defensive when Opposing missiles, though shields can still block them; +6 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill let you choose missile Hit Locations against cursed targets.

description:c2a8b3e2e3ffdf6534baffdd.name: Deadlock
description:c2a8b3e2e3ffdf6534baffdd.text: Temporarily suppress one persistent spell or magic item; weapons and armour retain their ordinary function. Alternatively, prevent a caster using one spell you know from seeing them cast it or reading their grimoire. Overcasting: +6 SL suppresses a Waystone, Ogham Circle, Herdstone or Leyline Junction’s Channelling/Casting bonus (Winds of Magic pp. 194–197), but not an Arcane Fulcrum; gain Yenlui (Light). +9 SL suppresses an Arcane Fulcrum’s Magical Flux control (Winds of Magic p. 192); gain Yenlui (Light).

description:7e367ecd7f16f453eb9a0dda.name: Drain Magic
description:7e367ecd7f16f453eb9a0dda.text: Immediately Dispel persistent spells in the area without Extended Tests and remove accumulated channelled magic. Magic items and Ward are unaffected. Overcasting: +5 SL expands the area to Willpower yards and Difficult (−1 SL) Intelligence lets you exempt allies and yourself; +7 SL also Dispels persistent Blessings and Miracles and grants Yenlui (Light); +10 SL also suppresses magic items and Ward, and requires casters to pass Challenging (+0 SL) Channelling or lose spellcasting for 24 hours.

description:fc0dddc033f5ca26995d4aaf.name: Fiery Convocation
description:fc0dddc033f5ca26995d4aaf.text: Each creature initially in the area takes a Damage +5 magic missile and 1 Ablaze Condition, repeated each subsequent Round even after leaving the area. Full immersion in water or sand removes the effect. Overcasting: +5 SL raises Damage to +6 in Round 2 and another +1 each following Round; gain Yenlui (Dark). +8 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Weapon Skill let you exempt allies.

description:0ba5fa61c87f6a1b928a4ddd.name: Fortune is Fickle
description:0ba5fa61c87f6a1b928a4ddd.text: The target Miscasts on every double on Channelling or Casting, regardless of Talents, ingredients or other protections. Their Casting cannot Critical, and Dispelling fails on doubles. Second Sight sees the distracting spirits as malign Qhaysh elementals. Overcasting: +4 SL makes doubles automatically fail non-spellcasting actions too; +6 SL makes Channelling/Casting doubles Major Miscasts and grants Yenlui (Dark).

description:a0404a6d39d4e07ae617f96b.name: Glamour of Teclis
description:a0404a6d39d4e07ae617f96b.text: Each Round, targets failing Very Hard (−3 SL) Navigation can only wander in a random direction at walking speed. Others see no maze, only dazed targets. After a target fails 3 Tests, Average (+2 SL) Leadership lets you choose its direction for the remainder; Test again for every change. Overcasting: +3 SL makes the effect last Intelligence Bonus hours for targets failing three Navigation Tests and grants Yenlui (Dark); +6 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Agility let you exempt allies.

description:0ee142d06a6dbf629b7fadd8.name: Greater Banishment
description:0ee142d06a6dbf629b7fadd8.text: Each Round, Daemonic and Undead creatures in the area take a Damage +8 magic missile, or +15 at Large Size or above; Unstable doubles this Damage. Destroyed Daemons cannot be summoned for 1,001 days; destroyed Undead can never be summoned again. Make a free Dispelling attempt against each Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic or Chaos spell in the area. Overcasting: each +1 SL adds +10 to Dispelling Tests; +4 SL and Average (+2 SL) Fellowship suppress evil or Chaotic magic items for the duration; +7 SL increases Damage to +15, or +30 at Large Size or above, and grants Yenlui (Light).

description:c4b99bb8d226c3cbfdd7162b.name: Hand of Glory
description:c4b99bb8d226c3cbfdd7162b.text: Allies gain 3d10 to one chosen Characteristic: Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative or Agility. Roll once for every target. Alternatively increase Movement by 2. Increased Toughness does not change Wounds. Overcasting: +3 SL removes all Broken Conditions from allies within Fellowship Bonus yards; +6 SL replaces the usual benefit with +3d10 to “all four Characteristics” (one roll shared across them) and +2 Movement; +8 SL removes all Broken and Fatigued Conditions from allies within Fellowship Bonus yards, heals them 1d10 Wounds, grants Immunity to Psychology (WFRP p. 340) for the duration, and gives Yenlui (Light).

description:d8a037775078758427a498ec.name: Invisible Eye
description:d8a037775078758427a498ec.text: Create a controllable invisible eye with Perception equal to your Language (Magick), Acute Sense (Sight) and Flight 120. Use its senses while your body is in a trance. It cannot pass solid objects and is destroyed by 3 Damage if detected. If someone interacts with your body, you may refocus on it, destroying the eye and gaining Surprised. Overcasting: +4 SL grants the eye Magical Sense, Second Sight and Dark Vision; +8 SL increases Range to Intelligence miles.

description:d225c1365b081e962ff65272.name: Shield of Saphery
description:d225c1365b081e962ff65272.text: Allies in the area gain Ward 9+. Each further High Magic spell you cast improves that Ward by 1. Overcasting: each +3 SL improves Ward by 1; +4 SL changes Range to half Willpower yards.

description:46f0030c031907443ced3e4d.name: Soul Quench
description:46f0030c031907443ced3e4d.text: A Damage +6 magic missile. Slain targets cannot become Ghosts or have their souls bound into leylines, Power Stones, Tree Kin or similar vessels. Overcasting: +3 SL turns slain bodies to dust; +7 SL doubles Range and Target, raises Damage to +11, and grants Yenlui (Dark).

description:fcbb204e60cfebd755745963.name: Tempest
description:fcbb204e60cfebd755745963.text: The tempest follows random vortex movement (Winds of Magic p. 21), skipping steps 1–2 and moving 2d10 yards at step 3. Each Round, creatures in the area take a Damage +4 magic missile and must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or lose 20 WS and BS for the tempest’s duration. Flying targets instead take Damage +5 and −1 SL on Athletics. Overcasting: +4 SL also requires Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to move; flying failures fall 50 yards per Round, and all BS Tests take −30. +5 SL also inflicts a Damage +15 magic missile each Round on buildings and war machines in the area. +8 SL and Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative let you exempt allies.

description:922971e819674eb2acb0e9ae.name: Walk between Worlds
description:922971e819674eb2acb0e9ae.text: Allies gain Ethereal and double Movement. Overcasting: +5 SL and Hard (−2 SL) Willpower extend Duration to Intelligence Bonus minutes; +8 SL lets targets at a suitable geomantic nexus use the Paths of the Old Ones to reach any other nexus you choose, regardless of distance.

description:ffb63b0e435f52b62e7b818f.name: Artist’s Touch
description:ffb63b0e435f52b62e7b818f.text:
Give a non-magical item you are crafting Fine. Other Qualities and Flaws are determined normally.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:0a2be7d51411e04b7cdf315c.name: Patience of Vaul
description:0a2be7d51411e04b7cdf315c.text:
For a non-magical item you are crafting, reduce each required Extended Test’s SL total to one quarter without reducing the finished quality.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:c90c57a0fba08c6f21ad2005.name: Vaul’s Grace
description:c90c57a0fba08c6f21ad2005.text:
Give a non-magical weapon or armour piece you are crafting Lightweight. When crafting a magical item, still Test Trade (Smith) to determine its other Qualities or Flaws.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:b4bab093c7b66ab48f778a5c.name: Vaul’s Rage
description:b4bab093c7b66ab48f778a5c.text:
Your forge explodes. Others within Willpower Bonus yards take a Damage +6 magic missile to a random location ignoring Armour, gain 2 Ablaze, and must pass Dodge or gain Prone and Stunned. Everyone within 2 × Willpower Bonus yards takes a Damage +3 hit to a random location and 1 Ablaze. Flammable terrain ignites. You and your tools are unaffected.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:09545b116da6579622cd282b.name: Divination of Flames
description:09545b116da6579622cd282b.text:
Sacrifice: 1 item. Detect and remotely see every creature within Intelligence yards of the targeted forge or campfire, including hidden creatures, regardless of line of sight or your distance. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL detects invisible creatures; +3 SL lets you target detected creatures with spells without line of sight, provided they are in range.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:c9f874424fc8284b17459804.name: Divination of Stones
description:c9f874424fc8284b17459804.text:
Sacrifice: 1 item. Detect rare minerals useful for magic items and where to dig for buried deposits. The GM decides presence and quantity; mountainous regions have a suggested 50% chance, usually yielding enough for 1d10 Encumbrance of magic items. These minerals improve the crafting Lore (Magic) Test from Very Hard (−3 SL) to Difficult (−1 SL) (Archives II p. 54). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL also detects ithilmar, found only at Vaul’s Anvil in Caledor.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:1e9673235326cf50b50dd366.name: Fires of Perfection
description:1e9673235326cf50b50dd366.text:
Sacrifice: Blindness. Ignore any Flaws, Quirks or Curses rolled while crafting the targeted magical item (Archives II p. 54). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL allows another crafting spell of Vaul on that item despite its normal non-magical-item restriction.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:645a06825c869b024bbbff05.name: Wisdom of the Skysteel
description:645a06825c869b024bbbff05.text:
Sacrifice: Blindness. With the required ithilmar ore and rare minerals, use a Crafting Endeavour to forge a non-magical ithilmar item, reducing its Encumbrance by 2 (minimum 0). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +4 SL instantly makes an ithilmar item as brittle as dry wood and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark). +6 SL permits crafting a magical ithilmar item (Archives II p. 54), without another enhancing spell of Vaul; choose this option only at the start, but make progress only while this spell remains active.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:576fa1b7ad411549eb6d65c8.name: Fortress of Hotek
description:576fa1b7ad411549eb6d65c8.text:
Sacrifice: Blindness. Give your forge’s chamber or building one defence: Flame Barrier surrounds it with Firewall (WFRP p. 248); Magical Armour protects you inside with Glittering Robe (p. 250); Metal Ward applies Crucible of Chamon (p. 249) to metal touching its walls, with exemptions chosen at casting; Strengthened Doors makes ordinary doors TB 5/W 15 and reinforced doors gates at TB 10/W 30, harmed only by siege weapons. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL adds one further listed defence.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:224056d8258a4fb405114341.name: Fishbonding
description:224056d8258a4fb405114341.text:
Befriend a non-magical, non-predatory fish of any Size; a fish that would not normally attack an Elf qualifies. Hostile fish become neutral towards you but may attack allies; neutral fish become friendly and defend you if able; friendly fish can be ridden with the appropriate Ride Skill. This does not enable communication.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:5d7c6fac616f37b399e2d166.name: Stormsense
description:5d7c6fac616f37b399e2d166.text:
Learn nearby storms’ direction, movement speed, intensity, duration, whether they are strengthening or subsiding, and whether they are magical.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:7139a8a5d8a15c1344a8abe2.name: Ocean’s Fury
description:7139a8a5d8a15c1344a8abe2.text:
Create a non-magical, undispellable storm: Near Gale for Willpower Bonus minutes, Strong Gale for the next Willpower Bonus minutes, then Violent Storm for the remaining duration (Sea of Claws p. 107).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:e7b750d93e7e8f1f82975ed2.name: Spirits of the Waves
description:e7b750d93e7e8f1f82975ed2.text:
Summon a wind elemental from ocean currents. While concentrating you move it 2d10 yards per Round; otherwise it follows random vortex movement (Winds of Magic p. 21). A struck ship suffers a Critical Hit to rigging (Sea of Claws p. 118). Within 50 yards, Visibility improves one level and Wind intensity drops one level (p. 106). Each +3 SL summons another elemental.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:616adec95331f7b0eb15cb08.name: Armour of Mathlann
description:616adec95331f7b0eb15cb08.text:
Sacrifice: +2 Fatigued Conditions. A single-masted ship’s hull gains Armour 2 with no weight penalty (Sea of Claws p. 97); rigging and crew are excluded. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL permits a ship one mast larger; +4 SL grants Armour 3 instead; +6 SL also protects rigging and crew against missiles.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:6aba871a121eb5590d2ce79b.name: Call of the Seas
description:6aba871a121eb5590d2ce79b.text:
Sacrifices: +2 Fatigued Conditions and −2 Wounds. Summon a Merwyrm (Sea of Claws p. 145), emerging after one full Round that does not count towards Duration. You cannot communicate with or control it. For Fishbonding it counts as neutral and non-predatory during the spell. It returns to the sea when the spell ends. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL makes it friendly for Fishbonding; +8 SL prevents its departure at expiry and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:5e0b5e6ca391d66ecf90d572.name: Cloak of Mathlann
description:5e0b5e6ca391d66ecf90d572.text:
Sacrifices: +2 Fatigued Conditions and −1 Wound. Fog conceals a single-masted ship and crew, imposing −3 SL on perception and ranged attacks against it. Challenging (+0 SL) Perception can notice its wake or fog eddies. Black arks and sea monsters are excluded. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: each +2 SL permits one additional mast; +8 SL permits black arks and sea monsters and shifts you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:c308eafbf17601ed0048a2a7.name: Mistress of the Deep
description:c308eafbf17601ed0048a2a7.text:
Sacrifices: +1 Fatigued Condition and −1 Wound. Summon a stationary, non-attacking Oceanid. Each Round, characters within 20 yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become Helpless (WFRP p. 162), able only to approach it. Use Syreen (Sea of Claws p. 145), Naiad (Death on the Reik Companion p. 88, recommended) or Siren (Imperial Zoo p. 86). It swims away when the spell ends. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +5 SL exempts you from its song; +3 SL lets you direct its movement at Movement 6, but not attacks.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:619aea711ee1d3b961c35ff2.name: Waterlungs
description:619aea711ee1d3b961c35ff2.text:
Sacrifice: +1 Fatigued Condition. The target breathes underwater as easily as air. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +4 SL also makes sight, hearing and smell work underwater as in air; a separate +4 SL option makes air cause Drowning and Suffocation (WFRP p. 181), draws the target towards water and permits breathing from a bucketful, shifting you towards Yenlui (Dark).

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:95a604d3b8a4ea45611be279.name: Writhing Mists
description:95a604d3b8a4ea45611be279.text:
Sacrifice: +1 Fatigued Condition. Allies in the mist gain +20 Stealth, and ranged attacks against them take −20 to hit. Leaving the area removes protection. The mist is stationary and ends if you stop concentrating. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL lets you move it up to Willpower Bonus yards each Round; a separate +3 SL option gives allies inside Fear 1.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:f1632e8d9384a7a877a6af16.name: Divine Stylus
description:f1632e8d9384a7a877a6af16.text:
Write luminous characters with your fingertip on solid surfaces or in mid-air, using any language you know. They shed candlelight and last Willpower Bonus hours. You cannot draw pictures.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:47059c4f07db63bd6ced03a6.name: Enlightenment
description:47059c4f07db63bd6ced03a6.text:
An animal gains +20 Intelligence and Willpower and loses Bestial and Skittish. It can understand and express more complex ideas, but may forget information when the spell ends.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:d4ead60e4b8964b74a1036cd.name: Arcane Insight
description:d4ead60e4b8964b74a1036cd.text:
Learn an item or artefact’s magical abilities, curses and bound beings. Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence reveals how it was made; extra SL provide information about its creator. Understanding a powerful artefact well enough to duplicate or repair it may require an Extended Intelligence Test across repeated castings.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:a989690060def85b9fdbf5b7.name: Greater Spirit Bond
description:a989690060def85b9fdbf5b7.text:
For an Animal Familiar you already possess, extend Animal Telepathy and Companion’s normal 4-yard range to Willpower miles (Archives III pp. 81–82). The distant bond cannot help spellcasting, but can work with Messenger and Sensory Sharing.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:56fa4c01404649175521c7f8.name: Crucible of Light
description:56fa4c01404649175521c7f8.text:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. Make a sword magical with Fast. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL adds Defensive or Precise; +5 SL gives it a mind and gives its wielder one level each of Combat Aware, Reaction Strike and Riposte; +7 SL makes bestowed Qualities permanent if cast during forging, with only one attempt per sword.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:0eb4cf570182d358f4fd5cfd.name: Mnemonic Control
description:0eb4cf570182d358f4fd5cfd.text:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. The target’s next Lore or non-magical Language Test automatically succeeds with SL equal to your Casting SL. There must be a plausible reason they encountered that knowledge before. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL permits the automatic success on their next Casting Test instead; +3 SL permits erasing one specific memory, excluding Skills and spells.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:2c1c0f5ec9496d53db5f55ad.name: Psychic Sending
description:2c1c0f5ec9496d53db5f55ad.text:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 10 SL total. Send a mental spoken message lasting up to one minute, in your own voice, to someone you previously met or corresponded with. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +3 SL includes a mental image; +4 SL permits a stranger whose full name you know.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:6ae25b4a28edd40a03800f56.name: Sacred Wards
description:6ae25b4a28edd40a03800f56.text:
Sacrifice: Extended Difficult (−1 SL) Research, 20 SL total. Ward an area with one effect, optionally exempting those with a password: Forgetfulness erases the last 24 hours’ memories on entry; Purity deals Mutations × 6 Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus/AP and bars Daemons; Surveillance lets you view the area by concentrating for a Round; Truthfulness prevents lies inside. Cast only once per area, but renew before expiry with CN 0, keeping the original area, duration and effects. Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +6 SL extends Duration to Intelligence Bonus weeks.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:69b913d8cb4e8b3afadda3ab.name: Soulcraft
description:69b913d8cb4e8b3afadda3ab.text:
Bind a Ghost into a waystone or leyline, with both in range. A mortal dead no more than one hour can have its ghost bound before departing for the spirit realm. An unwilling Ghost Opposes your Casting with Cool, increasing the effective CN by 1 per SL it scores.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:26a862a52be86a4311f73779.name: The Primary Words
description:26a862a52be86a4311f73779.text:
Sacrifice: Extended Hard (−2 SL) Research, 20 SL total. Communicate basic ideas with any mortal creature or animal. Advanced ideas may require Intelligence Tests by either or both parties. Others hear gibberish; those knowing Anoqeyån can grasp the exchange with Average (+2 SL) Language (Magick). Overcasting requires Yenlui Light: +2 SL enables advanced communication with species predating the Old Ones, including Dragons, Great Eagles, Fimir and most animals; +4 SL enables basic communication with spirits, elementals and Daemons.

Esoteric faith spell: a Mage needs a tutor or access to pertinent reading materials (p. 99). Sacrifices and referenced external creature/ship profiles remain GM references.

description:ac4262dad9e2108181c0fb01.name: Martial Arts
description:ac4262dad9e2108181c0fb01.text: Remove Undamaging from your unarmed attacks. Each later rank unlocks one Quality: Damaging, Defensive, Distract, Fast, Penetrating, Precise or Pummel. At combat’s start or your turn’s start, select one unlocked Quality to last until your next turn.

description:643dd601a03fc470eac5ff2d.name: Sword-dancing
description:643dd601a03fc470eac5ff2d.text: Gain Ritual of Cleansing free. Further techniques each cost 100 XP per technique already known. Performing them requires a Greatsword of Hoeth except in the book’s older traditions. Performance and Yenlui effects remain references.

description:da1cf9f206b8dae8ad0cfb3b.name: Blessed by Isha
description:da1cf9f206b8dae8ad0cfb3b.text: Elf only. Obtain the everqueen’s blessing in Ulthuan or Ariel’s in Athel Loren to unlock High Magic. See pp. 79–80 for all training requirements.

description:71a3b70b568967db4d37346d.name: High Magic
description:71a3b70b568967db4d37346d.text: Requires Blessed by Isha and one Channelling (Qhaysh) Advance. High Magic spells cost 200 XP per Intelligence Bonus band already known: 200, 400, 600, etc. No free spell is specified. The printed Talent adds rank to High Magic Overcasting SL and removes individual Wind-access restrictions for Colour casting. Adaptation warning: the source mentions ranks without a maximum; the user allows one creator purchase.

description:e8bc5039d6a3f3213ef1e82d.name: Lileath’s Blessing
description:e8bc5039d6a3f3213ef1e82d.text: Printed maximum: Initiative Bonus. Each rank adds +1 SL to Channelling (Qhaysh) Tests and allows one more simultaneous Ward-granting aura spell. Situational effects remain descriptive.

description:6bf9eb57f982d2a330ad9695.name: Uncouth Uranai
description:6bf9eb57f982d2a330ad9695.text: Reduce Standing by one when dealing with High Elves of Caledor, Ellyrion, Avelorn or Saphery. This does not apply in Eataine or the Outer Kingdoms. A cultural starting Talent; it does not permanently reduce general Status.

description:e4c89a808a6a7649456c5dbd.name: Blood of Aenarion
description:e4c89a808a6a7649456c5dbd.text: Optional High Elf ancestry: gain one starting Fate and choose Magical Prodigy or Martial Prodigy. A rolled mental-corruption result is a Psychology, not a Mutation. Make a weekly Average (+2 SL) Cool Test or enter Yenlui (Dark). Permanent effects and XP reductions apply in the creator; play effects remain references.

description:9ce6b919948ffa428b8043d7.name: Ritual of Cleansing
description:9ce6b919948ffa428b8043d7.text: Perform thirty precise forms over several minutes to enter meditation. At sunrise, you may shift Yenlui towards Light; at sunset, towards Dark.

description:a9d2aea8151cb0958b8c3bb9.name: Flight of the Phoenix
description:a9d2aea8151cb0958b8c3bb9.text: While not Engaged, throw your sword SB + WPB yards for its normal Damage with Penetrating. Each +1 SL adds 1 yard of Range and +1 Damage.

description:cb410b51dac648287938655c.name: Path of the Sun
description:cb410b51dac648287938655c.text: Gain one War Leader Talent level (WFRP p. 147) for Willpower Bonus Rounds. Each +1 SL grants another level or extends the effect by one Round.

description:52f7be91a58592c80fb019ac.name: Path of Frost
description:52f7be91a58592c80fb019ac.text: For Weapon Skill Bonus Rounds, successful strikes ignore 1 AP. During that period, add +10 to Critical Wound table rolls per +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test.

description:4819a8fb3a26384327a48868.name: Path of the Storm
description:4819a8fb3a26384327a48868.text: For Initiative Bonus Rounds, Oppose any missile attack with Melee (Two-handed); each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test adds one Round. This can break arrows and split gunpowder shot.

description:0c5ac0baf50d00bf9a047e85.name: Path of the Rain
description:0c5ac0baf50d00bf9a047e85.text: For Agility Bonus Rounds, gain +1 SL to Dodge Tests. Each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test adds another +1 SL to Dodge and one Round.

description:e0b7c54fce662f499e94de67.name: Shadows of Loec
description:e0b7c54fce662f499e94de67.text: Move up to SL × Movement yards, minimum 5 yards; terrain and obstacles apply normally. Enemies previously Engaged with you must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative Test or gain Surprised.

description:bc68c1f87fdc1ef251958499.name: Path of the Hawk
description:bc68c1f87fdc1ef251958499.text: Choose a target within Willpower Bonus yards. On a failed Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance Test, it suffers 10 + Sword-dancing SL Damage, ignoring armour but applying TB, and two Deafened Conditions. Each +1 SL on the Sword-dancing Test can add 1 yard to range and one target.

description:70d69199e7051898a02348c4.name: Path of Falling Water
description:70d69199e7051898a02348c4.text: Make one attack against every enemy Engaged with you and within weapon reach. Against an enemy with Swarm, you may make three attacks instead.

description:d58f4f8272bd8141098b3a98.name: Final Stroke of the Master
description:d58f4f8272bd8141098b3a98.text: The opponent must pass a Very Hard (−3 SL) Dodge Test or take the blow at +4 Damage, plus +1 Damage for each +1 SL on your Sword-dancing Test.

description:e2be04046d0f1b1c650ae9ab.name: Obsinite Club
description:e2be04046d0f1b1c650ae9ab.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:22236e1c0bc3c1949e4f1be7.name: Obsinite Spiked Maul
description:22236e1c0bc3c1949e4f1be7.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:8f5b2d0c6892d1e85c2d968d.name: Blowpipe
description:8f5b2d0c6892d1e85c2d968d.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:7ae8797622faa5bc68cc1013.name: Eagle Claw
description:7ae8797622faa5bc68cc1013.text: Elven artillery. Volley fire subtracts 4 Damage and requires a separate roll for each shot.

description:09a2360a76bfdc505ce6b6ce.name: Eagle Eye
description:09a2360a76bfdc505ce6b6ce.text: Printed compact Eagle Eye bolt thrower.

description:fb21770649ac0a2913be1c29.name: Blowpipe Dart (12)
description:fb21770649ac0a2913be1c29.text: Pack of twelve darts. Poison must be obtained separately. Price and Availability require a suitable Lustrian market.

description:199500df69a89b4dc74923ec.name: Waterlungs — Mathlann prayer
description:199500df69a89b4dc74923ec.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Hours. Targets breathe underwater but suffer Suffocation and Drowning in air (WFRP p. 181), feel drawn to water, and need only a bucketful to breathe. Each +2 SL adds one target.

description:1bbc0fe6a87cde7c5f9be7e7.name: Cloak of Mathlann — Mathlann prayer
description:1bbc0fe6a87cde7c5f9be7e7.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 boat or ship Duration: Fellowship minutes. A ship and crew become invisible, though those aboard still see its interior. Crew leaving become visible. Challenging (+0) Perception can notice the wake or fog eddies. Beyond one mast, each extra mast requires +2 SL. Black Arks and sea monsters are excluded.

description:861ced38d0430f874fe5a645.name: Volley
description:861ced38d0430f874fe5a645.text: May fire a number of simultaneous shots equal to the Quality's level. Roll each hit separately; Volley fire reduces Damage by 4.

description:d5c99104236cd570253cf60b.name: Contracting Thought Fog
description:d5c99104236cd570253cf60b.text:
| 1d10 | Test to avoid Thought Fog |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Challenging (+0) Endurance |
| 2 | Difficult (−10) Endurance |
| 3 | Hard (−20) Endurance |
| 4–6 | Challenging (+0) Cool |
| 7–8 | Difficult (−10) Cool |
| 9–10 | Hard (−20) Cool |

description:0baebbafb614f9ef2e53c42e.name: Lustrian Weather
description:0baebbafb614f9ef2e53c42e.text:
At each expedition Stage’s start, the GM rolls 1d10 for weather and applies its effects and modifiers.

| Weather | Wet season d10 | Dry season d10 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stifling Humidity | 1 | 1–4 |
| All is Well | 2 | 5–6 |
| Lingering Vapours | 3–4 | 7 |
| Rain Showers | 5–6 | 8 |
| Torrential Downpour | 7–8 | 9 |
| Tropical Storm | 9–10 | 10 |

description:a4d50fa00dfb1434180dc33e.name: Telepathy
description:a4d50fa00dfb1434180dc33e.text: Transmit and read thoughts without speech. A resisting subject must pass the printed Average (+20) Cool Test to prevent thought-reading.

description:339cf2ad34a38459a59ee231.name: Chameleon
description:339cf2ad34a38459a59ee231.text: Spotting it with Perception suffers −4 SL, or −2 SL while it moves. Ranged attacks against it suffer −2 SL.

description:8427b4ea3084d95c44d51066.name: Flammable
description:8427b4ea3084d95c44d51066.text: Tests to avoid Ablaze suffer the printed −20. Ablaze inflicts twice the Wounds it normally would.

description:35709712f61bab70c296a828.name: Grim (Lustria)
description:35709712f61bab70c296a828.text: At Turn start, raise Advantage to Grim Rating if currently lower. Entangled, Surprised or Unconscious prevents this gain. Under Up in Arms Group Advantage, instead generate Rating Advantage for the Adversary pool.

description:990beb1510289d46c6aaff62.name: Stationary Attacker
description:990beb1510289d46c6aaff62.text:
Immune to Psychology. Cannot relocate, pursue, manoeuvre, Charge, Flee, Leap, Run or Climb; only attack/Trait actions are available. An unaware target entering reach becomes Engaged and may be attacked with Surprised. Recognising the danger requires Challenging (+0) Perception to notice it, then suitable Lore to identify it; failing either leaves the threat unrecognised. Reach follows Size:

| Size | Reach |
| --- | --- |
| Tiny or Little | Very Short |
| Small | Short |
| Average | Medium |
| Large | Long |
| Enormous | Very Long |
| Monstrous | Massive |

description:58684f7bb5e22d933435b120.name: Giant Blowpipe
description:58684f7bb5e22d933435b120.text: Encumbrance: 6. Range: 40 yards. Damage: +0. Qualities and Flaws: Reload 1. Uses darts (p. 163). Uses the artillery rules in Sea of Claws or Up in Arms.

description:cd21cc85cea60a1eef2594bd.name: Giant Bow
description:cd21cc85cea60a1eef2594bd.text: Encumbrance: 15. Range: 100 yards. Damage: +10. Qualities and Flaws: Accurate, Crewed 2, Reload 2. Uses arrows. Uses the artillery rules in Sea of Claws or Up in Arms.

description:bacdc32a3d2948ff796b31b3.name: Engine of the Gods’ Burning Alignment
description:bacdc32a3d2948ff796b31b3.text: Encumbrance: 75. Range: 60 yards. Damage: +8. Qualities and Flaws: Blast 5, Crewed 3, Magical, Salvo 1d10. Every affected target also receives 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Requires the Winds of Magic; does not require ammunition. Uses the artillery rules in Sea of Claws or Up in Arms.

description:3f38c5ca3c909ac7b49437fa.name: Engine of the Gods’ Power of the Ancients
description:3f38c5ca3c909ac7b49437fa.text: Encumbrance: 40. Range: 150 yards. Damage: +15. Qualities and Flaws: Crewed 3, Imprecise, Magical, Reload 3. Every affected target also receives 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Requires the Winds of Magic; does not require ammunition. Uses the artillery rules in Sea of Claws or Up in Arms.

description:eb26d2c0252a23f8e9b04c27.name: Solar Engine’s Beam of Chotec
description:eb26d2c0252a23f8e9b04c27.text: Encumbrance: 75. Range: 60 yards. Damage: +1d10. Qualities and Flaws: Crewed 3, Magical, Repeater 5. Every affected target also receives 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Requires the Winds of Magic; does not require ammunition. Uses the artillery rules in Sea of Claws or Up in Arms.

description:b025b4904db55de0492a0d29.name: Apotheosis — Lustria version
description:b025b4904db55de0492a0d29.text: CN: 4 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: 1 Round. The target heals Willpower Bonus Wounds and gains Fear 1 temporarily. Overcasting: each +3 SL heals another Willpower Bonus Wounds; +6 SL heals a Critical Wound. Slann: each +2 SL can increase the target’s Fear rating by 1.

description:34dc41f01bd7d87d95b265f2.name: Arcane Unforging — Lustria version
description:34dc41f01bd7d87d95b265f2.text: CN: 9 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant. Deal 1 Damage to the body per 2 AP worn across all locations, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring AP. Challenging (+0) Willpower also destroys one random magic item. Overcasting: each +1 SL can destroy 1 AP of metal or leather armour; +8 SL increases Damage to 1 per AP. Slann: each +5 SL permits another destruction Test against a random magic item.

description:15557f4edc06c5a8a9c93fe2.name: Drain Magic — Lustria version
description:15557f4edc06c5a8a9c93fe2.text: CN: 6 Range: Half Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus Yards) Duration: Instant. Dispel all persistent spells in the area without an Extended Test. Magic items and innate magical auras are unaffected. Overcasting: +5 SL expands the area to Willpower yards; +7 SL also dispels persistent Divine Blessings and Miracles. Slann: each +4 SL can desaturate one leyline nexus or reduce environmental saturation by one level in the area (Winds of Magic p. 189).

description:bf2c611645cf2a37bd80621e.name: Walk Between Worlds — Lustria version
description:bf2c611645cf2a37bd80621e.text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus Yards) Duration: 1 Round. Selected targets gain Ethereal and double Movement. Overcasting: Slann +4 SL, or High Elves +8 SL, lets targets at a suitable geomantic nexus traverse the Paths of the Old Ones to another nexus you choose, without a distance limit. Wood Elves +6 SL lets targets in a magical forest enter the Worldroots and reach another Weave; they choose paths but may become lost without guidance.

description:9667dc26012fa7204bbbc9e9.name: Shroud of Fog
description:9667dc26012fa7204bbbc9e9.text: Create non-magical fog that limits visibility to 10 yards and cannot be Dispelled.

description:d9a77c8beca1c8b302d54d33.name: Uproot the Mountains
description:d9a77c8beca1c8b302d54d33.text: Shake a hill or mountain. At the start of each target’s Round, Very Hard (−3 SL) Athletics is required to avoid Prone and losing all actions and movement. Overcasting: each extra Round of Duration lets you move the terrain Willpower Bonus yards; anyone in its path must pass Average (+2 SL) Athletics or take 10 Damage to a random location. +5 SL can trigger an avalanche, requiring Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge from anyone in its path to avoid 15 Damage to a random location.

description:e5848d07bb4fd07a65a0e464.name: Earth Line
description:e5848d07bb4fd07a65a0e464.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Send energy along a leyline in your chosen direction to the next nexus. Anyone on it must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or take 15 body Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Overcasting: +4 SL creates an undispellable bridge 8 yards wide along the leyline, of any length across water of any depth, lasting Willpower Bonus hours; +6 SL clears an 8-yard-wide path through forest or jungle along the line.

description:edde0a41aee90e7b5f56763b.name: Ruination of Cities
description:edde0a41aee90e7b5f56763b.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Collapse an unfortified building, wall or bridge into Difficult terrain. Occupants must pass Hard (−2 SL) Dodge or take 20 body Damage and become buried, suffering Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Overcasting extra targets must select those nearest the first. Ground between them opens into a crevasse 2 yards wide and 4 yards deep; Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge avoids falling, while a Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. +6 SL permits fortified targets such as castle walls or towers.

description:848a900fbd04f5032ea70227.name: Mental Blast
description:848a900fbd04f5032ea70227.text: Slann only; requires a geomantic nexus or leyline within Willpower Bonus miles. Enemies take Intelligence Bonus + 6 Damage, plus 6 if Daemonic or Undead, allowing Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour. Average (+2 SL) Intelligence is also required to avoid Stunned. Overcasting: +6 SL, The Deliverance of Itza, changes Target diameter to AoE (Half Willpower yards), centred on the caster and expandable normally. +9 SL, The Great Leveller, sacrifices the Slann to kill enough outnumbering enemies in line of sight to equal the Slann’s allies in number, taking lowest Intelligence first. Only spending a Fate Point prevents a Character’s resulting instant death.

description:6e057defc70c1a0c0b4844a3.name: Waterlungs (Mathlann)
description:6e057defc70c1a0c0b4844a3.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. Targets breathe underwater but suffer Suffocation and Drowning in air (WFRP p. 181), feel drawn to water, and need only a bucketful to breathe. Each +2 SL adds one target.

description:a7213a47452d5f87c920d2ad.name: Cloak of Mathlann (Mathlann)
description:a7213a47452d5f87c920d2ad.text: Only Elven Priests of Mathlann may use this Miracle. A ship and crew become invisible, though those aboard still see its interior. Crew leaving become visible. Challenging (+0) Perception can notice the wake or fog eddies. Beyond one mast, each extra mast requires +2 SL. Black Arks and sea monsters are excluded.

description:9812056d4b0655da5ed38d4c.name: Obsinite Club
description:9812056d4b0655da5ed38d4c.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:9d7d30a5664b8d87a222129a.name: Obsinite Spiked Maul
description:9d7d30a5664b8d87a222129a.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:3e3e712acb12757ef17494c7.name: Blowpipe
description:3e3e712acb12757ef17494c7.text: Price and Availability apply to Lustrian markets; no Old World prices are supplied.

description:83c1d34988389f35c3c79396.name: Eagle Claw
description:83c1d34988389f35c3c79396.text: Elven artillery. Volley fire subtracts 4 Damage and requires a separate roll for each shot.

description:4d95c547cecef6a8c67cc7d4.name: Eagle Eye
description:4d95c547cecef6a8c67cc7d4.text: Printed compact Eagle Eye bolt thrower.

description:704c5dd035c8d8584a4b9034.name: Evawn
description:704c5dd035c8d8584a4b9034.text: Travel, Trade and Thievery patron. Strictures: give Evawn one coin in ten; profit daily through barter or theft; never be exposed as a liar; stay nowhere longer than one month; return useful stolen goods to your clan. Use the listed core Miracles with this god’s presentation (p. 90), retaining Fifth Edition effects and normal learning prices. Approved mapping: Rich Man, Poor Man, Beggar Man, Thief becomes Trickster’s Glamour. Strictures remain references, without tracking or automatic payments.

description:3d31b78c396662df0c0a8505.name: Mabyn
description:3d31b78c396662df0c0a8505.text: Shadows, Revenge and Magic patron. Strictures: defend Gnome burrows at any cost; avenge wrongs to you, your clan or burrow; hide your home burrow from outsiders; practise swordplay at least an hour daily; remain unseen when attempting concealment. Use the listed core Miracles with this god’s presentation (p. 90), retaining Fifth Edition effects and normal learning prices. Approved mapping: You Ain’t Seen Me, Right? becomes You Saw Nothing. Strictures remain references, without tracking or automatic payments.

description:1374176d6bac5556af5ee0b1.name: Ringil
description:1374176d6bac5556af5ee0b1.text: Entertainment, Merriment and Trickery patron. Strictures: accept reasonable requests to entertain; protect secrets within clan, cult or cronies; interrupt solemnity with humour, music or tricks; revenge through practical jokes; discover one useful secret weekly. Use the listed core Miracles with this god’s presentation (p. 90), retaining Fifth Edition effects and normal learning prices. Strictures remain references, without tracking or automatic payments.

description:ccfac046e26742dea1828bf0.name: Reveal the Inner Beauty
description:ccfac046e26742dea1828bf0.text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant. A touched inorganic object becomes brittle and unusable; organic material ripens rapidly into spoilage. A living target must pass Challenging (+0) Toughness or age 2d10 years and permanently lose −1d10% from Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, Strength, Toughness, Agility and Dexterity.

description:27247cfa2ac87fc967471ab4.text: Adaptation warning: user-approved proposed adaptation: start Gnomes at Fate 2 and Fortune 2, with no discretionary points. The source instead gives Fate 2, Resilience 0 and two extra points, without Fifth Edition values. Apply normal Fifth Edition random-creation bonuses.

description:0ee1e48dfe0250c592caeadf.text: One Language (Magick) Advance lets a Gnome attempt Dispelling without a casting Talent. Gnome wizards may learn Shadows, Dark Magic and Chaos Magic; their society outlaws Necromancy, Daemonology and every Chaos Magic Lore. The creator supports only Shadows through normal Arcane Lore selection; dark/Chaos training and live Dispelling are deferred.

description:823e10ef7d021eec430b6ed5.text: Inherit clan from the mother; marriage does not change it, though an epithet may conceal it. Eyes grey with age, usually completely by 200, while hair eventually turns deep silver. Use the source’s 2d10 appearance tables without added age thresholds or reroll rules.

description:ea2ec6fcddfb7ffd3d822ee3.text: Approved Fifth Edition Small adaptation: Wounds are 2 × Toughness Bonus, with another Toughness Bonus from Hardy (core pp. 120, 361). Do not use the older 2 × TB + WPB formula. Record Small separately from the five Species Talent slots.

description:d78409eda200f17aa05b6ebf.name: Suffuse with Ulgu
description:d78409eda200f17aa05b6ebf.text: Substitute Channelling (Ulgu) for Stealth on relevant Tests. Successful Lore of Shadow casting within 8 yards gains +1 SL once, regardless of how many characters have this Talent nearby. Adaptation warning: no Fifth Edition equivalent; the user retains the printed maximum of one and effects as references. The creator does not substitute displayed Stealth, apply nearby casting SL or import Fourth Edition per-rank Test bonuses.

description:11a92c455cfecdbb57cdae37.name: Enchanted Masks
description:11a92c455cfecdbb57cdae37.text:
Choose a personality-matched mask or roll d10.

| d10 | Personality; aspect | Example masks | Effects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Angry, warlike, proud; Kharnath | Hound, Bold Man, Enraged Woman, Bull, Spiked Mask | Frenzy and Magic Resistance; cannot cast spells or pray for Blessings/Miracles; +30 WS, +10 I, −20 Fel. |
| 3–4 | Humorous, pessimistic, kindly; Neiglen | Crow, Smiling Man, Starving Woman, Pitted Wood | Hardy; −20 to resist Disease; +20 T, −10 Ag, +5 Fel. |
| 5–6 | Greedy, lustful, friendly; Shornaal | Beautiful Man, Leering Woman, Serpent, Dragonfly | Ambidextrous and Distract; +10 I, +20 Ag, +10 Fel, −15 WP. |
| 7–8 | Cautious, cunning, patient; Tchar | Eagle, Sly Woman, Trickster, Swirling Patterns, Faceless | Scheming and Second Sight; +20 Int, +10 WP; +1 Corruption point on a failed exposure Test. |
| 9–10 | Moody, acquisitive, flexible; Mermedus | Fish, Drowned Man, Carved Scales, Eel, Seaweed-covered Face | Furious Assault and Sea Legs; +50 to Swim Tests; breathe underwater. |

Wearing one for over an hour or using any effect causes Moderate Corruption Exposure. Removing it leaves effects lasting d10 + 4 days; the removed mask loses its magic.

description:69e8f2b613a963635cdb424c.name: Chokan’s Fate rewards
description:69e8f2b613a963635cdb424c.text:
Offer a shiny object and pray for a 5% chance of a reward, then roll d100.

| d100 | Reward | Later cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 01–33 | A pivotal moment: gain 2 Fortune, even above maximum; at next session’s refresh, Fortune returns to Fate as usual. | Next Fortune spent causes 1 Corruption point without a resistance Test. |
| 34–66 | Clear foresight: gain Luck. | Next Fortune spent causes 1 Corruption point; test Cool normally to avoid another. |
| 67–00 | Fate revealed: gain 1 Fate. | Next Fate spent causes 2 Corruption points without a resistance Test. |

description:76579c619c410f13386eadc2.name: Dooming — Spite ability
description:76579c619c410f13386eadc2.text: Innately gains the equivalent of Blessed (Morr) and the Dooming Miracle, without allegiance to a Human god. Uses Willpower for Dooming, not Invoke.

description:2164bb1ab7a474ce5dc9b5b6.name: Prospecting Factors
description:2164bb1ab7a474ce5dc9b5b6.text:
| Prospecting factor | Modifier |
| --- | --- |
| You or a companion pass an initial Challenging (+0) Lore (Geology) Test | +1 SL |
| You or a companion have Second Sight and recognise Chamon | +1 SL |
| You or a companion pass an initial Difficult (−10) Lore (Local) Test | +1 SL |
| You or a companion pass an initial Challenging (−20) Gossip Test | +1 SL |
| Gnistre was recently nearby or beneath the area | +2 SL |
| Spend at least 2 extra weeks searching | +1 SL |
| Other prospectors currently search nearby | −1 SL |
| Previously searched area | −2 SL |
| Previously searched by Dwarf prospectors | −4 SL |

description:4c715dfeced72f6b2aae4be3.name: Size of Strike
description:4c715dfeced72f6b2aae4be3.text:
| SL | Result |
| --- | --- |
| +6 or more | Motherlode: supports up to twenty miners. |
| +4 to +5 | Rich Vein: supports up to ten miners. |
| +2 to +3 | Lucky Strike: supports up to five miners. |
| +0 to +1 | Hardscrabble: supports up to two miners. |
| −0 to −1 | Nothing; search elsewhere. |
| −2 to −3 | Nothing; one tool breaks. |
| −4 to −5 | Nothing; one tool breaks and you fall d10 yards. |
| −6 or more | Nothing; enter Beastman, Goblin or Dwarf territory and must flee. |

description:25cd1de29f246880e8b0771d.name: Mining Equipment
description:25cd1de29f246880e8b0771d.text:
| Equipment | Cost | Maintenance | Benefit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bellows | 20 GC | 1 GC/month | Ignore Suffocation events. |
| Caged Canaries | 1 GC | — | Mitigate Bad Air. |
| Elevator | 20 GC | 1 GC/month | Each miner produces 10 extra shillings of ore weekly. |
| Fortification | 40 GC | — | Ignore Attack! events. |
| Guild Membership | 20 GC | 20% of profits | Mitigate some events; +1 Status Tier for Charm/Gossip; Language (Guilder), Secret Signs (Guilder) and Etiquette (Guilders) become Career-available. |
| Pumps | 40 GC | 2 GC/month | Ignore Flooding events. |

description:36f00bb0cb57abbe7535b7dc.name: Mine Events
description:36f00bb0cb57abbe7535b7dc.text:
Roll for a mine event at each month’s end or during downtime.

| Roll | Event and effect |
| --- | --- |
| 01–50 | Quiet Month: normal operation. |
| 51–53 | Petering Out: Motherlode becomes Rich Vein, Rich Vein becomes Lucky Strike, Lucky Strike becomes Hardscrabble, or Hardscrabble ceases production. |
| 54–55 | New Find: an actively managing owner may pass Challenging (+0) Perception to discover another strike. Otherwise an employee claims it and becomes a competitor. |
| 56–65 | Flooding: without pumps, d10 miners must pass Challenging (+0) Swim or drown; work stops for two weeks. |
| 66–68 | Inspired Workforce: each miner produces 1 GC extra ore this month. |
| 69–74 | Attack!: fortification sends attackers elsewhere; otherwise lose 2d10 employees. With none left, the mine is captured. Paid-up guild membership provides help organising its recapture. |
| 75–78 | Legal Entanglements: an employed Lawyer or guild membership resolves the claim. Otherwise lose d10 months of output and hire a Lawyer in that time or pass Very Hard (−30) Charm to avoid losing the mine. |
| 79–83 | Labour Strike: guild members replace dissenters. Otherwise the owner or Foreman must pass Challenging (+0) Leadership or work stops until weekly pay increases by –/6. |
| 84–87 | Corruption: a random employee steals 2d10 shillings of ore weekly. At next month’s end, Hard (−20) Gossip identifies them; failure lets them flee with d10 GC of ore. |
| 88–90 | Bad Air: each miner must pass Difficult (−10) Endurance or succumb to gas; Caged Canaries improve this to Average (+20). |
| 91–94 | Suffocation: bellows prevent loss; otherwise lose d10 miners. |
| 95–97 | Cave In: the owner or employed Engineer tests Difficult (−10) Trade (Engineer). Success limits losses to one week’s excavation and shoring. Failure traps 2d10 miners, each needing Difficult (−10) Climb to survive. |
| 98–99 | Equipment Malfunction: a random piece fails. Owner or employed Engineer may pass Hard (−20) Trade (Engineer) for emergency repairs; failure requires a replacement. |
| 00 | New Seam: employ up to five additional miners. |

description:d503c15f0e9babadcb6e2ec3.name: Night Goblin Net
description:d503c15f0e9babadcb6e2ec3.text: Night Goblin net. Group: Night Goblins; Reach: SB × 2; Damage: —; Entangle (Strength 40).

description:b0cb6bfb9f35f696cae997dd.name: Bribery for smuggled cargo
description:b0cb6bfb9f35f696cae997dd.text:
For smuggled cargo, consider honesty, risk and relevant Skills/Talents when setting Bribery Tests (WFRP p. 120). Without special circumstances, persuading authorities to overlook it is never easier than Challenging (+0).

| Difficulty | Modifier | Cargo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Challenging | 0 | Taxed ordinary goods: wool, cloth, leather, beer or paper. |
| Difficult | −10 | Luxuries: fine wines/spirits, quality cloth, silk, perfume or fancy feathers. |
| Hard | −20 | Banned ordinary goods: weapons, armour or intoxicants. |
| Very Hard | −30 | Treasonous/heretical cargo: anti-Sigmarite texts, necromantic ingredients, warpstone or forbidden books. |

description:5f8aceb5af63c2bffa081b89.name: Community Size ratings
description:5f8aceb5af63c2bffa081b89.text:
Village: Population Size: 1–200; Rating: 1.

Small Town: Population Size: 201–1,500; Rating: 2.

Town: Population Size: 1,501–10,000; Rating: 3.

City: Population Size: More than 10,000; Rating: 4.

description:df58bfccb460e56928b47004.name: Community Wealth ratings
description:df58bfccb460e56928b47004.text:
Squalid: Rating: 0.

Poor: Rating: 1.

Average: Rating: 2.

Bustling: Rating: 3.

Prosperous: Rating: 4.

Wealthy: Rating: 5.

description:5d2cd9d3c6c3a4eeecfbebad.name: Smuggled Goods Generator
description:5d2cd9d3c6c3a4eeecfbebad.text:
Roll d100.

| d100 | Goods | Cost Modifier | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01–60 | Taxed, Ordinary | 50% | Cloth, wool, preserved foods, metal ore. |
| 61–85 | Taxed, Luxury | 60% | Fine brandy/wine, quality cloth, silk, art. |
| 86–95 | Banned, Ordinary | 70% | Prohibited ordinary or luxury goods. |
| 96–99 | Banned, Special | 80% | Gunpowder, weapons, stolen unique luxuries, heresy or magic items. |
| 00 | Treason! | 90% | Necromancy, Daemonology, Chaos or threats to an Elector’s safety/rule. |

Taxed Ordinary, Taxed Luxury and Banned Ordinary sell at Consumer Guide list prices (WFRP p. 288). Cost Modifier gives the average discounted buying price for the goods’ tax/legal risk. The GM prices Banned Special and Treason! items. These are bargaining starting points: except for Treason!, a successful Opposed Challenging (+0) Haggle Test reduces price another 10%; failure leaves it unchanged. Bargain for Treason! goods through roleplay.

description:f35cd1ce500eed5ac13c3152.name: Smuggling Events
description:f35cd1ce500eed5ac13c3152.text:
A Smuggler taking Income during downtime also rolls d10 here alongside normal events. Resulting questions mainly provide flavour; the GM may develop them into adventures.

| d10 | Event and effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Ratted Out!: pass Hard (−20) Stealth or earn nothing. |
| 2 | Desperate Seller: may earn 50% extra from unusually cheap contraband. |
| 3 | Help! The Watch!: pass Hard (−20) Perception or stolen goods leave no income. |
| 4 | Flooded Market: may earn 50% less. |
| 5 | Lucky Find: gain d10 GC in addition to normal income. |
| 6 | New Partners: double income, but unless Difficult (−10) Charm succeeds, the local crime boss demands a 60% employer’s share. |
| 7 | It Must Be Mine!: pass Average (+20) Haggle to double income, or triple it with Dealmaker. |
| 8 | Switcheroo: pass Hard (−20) Evaluate or worthless/spoiled goods yield no income. |
| 9 | Market Day: roll Earnings twice and use the higher amount. |
| 10 | Corruption: earn nothing; pay d10 shillings in bribes or Income is unavailable until moving to another town/city. |

description:1e444dd33ee6d37f4ca113a8.text: An explicit alternative to Fifth Edition Pilot, printed as Huffer in Sea of Claws p. 68.

description:3f6fe61b0fd2819ab6032eb1.name: Priest of Stromfels
description:3f6fe61b0fd2819ab6032eb1.text: Sea of Claws p. 89 requires Strength to reach the next Career tier’s minimum before any other Characteristic or the priest gains Sin Points. Retain this as a Legacy stricture: Fifth Edition uses trackers, so no XP gate applies. Other strictures remain play rules.

description:233ecb23e6abe05823c51d27.name: Norse Dwarf Bolt
description:233ecb23e6abe05823c51d27.text: Ballista ammunition with Hullbreaker: against wooden structures, adds +2 Damage and gains Damaging. It is not automatically loaded.

description:8ce82a0cc0a851770d90029e.name: Bomb (Mortar)
description:8ce82a0cc0a851770d90029e.text: Mortar ammunition. The source specifies no unit or bundle quantity.

description:15ebd35f01489a0402b6a404.name: Incendiary (Mortar)
description:15ebd35f01489a0402b6a404.text: Distinct from core Incendiary weapons. Mortar ammunition causing 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions; unit or bundle quantity is unspecified.

description:fbe432ef1a61a315667fc098.name: Bjornling Norse
description:fbe432ef1a61a315667fc098.text: Suggested surnames join a printed Norse parent’s name to core Dwarf sson/dottir endings (Sea of Claws p. 56). Enter nicknames freely.

description:3be8e38a553553dba4746228.text: Suggested surnames join a printed Norse parent’s name to core Dwarf sson/dottir endings (Sea of Claws p. 56). Enter nicknames freely.

description:57844051aaa023b93a05784e.name: Hullbreaker
description:57844051aaa023b93a05784e.text: Against wooden structures, including ships, this ammunition gains Damaging and +2 Damage.

description:ba004c3481d30f447b99856c.name: Grubark Gearing System
description:ba004c3481d30f447b99856c.text: Cost: 400 GC; Encumbrance: 120. Fits Little through Average ships only. Minimum rowing crew becomes one quarter, rounded up. After a shift, rowers gain +1 SL to Endurance Tests against exhaustion. On an Oars Critical Hit, roll d10: 5+ also ruins the gearing.

description:178ff3f0cf4f4f2edd6f0ca7.text: Ballista Bolt: 4/–, Enc 0, Scarce, range as weapon, Damage —, Impale, Penetrating.
