description:2a2f281aff214f6aa0293538.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
description:2a2f281aff214f6aa0293538.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the light as a Lurkerfish lure. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool; fail again and become effectively Unconscious, able only to move towards the light.

description:6a16deeff29d43ac13540fcb.name: Slimy
description:6a16deeff29d43ac13540fcb.text: When Grappled, a successful Toughness Test gives the Latch-eel +4 SL on later escape Tests. The opponent must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or either release it or begin Suffocating.

description:d44b297c42bc60f066e28532.name: Love the Light
description:d44b297c42bc60f066e28532.text: Light/fire attracts Daggerfish rather than deterring them. Despite Bestial, they neither shy from fire nor gain Broken from flaming attacks.

description:734af464517e5569c3fed72d.name: Immersion
description:734af464517e5569c3fed72d.text: Inflicting Entangled through a Grapple pulls the victim inside the Sea Elemental, causing Suffocation. Escape by removing Entangled through Opposed Strength against its Strength 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, remains free to act and is not Engaged by that victim.

description:0c8a45cbab90a941b900948e.name: Mindless Spellcaster
description:0c8a45cbab90a941b900948e.text: Use Strength when Casting or Channelling.

description:9248866d61ed721d6376f60f.name: Boat Crusher
description:9248866d61ed721d6376f60f.text: Can constrict vessels of Size Large or less. First spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size, then Extended Opposed Strength against the vessel's Toughness; SL reaching its Wounds destroys it. Crew may attack or lever it off. A hit inflicting over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure releases the vessel. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL prevents squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.

description:0547941f6b9628aa0413fc1f.name: Electrical Discharge
description:0547941f6b9628aa0413fc1f.text: At the start of a turn after Grappling, spend 1 Momentum to shock the victim: 10 Damage, ignoring non-magical metal armour. If Wounds are lost, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Stunned. Each discharge also requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance from the Gargantuan; failure gives 1 Fatigued. While Fatigued, its shock deals 6 Damage. Shocking a Grappled boat harms no hull, but every crew member takes 6 Damage, or 3 while the Gargantuan is Fatigued.

description:8065d7bcab6d2a9579fb6e02.name: Whale Bane
description:8065d7bcab6d2a9579fb6e02.text: Fanged Maw attacks use Venom with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery. Causing Wounds applies Poisoned; the Test Difficulty governs recovery rather than avoiding the poison.

description:1b56e41518eaaefaeff319d1.name: Syreen’s Call
description:1b56e41518eaaefaeff319d1.text: Spend an Action singing. Anyone within the Syreen's Initiative in yards must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or become effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards it.

description:a5cf18cbfdd4c5ac5633e7c2.name: Resistant to Cold
description:a5cf18cbfdd4c5ac5633e7c2.text: An Endurance Test may negate the ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other sources.

description:a6f72262660b7224d1d7e6a2.name: Lure of the Leviathan
description:a6f72262660b7224d1d7e6a2.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) recognises the underwater light as a lure and allows looking away. Failure requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool or 1 Stunned.

description:9e19a218dd11e84bbad38a3a.name: Devastating Assault
description:9e19a218dd11e84bbad38a3a.text: Charging a ship causes a collision at CR 50.

description:f7496bc848f8800d85bffa84.name: On a Different Scale
description:f7496bc848f8800d85bffa84.text: Although Bestial, the Black Leviathan fears only flames at least as large/intense as a large bonfire. The GM similarly judges Fear/Terror by whether the source's size warrants its respect; insignificant threats do not concern it.

description:e6a2199acd1cfdd15c772982.name: Marine Creature
description:e6a2199acd1cfdd15c772982.text: The printed profile assumes water, where full Movement applies. On land, Movement becomes 1 and all Tests suffer −2 SL. Without regular dousing, it begins Suffocating.

description:a67bd55cc9c3ca4c06e1715c.name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
description:a67bd55cc9c3ca4c06e1715c.text: Cast while travelling towards a fixed destination whose location you know. For the duration, your Navigation Tests, including Crew Tests involving you, gain +2 SL.

description:5df6b5338e419fb4a38ddc9a.name: Niezlib’s Optimal Firing Solution
description:5df6b5338e419fb4a38ddc9a.text: Cannon-firing Tests gain +1 SL for the duration.

description:14f421bf2032d18d4801947d.name: Sea of Glass
description:14f421bf2032d18d4801947d.text: Ask everyone aboard to be silent, then close your eyes. Apply Doldrums from the Wind Effect Table (p. 107) for the duration.

description:0d419162b3b763eb7d95ba1b.name: Living Mire
description:0d419162b3b763eb7d95ba1b.text: Ensnare a ship at sea in seaweed, giving −2 Movement and −3 SL Manoeuvre. Its crew can cut it free with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Boat Handling Test requiring your Willpower Bonus + casting SL.

description:945ad3af3dcd286ea238c026.name: Water Water Everywhere
description:945ad3af3dcd286ea238c026.text: Purify seawater and direct it into the ship’s stores to refill empty water barrels.

description:e06df779e8c480527daaf4fd.name: Whirlpool
description:e06df779e8c480527daaf4fd.text: Create Gentle Rotation in the target area (whirlpools, p. 114). Normal Overcasting can enlarge it. Strength options: 5 SL — Whirlpool; 8 SL — Powerful Vortex; 13 SL — A Maelstrom; 21+ SL — The Maelstrom.

description:30dd9ef629bfde813971768d.name: Breathe Water
description:30dd9ef629bfde813971768d.text: The target breathes water and ignores Suffocation from drowning in water (WFRP p. 181) for the duration. You cannot invoke this while your own mouth is underwater.

description:4ae11eea39ce9fe36d925a1b.name: Quell Waters
description:4ae11eea39ce9fe36d925a1b.text: Reduce a strait or whirlpool’s M rating to 0 for the duration.

description:40700a52c3e3c812178f29b7.name: Sea Curse
description:40700a52c3e3c812178f29b7.text: Target a ship crewed by those unworthy of Manann’s respect, including Chaos followers, Stromfels worshippers, Orcs and Goblins, Skaven or a crew with negative Manann’s Mood. For the duration, every hit received by that crew gains +2 Damage.

description:c88539b130e775aad78230ad.name: Repel Sea Beast
description:c88539b130e775aad78230ad.text: A sea creature takes no hostile actions for the duration, unless it suffers Damage or harmful Conditions.

description:4c37f2642484635d03602d0f.name: Rip Tides
description:4c37f2642484635d03602d0f.text: A visible ship takes −1 M and −1 SL Man.

description:b84ae84dc8e0625916fc3cf0.name: Blessed Voyage
description:b84ae84dc8e0625916fc3cf0.text: Invoke when calculating Manann’s Mood. Improve it by 2d10 minus your current Sin Points.

description:7734db5bda8f69f1c49c5cd0.name: Blessing of the Albatross
description:7734db5bda8f69f1c49c5cd0.text: An albatross arrives and waits up to 1 hour for sailing, then follows the ship for the duration. While it remains, the ship cannot sink regardless of Damage. Killing it gives the ship −d10 Morale and −2d10 Manann’s Mood. If needed, use the pigeon profile (WFRP p. 316), changed to Small Size and 3 Wounds.

description:699063872ff32aa139d7c92e.name: Blessing of the Mariner
description:699063872ff32aa139d7c92e.text: The target gains +1 SL on Row, Sail and Swim Tests.

description:2dcdca4b440f17b03df4c2d6.name: Raging Seas
description:2dcdca4b440f17b03df4c2d6.text: Strike a specific target in the sea or on shore with a wave of CR 15.

description:95b42a65ed2c6c7f8e61f094.name: Send ‘em to Stromfels
description:95b42a65ed2c6c7f8e61f094.text: Double the target ship’s Holed Rating (p. 117).

description:739adc1da9b84a74501fd64a.name: Storm Winds
description:739adc1da9b84a74501fd64a.text: Increase wind intensity for one ship by one step for the duration (p. 107), without changing direction.

description:5c258e93aa3cd6e02c3804cf.name: Blood Trail
description:5c258e93aa3cd6e02c3804cf.text: Track an injured person over land or water with Easy (+4 SL) Track, smelling even tiny or partially removed blood traces.

description:65c32d3a72f5a61047d07de6.name: Curse of the Harsh Mistress
description:65c32d3a72f5a61047d07de6.text: The target suffers nightmares. Whenever resting to remove Fatigued Conditions, they must pass Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or retain the Fatigued Condition.

description:a32b6f2855a55bbf1b80fe32.name: Manann’s Mood Made Meaningless
description:a32b6f2855a55bbf1b80fe32.text: For your current ship, roll on the Manann’s Mood table below, adding 1 per Sin Point. 1 to 4: Stromfels Triumphant! Treat Mood as 0 for the duration. 5 to 8: Stromfels Ascends! Roll 5d10, adding it to negative Mood or subtracting it from positive Mood. 9: No effect; calculate Mood normally. 10 or more: Manann Provoked! Subtract 5d10 from Mood (p. 130).

description:4ed5844d0cfc3867c72721a2.name: Seasickness
description:4ed5844d0cfc3867c72721a2.text: Give the target Seasickness for the duration, using Sea of Claws p. 125.

description:32e19283b0e7873c64ffbbc9.name: Chanty (Any)
description:32e19283b0e7873c64ffbbc9.text: Each purchase teaches a different p. 67 chanty. Perform an Entertain (Singing) Test where the crew can hear you. Establishing it takes 30 seconds; its effect then lasts three minutes plus SL minutes and affects the crew. Dodge is your only combat action while singing; the GM may permit other actions such as Perception or Cool Tests. Damage or any failed Opposed Test ends it. Sing one chanty each watch.

description:f3ed0e2a16574cd8e8eaefc6.name: We’re all in this together so, heave ho, heave ho…
description:f3ed0e2a16574cd8e8eaefc6.text: Crew members gain +10 to their individual Tests within a Crew Test.

description:75795858aa3927470d885ba9.name: Jacques Bret came sailing to meet our steel!
description:75795858aa3927470d885ba9.text: Each crew member gains +1 SL on successful Melee Tests.

description:c452ddef69a81bfe11528656.name: Of all the terrors upon the sea…
description:c452ddef69a81bfe11528656.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Cool Tests.

description:b49c74c6f0621c52a35169ef.name: You band of shipmates gather round…
description:b49c74c6f0621c52a35169ef.text: Crew members gain +1 SL to Fellowship Tests intended to befriend or calm fellow crew.

description:3ee4fa20613d34298b6cb1e8.name: All arise, for the night has eyes…
description:3ee4fa20613d34298b6cb1e8.text: Those trying to stay awake gain +20 to Tests that could make them fall asleep and +10 to Perception Tests.

description:006d8878f245be1a0e3500e9.name: The ladies of L’Anguille…
description:006d8878f245be1a0e3500e9.text: Anyone singing along may ignore one Condition.

description:a1beec2d7f4904b880911f7e.name: They do say do as the Captain do say…
description:a1beec2d7f4904b880911f7e.text: The Captain or another onboard authority gains +20 to Fellowship Tests targeting the crew.

description:9ace083d1180176d4fa47e53.name: Master and Commander
description:9ace083d1180176d4fa47e53.text: Appropriate Leadership Tests aboard your ship or involving your crew gain +1 SL per Master and Commander level. Applies to individual Leadership and Crew Tests.

description:d7f1e5d26e1a950bcd4e806e.name: Rough Spirits, pint bottle
description:d7f1e5d26e1a950bcd4e806e.text: Printed tavern fair price covers 8 shots. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:2bb6aba6161c8805591e42d0.name: Excellent Spirits, pint bottle
description:2bb6aba6161c8805591e42d0.text: Printed tavern fair price covers 8 shots. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:2c4ba96a79c3138fff7fc895.name: Fine Wine, bottle
description:2c4ba96a79c3138fff7fc895.text: Printed tavern fair price covers 5 glasses. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:94fefb22f4d95318fc79cfbc.name: Small Beer, pint
description:94fefb22f4d95318fc79cfbc.text: Printed tavern fair price covers 1 pint. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:8e097adc2b577d5270078f40.name: Strong Ale, pint
description:8e097adc2b577d5270078f40.text: Printed tavern fair price covers 1 pint. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:62c9675126f56517f94a6e6d.name: Snacks, tavern serving
description:62c9675126f56517f94a6e6d.text: Printed tavern fair price covers one serving, with no specified portion size. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:18ff18bae19f2c6e5c6301d7.name: Stew, tavern serving
description:18ff18bae19f2c6e5c6301d7.text: Printed tavern fair price covers one serving, with no specified portion size. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:67ab323baa20610d273fc812.name: Simple Meal, tavern serving
description:67ab323baa20610d273fc812.text: Printed tavern fair price covers one meal, with no specified portion size. Encumbrance and Availability are unknown. Purchasing records the item; consumption, illness and venue discounts remain manual.

description:56842af4bb8fe18844005917.name: Tavern drink: Ale
description:56842af4bb8fe18844005917.text: Fair price: 3d per pint. Each pint requires one Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test. Beer, mead and cider can have equivalent prices.

description:7e477454b583ac3eb225ed86.name: Tavern drink: Dwarf Ale
description:7e477454b583ac3eb225ed86.text: Fair price: 9d per pint. Each pint requires three Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Tests.

description:cf3909fcf31e73a97df0b20c.name: Tavern drink: Excellent Spirits
description:cf3909fcf31e73a97df0b20c.text: Fair price: 8d per shot or 4/– for a pint bottle containing 8 shots. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per shot.

description:ca981f89526b71036ab82c64.name: Tavern drink: Fine Wine
description:ca981f89526b71036ab82c64.text: Fair price: 8d per glass or 2/8 per bottle containing 5 glasses. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per glass.

description:176c3278495d6130c0b77b47.name: Tavern drink: Legendary Wine
description:176c3278495d6130c0b77b47.text: Prices start at 4/– per glass or 18/– per 5-glass bottle and may be much higher. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per glass.

description:daea67b2b6291597fe440225.name: Tavern drink: Rough Spirits
description:daea67b2b6291597fe440225.text: Fair price: 2d per shot or 1/– per pint bottle containing 8 shots. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per shot.

description:061451e77059f881e9602025.name: Tavern drink: Spirits
description:061451e77059f881e9602025.text: Fair price: 4d per shot or 2/– per pint bottle containing 8 shots. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per shot.

description:4403c2c873acaa639c77ea74.name: Tavern drink: Small Beer
description:4403c2c873acaa639c77ea74.text: Fair price: 2d per pint. Each pint requires an Easy (+40) Consume Alcohol Test.

description:030a78e75562a97e0b44af64.name: Tavern drink: Strong Ale
description:030a78e75562a97e0b44af64.text: Fair price: 5d per pint. Each pint requires a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test.

description:c16aad96727faeab4b841a18.name: Tavern drink: Wine
description:c16aad96727faeab4b841a18.text: Fair price: 4d per glass or 1/4 per bottle containing 5 glasses. Make an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test per glass.

description:fb5881df43ad44d3dca628b4.name: Tavern fare: Snacks
description:fb5881df43ad44d3dca628b4.text: Fair price: 2d. A snacks-only diet lasts Toughness Bonus days before Starvation Tests are required if proper food remains unavailable.

description:5607c9daedf3184834c53a73.name: Tavern fare: Stew
description:5607c9daedf3184834c53a73.text: Fair price: 4d. Stew provides enough nourishment to avoid Starvation indefinitely.

description:71c43139ce5687796f29643b.name: Tavern fare: Simple Meal
description:71c43139ce5687796f29643b.text: Fair price: 10d for a simple meal of inexpensive local ingredients.

description:9b77ed71df77497b4a44d849.name: Tavern fare: Meal
description:9b77ed71df77497b4a44d849.text: Fair price: 1/– for a meal with grains, vegetables, meat or fish, and fresh bread.

description:17ebfbd43f2f038b6270f16e.name: Tavern fare: Menu
description:17ebfbd43f2f038b6270f16e.text: Offers stew, simple meals and meals at their normal prices.

description:aac5c90d5d2b65cd3fb9c374.name: Tavern fare: Fine Menu
description:aac5c90d5d2b65cd3fb9c374.text: Fine meals cost twice normal prices and include side dishes and dessert. Fine snacks and stews are also available.

description:0eb3725a3e4371a26407cf37.name: Tavern fare: Lavish Menu
description:0eb3725a3e4371a26407cf37.text: Meals made with exceptional ingredients cost three times normal prices. Fine snacks and stews are also offered, though the venue may expect them as part of a meal.

description:10e594c46fe95037bff92595.name: Tavern board: Common Room
description:10e594c46fe95037bff92595.text: Shared sleeping room with single beds and no privacy; toilet facilities may be communal. Brackets show the number of beds. Fair price: 10d per person per night.

description:c00e97c0244e27bf8f9e5fb1.name: Tavern board: Room
description:c00e97c0244e27bf8f9e5fb1.text: Private room with 2 single beds or one double, and a ceramic chamber pot. A key may be provided, though poor rooms may lack one. Brackets show the inn’s number of rooms. Fair price: 10/– per room per night.

description:799fbd67cf17806a6bb122a7.name: Tavern board: Large Room
description:799fbd67cf17806a6bb122a7.text: A larger standard room with 2 additional single beds or an additional double. Brackets show the number of large rooms. Fair price: 14/– per room per night.

description:1e4d2a31c33aa0a9d24d5ce1.name: Tavern board: Fine Room
description:1e4d2a31c33aa0a9d24d5ce1.text: Spacious decorated room with 2 single beds or a double, porcelain commode, furnishings and a key. Brackets show the number of fine rooms. Fair price: 1 GC per room per night.

description:e19b92a976fbc0b35271ca70.name: Random Tavern Tier Table
description:e19b92a976fbc0b35271ca70.text:
Roll 2d10. 2–12: Urban Location: Brass; Rural Location: Brass.

13–15: Urban Location: Silver; Rural Location: Brass.

16–17: Urban Location: Silver; Rural Location: Silver.

18–19: Urban Location: Gold; Rural Location: Silver.

20: Urban Location: Gold; Rural Location: Gold.

description:c36b4f219fe05fd7cb404880.name: Brass Tavern Venue Vital Statistics Table
description:c36b4f219fe05fd7cb404880.text:
Roll d10.

1: Staff: Landlord; Drinks: Small Beer (Poor); Fare: None; Board: None.

2: Staff: Landlord; Drinks: Small Beer; Fare: None; Board: None.

3: Staff: Skeleton Staff; Drinks: Ale (Poor); Fare: Snacks (Poor); Board: None.

4: Staff: Skeleton Staff; Drinks: Ale; Fare: Snacks; Board: None.

5: Staff: Skeleton Staff; Drinks: Ale; Fare: Snacks and roll again; Board: CR (12) (Poor).

6: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: Small Beer, Ale; Fare: Stew (Poor); Board: CR (12).

7: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: Ale, Strong Ale; Fare: Stew; Board: CR (18) (Poor).

8: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, RS; Fare: Stew and roll again; Board: CR (18).

9: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, RS, W; Fare: Simple Meal (Poor); Board: CR (12), R (2) (Poor).

10: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, RS, W; Fare: Simple Meal; Board: CR (12), R (2).

A: Ale; DA: Dwarf Ale; ES: Excellent Spirits; FW: Fine Wine; LW: Legendary Wine; RS: Rough Spirits; S: Spirits; SB: Small Beer; SA: Strong Ale; W: Wine. CR: Common Room; R: Room; L: Large Room; FR: Fine Room.

description:b49169436897dd86a68ddae0.name: Silver Tavern Venue Vital Statistics Table
description:b49169436897dd86a68ddae0.text:
Roll d10.

1: Staff: Skeleton Staff; Drinks: Ale; Fare: Snacks; Board: None.

2: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: Ale; Fare: Stew; Board: CR (12).

3: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: Ale, Strong Ale; Fare: Simple Meal (Poor); Board: CR (18).

4: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: Ale, Strong Ale; Fare: Simple Meal and roll again; Board: CR (12), R (2).

5: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, RS; Fare: Simple Meal; Board: CR (12), R (6).

6: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, W; Fare: Meal (Poor); Board: CR (12), R (2), L (2).

7: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, DA, SA, RS, W; Fare: Meal; Board: CR (12), R (6), L (4).

8: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, W; Fare: Meal and roll again; Board: R (6), L (2).

9: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, W; Fare: Menu; Board: R (8), L (4).

10: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, DA, SA, S, W, FW; Fare: Menu; Board: R (8), L (4), FR (2).

A: Ale; DA: Dwarf Ale; ES: Excellent Spirits; FW: Fine Wine; LW: Legendary Wine; RS: Rough Spirits; S: Spirits; SB: Small Beer; SA: Strong Ale; W: Wine. CR: Common Room; R: Room; L: Large Room; FR: Fine Room.

description:0c2eb53dbdc3a2c170e7b448.name: Gold Tavern Venue Vital Statistics Table
description:0c2eb53dbdc3a2c170e7b448.text:
Roll d10.

1: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, W; Fare: Snacks; Board: None.

2: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, W, FW; Fare: Meal; Board: None.

3: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, W, FW; Fare: Menu; Board: R (6), L (2).

4: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, DA, SA, S, W, FW; Fare: Menu; Board: R (8), L (4).

5: Staff: Adequate Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, FW, ES; Fare: Menu; Board: R (8), L (4), FR (2).

6: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, DA, SA, S, FW, ES; Fare: Fine Menu; Board: FR (6).

7: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, FW, LW; Fare: Fine Menu; Board: FR (6).

8: Staff: Quality Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, FW, ES, LW; Fare: Fine Menu; Board: FR (6).

9: Staff: Excellent Staff; Drinks: A, SA, S, FW, ES, LW; Fare: Lavish Menu; Board: FR (12).

10: Staff: Excellent Staff; Drinks: A, DA, S, FW, ES, LW; Fare: Lavish Menu; Board: FR (12).

A: Ale; DA: Dwarf Ale; ES: Excellent Spirits; FW: Fine Wine; LW: Legendary Wine; RS: Rough Spirits; S: Spirits; SB: Small Beer; SA: Strong Ale; W: Wine. CR: Common Room; R: Room; L: Large Room; FR: Fine Room.

description:da253e368f4f5d1aaddff9e0.name: Brass Tavern Capacity, Games and Entertainment Table
description:da253e368f4f5d1aaddff9e0.text:
Roll d10.

1: Capacity: 1d10 Stools; Games: None; Entertainment: None.

2: Capacity: 1d10 Stools; Games: Beast Among the Tailors; Entertainment: None.

3: Capacity: 1d10 Stools and roll again; Games: Stones; Entertainment: Rat baits.

4: Capacity: 2 Benches; Games: Mühlen; Entertainment: Cock fights.

5: Capacity: 2 Benches and roll again; Games: Scarlet Empress; Entertainment: Bear baits.

6: Capacity: 2 Tables; Games: Scarlet Empress; Entertainment: Comic skits (poor).

7: Capacity: 2 Tables and roll again; Games: Al-zahr; Entertainment: Comic skits.

8: Capacity: 4 Tables; Games: Dominos; Entertainment: Storytelling.

9: Capacity: 4 Tables, 1 Booth; Games: Darts; Entertainment: Folk music sessions (poor).

10: Capacity: 4 Tables, 2 Booths; Games: Alvatafl; Entertainment: Folk music sessions.

description:5011aadb0f4d0239c41aa7de.name: Silver Tavern Capacity, Games and Entertainment Table
description:5011aadb0f4d0239c41aa7de.text:
Roll d10.

1: Capacity: 6 Stools, 4 Tables; Games: None; Entertainment: None.

2: Capacity: 6 Stools, 6 Tables; Games: Stones; Entertainment: Cock Fights.

3: Capacity: 6 Stools, 8 Tables; Games: Mühlen; Entertainment: Comic skits.

4: Capacity: 8 Tables; Games: Scarlet Empress; Entertainment: Storytelling.

5: Capacity: 10 Tables; Games: Cerevis; Entertainment: Folk music sessions (poor).

6: Capacity: 12 Tables; Games: Al-zahr; Entertainment: Folk music sessions.

7: Capacity: 6 Tables, 2 Booths; Games: Dominos; Entertainment: Folk music sessions (quality).

8: Capacity: 8 Tables, 4 Booths; Games: Darts; Entertainment: Mummers.

9: Capacity: 10 Tables, 2 Booths; Games: Alvatafl; Entertainment: Mummers.

10: Capacity: 10 Tables, 4 Booths; Games: Bowls; Entertainment: Class act (music or drama).

description:410bd076197e7547481d292f.name: Gold Tavern Capacity, Games and Entertainment Table
description:410bd076197e7547481d292f.text:
Roll d10.

1: Capacity: 8 Tables; Games: Discouraged; Entertainment: None.

2: Capacity: 8 Tables; Games: Discouraged; Entertainment: None.

3: Capacity: 10 Tables; Games: None; Entertainment: None.

4: Capacity: 10 Tables; Games: Mühlen; Entertainment: None.

5: Capacity: 12 Tables; Games: Scarlet Empress; Entertainment: Class act (music or drama).

6: Capacity: 12 Tables; Games: Cerevis; Entertainment: Class act (music or drama).

7: Capacity: 8 Tables, 4 Booths; Games: Bowls; Entertainment: Class act (music or drama).

8: Capacity: 8 Tables, 4 Booths; Games: Alvatafl; Entertainment: Class act (music or drama).

9: Capacity: 12 Tables, 6 Booths; Games: Alvatafl; Entertainment: Class act (carnival).

10: Capacity: 12 Tables, 6 Booths; Games: Alvatafl; Entertainment: Class act (carnival).

description:afbf8e486d5ddc53fb01d730.name: Copper Staff
description:afbf8e486d5ddc53fb01d730.text: While holding it, a Shaman counts as isolated from Orcs and Goblins: −2 SL to Channelling or Casting Tests, and ignore Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins when rolling Waaagh! Miscasts. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:14ed6da3df2bb93c3823985c.name: Dangly Wotnotz
description:14ed6da3df2bb93c3823985c.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll a successful Casting Test, but must use the second result. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:dd0c542ad900d6df981b9b23.name: Effigy of Mork
description:dd0c542ad900d6df981b9b23.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll Dodge or Melee Tests to Oppose attacks, accepting the second result even if worse. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:2a9d15b2fdc5f26ff7eea373.name: Effigy of Gork
description:2a9d15b2fdc5f26ff7eea373.text: A Shaman carrying this may reroll Melee attacks, accepting the second result even if worse. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:32eab7586adcdd84df54c440.name: Glowy Green Amulet
description:32eab7586adcdd84df54c440.text: Grants Magic Resistance. Whenever the bearer is targeted by a spell, roll 1d100: on 01, the amulet deals 1d10 Wounds, ignoring TB and armour, and causes Prone. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:15cbbd954e60fe1648d79aa2.name: Shaman Staff
description:15cbbd954e60fe1648d79aa2.text: Roll 1d10 once for this staff. For Channelling, Casting and Waaagh! Miscast rolls, the Shaman always counts as having that many Orcs within Willpower Bonus yards. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:0d8decdab07a198578f9d8d7.name: War Machine Bolt
description:0d8decdab07a198578f9d8d7.text: Printed name: Bolt. Range: as weapon; Damage: —; Impale, Penetrating. No price supplied.

description:500a0bd93615c2524735404b.name: War Machine Stone
description:500a0bd93615c2524735404b.text: Printed name: Stone. Range: as weapon; Damage: —; Damaging, Impact. No price supplied.

description:5968326640e4320f20d1006b.name: Wulfang’s Pelt
description:5968326640e4320f20d1006b.text: While worn, grants one core Rough Rider rank and gives the wearer’s mount +1 Movement. The printed Roughrider name follows the documented core spelling. Neither benefit is permanent. No price or Encumbrance supplied; acquired/reference only.

description:6a8a798086c648690026a1e2.name: Spear Chukka
description:6a8a798086c648690026a1e2.text: No purchase price is supplied. Acquired/reference profile only.

description:4358b06bc531288c50fd2bbb.name: Doom Diver
description:4358b06bc531288c50fd2bbb.text: No purchase price is supplied. Acquired/reference profile only.

description:5d6d2895a70765d9b2e1bb38.name: Rock Lobber
description:5d6d2895a70765d9b2e1bb38.text: No purchase price is supplied. Acquired/reference profile only.

description:9cbdd0a40fe7fd61672b203b.name: Gut Magic Miscast Table
description:9cbdd0a40fe7fd61672b203b.text:
| 1d100 | Gut Magic Miscast |
| --- | --- |
| 01–15 | Besmirched: −2 SL to Fellowship Tests until the Butcher cleans up. |
| 16–20 | Gobstopper: fail Hard (−20) Endurance and lose speech, including Gut Magic casting, for 1d10 Rounds. |
| 21–30 | Rage of the Maw: become subject to Frenzy. |
| 31–35 | Green Around the Gills: Nausea for 1d10 hours. |
| 36–40 | Dental Mishap: lose one tooth. |
| 41–45 | Runny Guts: immediately contract Bloody Flux. |
| 46–50 | Famishing: eat one pound of flesh within 2d10 Rounds or suffer Starvation as after 2 foodless days. |
| 51–55 | Rampant Ravenous Rage: all creatures within 3d10 yards gain Hungry. Those already Hungry must pass Challenging (+0) Cool or eat the closest edible creature or object. |
| 56–60 | Roiling Reflux: for 1d10 Rounds, gain Vomit and test Challenging (+0) Endurance each Turn, losing 1 Wound per failure. |
| 61–65 | Flatulent Eruption: characters within 20 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or have Nausea for 1d10 hours. |
| 66–70 | Shattered Teeth: lose 1d10 teeth. |
| 71–75 | Trapped Wind: gain three Poisoned Conditions, removed normally. Removing the final one triggers Flatulent Eruption. |
| 76–80 | Displeasure of the Maw: take a 1d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 81–85 | Corpomantic Maelstrom: for 1d10 Turns, test Difficult (−10) Endurance each Turn. Failure causes vomiting; every character within 5 yards must pass Hard (−20) Dodge or suffer a TB +4 Weapon Damage hit and Stunned. |
| 86–90 | Maimed Tongue: lose 1 Wound and cannot speak or cast Gut Magic for 1d10 days. Afterwards, suffer −2 SL to Language and other speech Tests. |
| 91–95 | Gastromantic Ravaging: take a 2d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 96–100 | Jawbreaker: Broken Jaw Critical Wound gives 3 Stunned Conditions, Broken Bone (Major), and Unconscious unless Challenging (+0) Endurance succeeds. |
| 101–115 | Suppurating Ulcers: take a 3d10 Damage Body hit. |
| 116–120 | Thaumaphagic Catastrophe: Butcher dies. Everyone within 10 yards must pass Hard (−20) Dodge or take TB +6 Weapon Damage and Stunned. |

description:78b266e3ca1a3d09e5ad11b7.name: Waaagh! Miscast Table
description:78b266e3ca1a3d09e5ad11b7.text:
| Roll | Waaagh! Miscast |
| --- | --- |
| 01–10 | Green Haze: musty green fog surrounds the Shaman. |
| 11–15 | Mad Yatterin’: for 1d10 Rounds, cannot communicate verbally, Cast or Channel. |
| 16–20 | Ungodly Racket: Shaman and everyone with Acute Sense (Hearing) within 10 yards gain Deafened. |
| 21–25 | Shroom Spurt: gain Fatigued. A Night Goblin under Shaman Shrooms must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or turn into a patch of those mushrooms. |
| 26–30 | Fzzzaap!: gain Stunned. |
| 31–35 | Body Shock: lose 2 Wounds, ignoring TB/AP; fail Average (+20) Endurance and also gain Stunned. |
| 36–40 | Squig Magnet: a squig appears at the Shaman’s feet and attacks them (WFRP p. 318 profile). |
| 41–45 | Whoops!: spell targets a random creature within 10 yards, possibly the Shaman. |
| 46–50 | Yuuurgh!: gain Stunned Conditions equal to the last Channelling or Casting Test’s SL, minimum 1. |
| 51–55 | Get Angry!: Shaman loses 3 Wounds ignoring TB/AP. Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins within 5 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Endurance or lose 1 Wound ignoring TB/armour and enter Frenzy. |
| 56–60 | Flying Rocks: Shaman takes 1d10 hits at Weapon Damage 2; everyone within 10 yards takes one Weapon Damage 2 hit. |
| 61–65 | Pretty Colours!: gain Blinded for 2 Rounds and 1 Fatigued Condition. |
| 66–70 | I’z Gone on Fire!: gain Ablaze. |
| 71–75 | Gertcha!: lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/armour and gain Prone. |
| 76–80 | Sorcerous Spew: gain 3 Stunned Conditions. |
| 81–85 | Weird Flailing: gain 2 Stunned; everyone within 1d10 yards must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge or take Damage 3 to a random location. |
| 86–90 | Me ’Ead ’Urts!: gain 2 Stunned and take 1d10 Wounds to the head, ignoring TB/armour. |
| 91–95 | I’ve Forgot!: permanently lose one random spell and gain Blinded. |
| 96–100 | I Fink I’m Gonna…: gain Unconscious. Orcs and Goblins within 10 yards gain Stunned. |
| 101–105 | Eye Melta: both eyes are amputated; take 1d10 +3 Wounds to the head. |
| 106–110 | ’EADBANG!: Shaman dies. |
| 111 or more | ’EADBANGERZ!: Shaman dies; Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins within 10 yards also die unless they pass Very Hard (−30) Cool. |

description:ffd54fcee1def684fe0af3bf.name: Die Hard
description:ffd54fcee1def684fe0af3bf.text: Any Critical Wound can heal. For TB Rounds after death, attempt Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance at each Round's start; success restores life at 1 Wound.

description:1b6578eeef747927a8e59b37.name: Corrupting Vomit
description:1b6578eeef747927a8e59b37.text: Being hit by Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to Moderate Corruption.

description:81330162325a58ef7653379b.name: Rotten Regeneration
description:81330162325a58ef7653379b.text: Follow core Regeneration, replacing restored Wounds with half of 1d10, rounded down (p. 88).

description:d33bb0122565b8ed00002351.name: Bileful Vomit
description:d33bb0122565b8ed00002351.text: Use Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; Instant). Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack. It is a magic missile dealing TB Damage that ignores AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or contract Blood Rot.

description:75cf8a4164c1dae229be67a7.name: That’s No Mound
description:75cf8a4164c1dae229be67a7.text: Stealthy applies only until the Troll moves or takes an Action.

description:e2542672ea8d122bcbb4e82a.name: Sated
description:e2542672ea8d122bcbb4e82a.text: Eating an Average-or-larger creature undisturbed removes the Hungry Troll template.

description:7589573b44ce7396e8051c36.name: Starving
description:7589573b44ce7396e8051c36.text: After 24 hours without food, the Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation.

description:3a285cc0390943170103ea7e.name: Water Wise
description:3a285cc0390943170103ea7e.text: The River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; elsewhere it still applies.

description:c0517964f4739cb196ac26ff.name: Purple Skullback Bite
description:c0517964f4739cb196ac26ff.text: Being wounded and Poisoned by the bite requires Average (+2 SL) Cool; failure gives 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still suffer damage/poison, but gain the printed +2d10 to Channelling and Language (Magick) for 2d10 hours and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. These bonuses are temporary.

description:d18d685d1586ad9da8b82a30.name: Bilebrew
description:d18d685d1586ad9da8b82a30.text: Drink a mixture of spleen and gall. You and friendly Ogres in the area gain Hatred of a target or group you choose.

description:cb00c03709e72f933150640d.name: Bloodgruel
description:cb00c03709e72f933150640d.text: Suck blood and marrow from a severed limb, then Test Easy (+4 SL) Endurance. Success heals 1 Wound plus 1 per SL; failure gives you Bloody Flux.

description:d95fc7de597ca373b9d766a6.name: Get Some Guts
description:d95fc7de597ca373b9d766a6.text: Consume a male Mournfang’s large intestine. Targets ignore Broken Conditions for the duration.

description:cee7c3ff82ab4ae2b4f4aa05.name: Toothcracker
description:cee7c3ff82ab4ae2b4f4aa05.text: Chew earth-encrusted bedrock from a mountain peak, then Test Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance; failure costs one tooth per −1 SL. Successful casting gives you and friendly Ogres in the area +20 to Endurance and Cool Tests and +1 AP at every location for the duration.

description:41cfba15d12aad65a6853d4c.name: Behave!
description:41cfba15d12aad65a6853d4c.text: An affected Squig, Giant Wolf, Spider of any Size, or Snotling obeys the Shaman like a trained dog.

description:a76773a9a36c4a20baca0eee.name: Cunnin’ Words
description:a76773a9a36c4a20baca0eee.text: The Shaman speaks a language understood by the listener.

description:115bee8c2d717d7be437bd36.name: Curse of Da Bad Moon
description:115bee8c2d717d7be437bd36.text: Enemies in the area gain +1 Fatigued Condition and cannot spend Fortune Points for the duration.

description:dede474daed3a7ec55b583ac.name: Gift of the Spider-God
description:dede474daed3a7ec55b583ac.text: Affected allies gain Venom at Challenging (+0 SL) potency. Existing Venom becomes Difficult (−1 SL) potency instead.

description:e61de967c19bb0fb54fa06e9.name: Gork’ll Fix It
description:e61de967c19bb0fb54fa06e9.text: The target suffers one Fatigued Condition for the duration.

description:e9ffe6f13089c3d6322f72c1.name: The Great Green Spite
description:e9ffe6f13089c3d6322f72c1.text: During the spell, every successful Goblin melee or ranged strike against an enemy in the area counts as a Critical Hit. A Hobgoblin caster grants this effect to Hobgoblins instead.

description:dfa52f1db3683732399496d0.name: Itchy Nuisance
description:dfa52f1db3683732399496d0.text: The target takes −1 SL to every Test for the duration, increased to −2 SL while wearing metal armour.

description:78e01f72c71b1cfb619c2579.name: Mork Wants Ya!
description:78e01f72c71b1cfb619c2579.text: The target must win an Opposed Strength Test against Strength 80 to escape a giant hand. Failure causes a 10 Damage body hit, then a fall from 2d10 yards.

description:37926a68f2143b842781aca1.name: Night Shroud
description:37926a68f2143b842781aca1.text: Throw a black-capped nightshade mushroom to create a cloud. Everyone inside gains Blinded and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception when trying to move or gain Prone. Night Vision or Dark Vision makes a character immune to both effects.

description:9a0643dc8b59032f6f4f9542.name: Nikkit!
description:9a0643dc8b59032f6f4f9542.text: Attempt to pick a pocket in range using Sleight of Hand 55. After a successful theft, the victim may pass Challenging (+0 SL) Perception to see the conjured hands returning the loot to the Shaman.

description:1312e46cfdb20ccf29174a40.name: Sneaky Stabbin’
description:1312e46cfdb20ccf29174a40.text: Affected targets’ blows gain Impale and Penetrating.

description:5718d1f0070fd924f679654e.name: Vindictive Glare
description:5718d1f0070fd924f679654e.text: A Damage +4 magic missile strikes everyone in the area. Targets taking Damage must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned.

description:ee68e4954c1aa56cc4d4aa49.name: ‘Ard as Nails
description:ee68e4954c1aa56cc4d4aa49.text: The target gains Hatred of all enemies, ignores harmful effects of Conditions and Diseases, and adds +2 SL to Toughness-based Tests.

description:6ffe81ef4e414d97eba248ae.name: Bash ‘Em Lads!
description:6ffe81ef4e414d97eba248ae.text: Allocate one Momentum per Casting SL among allied Orcs, Goblins and Hobgoblins in range. Multiple points may go to one target.

description:dc37d06d566db4c327dccc87.name: Brainbursta
description:dc37d06d566db4c327dccc87.text: The target immediately gains Prone and Stunned, plus one additional Stunned per Casting SL. If its Stunned Conditions exceed Toughness Bonus, it must immediately pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or take a Critical Hit to the head.

description:2b7434c37d9ba9e9f42726d5.name: ‘Eadbutt
description:2b7434c37d9ba9e9f42726d5.text: A Damage +1 magic missile always hits the head. Damage becomes +6 against a target with Aethyric Attunement or Second Sight.

description:5c86cedf3d1dd8d55fc9ae4c.name: ‘Ere We Go!
description:5c86cedf3d1dd8d55fc9ae4c.text: Targets in the area gain +2 Momentum for Melee Tests. For a Hobgoblin caster, the spell targets Hobgoblins instead of Orcs.

description:fe5980e3911e2f4e71e60d55.name: The Evil Sun
description:fe5980e3911e2f4e71e60d55.text: Each Round, targets in the area suffer 8 + SL Damage and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or gain an Ablaze Condition.

description:26bed32070eba69f9b0802e4.name: Fists of Gork
description:26bed32070eba69f9b0802e4.text: Drop everything held and attack only with fists for the duration, using Melee (Brawling) 55 and Weapon (Fists) +9.

description:a2715088ebac5146e61782c7.name: Foot of Gork
description:a2715088ebac5146e61782c7.text: All targets in the area gain Prone and take an 8 Damage hit to a random location, ignoring AP. Passing Difficult (−1 SL) Dodge reduces Damage to 4.

description:9962382c16e56c7f0a865942.name: Gaze of Mork
description:9962382c16e56c7f0a865942.text: A Damage +4 magic missile hits every living creature on a straight line along the blast. Structures of Toughness 65 or less also take Damage.

description:318de4b26483a6ba119ff62e.name: The Hand of Gork
description:318de4b26483a6ba119ff62e.text: Move 1d10 targets to a place in range. They must begin within Willpower Bonus yards of each other. On landing, targets immediately entering Melee gain +1 Momentum in combat.

description:10505ce702779be67e8c0d59.name: Mork Save Us!
description:10505ce702779be67e8c0d59.text: For each Casting SL, give one allied Orc, Goblin or Hobgoblin in range Ward 10. An existing Ward improves by 1 instead, but cannot reach 7+ or better this way.

description:c33e4b92bd54159d11e4d818.name: WAAAGH!
description:c33e4b92bd54159d11e4d818.text: Orcs, Hobgoblins and Goblins in the area gain 1 Momentum usable for Melee and Ranged Tests, remove all Broken Conditions, and gain +2 SL to Cool and Endurance for the duration.

description:a099cc07c881b24d98ab3252.text:
| Roll | Description | Wounds | Additional Effects |

| 01–03 | Dramatic Injury | T | Gain 1 Bleeding. After healing, the scar grants +1 SL to suitable social Tests; this benefit cannot be gained more than once. |
| 04–06 | Rattling Blow | 1 | Gain 1 Stunned. |
| 07–09 | Poked Eye | 1 | Gain 1 Blinded. |
| 10–15 | Ear Bash | 1 | Gain 1 Deafened. |
| 16–20 | Minor Cut | 1 | Gain 1 Bleeding. |
| 21–25 | Black Eye | 2 | Gain 2 Blinded. |
| 26–30 | Sliced Ear | 2 | Gain 2 Deafened and 1 Bleeding. |
| 31–35 | Struck Forehead | 2 | Gain 2 Bleeding and 1 Blinded; Blinded persists until all Bleeding is removed. |

| 46–50 | Major Ear Wound | 3 | Hearing Tests suffer –20. Receiving this result again permanently removes hearing. |

| 66–75 | Smashed Mouth | 4 | Gain 2 Bleeding; lose 1d10 teeth, Amputation (Easy). |
| 76–80 | Concussive Blow | 4 | Gain 1 Deafened, 2 Bleeding and 1d10 Stunned, plus 1 Fatigued lasting 1d10 days. |
| 81–85 | Devastated Eye | 5 | Gain 3 Blinded, 2 Bleeding and 1 Stunned; lose an eye, Amputation (Difficult). |
| 86–94 | Disfiguring Blow | 5 | Gain 3 Bleeding, 3 Blinded and 2 Stunned; lose an eye and nose, Amputation (Hard). |
| 95–99 | Mangled Jaw | 5 | Gain 4 Bleeding, 3 Stunned and a Broken Bone (Major); lose the tongue and 1d10 teeth, Amputation (Hard). |
| 00 or more | Shattered Skull | Death | The skull is destroyed; death is immediate. |

description:499b2b0fe249193f3c231a71.text:

| 01–10 | Jolted Wrist | T | Drop the item in the affected hand. |

| 26–40 | Sprain | 1 | Suffer a Torn Muscle (Minor). |
| 41–45 | Torn Muscles | 1 | Gain 1 Bleeding and a Torn Muscle (Minor). |
| 46–50 | Bleeding Hand | 1 | Gain 1 Bleeding. While this Bleeding remains, pass an Average (+20) Dexterity Test before any Action using an item in that hand, or drop it. |
| 51–55 | Wrenched Arm | 2 | Drop the held item; the arm is unusable for 1d10 Rounds (Amputated Parts). |
| 56–60 | Gaping Wound | 2 | Gain 2 Bleeding. Until Surgery closes the wound, each instance of Damage to this arm adds 1 Bleeding. |
| 61–75 | Clean Break | 2 | Drop the held item and suffer a Broken Bone (Minor). Fail a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test and gain 1 Stunned. |
| 76–80 | Ruptured Ligament | 2 | Drop held items and suffer a Torn Muscle (Major). |
| 81–85 | Deep Cut | 3 | Gain 2 Bleeding, 1 Stunned and a Torn Muscle (Minor). Fail a Hard (–20) Endurance Test and gain Unconscious. |

| 110–115 | Severed Finger | 4 | Lose a finger, Amputation (Average), and gain 1 Bleeding. |

| 126–130 | Mangled Hand | 5 | Lose the hand, Amputation (Hard), and gain 2 Bleeding. Fail a Hard (–20) Endurance Test and gain Stunned and Prone. |

description:13397e50fea4f4d55e02ce27.name: Equipment
description:13397e50fea4f4d55e02ce27.text:
| Item | Cost | Enc | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Theodolite | 6 GC | 3 | Exotic |
| Ostrich Feather | 3/– | 0 | Rare |
| Compass | 10/– | 0 | Scarce |
| Bandoleer | 6/– | 1 | Common |
| Slow Match | 2d / yard | 1 | Common |
| Fuse | 3d / yard | 1 | Scarce |
| Bow String | 4/– | 0 | Common |
| Whetstone | 2/6 | 0 | Common |
| Sealskin | 30/– | 1 | Scarce |
| Silk Underwear | 1GC | 0 | Scarce |
| Captain Braun’s Multi-Stove | 10/– | 3 | Scarce |
| Captain Braun’s Insta-Boiler | 6/– | 2 | Scarce |

Bandoleer: Carries roughly a dozen measured blackpowder charges to ease and speed handgun loading.

Slow Match: Sold by the yard; burns about 1 foot per hour.

Fuse: Sold by the yard; burns about 1 inch per second. Standard Quality has approximately a 5% failure chance over 10 yards; Shoddy fuse tests every 5 yards.

Bow String: Spare strings replace broken ones; higher Quality reduces breakage.

Whetstone: Enables blade sharpening. Sharpening services cost a couple of pennies per blade; the GM determines consequences of neglect.

Sealskin: Weatherproof coat; matching over-mittens prevent dextrous work. Good examples can help resist cold exposure (WFRP p. 181).

Silk Underwear: Reduces chafing.

Captain Braun’s Multi-Stove: Cooks several meals together, retains heat and uses less fuel with fewer visible signs of fire. May cook while moving but becomes hot.

Captain Braun’s Insta-Boiler: Enclosed cooker for faster cooking at lower heat; uses less fuel and is less conspicuous than an open fire. Can be used cautiously while moving.

description:5b61a958fe1fbc3cd9294639.name: Slash (XA)
description:5b61a958fe1fbc3cd9294639.text: Critical Damage also gives 1 Bleeding. Spend X Advantage to inflict one further Bleeding.

description:dd3f2103a2d1c43e48b29575.name: Spread (Rating)
description:dd3f2103a2d1c43e48b29575.text: Point Blank: one target and +Rating Damage. Short–Long: also hit the next Rating nearest visible creatures, with no pair more than Rating yards apart. Extreme: use the same multiple targets but reduce Damage by Rating.

description:72d24d107eea240c6f9dd2e4.name: Trip
description:72d24d107eea240c6f9dd2e4.text: After a hit, spend 2 Advantage for Opposed Strength/Athletics. Winning makes the opponent Prone; a mounted opponent first falls 2 yards. Losing adds nothing beyond normal consequences for losing an Opposed combat Test.

description:649d33249fa6c6362ce21d92.name: Unbalanced
description:649d33249fa6c6362ce21d92.text: Opposing an incoming attack with this weapon incurs −1 SL.

description:3b1f2e2a72014ecd5c7b7a63.name: The Shield Quality
description:3b1f2e2a72014ecd5c7b7a63.text: When opposing an attack with WS or Melee, add Shield Rating AP, including when the main-hand weapon defends and the shield is off-hand. No benefit when unable to Oppose, such as while Surprised. Rating 2+ also allows opposing missiles within line of sight. Ordinary off-hand penalties apply to that defence (printed −20); Melee (Parry) avoids them, and Defensive grants its +1 SL when applicable.

description:c32ba2497c13d29e2a3f5a28.name: Trained (Shock Cavalry)
description:c32ba2497c13d29e2a3f5a28.text: Requires Trained (War). A charging rider may pass through smaller creatures. Each must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge or suffer 4 + mount's SB Damage; every creature damaged reduces remaining Movement by 2 yards. Same/larger creatures halt the mount. At the Charge's end, enemies in melee range become Engaged; resolve the Charge against one of them. A smaller creature not yet acting that Round may forgo Dodge to make one held-weapon attack against mount or rider; only killing/disabling the mount stops the Charge.

description:9112677be360494a822e1a56.name: Structure Damage
description:9112677be360494a822e1a56.text:
Structure Toughness modifies incoming Damage; its Damage score measures what it can withstand. Wall statistics apply to a 5-yard section, so destruction of that section need not destroy the entire wall. Structures have no Hit Locations. When a ranged attack misses someone sheltered within or behind a structure, use the failed shot’s SL below to check whether it strikes the structure.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| LEVELS OF FAILURE | EFFECT |
| 0 to –2 | The shot hits the structure and can damage it. |
| –3 or lower | The shot also misses the structure. |

description:ab39a1404815c20238d40d51.name: Structure Critical Damage
description:ab39a1404815c20238d40d51.text:
| Roll | Description | Wounds | Additional Effects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01–35 | Chipped | T | Randomly choose one Character on the structure or using it as cover. Debris deals Damage equal to the structure’s Toughness Bonus. |
| 36–50 | Jolted | 1 | Everyone on or inside must pass an Easy (+40) Athletics Test or gain Surprised. |
| 51–60 | Holed | 1 | A breach worsens cover; for example, Difficult (-10) Cover Penalty becomes Challenging (-0). |
| 61–70 | Rocked | 2 | Everyone on or inside must pass an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain Prone. |
| 71–80 | Hail of Splinters | 2 | Debris hits everyone on the structure or using it as cover, dealing Damage equal to the structure’s Toughness Bonus. |
| 81–90 | Partial Collapse | 3 | Everyone on or inside must pass a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test or suffer a fall under the core rules. Halve the Encumbrance Limit. Artillery or other heavy equipment exceeding this new limit falls and cannot be used until repaired. |
| 91–95 | Breached | 3 | Debris deals Damage equal to the structure’s Toughness Bonus to everyone on or inside. Those Characters no longer receive cover from the structure. |
| 96 or more | Collapse | Destroyed | The structure is destroyed. Debris deals Damage equal to its Toughness Bonus to Characters using it as cover. Everyone on or inside tests for falling, then takes a weapon hit with Strength equal to the structure’s remaining Wounds. All artillery or other heavy equipment falls and cannot be used until repaired. |

description:08f4b117f086bd80ab713d61.name: Crewed
description:08f4b117f086bd80ab713d61.text:
Every crew member needs the relevant Ranged Skill; nominate one to make the firing Test. Extra crew do not improve weapon efficiency, but can help move it or replace casualties. Crew shortages impose cumulative penalties: short 1 doubles reload time, short 2 adds Imprecise, short 3 adds Dangerous. Each already-present Flaw instead adds printed −10 to firing Tests. One crew member may assist Tests for reload time. Misfires affect the entire crew.

| Crew | Crewed 2 Weapon | Crewed 3 Weapon | Crewed 4 Weapon |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4 | N/A | N/A | N/A |
| 3 | N/A | N/A | Double Reload Time |
| 2 | N/A | Double Reload Time | Gain Imprecise Flaw |
| 1 | Double Reload Time | Gain Imprecise Flaw | Gain Dangerous Flaw |

description:d77fb67df756862684231cca.name: Salvo
description:d77fb67df756862684231cca.text: Holds the listed Salvo number of shots; each firing reduces it by 1. Reload is unnecessary until Salvo reaches 0. May fire repeatedly in one Turn, with cumulative printed −10 to Ranged for each shot after the first; this sequence resets next Turn. On a misfire, resolve normal misfire effects and then the book's following table.

description:5a91d1ba499f9124482c11e1.name: Salvo Artillery Misfire Table
description:5a91d1ba499f9124482c11e1.text:
| D10 Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1–4 | All crew take full Damage to their primary arm, with the units die used as hit SL. Destroy the artillery. |
| 5–7 | All crew take full Damage to a random Hit Location, with the units die used as hit SL. Destroy the artillery. |
| 8–9 | For every remaining Salvo point, all crew take full Damage to randomly determined Hit Locations, using the units die as hit SL. Destroy the artillery. |
| 10 | Fire one shot per remaining Salvo point in a random direction, each travelling D100 yards. Anyone between the machine and an impact point must pass a Very Hard (-30) Dodge Test or be hit. |
