description:a458de22a531808951cbc08f.name: Benefits Of Advantage
description:a458de22a531808951cbc08f.text:
Spend from the relevant Advantage Pool during a player’s or creature’s turn; consultation is not required.

| Advantage cost | Advantage spend | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 Advantage | Batter | Special Action: Make an Opposed Strength Test. On a win, the opponent gains Prone and +1 Advantage. On a loss, the opponent gains +1 Advantage and your Action ends. Winning gives you no normal opposed-Test Advantage. |
| 1 Advantage | Trick | Special Action: Make an Opposed Agility Test. On a win, gain +1 Advantage and, if circumstances suit, inflict Ablaze, Blinded or Entangled on the opponent, choosing one. The GM may reject a Condition if you lack a suitable item or have already inflicted it on this opponent. On a loss, the opponent gains +1 Advantage and your Action ends. Winning gives no additional normal opposed-Test Advantage. |
| 2 Advantage | Additional Effort | Free Action: Before a Test, gain +10%; each further Advantage spent adds another +10% (3 Advantage gives +20%; 4 gives +30%). This Test cannot generate Advantage for you. |
| 2 Advantage | Flee from Harm | Move: Leave opponents without penalty; replaces Disengaging (WFRP p. 165). |
| 4 Advantage | Additional Action | Free Action: Take another Action, which cannot generate Advantage for you. This spend is limited to once per turn. |

Creature Traits may also be activated with the appropriate pool, following WFRP pp. 338–343.

description:6fffa06fa07bd50dfd0e5f44.name: Initial Advantage
description:6fffa06fa07bd50dfd0e5f44.text:
| CIRCUMSTANCES | ADVANTAGE AWARDED |
| --- | --- |
| Manoeuvrability: Superior movement, for example mounted troops or giant spiders among trees. | 2 |
| Outnumbering: More combatants, but fewer than twice the opposing number. | 1 |
| Outnumbering: A 2-to-1 numerical advantage. | 2 |
| Outnumbering: A 3-to-1 numerical advantage. | 3 |
| Surprise: An unexpected attack. | 2 |
| Terrain: Light cover or fortifications, or a favourable position such as a hill. | 1 |
| Terrain: Heavy cover or a key position such as a bridge. | 2 |
| Threat: A dangerous asset such as a warpfire thrower, Ogre or Troll. | 1 |
| Threat: An asset that can match several foes, such as an organ gun, Manticore or Griffon. | 3 |
| Threat: An asset that can match a dozen lesser foes, such as a Dragon or Greater Daemon. | 5 |

Example: Five adventurers surprise ten Goblins and a Shaman riding a Manticore. The allies gain 2 Advantage for surprise. Their opponents gain 2 for outnumbering them 2 to 1 and 3 for the Manticore, totalling 5.

description:e7a692ccdfdcd0ac9bc2588a.name: Fanmaris’s Perfect Shot
description:e7a692ccdfdcd0ac9bc2588a.text:
Warrior Endeavour: Pass a Difficult (–10) Ranged (Bow) Test after training to earn one Perfect Shot during the next adventure. Spend a combat Round aiming at an opponent, then declare the Perfect Shot and make a Ranged Test with all normal modifiers, including +20 for aiming. Apply every effect reached by the total SL; the effects are cumulative.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | EFFECT (CUMULATIVE) |
| +1 | Choose the Hit Location. |
| +2–3 | Gain Penetrating for this attack (WFRP p. 298); if already present, add 2 Damage instead. |
| +4–5 | Inflict an automatic Critical Hit. |
| +6 | Gain Damaging for this attack (WFRP p. 297); if already present, gain Impact instead (p. 298). |

This Endeavour may be undertaken repeatedly.

description:72e5b1530cd4fe525629e1b7.name: The Leitdorf Defence
description:72e5b1530cd4fe525629e1b7.text: Warrior Endeavour: After undertaking it, pass a Difficult (–10) Melee Test to earn one use during the next adventure. After at least one Round engaged with an opponent, declare the Leitdorf Defence and attack with an Opposed Melee Test at –10. The defender cannot use Talents or Skill Advances against this attack. Resolve the attack, then: if you won, suffer 1d10 Damage ignoring Armour; if the opponent won, they inflict a Critical Hit.

description:e7b5422fa28114897846b692.name: Warrior Endeavours
description:e7b5422fa28114897846b692.text: Any Character can attempt Warrior Endeavours. If the Character has never belonged to the Warrior Class, increase the Difficulty of all related Tests by one level; Difficult (–10), for example, becomes Hard (–20).

description:0337d720f4cb43675c1e3343.name: Alcatini Method
description:0337d720f4cb43675c1e3343.text: Warrior Endeavour; requires at least two ranks of Drilled. After undertaking it, make a Difficult (–10) Leadership Test. Each SL lets one Character gain a rank of Drilled for the next adventure (WFRP p. 136). Those already possessing Drilled gain +1 rank, up to your own Drilled rank. Inspiring multiplies the number of recipients using its core table (WFRP p. 139): +3 SL and Inspiring 2 can grant +1 Drilled rank to 30 Characters.

description:a4c408a448d27ddaf79f7510.name: Count Punchausen’s Narrative Auction
description:a4c408a448d27ddaf79f7510.text: Warrior Endeavour: Sell an account of your adventures by passing a Difficult (–10) Charm Test or Challenging (+0) Entertain (Storytelling) Test. Success earns 2d10 shillings and, once during the next adventure, lets you reverse the dice of a Charm or Entertain (Storytelling) Test because a listener knows your published story.

description:54c7a4bd3b5a28f90b3e857b.name: The Quartermaster Shuffle
description:54c7a4bd3b5a28f90b3e857b.text:
Warrior Endeavour: Choose a Trapping and its desired Qualities. Round the final price up to whole Gold Crowns; the usual limit is 20 GC, which the GM may waive. Pass a Challenging (+0) Gossip Test to find an associate offering a job through which the item can be acquired as payment or during the job.

Then make a Difficult (–10) Melee or Ranged Test. Either result grants the item and a Critical Wound to a random Hit Location. On success apply –20 to Critical severity; on failure increase severity by the item’s price in Gold Crowns. Critical Deflection cannot negate this wound, though spending Fate may avert some consequences. The tables on p. 139 can generate the job.

description:3ac34dcef1f6b01908069e4e.name: Beat Blade
description:3ac34dcef1f6b01908069e4e.text: Max: Weapon Skill Bonus. Tests: Melee for Beat Blade. Declare Beat Blade before using your Action for a non-Opposed Melee Test. Success removes 1 Advantage from the opposing Pool; 6 SL removes one more. Requires an armed opponent no larger than you.

description:7350360740004472cdfd4a6a.name: Distract
description:7350360740004472cdfd4a6a.text: Max: Agility Bonus. Bonus Tests: Athletics to Distract. Spend your Move on an Opposed Athletics/Cool Test. If you win, the target cannot generate Advantage for its Pool until the next Round ends.

description:67a9fc48f6b375eede19b2df.name: Drilled
description:67a9fc48f6b375eede19b2df.text: Max: Weapon Skill Bonus. Bonus Tests: Melee beside an ally with Drilled. Count as two combatants when determining Losing Advantage (p. 137).

description:a21f55a2125c6cded930a921.name: Flee!
description:a21f55a2125c6cded930a921.text: Max: Agility Bonus. Tests: Athletics while fleeing or as pursuit Quarry. Count Movement as 1 higher in those circumstances.

description:dd916fef8b887952d7d58b65.name: Gunner
description:dd916fef8b887952d7d58b65.text: Max: Dexterity Bonus. Add Gunner level SL to Extended Tests to reload blackpowder weapons. In combat, reloading also counts as Assess, with +1 extra Advantage from that Assess Test.

description:8bc52dfd6c44a9abecf6eb89.name: Rapid Reload
description:8bc52dfd6c44a9abecf6eb89.text: Max: Dexterity Bonus. Add Rapid Reload level SL to Extended Tests to reload ranged weapons. In combat, reloading also counts as Assess, with +1 extra Advantage from that Assess Test.

description:39adb2e58bfb101417044252.name: Relentless
description:39adb2e58bfb101417044252.text: Max: 1. Flee from Harm costs only 1 Advantage.

description:9950a7099446c7b75ac0b289.name: Reversal
description:9950a7099446c7b75ac0b289.text: Max: Weapon Skill Bonus. Tests: defensive Melee. After winning an Opposed Melee Test, you may transfer 1 Advantage from the opposing Pool to yours instead of gaining +1 Advantage. This causes no Damage, including on your own Turn.

description:10cc73df8d3cba3c70ad06a3.name: Roughrider
description:10cc73df8d3cba3c70ad06a3.text: Max: Agility Bonus. Tests: Ride in combat. With Ride, direct your mount to take an Action as well as a Move without a Ride Test. While mounted, use the mount’s Size when resisting Fear or Terror caused solely by an enemy’s Size. This does not protect against other causes, such as Daemonic or Undead nature.

description:f9e7aa788ca0412328c97fa0.name: Shieldsman
description:f9e7aa788ca0412328c97fa0.text: Max: Strength Bonus. Tests: shield defence. Once per turn while defending with a Shield, spend 2 Advantage either to deal Damage as though attacking on your Action or to push the attacker 2 yards directly away and end engagement.

description:46de6038d92510b6da37293f.name: Strike to Injure
description:46de6038d92510b6da37293f.text: Max: 1. Roll twice on Critical Damage tables and choose either result.

description:be9d9cb84ec8d51a076cda8e.name: Command the Legion
description:be9d9cb84ec8d51a076cda8e.text: Issue a command to an ally in line of sight, provided it advances an armed struggle or current strategy. Resulting Leadership Tests gain +10.

description:3dafe1dab9a9a3bafb14288e.name: In Good Order
description:3dafe1dab9a9a3bafb14288e.text: Allies may leave combat without giving enemies Momentum or free attacks while the Miracle lasts (printed Fleeing cross-reference: WFRP p. 165).

description:7b054175521f9914063b212a.name: Know Your Enemy
description:7b054175521f9914063b212a.text: The GM should let you inspect the target enemy’s profile, Traits, Skills and Talents.

description:5c778a5e4d435da149d48733.name: On Deadly Ground
description:5c778a5e4d435da149d48733.text: Allies cannot receive Broken Conditions for the duration.

description:ce6869848286d4bc9a09765a.name: Quick Strike
description:ce6869848286d4bc9a09765a.text: At each Round’s start, pass Challenging (+0) Initiative to make an immediate free attack outside turn order with your primary-hand weapon.

description:8ab6d50638726fe2f90f93c7.name: Shieldmaiden’s Devotion
description:8ab6d50638726fe2f90f93c7.text: Myrmidians in range gain +1 Fearless (Enemy), choosing a particular individual or species.

description:c8f92fa7442a39eeb38dab67.name: Skill of Combat
description:c8f92fa7442a39eeb38dab67.text: Allies in range gain +10 WS and BS for the duration.

description:5146ee01a21c62547144bc92.name: Vengeful Wrath
description:5146ee01a21c62547144bc92.text: You must charge and attack the nearest unrepentant enemy, and may reroll all Melee Skill rolls for the duration.

description:8e73e9734215732e45165844.name: Crew Commander
description:8e73e9734215732e45165844.text: Fourth Edition reference. Max: Initiative Bonus. Tests: Ranged with a Crewed weapon. Pass a Challenging (+0) Leadership Test to aid a crew within earshot; its members may use your Ranged Skill to shoot the weapon.

description:89a1dbd43928ffa6eda5c21a.name: Mundane Alchemist
description:89a1dbd43928ffa6eda5c21a.text: Petty Magic and Arcane Magic (Metal) are Human-only. Spell access is limited to four named Petty spells plus Mundane Aura, Ward, Enchant Weapon, Fool’s Gold, Forge of Chamon and Mutable Metal (p. 39). Further spells require a later Wizard Career, outside current creator scope.

description:419c91321410e0c9f8e74c64.name: Scryer
description:419c91321410e0c9f8e74c64.text: Psychometry is Human-only. A starting Scryer uses normal Career Skill allocations and sacrifices no random Species Talent (p. 48). Psychometry and Augury are mutually exclusive (p. 46).

description:20f352ef512c46c70a181f70.name: Hierophant
description:20f352ef512c46c70a181f70.text: Light College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:0d452c0bde0b82dfef72ec6e.name: Alchemist
description:0d452c0bde0b82dfef72ec6e.text: Metal College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:e75e5bf63b0c97d02a2e4205.name: Druid
description:e75e5bf63b0c97d02a2e4205.text: Life College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:4ddf43691ecd0b97100d82e7.name: Astromancer
description:4ddf43691ecd0b97100d82e7.text: Heavens College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:0d9037a17fe4805f73f485ff.name: Shadowmancer
description:0d9037a17fe4805f73f485ff.text: Shadows College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:6f8d9c3c095e940388fbae6f.name: Spiriter
description:6f8d9c3c095e940388fbae6f.text: Death College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:4e6e89fd15066fe19ac50e33.name: Pyromancer
description:4e6e89fd15066fe19ac50e33.text: Fire College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:f8485ae4bd0549da32c562c7.name: Shaman
description:f8485ae4bd0549da32c562c7.text: Beasts College tradition. The printed Career is Human-only; core Wizard remains available. College affiliation and Arcane Marks are covered on p. 35 and the corresponding chapter.

description:7d0044a26b126778f14b6aa7.name: Practical Robes
description:7d0044a26b126778f14b6aa7.text: Approved shop price represents second-hand illicit-market robes. For the matching Wind, gain +1 SL to Channelling; a different Lore causes −1 SL to Casting and Channelling. Witch and Hedge Witch Careers gain no benefit. Agree the associated Wind with the GM. Magic modifiers remain situational references.

description:80f4110414a593d6122a4e92.name: Standard Robes
description:80f4110414a593d6122a4e92.text: Approved shop price represents second-hand illicit-market robes. For the matching Wind, gain +2 SL to Channelling; a different Lore causes −1 SL to Casting and Channelling. Witch and Hedge Witch Careers gain no benefit. Agree the associated Wind with the GM. Magic modifiers remain situational references.

description:038041b992fbbe3a018bc56e.name: Elaborate Robes
description:038041b992fbbe3a018bc56e.text: Approved shop price represents second-hand illicit-market robes. For the matching Wind, gain +3 SL to Channelling; a different Lore causes −1 SL to Casting and Channelling. Witch and Hedge Witch Careers gain no benefit. Agree the associated Wind with the GM. Magic modifiers remain situational references.

description:c6367fcdf025e370d8eda10f.name: Portable Alchemical Laboratory
description:c6367fcdf025e370d8eda10f.text: Travelling trunk containing mortar and pestle, crucibles, small forge, metal-working tools, glassware and ingredient drawers. Cost: 12 GC. Encumbrance and Availability are unspecified.

description:a7f969a4f95f695cf8ddc4e9.name: Enchanted Staff
description:a7f969a4f95f695cf8ddc4e9.text: Replacing it costs 15 GC through a Commission Endeavour, deferred by user choice; unavailable as a shop purchase. In combat, use core p. 301’s Quarterstaff profile. While borne, reduce CN by 1, minimum 0, for its Lore and the bearer’s Arcane spells; it also extends Touch-spell reach as part of the body. A Dhar-attracting staff causes Minor Corruption Exposure once daily. Elven Multi-Wind techniques are secret. Apprentice Staff Trappings are mundane.

description:f508e5d21d86dc5e67efa7cc.name: Vortex Movement Table
description:f508e5d21d86dc5e67efa7cc.text:
| Roll | Movement Direction – Map Based | Movement Direction – Abstract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Vortex disappears | Vortex disappears |
| 2 | North | Caster chooses direction |
| 3 | Northeast | Caster chooses direction |
| 4 | East | Caster chooses direction |
| 5 | Vortex remains in place | Caster chooses direction |
| 6 | Southeast | Vortex remains in place |
| 7 | South | GM chooses direction |
| 8 | Southwest | GM chooses direction |
| 9 | West | GM chooses direction |
| 10 | Northwest | GM chooses direction |

description:41480dd34f2a553f71fd2186.name: Overcast Table
description:41480dd34f2a553f71fd2186.text:
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SL | Additional Target | Extra Damage | Extra Range | Extra AoE | Longer Duration |
| 1 | +1 Target | +1 Damage | 2 × Range | Listed AoE | Listed Duration |
| 2 | +1 Target | +2 Damage | 2 × Range | Listed AoE | 2 × Duration |
| 3 | +1 Target | +3 Damage | 2 × Range | 2 × AoE | 2 × Duration |
| 5 | +2 Targets | +4 Damage | 3 × Range | 2 × AoE | 2 × Duration |
| 8 | +2 Targets | +5 Damage | 3 × Range | 2 × AoE | 3 × Duration |
| 13 | +2 Targets | +6 Damage | 3 × Range | 2 × AoE | 3 × Duration |
| 21 or more | +3 Targets | +7 Damage | 4 × Range | 3 × AoE | 3 × Duration |

description:e50c28dda43dff4079930322.name: Minor Miscast Table
description:e50c28dda43dff4079930322.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| 01–05 | Witchsign: Mutate the next living creature born within 1 mile. |
| 06–10 | Soured Milk: Instantly spoil all milk within 1d100 yards. |
| 11–15 | Blight: Crops rot overnight in Willpower Bonus fields within Willpower Bonus miles. |
| 16–20 | Soulwax: Gain 1 Deafened; it persists until another person cleans your ears with a successful Average (+20) Heal Test. |
| 21–25 | Freezing Breath: For 1 minute, the air within Willpower Bonus yards becomes visibly cold. Anyone there must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer –10 Ballistic Skill, Agility and Dexterity until leaving the area. |
| 26–30 | Unfasten: All your buckles and laces open, potentially dropping belts and bags, opening pouches and loosening armour. |
| 31–35 | Wayward Garb: Gain 1 Entangled from moving clothing, opposed by Strength 1d10 × 5. |
| 36–40 | Curse of Temperance: Spoil all alcohol within 1d100 yards, making it foul and bitter. |
| 41–45 | Cloyed Tongue: Apply –10 to all Language Tests, including Casting Tests, for 1d10 Rounds. |
| 46–50 | Driven to Distraction: Gain Surprised if fighting; otherwise become startled and unable to concentrate briefly. |
| 51–55 | Unholy Visions: Gain 1 Blinded; fail a Challenging (+0) Cool Test and gain another. |
| 56–60 | Hexeyes: Your eyes take your Lore’s unnatural colour for 1d10 hours. Throughout, gain 1 Blinded that cannot be removed, and lose access to Magical Sense and Second Sight. |
| 61–65 | Rupture: Bleeding from the face causes 1 Bleeding. |
| 66–70 | Fell Whispers: The GM may choose two reversed symbols (Symbols Table, p. 45). Fail an Average (+20) Willpower Test and gain 1 Corruption point. |
| 71–75 | The Horror!: The GM may select one reversed symbol (Symbols Table, p. 45). Fail a Hard (–20) Cool Test and gain 1 Broken from visions of Chaos. |
| 76–80 | Curse of Corruption: Gain 1 Corruption point. |
| 81–85 | Intestinal Rebellion: Soil yourself and gain 1 Fatigued; this cannot be removed until you clean yourself and change clothing. |
| 86–90 | Marked by Magic: Gain an Arcane Mark of your Wind: Hysh p. 58; Chamon p. 70; Ghyran p. 82; Azyr p. 94; Ulgu p. 106; Shyish p. 118; Aqshy p. 130; Ghur p. 142. If no table suits your tradition, or the rolled mark is already present, roll on Major Miscasts instead. |
| 91–95 | Multiplying Misfortune: Roll twice here, rerolling 91–00. |
| 96–00 | Cascading Chaos: Roll on Major Miscasts. |

description:763f791d950a8865ddb56c9d.name: Major Miscast Table
description:763f791d950a8865ddb56c9d.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| 01–05 | Ghostly Voices: All within Willpower yards hear whispers of Chaos. Every sentient creature must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or gain 1 Corruption point. |
| 06–10 | Aethyric Shock: Lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armour Points. Fail an Average (+20) Endurance Test and also gain Stunned. |
| 11–15 | Death Walker: For 1d10 hours, nearby plants die as you pass. |
| 16–20 | Double Trouble: Repeat the cast spell’s effect elsewhere within 1d10 miles; the GM should apply consequences where possible. |
| 21–25 | Soulfire: Gain 1 Ablaze from flames coloured to match your Lore. |
| 26–30 | Speak in Tongues: For 1d10 rounds, speech becomes unintelligible. You cannot communicate verbally or make Casting Tests; other actions remain possible. |
| 31–35 | Swarmed: A GM-chosen aethyric swarm of Rats, Giant Spiders, Snakes or similar engages you. Use its normal profile plus Swarm. If not destroyed, it retreats after 1d10 rounds. |
| 36–40 | Ragdoll: Fly 1d10 yards in a random direction. On landing lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring Armour Points and gain Prone. |
| 41–45 | Limb frozen: One random limb is unusable for 1d10 hours; treat it as Amputated (WFRP p. 180). |
| 46–50 | Darkling Sight: Lose Second Sight and suffer –20 to Channelling Tests for 1d10 hours. |
| 51–55 | Chaotic Foresight: Gain an extra pool of 1d10 Fortune, which may exceed the normal limit. Each spent point gives 1 Corruption point; unused points expire at session end. The GM assigns Willpower Bonus reversed symbols (p. 45). |
| 56–60 | Levitation: Float 1d10 yards above ground for 1d10 minutes. Others can move you forcibly; spells, wings or similar can move you, but otherwise you return to the levitating position. Apply falling rules when it ends (WFRP p. 166). |
| 61–65 | Regurgitation: Vomiting gives Stunned for 1d10 Rounds. |
| 66–70 | Chaos Quake: Everyone within 1d100 yards must pass an Average (+20) Athletics Test or gain Prone. |
| 71–75 | Forgetfulness: Forget the spell being cast and memorise it again if previously memorised. If casting from a grimoire, its spell page burns and the spell is lost; prompt intervention is needed to stop the grimoire gaining Ablaze. |
| 76–80 | Traitor’s Heart: Betraying or attacking an ally with your full capabilities restores all Fortune. Causing another Character to lose a Fate point grants you +1 Fate point. |
| 81–85 | Foul Enfeeblement: Gain 1 Corruption point, Prone and Fatigued. |
| 86–90 | Hellish Stench: Gain Distracting (WFRP p. 339) for 1d10 hours; the odour may also provoke hostility. |
| 91–95 | Power Drain: The Talent used for this spell, usually Arcane Magic, becomes unusable for 1d10 minutes. |
| 96–00 | Aethyric Feedback: All friends and enemies within Willpower Bonus yards lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armour Points and gain Prone. If no targets are in range, your head explodes and you die immediately. |

description:aa777d964aba3f7fc908329b.name: Silence
description:aa777d964aba3f7fc908329b.text:
CN: 4 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus Yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus minutes

Sound cannot travel within, into or out of the surrounding zone. Casting suffers −3 SL.

description:37ed70ddd20a99fdf77a7dd1.name: the Bloody Hidesman
description:37ed70ddd20a99fdf77a7dd1.text: CN: 85 Type: Lore of Beasts Learning XP: 500. Ingredients: a constructed totem of bones and freshly flensed pelts from at least eight large animals. Conditions: Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Sacrifices: each Channelling Round requires Average (+20) Endurance or a Fatigued Condition. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, takes a Damage +12 freezing Ghur attack ignoring leather and fur armour. The totem becomes an Incarnate Elemental of Beasts (p. 176).

description:38ce57bf12e2cea48cdc5815.name: Create Familiar
description:38ce57bf12e2cea48cdc5815.text:
CN: 45 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 250. Prepare a vessel such as a puppet, animal, skeleton or book (p. 180); a concept or idea doubles CN. No conditions are required. Permanently sacrifice one Wound, Fate point or Resilience point. Failure destroys the vessel. Create a Power Familiar assisting magic, a Spell Familiar with its own wizardry, or a Combat Familiar guarding you. Each is an independent Character bound to obey and protect you, regardless of affection, and can improve or be played by another Player (p. 184). A second familiar requires CN 80 and a sacrifice of two Wounds, Fate Points or Resilience Points. Humanoid form is the default; the GM assigns benefits, deficits and CN adjustments for other forms. The following suggested modifiers are not exhaustive.

| FAMILIAR TRAITS | FAMILIAR TRAITS |
| --- | --- |
| Trait | CN |
| Size (Tiny) | –10 |
| Size (Little) | –5 |
| No arms | –10 |
| May not talk | –10 |
| May not smell | –5 |
| Amphibious | +20 |
| Dark Vision | +5 |
| Flight (20) | +20 |
| Stride | +10 |
| Ward (10) | +30 |

description:edc9a6d45d5bd83d8cc83c2e.name: Brew Potion
description:edc9a6d45d5bd83d8cc83c2e.text: As one Endeavour, brew one batch of a chosen potion using the process on p. 160. Have its ingredients ready or obtain them with Commission or Gather Ingredients. A laboratory is required unless you have Concoct (p. 161).

description:32e8ead896493b3b4b7f52a1.name: Gather Ingredients
description:32e8ead896493b3b4b7f52a1.text: If the GM agrees a suitable ingredient-gathering location is close enough, spend one Endeavour gathering there under p. 155’s process, which normally takes a week. A failed attempt may be retried as a second Endeavour.

description:3bc4250e270bf3cbb9c0a2f7.name: Improve Familiar
description:3bc4250e270bf3cbb9c0a2f7.text:
A familiar cannot use Endeavours independently. Its creator must take Improve Familiar and pass a Hard (–20) Research Test; the familiar may assist. Success lets the familiar immediately undertake one eligible Endeavour, which it must still complete normally:

- Training (WFRP p. 199).
- Unusual Learning (WFRP p. 199), excluding Bless, Invoke and Pure Soul.
- Train with Unusual Weapon (Altdorf p. 219), for Combat Familiars only.
- Test Magic Item (Altdorf p. 219), for Spell or Power Familiars only.

Each successful Improve Familiar grants one such opportunity.

description:dccb5a3f299ac7dbe315c22a.name: New Endeavours
description:dccb5a3f299ac7dbe315c22a.text: Spellcasters may take these Endeavours between adventures. Magical-item crafting Endeavours are in Archives of the Empire vol II.

description:aeef2264f10208da84f69ea5.name: Perform Ritual
description:aeef2264f10208da84f69ea5.text: A ritual may be performed between adventures as an Endeavour. With GM and Player agreement, the caster can locate a site with Heavy or Extreme magical Saturation. Halve the ritual’s CN, rounding up, to represent careful preparation and a slower pace; the required channelled energy is unchanged. Its effects may end before the next adventure, and enemies may learn of the ritual and prepare countermeasures.

description:539f187faf242cfbfc178af1.name: Randomly Generating New Careers
description:539f187faf242cfbfc178af1.text:
When randomly generating a Career from WFRP pp. 30–31, use the second roll below if the initial Career has an alternative. The Player may keep the first Career instead of rolling again; a second roll may still return that Career. These Careers can also be entered later through the normal XP and circumstance requirements.

| Career | ACADEMICS |
| --- | --- |
| Apothecary | 01–75: Apothecary 76–00: Mundane Alchemist |
| Wizard | 01–95: Core Wizard or a College Career: Hierophant, Alchemist, Druid, Astromancer, Shadowmancer, Spiriter, Pyromancer or Shaman. 96–00: Magister Vigilant |

description:13b96bc54402d902ea638581.name: Augury Table
description:13b96bc54402d902ea638581.text:
|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SL | Result | Effect |
| +6 or more | Astounding Success | Select two Symbol Table symbols. |
| +4 to +5 | Impressive Success | Generate two Symbol Table symbols randomly. |
| +2 to +3 | Success | Select one Symbol Table symbol. |
| +0 to +1 | Marginal Success | Generate one Symbol Table symbol randomly. |
| –0 to –1 | Marginal Failure | Learn nothing. |
| –2 to –3 | Failure | Generate one reversed Symbol Table symbol randomly. |
| –4 to –5 | Impressive Failure | Generate two reversed Symbol Table symbols randomly. |
| –6 or less | Astounding Failure | Generate three reversed Symbol Table symbols randomly. |

description:d44001104738f7d9f6d87e19.name: Symbol Table
description:d44001104738f7d9f6d87e19.text:
| Roll | Symbol | Common Meanings | Related Tests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Morrslieb | Misfortune, Chaos | Perception. Reversed: Tests made to resist Corruption. |
| 2 | Morr | Death, Dreams | Intuition. Reversed: Intuition. |
| 3 | Ulric | Battle, Wolves, Winter | Charm Animal, Endurance, Outdoor Survival. Reversed: Ranged (Blackpowder) Tests. Tests made to resist Prejudice or Animosity. |
| 4 | The Tower | Hubris, Hidden Threat | Bribery, Stealth. Reversed: Perception. |
| 5 | Sigmar | Victory, Unity, Hope | Leadership. Reversed: Channelling. |
| 6 | Ace of Hammers | Defiance of Evil | Melee (Any). Tests made to resist Corruption. Reversed: Ranged (Any), Charm. |
| 7 | Verena | Justice, Wisdom | Charm Tests made to convince a person of the truth. Lore (Any). Reversed: Pick Lock, Sleight of Hand, Channelling (Ulgu). |
| 8 | Blitzbeil | Strength, Ferocity | Tests to enter Frenzy. Melee (Basic). Reversed: Gossip Tests. Haggle Tests. |
| 9 | The Fortress | Fortitude, Safety | Melee (Basic) Tests made to oppose attacks. Reversed: Athletics, Climb. |
| 10 | The Daemon | Manipulation, Danger | Channelling, Charm, Language (Magick). Reversed: Leadership. |

The GM records symbols reversed by failed Augury Tests. Apply –1 SL to the first Test associated with a reversed symbol. Where several Skills are listed, apply the benefit or penalty once to each Skill.

description:8888731660f72dfbff5b69d4.name: Augury Spells Overcast Table
description:8888731660f72dfbff5b69d4.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| SL | Effect |
| 1 | Roll once on the Symbol Table. |
| 2 | Roll once on the Symbol Table. |
| 3 | Choose a symbol from the Symbol Table. |
| 5 | Choose a symbol from the Symbol Table. |
| 8 | Roll twice on the Symbol Table. |
| 13 | Roll twice on the Symbol Table. |
| 21 or more | Choose two symbols from the Symbol Table. |

description:63e97ec1849d130008b8f669.name: Psychometery Result Table
description:63e97ec1849d130008b8f669.text:
| SL | Result | General | Burglary Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| +6 or more | Astounding Success | Learn at least three details, including one highly relevant detail. | Sense fear, see a group breaking a window, and hear a threat to keep silent. |
| +4 to +5 | Impressive Success | Learn two details. | See a racketeer approaching the window with a rock, and feel unable to speak. |
| +2 to +3 | Success | Learn one detail. | Hear breaking glass. |
| +0 to +1 | Marginal Success | Receive an indistinct or metaphorical clue. | See a swimming fish: the racketeers’ organisation is called ‘the Fish’. |
| –0 to –1 | Marginal Failure | Learn nothing. | No useful impression. |
| –2 to –3 | Failure | Receive a somewhat misleading clue. | Mistakenly connect the victim’s fear to an uninvolved person. |
| –4 to –5 | Impressive Failure | Receive disturbing, misleading impressions. | Experience many images and feelings without a relevant clue. |
| –6 or less | Astounding Failure | Nightmarish impressions overwhelm you; gain 1 Corruption point. | Feel overwhelming fear, powerlessness and shame; gain 1 Corruption point. |

description:a8ddb96e9454dc09ee2145fa.name: Alchemical Products
description:a8ddb96e9454dc09ee2145fa.text:

| Bladders of Liftgas | 12 | 14 | 2 Days | 1 GC 6/– | Very Hard (-30) |
| Keg of Blackpowder (contains enough for 12 horns, which each contain enough for 12 shots) | 1 | 4/– | 3 Days | 8/– | Challenging (+0) |
| Keg of Improved Blackpowder (contains enough for 12 horns, which each contain enough for 12 shots) | 1 | 4/– | 5 Days | 2 GC | Difficult (-10) |

description:799f39e629ff9575e1e4d9ab.name: Banishment
description:799f39e629ff9575e1e4d9ab.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Creatures in the area whose Toughness is below your Willpower are affected. Those with Undead or Daemonic gain Unstable (WFRP p. 343), or fall to 0 Wounds if already Unstable.

description:3d10e7f0b858c153956db476.name: Blinding Light
description:3d10e7f0b858c153956db476.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Everyone looking at you gains Blinded Conditions equal to SL unless they possess Arcane Magic (Light).

description:5a93137b3f420c0c48db5268.name: Clarity of Thought
description:5a93137b3f420c0c48db5268.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Intelligence minutes

The target ignores penalties to mental processes for the duration, including Stunned, Mental Mutations and Psychologies.

description:1e09b7fc1134d51a3b311fa1.name: Daemonbane
description:1e09b7fc1134d51a3b311fa1.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Oppose your Casting Test with the target’s Willpower. Winning banishes a Daemonic creature to its origin. On banishment, observers of the target gain Blinded Conditions equal to SL unless they possess Arcane Magic (Light).

description:4c07226b1742a53e3378f24f.name: Healing Light
description:4c07226b1742a53e3378f24f.text:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

The target glows as brightly as a campfire and heals Intelligence Bonus + Willpower Bonus Wounds. Passing Very Hard (−30) Endurance also removes 1 Corruption point gained within the past hour.

description:9a98430ac3119be770dd3a98.name: Net of Amyntok
description:9a98430ac3119be770dd3a98.text:
CN: 8 Range: Intelligence Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Target’s Intelligence Bonus rounds

Targets gain one Stunned Condition that cannot be removed during the spell. Afterwards, recovery Tests use Intelligence instead of Endurance. Bestial creatures are immune.

description:97f1b361b7b50aecf4d1774f.name: Phâ’s Protection
description:97f1b361b7b50aecf4d1774f.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Creatures with Undead, Daemonic, mutations, or Corruption exceeding their combined Willpower and Toughness Bonuses cannot enter. Those already inside gain Broken until leaving. No creature inside can gain Corruption while the spell lasts.

description:99354b3f9a43bd87edaca00d.name: Speed of Thought
description:99354b3f9a43bd87edaca00d.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain +20 Intelligence and Initiative.

description:909be04a01f3cfbeb8527601.name: Crucible of Chamon
description:909be04a01f3cfbeb8527601.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 object Duration: Instant

Melt and destroy one non-magical metal object, including a weapon or armour covering one body part. Held objects are dropped. A worn object causes its wearer a magic-missile-like hit with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus. The cooled metal retains its raw-material value for smithing.

description:8eab29bdcf8a47cdf969d1f5.name: Enchant Weapon
description:8eab29bdcf8a47cdf969d1f5.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

One non-magical weapon becomes magical, gains Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, and gains Unbreakable (WFRP p. 298). Each +3 SL also adds one Weapon Quality or removes one Weapon Flaw for the duration.

description:88a1fed09c3d20c97d182426.name: Feather of Lead
description:88a1fed09c3d20c97d182426.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: Area of Effect (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

Choose one effect for everyone in the area: count as two steps more Overburdened, or ignore Overburdened entirely (Encumbrance, WFRP p. 293).

description:19f0a66ca3698f60b16de72e.name: Fool’s Gold
description:19f0a66ca3698f60b16de72e.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

All metal in a touched non-magical object becomes real gold for the duration, then reverts. Changed weight and material can spoil weapons or make armour unwearable.

description:959fc0b40e4601f2d2183d76.name: Forge of Chamon
description:959fc0b40e4601f2d2183d76.text:
CN: 9 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Willpower minutes

A metal item gains one Item Quality or loses one Item Flaw. Each +2 SL permits one further Quality added or Flaw removed.

description:2471b891cf4b3c1bfa6dab74.name: Glittering Robe
description:2471b891cf4b3c1bfa6dab74.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Toughness Bonus Rounds

Gain Ward (9+) against every attack and spell targeting you (WFRP p. 343). Each hit saved improves it by 1, to a maximum of Ward (3+).

description:209a5a4445e631f3654adbfa.name: Mutable Metal
description:209a5a4445e631f3654adbfa.text:
CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

A touched non-magical metal object becomes pliable. Reshape it with Average (+20) Strength, or, with GM agreement for complex work, an appropriate Average (+20) Trade or Art Test.

description:27cffc94025cb3f855671b53.name: Transmutation of Chamon
description:27cffc94025cb3f855671b53.text:
CN: 12 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds

A magic missile hits everyone in the area with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus, ignoring Toughness Bonus. They gain one each of Blinded, Deafened and Stunned for the duration, +1 AP, and suffer Suffocation (WFRP p. 181). Anyone dying during the spell remains permanently encased in base metal.

description:1fe9b9307178ec9e54e362ee.name: Barkskin
description:1fe9b9307178ec9e54e362ee.text:
CN: 3 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

The target gains +2 Toughness Bonus but takes −10 Agility and Dexterity.

description:f213fc24aa306fdb38344c04.name: Earthblood
description:f213fc24aa306fdb38344c04.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Casting requires direct contact with earth, by touch or bare feet. Each living creature in the area directly touching earth heals Willpower Bonus Wounds at the start of every Round.

description:fdd32435c815a6e55d93469e.name: Earthpool
description:fdd32435c815a6e55d93469e.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Instant

Disappear into the ground and emerge at the next Round’s start anywhere within Willpower yards, plus Willpower yards per +2 Casting SL. Enemies you engage upon emergence gain Surprised. Travel through water is allowed; solid rock blocks it.

description:de534fa603c014cf792b89ec.name: Fat of the Land
description:de534fa603c014cf792b89ec.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

The target needs no food or drink but still excretes normally, with green waste.

description:95377c9855f1cda554f4ec4d.name: Forest of Thorns
description:95377c9855f1cda554f4ec4d.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Target earth to grow dense thorny plants. Anyone without Arcane Magic (Life) trying to cross on foot must pass Hard (−20) Agility or gain one Bleeding and one Entangled Condition at Strength equal to your Willpower. When the spell ends, the plants remain without magical effects.

description:d078b92470e9a692552d3973.name: Lie of the Land
description:d078b92470e9a692552d3973.text:
CN: 5 Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: You Duration: Special

Touch earth and commune for 1 minute to obtain a mental map of natural terrain in range, including land, woods and rivers. Settlements appear only indirectly as clearings or trenches. Each SL spent increasing Range also adds 1 minute of communion.

description:2d534ad806fe1607ed0d2d04.name: Lifebloom
description:2d534ad806fe1607ed0d2d04.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: Special Duration: Special

Restore a blighted or desolate target: a dry river flows again; a dry or polluted well becomes clean and full; planted fields, vineyards or orchards ripen immediately; a sick or unproductive domestic animal loses all diseases and regains vitality.

description:5d761b7fe4debef0cff37860.name: Regenerate
description:5d761b7fe4debef0cff37860.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

The target gains Regenerate (WFRP p. 341).

description:4a3e890917d6e32fc95a9a6f.name: Cerulean Shield
description:4a3e890917d6e32fc95a9a6f.text:
CN: 7 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain AP equal to SL at every location against melee attacks. An attacker using a metal weapon takes Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus, reduced by Toughness Bonus but ignoring Armour.

description:fb5fffebc66046a2b7ec1b4f.name: Comet of Casandora
description:fb5fffebc66046a2b7ec1b4f.text:
CN: 10 Range: Initiative yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Special

Choose an impact point in range. At the end of the next Round, Test Average (+20) Perception. Each positive SL lets you move the point Initiative Bonus yards; for each negative SL the GM moves it that far in a random direction. A Damage +12 magic missile then hits everyone in the area and gives them one Ablaze and Prone.

description:fbf270e136dc401f06c7f668.name: Fate’s Fickle Fingers
description:fbf270e136dc401f06c7f668.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

All allies in the area except those with Arcane Magic (Heavens) pool their Fortune points. Any participant may spend from the pool in order of request. When the spell ends, distribute remaining points as fairly as possible.

description:00624572a01f0a17ab86e777.name: Starcrossed
description:00624572a01f0a17ab86e777.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

For the duration, you can spend Fortune points to force an opponent to reroll Tests.

description:3d293a3ea5e45bb4e36f2082.name: The First Portent of Amul
description:3d293a3ea5e45bb4e36f2082.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain 1 Fortune point, plus 1 per +2 SL. Unspent points disappear when the spell ends.

description:e9a1327016208ba9a53e0542.name: The Second Portent of Amul
description:e9a1327016208ba9a53e0542.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain Fortune points equal to SL, plus 1 per +2 SL. Unspent points disappear when the spell ends.

description:f6bc356082920c593bdc5739.name: The Third Portent of Amul
description:f6bc356082920c593bdc5739.text:
CN: 12 Range: You Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus rounds

Gain 1 Fate point, lost if unused when the spell ends.

description:3dd7d3f32ff934980be6037b.name: Bewilder
description:3dd7d3f32ff934980be6037b.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A target failing Challenging (+0) Willpower rolls 1d10 once for its behaviour throughout the duration.

| Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Befuddled: The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test to take actions. |
| 3–4 | Wander: The target can act normally but moves in a random direction. |
| 5–6 | Attack: The target charges the nearest target and attacks. |
| 7–8 | Do Nothing: The target can only stand still and Dodge. |
| 9–10 | Curl Into a Ball: The target receives the Prone Condition and is Helpless (WFRP, page 162). |

description:3a5e79fcf6c394120cbe3197.name: Choking Shadows
description:3a5e79fcf6c394120cbe3197.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A target needing to breathe gains 1 Fatigued Condition, cannot speak, and suffers Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).

description:8cc4614a225bdb66860370ed.name: Doppelganger
description:8cc4614a225bdb66860370ed.text:
CN: 10 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus minutes

Take the appearance of a humanoid you know sufficiently well, as judged by the GM. Those without Second Sight are visually fooled, though wrong mannerisms may raise suspicion. Second Sight users need Difficult (−10) Intuition to detect the disguise.

description:6e109e39571ce4fa2a314782.name: Illusion
description:6e109e39571ce4fa2a314782.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Create a chosen illusion in the area. Anyone without Second Sight is fooled; Second Sight users need Difficult (−10) Intuition to recognise it, without seeing through or ending it. It stays still unless you use your Action and pass Hard (−20) Channelling to animate it within the area for one round.

description:8f056ecadbdd5333df6c6971.name: Mindslip
description:8f056ecadbdd5333df6c6971.text:
CN: 6 Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Willpower minutes

The target forgets all previous memories of you for the duration. At expiry, Average (+20) Intelligence is required to recover them; failure makes the loss permanent until dispelled.

description:5153b3b37e0d11d9f2689e30.name: Mystifying Miasma
description:5153b3b37e0d11d9f2689e30.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Anyone in the mist without Arcane Magic (Shadows) gains one each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued for the duration. Moving requires Challenging (+0) Perception to avoid Prone. If dispelled, affected creatures must pass Easy (+40) Initiative or gain Stunned.

description:4aed4f94f33d6b64e5f0ced2.name: Shadowsteed
description:4aed4f94f33d6b64e5f0ced2.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Until the next sunrise

Summon a Riding Horse (WFRP p. 316) without Skittish. Outside sunlight it gains Dark Vision, Ethereal, Fear (1), Magical, Painless, Stealthy, Stride and Ward (9), and remains rideable while insubstantial. Ride Tests gain +20 for riders with Arcane Magic (Shadows), or −20 without it. It never needs rest and dissolves at sunrise; a mounted rider then falls and takes falling damage (p. 166).

description:25ccad7145c30fc2ec499bc1.name: Shadowstep
description:25ccad7145c30fc2ec499bc1.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: You Duration: Instant

Teleport up to Willpower yards. Enemies engaged with you at either departure or arrival gain Surprised.

description:daa409ba8c7c613c06225132.name: Shroud of Invisibility
description:daa409ba8c7c613c06225132.text:
CN: 8 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Make the target invisible, automatically fooling those without Second Sight. A Second Sight user passing Challenging (+0) Perception senses someone nearby without locating them precisely. Other senses can still detect the target. Loud noise or attacking ends the spell.

description:71f480da71b3a0711e67257e.name: Caress of Laniph
description:71f480da71b3a0711e67257e.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

A Damage +6 magic missile ignores Toughness Bonus and AP. Heal 1 Wound per 2 Wounds inflicted, up to your maximum.

description:e205a00932f3ef2e8645dc5f.name: Crystal Maze
description:e205a00932f3ef2e8645dc5f.text:
CN: 13 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Targets vanish into the crystal maze and cannot be harmed or affected. At the end of each of their subsequent rounds, each rolls 1d10 on the following table.

| Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Escape: The target returns to the material realm where it disappeared. |
| 4–6 | Confused: The target rolls again next round. |
| 7–9 | Lost: The target is lost for 1d10 hours and rolls to resist a Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP, page 182) when they return. |
| 10 | Doomed: The target is lost forever in the Realm of Tzeentch. |

description:42dad294eae1be17da2f3f3c.name: Dying Words
description:42dad294eae1be17da2f3f3c.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Touch someone dead no more than a day to call their soul back for the duration. It can only speak, need not answer, and cannot lie.

description:2a4d6035e6105b2f20bc3e6a.name: Purple Pall of Shyish
description:2a4d6035e6105b2f20bc3e6a.text:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain AP equal to Willpower Bonus at every location and Fear (1) (WFRP p. 339). Each +2 SL may increase Fear by 1.

description:eacfe367b91608007f5caf8e.name: Sanctify
description:eacfe367b91608007f5caf8e.text:
CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower minutes

Inscribe a circle that Undead cannot enter or leave.

description:daba0cc0f5a9f699666d7b42.name: Scythe of Shyish
description:daba0cc0f5a9f699666d7b42.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Create a magical scythe using Melee (Polearm), with Halberd rules and Damage Willpower Bonus + 3. Engaged Undead receive no Advantage against you.

Shyish Uncovered — CN: 4 Range: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Target: You Duration: Initiative Bonus minutes. Learn how many creatures of each species died in the area and when, within the previous month plus one month per +1 SL. Names and causes of death are not revealed. If you know a deceased person’s name, each additional +2 SL permits one question answered through knocks, such as yes/no or numbers.

description:2b500bd6ad605ff132c44abc.name: Soul Vortex
description:2b500bd6ad605ff132c44abc.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Everyone in the area gains +1 Broken Condition. Undead also take a Damage +10 magic missile ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP.

description:ad3643c1a469111f94ac7fd8.name: Steal Life
description:ad3643c1a469111f94ac7fd8.text:
CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

A Damage +6 magic missile ignores AP and causes 1 Fatigued Condition. Remove all your own Fatigued Conditions and heal up to half the Wounds it inflicted, rounded up.

description:e3be49521d65c43841a6ab70.name: Swift Passing
description:e3be49521d65c43841a6ab70.text:
CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Instant

Touch a target at 0 Wounds with at least 2 Critical Wounds to kill them. They cannot be raised as Undead.

description:7aec42b4471099da8a0f6d05.name: Aqshy’s Aegis
description:7aec42b4471099da8a0f6d05.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Ignore Damage from non-magical fire and any Ablaze Conditions you receive. Gain Ward (9) against magical fire, including warpfire, Breath (Fire) and Lore of Fire spells (WFRP p. 343).

description:3891df7ea8100706acaab9eb.name: Cauterise
description:3891df7ea8100706acaab9eb.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

The target heals 1d10 Wounds, removes all Bleeding Conditions, and avoids infection in those wounds. Without Arcane Magic (Fire), they must pass Challenging (+0) Cool or scream. Failure by at least 6 SL also causes Unconscious and permanent scarring; they wake after 1d10 hours.

description:ca35d6b3f4c042a6f68825f7.name: Crown of Flame
description:ca35d6b3f4c042a6f68825f7.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain Fear (1) (WFRP p. 190), War Leader (p. 147) and +10 on Aqshy Channelling and Casting. Each +2 Casting SL increases Fear by 1 or grants another War Leader level.

description:5d4a6a1b14fbb0f8b61d3b2c.name: Firewall
description:5d4a6a1b14fbb0f8b61d3b2c.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Special) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Create a wall Willpower Bonus yards long, 1 yard high and 1 yard deep. Each +2 Casting SL adds Willpower Bonus yards of length. Crossing causes 1 Ablaze and a magic missile with Damage equal to Willpower Bonus.

description:edb589b601a435bd611c1b52.name: Flaming Hearts
description:edb589b601a435bd611c1b52.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Allies remove all Broken and Fatigued Conditions and gain Drilled, Fearless and Stout-hearted. Each already possessed Talent gains one temporary level instead.

description:526ac59d1eab0cb75271feb4.name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
description:526ac59d1eab0cb75271feb4.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A sword (Hand Weapon) gains Damage SB+6 and Impact (WFRP p. 298). Each struck creature gains 1 Ablaze. A wielder without Arcane Magic (Fire) also gains 1 Ablaze when Fumbling an attack with it.

description:6c07204e6eed5d566799d4e0.name: Great Fires of U’Zhul
description:6c07204e6eed5d566799d4e0.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A Damage +10 magic missile ignores AP and causes 2 Ablaze and Prone. Everyone in the target area also takes a Damage +5 hit ignoring AP and must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge or gain 1 Ablaze. The remaining fire no longer counts as a magic missile: at each Round’s end, anyone in the area takes 1d10 + 6 Damage ignoring AP and gains 1 Ablaze for the duration.

description:1ca7452257708f3d8796f58f.name: Purge
description:1ca7452257708f3d8796f58f.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Ignite flammable material in the area and give creatures Ablaze Conditions equal to SL. Corrupting Influences such as Dhar, Warpstone and Chaos-tainted items begin burning away. Maintain the spell each subsequent round with Challenging (+0) Channelling. The GM sets removal time: a sub-acorn Warpstone quantity or minor tainted item suggests 10 − Willpower Bonus rounds (minimum 1); a fist-sized quantity or stronger item takes twice as long; major artefacts may require hours or longer (WFRP p. 182).

description:b810255973ef7c79eee0dbb9.name: Amber Talons
description:b810255973ef7c79eee0dbb9.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Unarmed attacks become magical, deal Damage equal to SL + Strength Bonus + Willpower Bonus, and inflict 1 Bleeding whenever they cause Wound loss.

description:162559f57632fcf27b08a3a7.name: Beast Form
description:162559f57632fcf27b08a3a7.text:
CN: 5 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Become a creature from Beasts of the Reikland (WFRP p. 314), gaining all standard Traits except Bestial and replacing Movement, Strength, Toughness, Agility and Dexterity; recalculate Wounds. Each +2 SL permits one Optional Trait. You resemble a normal amber/brown specimen, cannot speak, cast or dispel. On reverting, subtract the same number of Wounds lost in Beast Form from your normal Wounds, to a minimum of 0.

description:8f392baa2a80dc39d1adeb51.name: Beast Master
description:8f392baa2a80dc39d1adeb51.text:
CN: 10 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus days

One Bestial creature of Small, Average or Large Size accepts you as pack master, obeys simple instructions and fights to the death to protect you. After expiry it will not attack you unless compelled, though allies have no such protection.

description:87d02fce97357625f34e1588.name: Beast Tongue
description:87d02fce97357625f34e1588.text:
CN: 3 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower minutes

Communicate with Bestial creatures and gain +20 Charm Animal and Animal Training. They need not answer or obey but usually listen. You cannot speak ordinary languages, cast or dispel during the spell; gestures and Language (Battle) can communicate with your party.

description:a3fda93ea05456daa56ccdf3.name: Beast Unbroken
description:a3fda93ea05456daa56ccdf3.text:
CN: 4 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

A domestic animal becomes permanently wild until dispelled. The GM chooses flight or hostility to its owner. Charm Animal can deter attacks but cannot tame it. Riders must pass Hard (−20) Ride to avoid being thrown. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead target a Human, who resists with Difficult (−10) Willpower. Failure causes thick body hair, loss of speech and the following 1d10 behaviour roll each round. Both versions persist until dispelled.

| Roll |  |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Distracted: The target scratches its fur, defecates, or picks its nose |
| 4–6 | Panicked: The target moves in a random direction, running into obstacles or attacking creatures in its path |
| 7–9 | Friendly: The target laughs maniacally and crawls or dances toward the nearest character |
| 10 | Enraged: The target releases a primal scream, causing Fear (1) in anyone without the Arcane Lore (Beasts) Talent who can hear it |

description:c0bdc1b6826d83dfb3431f0b.name: Flock of Doom
description:c0bdc1b6826d83dfb3431f0b.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

A bird flock deals a Damage +7 hit at each Round’s end to everyone in the area without Arcane Magic (Beasts). Every creature in the area suffers 1 Blinded. As your Action, pass Average (+20) Charm Animal to move the flock to another target in range.

description:93ec5646fed39920553b67ca.name: Hunter’s Hide
description:93ec5646fed39920553b67ca.text:
CN: 6 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain +20 Toughness, Dark Vision and Fear (1) (WFRP p. 339), and Acute Sense (Smell) (p. 132).

description:96de4afce1af1005c9d10356.name: The Amber Spear
description:96de4afce1af1005c9d10356.text:
CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant

A Damage +12 magic missile follows a straight line, ignoring leather and fur AP. Whenever it wounds a creature, also give that creature 1 Bleeding and continue to the next target, reducing Damage by 1 per creature passed through. Failure to inflict Wounds stops it. Only the first target receives the minimum 1 Wound rule (WFRP p. 159).

description:07d37de61f43632084122abe.name: Wyssan’s Wildform
description:07d37de61f43632084122abe.text:
CN: 8 Range: You Target: You Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Gain Arboreal, Armour (2), Belligerent, Big, Bite (Strength Bonus +1), Fear (1), Fury, Magical and Weapon (Strength Bonus +2) (WFRP p. 338). You cannot use Language or Lore Skills for the duration.

description:a3305c43c9e923e5edcaa173.name: Wizard’s Robes
description:a3305c43c9e923e5edcaa173.text:
Wizard robes grant a bonus to Channelling Tests and are awarded at the listed Career ranks. The prices and Availability below are rough guides to illicit second-hand sales; robes may also be made with the Crafting Endeavour.

| Grade | Channelling bonus | Awarded to | Cost | Enc | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Practical Robes | +1 SL | Wizard | 1 GC | 1 | Rare |
| Standard Robes | +2 SL | Master Wizard | 8 GC | 2 | Exotic |
| Elaborate Robes | +3 SL | Wizard Lord | 30 GC | 4 | Exotic |

Chaos sorcerers, necromancers and daemonologists use their own designs and need a willing tailor. Witches and hedge witches receive no benefit from robes. A wizard, witch or hedge witch wearing robes for a Lore they do not practise suffers –1 SL to all Casting and Channelling Tests.

Practical outfits are plain and may conceal the wearer’s profession. Standard outfits are more complex, commonly including a heavy coat or cloak and distinctive headwear. Elaborate outfits are bulky, heavy and impractical, and immediately identify the wearer as a wizard; any grade can comprise coordinated clothing and accessories rather than a literal robe.

| 85–86 | Voice Change | Retching | Mindslip | Roll Minor |
| 87–88 | Voice Change | Retching | Roll Minor | Roll Moderate |
| 89–90 | Warts | Gut Burn (2) | Roll Moderate | Roll Major |
| 91–92 | Warts | Roll Minor | Roll Extreme | Roll Two Times |
| 93–94 | Wens | Roll Major | Roll Two Times | Roll Two Times |
| 95–96 | Wens | Roll Two Times | Roll Two Times | Roll Three Times |
| 97–98 | Roll Moderate | Roll Two Times | Roll Three Times | Deadly! |
| 99–00 | Roll Two Times | Roll Three Times | Deadly! | Deadly! |

Fungus: Begins after 1d10 days and lasts 1d10 days. Major imposes –2 SL to Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests; Extreme imposes –4 SL.

Goitre: Neck swelling develops over a couple of hours and may be mistaken for mutation. Minor is painful for 1 week; Moderate applies –1 SL to all Tests for 1 week.

Gripes: Apply –1 SL to Willpower-based Tests. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 1d10 hours; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Gut Burn (X): After 1d10 rounds, take a Damage X hit ignoring Armour.

Hair Loss: Starts after 1 day. Minor loses hair in clumps with normal regrowth; Moderate leaves noticeable bald patches after regrowth.

Hallucination: Starts after 1 hour. Minor lasts 1 hour with no penalty. For Moderate, test Easy (+40) Intelligence at the start of every round for 1 hour; Major uses Average (+20) for 1d10 hours; Extreme uses Challenging (+0) for 1 day. Each failed Test gives Stunned.

Itchy Bits: Starts after 1d10 rounds. Apply –1 SL to Agility-based Tests for 1 hour with Minor, or 1d10 hours with Moderate.

Intoxicating: On drinking, make a Challenging (+0) Consume Alcohol Test; failure requires a Stinking Drunk roll (WFRP p. 121). After 1d10 days, the effect may recur and requires an Average (+20) Consume Alcohol Test. Thereafter test Easy (+40) every 1d10 days until 5 consecutive Consume Alcohol Tests succeed and the potion leaves your system.

Mindslip: Roll on Mental Corruption (WFRP p. 185). The effect lasts 1 day for Moderate or 1 week for Major.

Oozing Orbs: Eyes sting and weep for 1d10 hours. Minor applies –1 SL to Perception and Ballistic Skill Tests; Moderate applies –2 SL.

Permeating Stench: Gain Distracting (WFRP p. 339), affecting allies and enemies. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 1d10 hours; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Poison: Moderate requires a Hard (–20) Endurance Test or gives 1 Poisoned. Major requires Very Hard (–30) or gives 2 Poisoned. Extreme requires Futile (–40) or gives 3 Poisoned.

Potent Brew: On drinking, make a Hard (–20) Consume Alcohol Test; failure requires a Stinking Drunk roll (WFRP p. 121).

Ravenous: Each round for 1d10 rounds, pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or attempt to eat the nearest organic object, including creatures or refuse. Moderate uses Challenging (+0) instead.

Retching: Begins after 1d10 hours. Failing a Test involving physical movement gives Stunned from vomiting. Duration: Moderate 1 day; Major 1d10 days.

Scabies: Moderate applies –1 SL to Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill and Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests for 2d10 hours. Major applies that penalty for 1d10 days. Extreme applies –2 SL for 2d10 days.

Sensory Loss: Roll on Sensory Loss. Moderate removes one sense for 1d10 minutes; Major removes two for 1d10 hours; Extreme removes three for 1d10 days.

Shrieks: Involuntary screaming lasts 1 round with Moderate, 1d10 minutes with Major, or 1d10 hours with Extreme. After Extreme, speech remains a hoarse whisper for 1d10 days.

Spots: Begins after 1d10 minutes, applying –2 SL to vision-based Perception Tests. Minor lasts 1d10 minutes; Moderate lasts 1 hour.

Suppurating Sores: Moderate inflicts a Damage 4 hit; Major a Damage 6 hit; Extreme a Damage 8 hit plus permanent loss of 1 Wound. These hits ignore Armour.

Tingles: Gain +1 SL to Toughness-based Tests and –1 SL to Agility- and Dexterity-based Tests. Duration: Minor 1 hour; Moderate 2d10 hours; Major 1d10 days; Extreme 1d10 weeks.

Vapours: Before any Skill Test, pass an Average (+20) Cool Test; Cool Tests and Tests to defend against clear danger are exempt. Minor lasts 1 hour; Moderate 1 day.

Violent Wind: At the start of each round, make a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test. Failure gives Distracting (WFRP p. 339), affecting allies and enemies, and forces a choice of either Move or Action in the following round. Duration: Minor 1 minute; Moderate 1 hour; Major 1 day; Extreme 1d10 days.

Voice Change: Voice pitch rises or falls without further effect. Minor lasts 1d10 minutes; Moderate 1d10 hours.

Warts: Apply –1 SL to Dexterity-based Tests. Minor lasts 1 day; Moderate 1 week.

Wens: Roll a Hit Location for cysts that last 1d10 days. A combat hit there requires a Hard (–20) Endurance Test; failure causes Festering Wound (WFRP p. 187).

description:ed00e5569157eb3b923a79de.name: Potion Brewer’S Requirements
description:ed00e5569157eb3b923a79de.text:
|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Approach | Requirements |
| Magic | Laboratory, Ingredients, Channelling Skill |
| Alchemy | Laboratory, Ingredients, Trade (Alchemy) Skill |
| Herbalism | Mortar and Pestle, Cauldron, Ingredients, Trade (Herbalist) Skill |
| Apothecary | Laboratory, Ingredients, Trade (Apothecary) Skill |

An Alchemical Laboratory, including space and equipment, costs 100 GC. Poor Quality costs 50 GC and applies –1 SL to Brewing Tests; Fine Quality costs 200 GC and grants +1 SL.

The brewer also needs the chosen potion’s recipe. Negotiate its price with the owner; no fixed price or guarantee of effectiveness is supplied, beyond the seller’s reputation.

description:b3a31dfb082356077ed2d8d3.name: Brewing Disasters
description:b3a31dfb082356077ed2d8d3.text:
| Roll | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1–3 | Spoiled: Finish the potion, but roll its spoilage on Potion Spoilage Effects. |
| 4 | Smoke and Stink: Burn the potion; the brewer and equipment smell strongly of brimstone for several days. |
| 5 | Butterfingers: Ruin the batch and break glassware. Repair or replacement costs 5% of the laboratory’s total cost. |
| 6 | Headaches: Ruin the batch. Fail a Difficult (–10) Endurance Test and gain 1 Poisoned. |
| 7 | Acid Burns: Take a Damage 1d10 hit. Without a healer’s attention within 1 hour, the burns leave permanent scars. |
| 8 | Trivial Explosion!: Take a Damage 1d10 + 2 hit. Repair or replacement of equipment costs 10% of the laboratory’s total cost. |
| 9 | Explosion!: Take a Damage 1d10 + 4 hit. Repair or replacement of equipment costs 20% of the laboratory’s total cost. |
| 10 | Fire!: The laboratory burns; repair or replacement of damaged equipment costs 30% of its total cost. |
| 11 | Major Explosion!: Destroy the laboratory and take a Damage 1d10 + 6 hit. |

description:650c2a8161b70e2bb042272c.name: Concoct
description:650c2a8161b70e2bb042272c.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus. Tests: Trade (Apothecary) and Trade (Alchemist). Take one free Crafting or Brew Potion Endeavour using either Skill without a workshop or laboratory. Other Crafting Endeavours gain no benefit.

description:6d8a59063984401dc31ae131.name: Panacea Universalis
description:6d8a59063984401dc31ae131.text:
Onset: 1d10 rounds. Volatility: Moderate. Ingredient Cost: 6 GC; Locale: Temperate Forest; Ingredient Difficulty: −10. Creation Difficulty: −2 SL; Time: 1 month. Once active, immediately recover 3 × Toughness Bonus Wounds and remove all Bleeding and Fatigued Conditions. Each listed Critical Injury may also heal on its required Test; multiple injuries can heal, but amputations cannot.

| PANACEA UNIVERSALIS CRITICAL HEALING | PANACEA UNIVERSALIS CRITICAL HEALING |
| --- | --- |
| Critical Injury | Healed on a… |
| Minor Broken Bone | Challenging (+0) Endurance Test |
| Major Broken Bone | Difficult (–10) Endurance Test |
| Minor Torn Muscle | Easy (+40) Endurance Test |
| Major Torn Muscle | Average (+20) Endurance Test |

Each disease is cured on an Average (+20) Endurance Test; test separately for every disease.

| 91–95 | Up in Smoke: Erase the spell from the grimoire. |

description:08984ea5746bc3277217401c.name: The Cursed Quality
description:08984ea5746bc3277217401c.text: Cursed also makes the item Magical, allowing its weapons to harm targets vulnerable only to Magical attacks. Close examination with the Sight reveals Dhar gathering in it. Each item has a normal benefit (Boon), a curse (Bane), and circumstances that activate it (Trigger).

description:fd3e4272c1f5ce2d3d3e4e8e.name: Knuckles of Ignominy
description:fd3e4272c1f5ce2d3d3e4e8e.text:
Knuckledusters with Impale. Causing a Critical Hit automatically infects the bearer without a resistance Test. Roll once on this table each time they Impale during a combat. Onset occurs within 1 or 2 days, usually publicly; the disease ends within 24 hours after at least one socially embarrassing interaction.

| 1d10 | Cursed Knuckleduster Diseases |
| --- | --- |
| 1–2 | Festering Wound |
| 3–4 | Itching Pox |
| 5–7 | Galloping Trots |
| 8–9 | Packer’s Pox |
| 10 | Bloody Flux |

description:c12e8ac26efa23191d6af2aa.name: Grim (Rating)
description:c12e8ac26efa23191d6af2aa.text: At its Turn's start, raise Advantage to Grim Rating if currently lower. With Up in Arms Group Advantage, generate Rating Advantage for the Adversary pool instead.

description:89e2e801834b4db48610997d.name: Lores And Familiars
description:89e2e801834b4db48610997d.text:
The table limits which familiar forms and types each magical tradition can create.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lore | Typical Form of Familiar | Types of Familiar |
| One of the College Lores | Varied, see page 182 | Combat, Power, or Spell |
| Lore of Witchcraft | Animal Companion | Power |
| Lore of Hedgecraft | Animal Companion | Power |
| Lore of Necromancy | Small Undead Construct | Combat or Power |
| Lore of Daemonology or Chaos Lore | Diminutive Daemonic Entity | Combat, Power, or Spell |

Witches and hedge witches enchant an animal or bird, rarely larger than a large cat, increasing its intelligence and understanding and making it magical. Some Imperial wizards, especially Jade and Amber, use the same method. Chaos Sorcerers and Daemonologists generally summon and bind minor Daemons.
