| 4 | Peevish | Selenophile | Mercurial | Aloof | Gentle | Pious | Grim | Shy |
| 5 | Lively | Knowing | Miserly | Anxious | Diligent | Pompous | Sombre | Cynical |
| 6 | Manic | Snooty | Bureaucratic | Fierce | Friendly | Uptight | Aloof | Sly |
| 7 | Wrathful | Proud | Confident | Fearful | Bucolic | Bookish | Slothful | Devious |
| 8 | Apoplectic | Inspired | Humorous | Physical | Solid | Solipsistic | Stoic | Shrewd |
| 9 | Blustery | Pretentious | Generous | Quick | Verbose | Traditional | Fatalistic | Ironic |
| 10 | Brooding | Graceful | Bloviating | Savage | Vulgar | Spiritual | Doomed | Aloof |

description:16383efe169a92deb44a9a25.name: Characteristics
description:16383efe169a92deb44a9a25.text:
To play a familiar, agree its type with the Player of its creator wizard, then generate the familiar as a Character.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  | Combat Familiar | Spell Familiar |
| Weapon Skill | 1d10 + 30 | 2d10 + 10 |
| Ballistic Skill | 2d10 + 10 | 2d10 + 10 |
| Strength | 1d10 + 30 | 2d10 + 10 |
| Toughness | 2d10 + 20 | 2d10 + 10 |
| Initiative | 2d10 + 20 | 2d10 + 20 |
| Agility | 2d10 + 20 | 2d10 + 20 |
| Dexterity | 2d10 + 20 | 2d10 + 20 |
| Intelligence | 2d10 + 10 | 1d10 + 30 |
| Willpower | 2d10 + 10 | 1d10 + 30 |
| Fellowship | 2d10 + 10 | 2d10 + 10 |
| Wounds | (2 × TB) + WPB | (2 × TB) + WPB |
| Fate | 1 | 2 |
| Resilience | 2 | 1 |
| Extra Points | * | * |
| Movement | 4 | 4 |

* The creator surrenders 1 Fate or Resilience point to create the familiar. Each additional Fate or Resilience point spent grants the familiar 1 extra point to assign to Fate or Resilience.

description:691980b5640f6e15aff06920.name: Magical Assistant
description:691980b5640f6e15aff06920.text: Max: 1. Power Familiar only; unavailable to other Species. Assist the creating wizard’s Channelling, Lore (Magic) and Language (Magick) Tests, and Research concerning magical innovation or discovery. Assistance gives +20 rather than +10 (WFRP p. 155).

description:02bf9784b76473b9a1e78826.name: Suffuse With (Wind)
description:02bf9784b76473b9a1e78826.text: Max: 1. Tests: see effects. Select one Wind. Successful casting from its associated Lore within 8 yards gains +1 SL; multiple nearby sources of the same Wind do not stack. Additional effects: Aqshy permits Frenzy and substitutes Channelling (Aqshy) for Willpower to enter it; Azyr substitutes its Channelling for Perception; Chamon for Evaluate; Ghur for Charm Animal and Lore (Beasts); Ghyran for Lore (Plants, Animals, Herbs) and Animal Care; Hysh for Research; Shyish for Intimidate; Ulgu for Stealth. Each substitution applies to all relevant Tests.

description:32c39492a448a5be292d2134.name: Environmental Saturation Effects
description:32c39492a448a5be292d2134.text:
|  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wind | Sympathetic Geography | Saturation Effects | Nicknames |
| Ghyran Life | Forests, Rivers, Farmland, Lakes, Springs, Jungle | Plant growth; misty air; sociable animals; sentient trees | Mother’s Bosom, Sea of Green |
| Azyr Heavens | Oceans, Rivers, Mountains, Lakes, Towers | Heavy rain; wild hyacinth; flocks of birds; violent thunderstorms | Eagle’s Tempest, Howling Brawl |
| Shyish Death | Battlefields, Deserts, Graveyards, Bogs, Marshes, Caves | Unnatural calm; wilted plants; conspiracies of ravens; ghostly apparitions | Raven’s Pickings, Deathly Pall |
| Chamon Metal | Mountains, Mines, Valleys, Settlements, Volcanic areas | High air pressure; mountain orchids; animals bicker and hoard; metallic terrain | Miner’s Blanket, Weighty Fray |
| Hysh Light | Plains, Deserts, Tundra, Settlements, Coastlines, Lakes | Clear sky; harmonious birdsong; wild garlic; blinding sunlight | Maiden’s Glare, Shimmering Rays |
| Ulgu Shadow | Valleys, Marshes, Settlements, Forests, Caverns | Thick fog; intoxicating mushrooms; silent animals; illusions in the fog | Trickster’s Mist, Bewildering Stew, Muddle-murk |
| Ghur Beasts | Tundra, Forests, Hills, Farmland, Plains, Jungle | Feral animals; bramble thickets; howling winds; giant animals | Raging Howl, Stag’s Rack |
| Aqshy Fire | Deserts, Jungle, Settlements, Volcanic areas | Heatwave; burning nettles; short-tempered animals; sudden wildfires | Comet’s Fury, Flaming Drought, Witch’s Pyre |

Use local geography to identify the dominant Wind unless Saturation comes from a leyline or a portal of a particular colour. In the source, italic effects generally appear first and bold effects occur only at Extreme Saturation. The nicknames are common names for these conditions.

description:0831055a994afae5d48e09c9.name: Chaotic Corruption Effects
description:0831055a994afae5d48e09c9.text:
When a region becomes corrupted, roll twice on this table. Chaos Magic users gain +1 SL to Casting and Channelling Tests there.

| Roll | Effect | Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1–5 | Pillars of Skulls | 51–55 | Crystallised Trees |
| 6–10 | Brass Sky | 56–60 | Multicoloured Soil |
| 11–15 | Rain of Blood | 61–65 | Phosphorescent Water |
| 16–20 | Frenzied Animals | 66–70 | Green Lightning |
| 21–25 | Razor Grass | 71–75 | Random Weather |
| 26–30 | Whispering Trees | 76–80 | Rotting Plants |
| 31–35 | Intoxicating Flowers | 81–85 | Diseased Trees |
| 36–40 | Alluring Voices | 86–90 | Putrid Water |
| 41–45 | Hairless Animals | 91–95 | Bloated Fly Swarms |
| 46–50 | Fleshy Tendrils | 96–00 | Blossoming Pustules |

description:ce4bb8af792419624db809b0.name: Necromantic Corruption Effects
description:ce4bb8af792419624db809b0.text:
When a region is corrupted, roll twice on this table. Dark Magic users gain +1 SL to Casting Rolls there. Corpses not consecrated to Morr rise as Zombies or Skeletons.

| Roll | Effect | Roll | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1–5 | Petrified Forest | 51–55 | Mounds of Bone |
| 6–10 | Barren Crops | 56–60 | Sunless Sky |
| 11–15 | Dire Wolves | 61–65 | Rain of Ash |
| 16–20 | Vampire Bats | 66–70 | Spirit Hosts |
| 21–25 | Poisoned Water | 71–75 | Ghoul Packs |
| 26–30 | Walking Dead | 76–80 | Foetid Swamp |
| 31–35 | Blackened Earth | 81–85 | Penetrating Chill |
| 36–40 | Withered Plants | 86–90 | Skeletal Animals |
| 41–45 | Insect Swarms | 91–95 | Bat Swarms |
| 46–50 | Carrion Birds | 96–00 | Dreadful Mist |

description:061a52cae5761428bb277805.name: summary of arcane phenomena
description:061a52cae5761428bb277805.text:
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Phenomenon |  | Casting | Channelling | Saturation | Special |
| Leyline | Natural | +1 SL | – | +1/year | – |
|  | Planned | +1 SL | – | See Vortex | Connects to Vortex |
| Waystone | Attraction | – | – | – | Creates junction |
|  | Refraction | – | +1 SL College Lores/ -1 SL Other | – | – |
|  | Dampening | -2 SL | – | – | +2 SL to Dispel Tests |
|  | Containment | – | – | Blocks | Negates Vortex |
|  | Amplification | +2 SL | – | +1/year | Leyline voids saturation |
| Ogham Circle |  | +1 SL for Life or Hedgecraft | +1 SL for Life or Hedgecraft | – | May possess waystone property |
| Great Vortex |  | – | – | -1/year | – |
| Nexus of Power | Leyline Junction | +1 to +3 SL | – | – | – |
|  | Geomantic Web | – | +2 SL | – | – |
| Arcane Fulcrum | Saturated Junction | +1 to +8 SL, Critical 0 or dbl. | – | +1/month | May become Dhar pool |
|  | Warp Rift | +1 to +5 SL, roll 1d10/2 / round | – | +1/month | Malignant Influence |
|  | Magic Portal | +1 to +5 SL, roll 1d10/2 / round | – | +1/month | Single colours of magic |
| Storm of Magic |  | +2 SL, flux for Critical Casting | Arcane Fulcrm can control flux | +1, Junctions may saturate | Random magical flux rolled every round |
| Environmental Saturation | Low | -1 SL | -1 SL | – | – |
|  | Normal | – | – | – | – |
|  | Heavy | +1 SL dominant | +1 SL dominant | 1-2 effects | – |
|  | Extreme | +2 SL dominant, +1 SL others | +1 SL dominant | 3-4 effects | – |
|  | Corrupted | +2/+1 SL Chaos or Dark Magic | +2/+1 SL Chaos or Dark Magic | 2 Corruptions +1 per level | Minor Exposure to Corruption |

description:9232cf6091faaa1eab64c01c.name: A Bite of Midges
description:9232cf6091faaa1eab64c01c.text:
CN: 5 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

At each Round’s end, warm-blooded creatures in the area take a Damage +2 hit. While inside, each must pass Average (+20) Endurance or gain one Blinded and one Fatigued.

description:cdcbe749eefdfcd777b95fd6.name: Despondent Slough
description:cdcbe749eefdfcd777b95fd6.text:
CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: 1 Duration: Special

The target gains one Entangled at Strength equal to your Intelligence, plus another per +2 Casting SL. The spell ends only when all are removed. Each round still Entangled requires Average (+20) Cool to avoid gaining Fatigued.

description:a39d112deb0f404a86599359.name: Inculcate Mizzle
description:a39d112deb0f404a86599359.text:
CN: 9 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus miles) Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

Create freezing drizzle. Fimir find it comfortable; others must pass Easy (+40) Endurance or gain Fatigued. Blackpowder shooting, Lore of Fire Casting and attempts to enter Frenzy take −2 SL while it lasts.

description:986f2d4dea5b23f5872b7fdb.name: Mystic Mist
description:986f2d4dea5b23f5872b7fdb.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds

Use Mystifying Miasma’s effects (Lore of Shadows, p. 112), at this spell’s lower CN.

description:c509af7a93ea740ce8152e76.name: O Mere Be More
description:c509af7a93ea740ce8152e76.text:
CN: 20 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus years

Stand at a marsh edge with one foot in water and one on dry ground. The marsh expands across the area. Mòna’s new spell remains unperfected.

description:68832946e9e3f020cf270eb5.name: Turned Around
description:68832946e9e3f020cf270eb5.text:
CN: 4 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus hours

The target must remain unaware of the casting. For the duration, its Navigation Tests within a swamp take −3 SL.

description:cb91ebd725102ea166334d64.name: Skin Of Bone And Bark
description:cb91ebd725102ea166334d64.text: Two different wizards contribute Ghyran CN 1 and Ghur CN 3 in the same round. Range: either caster Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus rounds, using the participants’ higher Willpower. The affected caster gains +20 Toughness.

description:11d10e4e8547a004ac749747.name: Construct Traits
description:11d10e4e8547a004ac749747.text:

description:27f49c4a59b82ad29f733ab6.name: Augury
description:27f49c4a59b82ad29f733ab6.text: Read omens to gain visions of the future. Learnable only by Humans/Elves and incompatible with Psychometry. Readings and conditional first-level Career access are detailed on pp. 44–46.

description:39427d21ff7757eb726e292f.name: Psychometry
description:39427d21ff7757eb726e292f.text: An innate Human gift: perceive recent events or unspoken thoughts at a connected location or while touching an associated person/object. Each use requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gives 1 Fatigued. Incompatible with Augury (p. 48).

description:fd010de30de8a7ddd2909be2.name: Belligerence of the Bloodmarsh
description:fd010de30de8a7ddd2909be2.text: A Fenbeast gains Frenzy if it does not already have it (WFRP p. 190).

description:3ac0243d48f8a466d93adb26.name: Collapse Construct
description:3ac0243d48f8a466d93adb26.text: After casting, win an Opposed Willpower/Toughness Test against a construct to make it inert.

description:ecb262ecadd2fc734cb5a5ec.name: Decipher Curse
description:ecb262ecadd2fc734cb5a5ec.text: Identify whether an item is cursed and learn its benefits, drawbacks and trigger. If you decipher a curse, pass Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence or suffer Moderate Exposure to Corruption from its secondary wards (WFRP p. 182). The curse remains active; removing it requires Remove Curse (p. 33).

description:719d7896d82616de1f305f9e.name: Disrupt Magic
description:719d7896d82616de1f305f9e.text: Cast before another caster finishes a channelled spell or ritual, then optionally make an Opposed Willpower Test against them. Winning makes their spell fail and gives them a Minor Miscast.

description:18a84ab1e659c3c7cbe8903d.name: Lifebloom Silt
description:18a84ab1e659c3c7cbe8903d.text: For the duration, a Fenbeast regenerates twice its usual Wounds.

description:63aefbf3c394d5ff4e48abea.name: Succour Magical Servant
description:63aefbf3c394d5ff4e48abea.text: Your Familiar or Construct immediately heals Toughness Bonus Wounds, doubled if Casting achieves at least +3 SL. Ritual magic requires large amounts of channelled power and may need particular surroundings, ingredients or personal sacrifices.

description:20fa8226c0b9847fb58c4773.name: Abulla’s Snare
description:20fa8226c0b9847fb58c4773.text: The target gains 2 Entangled at Strength equal to your Willpower and rises 2 yards. Next round it is pulled towards you, suspended about 5 yards above and 2 yards in front of your head, moving with you until expiry. Each +1 SL adds one Entangled or lifts it another 2 yards, maximum 10 yards. Release causes falling damage (WFRP p. 166).

description:c15af6010b912f44228af2f8.name: Assault of Stone
description:c15af6010b912f44228af2f8.text: Raise a permanent hill about 20 yards across and 5 yards high. Characters on the rising terrain take 20 Damage to a random location, reduced to 10 Damage by Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge.

description:1a4cb62637210b0efbc4d2f6.name: Crevasse
description:1a4cb62637210b0efbc4d2f6.text: Open a crevasse 3 yards in each dimension. Each +2 SL adds 1 yard of length and depth, to a maximum depth of 10 yards. Targets on or beside it need Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge to avoid falling; Marginal Failure allows grabbing the edge. Horses and vehicles fall automatically, and structures may partly collapse. At expiry it closes, dealing 20 Damage to trapped victims and burying them alive with Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).

description:975924b870954cda130b2c9d.name: Dazzling Brightness
description:975924b870954cda130b2c9d.text: Everyone in the area gains 1 Blinded unless they have Arcane Magic (Light). Daemons gain 1 Stunned.

description:989c89b7550cbdc0b4e28033.name: Driving Intent
description:989c89b7550cbdc0b4e28033.text: The target gains +2 SL to resist Charm and Intimidation. On yourself, you may instead choose +2 SL to Charm while speaking only truth; the College of Light regards this use as glamour.

description:cd9298ddbc505bcb4ce60ace.name: Erect the Edifice
description:cd9298ddbc505bcb4ce60ace.text: Raise a wall from local earth and stone, 5 yards long, 1 yard high and 6 inches thick, providing Hard Cover (WFRP p. 161), or Earthwork under Up In Arms artillery rules. Each +2 SL allows an extra round adding 5 yards length or 1 yard height; each extra yard of height adds 6 inches thickness. Each 2-yard section may have one door/window opening. A bend or curve costs +2 SL. Repeated castings can make a building shell, but it collapses after Willpower Bonus + SL days unless you or an adviser present during casting have Lore (Engineering) or Trade (Stoneworker). The spell makes no basements, floors or roofs; finishing needs carpentry.

description:59a69db07d09e052aa53b9e8.name: Eyes of Volans
description:59a69db07d09e052aa53b9e8.text: Take −2 SL to sight-based Perception, except gain +20 when reading Winds with Second Sight. See corruption and recognise mutations in Humans and other civilised species, though clothing may conceal them; plants and animals are excluded. Looking at a target reveals its Corruption point total or Corrupted Trait.

description:274893dfb908e72419ada5dc.name: Hands of Karkora
description:274893dfb908e72419ada5dc.text: Targets in the area must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or be Grappled (WFRP p. 163) by hands with Strength equal to your Willpower. If declared at casting, the hands may pull victims underground in later rounds instead of dealing Damage, causing Suffocation (p. 181).

description:89c73dd4175c9665f8d1a61c.name: Illuminate the Edifice
description:89c73dd4175c9665f8d1a61c.text: Fill every enclosed space in a house with daylight, including light escaping through cracks. +2 SL permits a tower or large manor; +4 SL a castle. Daemons and Undead need Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower to enter, then take Damage equal to Casting SL ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP.

description:debff818cfa8e6ad9899dcf1.name: Light of Purity
description:debff818cfa8e6ad9899dcf1.text: A light source grants Resistant (Disease) to everyone it illuminates. Wizards there add your Casting SL to attempts to dispel Dark and Chaos spells. The source sets Range and Duration (WFRP p. 309), capped at 1 mile and 1 day.

description:5a7b1226d9cb5ab62a5d0d35.name: Meissner’s Instantaneous Librarian
description:5a7b1226d9cb5ab62a5d0d35.text: Make a desired scroll, book or grimoire glow for Willpower Bonus + SL Rounds. Specify its title or a topic of at most 10 words; vague topics may identify several books. Immediately add 1 + SL towards an Extended Research Test. Further research normally needs reading, though complex research in a suitable library may count a second or third casting.

description:f79e9c43a963ba90124ccd6a.name: Orb of Hysh
description:f79e9c43a963ba90124ccd6a.text: Enclose one object of any size in solid light. Move, rotate or lift up to Willpower Bonus + SL Encumbrance at speed equal to Willpower Bonus. Malignant Influences inside are safely contained (WFRP p. 236), reducing exposure-based Corruption Tests by one level.

description:93e3c67e0f208a08637bcef7.name: Perfect Comprehension
description:93e3c67e0f208a08637bcef7.text: Understand spoken, written, coded, garbled or otherwise communicated language. This does not let you use languages you do not know. Dark Tongue is excluded; the GM may also exclude ancient obscure languages such as Slann or Old Ones speech.

description:e024fa167114eecccf6fa8e0.name: Pierce the Veil
description:e024fa167114eecccf6fa8e0.text: See through ordinary darkness, mist, smoke and fog as in daylight. An Opposed Willpower Test against the caster also lets you see through magical darkness, invisibility and illusions.

description:d35f6f38a8670f938153637b.name: Shimmering Cloak
description:d35f6f38a8670f938153637b.text: Melee and missile attacks lose their Damage rating and inflict only SL Wounds. Other non-magical Damage, including fire and falls, is negated. Magical attacks are unaffected. You cannot hide during the spell.

description:3a2ee9f4366d583dfa35ea9f.name: Time Amok
description:3a2ee9f4366d583dfa35ea9f.text: Every ally immediately receives one extra action without an extra move. Resolve these in Initiative order, skipping enemies and neutrals, then resume the usual order with the character after you.

description:4f8315d19213e1f947f923bc.name: Armour of Tin
description:4f8315d19213e1f947f923bc.text: Metal armour in the area loses 2 AP at every location.

description:11c5219f571f37d9e0b1ac3a.name: Breach the Unknown
description:11c5219f571f37d9e0b1ac3a.text: Learn an object’s physical properties as from a full day’s study, or a creature’s health and highest physical attribute. Each +2 SL reveals one further hidden detail, such as poison, medicinal properties or a Trait. Casting while touching a magical object temporarily grants Detect Artefact (WFRP p. 135).

description:e34ae6aa3a251e8073b36782.name: Curse of Rust
description:e34ae6aa3a251e8073b36782.text: Permanently rust one non-magical metal object into uselessness. At +4 SL you may also make a non-metal object brittle as glass for Willpower Bonus minutes. Mixed objects can have rusted metal and temporarily brittle non-metal parts; failed fasteners may break them apart. Maximum affected Encumbrance is 1, plus 1 per additional +2 SL.

description:fb7b6384d099ceffe1dcfa07.name: Fault of Form
description:fb7b6384d099ceffe1dcfa07.text: A partly metal weapon loses beneficial Qualities and gives −1 SL to hit. Dangerous Fumbles on 8, 9 or doubles; Reload doubles; Slow gives defenders +2 SL. Magical weapons resist alteration, but +4 SL temporarily suppresses their enchantments.

description:79b875961c70c71966de2e38.name: Gehenna’s Golden Globe
description:79b875961c70c71966de2e38.text: A golden sphere applies Golden Touch to targets in its area and moves using random vortex rules.

description:6a7d20f42829dbe438f92d59.name: Gilded Cage
description:6a7d20f42829dbe438f92d59.text: Golden bars enclose the area, bursting through obstructing walls or ceilings indoors. The half-inch bars can be bent with Hard (−2 SL) Strength or cut using suitable tools. Tiny or Little prisoners fit through 6-inch gaps. Outsiders cannot enter, but weapons and missiles pass between bars.

description:8fab380b909c4e121960d914.name: Golden Touch
description:8fab380b909c4e121960d914.text: The next living creature you touch must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower or become a golden statue. The GM secretly rolls Duration. The statue has Toughness Bonus 10, retains normal Wounds, cannot see, hear or feel, and need not breathe. Any Wounds suffered immediately end the spell.

description:da75f5bc431747373ac33cc6.name: Goldsteel Shielding
description:da75f5bc431747373ac33cc6.text: Reinforce a non-living object, building or surface with +4 Armour and immunity to natural damage such as fire, earthquakes and hurricanes. Each exterior wall of a small two-storey house is roughly 4 × 4 yards; full coverage may need repeated casting. Taking cover behind it reduces Corruption exposure by two levels and gives +1 SL to Dispel spells targeting you. It can contain Malignant Influences such as Warpstone.

description:b342ad872e7a939dcf3ec935.name: Inscription
description:b342ad872e7a939dcf3ec935.text: Write or draw on metal by moving your hand over it, at twelve words per round. +2 SL permits invisible Secret Runes, revealed only by another Gold Wizard casting this spell on them. Alternatively, spray acid at a metal-armoured enemy as a Damage +2 magic missile; a hit destroys 1 AP at that location unless washed off within 10 rounds.

description:fef71874d67d4f938ba5a393.name: Knot Untied
description:fef71874d67d4f938ba5a393.text: For a puzzle, riddle, trap or mystery solvable by deduction, the GM must give one hint and may give another per +2 SL. Related Lore Tests gain +2 SL.

description:94c3a45a63ca4d72f89ffc31.name: Metal Mended
description:94c3a45a63ca4d72f89ffc31.text: Restore a damaged metal object of any size, replacing missing parts if at least three-quarters remain. Alternatively fuse two metal objects, assisting Trade (Smithing) or adding Unreliable and Bulky to enemy armour (WFRP p. 293). The GM decides other applications.

description:9f234752e033d94ea41583a6.name: Meteoric Ironclad
description:9f234752e033d94ea41583a6.text: Targets gain Ward (4) (WFRP p. 343) through weightless magical armour, compatible with ordinary armour.

description:8219511012659c641b2039a5.name: Prismatic Refraction of Habermas
description:8219511012659c641b2039a5.text: All Channelling and Casting in the area, including yours, take −1 SL. At expiry the collected Winds become harmless coloured light. Choose one Colour to become a handful of aethyric fluid instead, adding +1 SL to one Casting Test from its Lore. The fluid evaporates unused after two Rounds.

description:9eea02ce646f2257ec3646c8.name: Puchta’s Silver Compass
description:9eea02ce646f2257ec3646c8.text: A normal compass functions as a Compass of Meteoric Silver (p. 53) for the duration.

description:ef13218efef508ef3eff79dd.name: Replication of Levorg
description:ef13218efef508ef3eff79dd.text: Conjure a functional inanimate non-magical object of up to 4 Enc, plus 1 Enc per +2 SL. A skilled tradesperson can recognise the copy. It disappears when the spell ends.

description:2d331867446d70bd2b5988d8.name: Trial and Error
description:2d331867446d70bd2b5988d8.text: Choose one Skill at casting. You or an ally gain +2 SL on their next Test with it; achieving +2 SL also gives a single reroll for that Test.

description:58c07a8583a416f0e8e4993e.name: Almanac
description:58c07a8583a416f0e8e4993e.text: Spend one day attuning to an area, while free to move and cast other spells. Afterwards forecast major weather and seasonal events over the coming year. Dates are initially approximate; +2 SL narrows them to a week and +4 SL to a day.

description:c5e70781cd11184b97048e34.name: Dwellers Below
description:c5e70781cd11184b97048e34.text: Earth spirits seize targets in the area. Each must pass Strength, optionally using a mount’s Strength, or be pulled underground for 1d10 hours. The spirits neither deal Damage nor can be harmed. Returning targets must Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). The spirits depart underground at expiry.

description:bfeb863beb65ce2a753a6916.name: Flesh of Stone
description:bfeb863beb65ce2a753a6916.text: Turn a target to living stone, resisted if unwilling by Opposed Willpower. It can move and fight but cannot speak, has half Movement, +30 Strength and Toughness, and +4 AP everywhere, and needs no air.

description:44f610c1aef4a82d166f160d.name: Gardener’s Warcry
description:44f610c1aef4a82d166f160d.text: Target earth to create a lasting Blood Forest. Everyone initially in the area takes 10 Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus and Armour, and gains Bleeding. Later crossing above half Movement requires Challenging (+0 SL) Agility to avoid Bleeding. The forest persists until cut or burned.

description:106da2e54611c47bcbd4b4d2.name: Geyser
description:106da2e54611c47bcbd4b4d2.text: Targets in the area take a Damage +4 magic missile, are pushed Willpower Bonus yards in your chosen direction, and gain Prone. Each additional +2 SL may give any one affected target Stunned. A pool of fresh springwater remains afterwards.

description:460f7c50455b30c9a6909375.name: Invigorating Chant
description:460f7c50455b30c9a6909375.text: Awaken dormant plant creatures in the area, such as Dryads, Tree Kin, Fenbeasts or carnivorous plants; they spend one round stirring before acting. Targets immediately heal SL Wounds and gain SL on all Tests for the duration. You do not control them. They may resent waking out of season but are unlikely to attack you during the spell. The GM sets their forms and abilities, with Constructs (p. 30) as guidance.

description:b516f45c366ee2b53f0b3ea8.name: Jade Casket
description:b516f45c366ee2b53f0b3ea8.text: Animate a creature dead within the past hour at maximum Wounds. It obeys simple commands or otherwise instinctively protects you. It retains non-magical Skills, Traits and Talents but cannot speak or remember its former life. It is neither truly alive nor Undead.

description:92695b0ac41f99ed932bf790.name: Leaf Fall
description:92695b0ac41f99ed932bf790.text: Missile attacks against you take −2 SL. Gain Contortionist (WFRP p. 135) and reduce Damage from falling, crushing, clubs, hammers and other blunt weapons by 3.

description:968bd646f159ea0508c0a3c1.name: Leyfinding
description:968bd646f159ea0508c0a3c1.text: Gain a detailed mental map of leylines and stone circles in range, adding +2 SL to Navigation to locate planned or natural leylines. Sense each line’s minor/major strength and each circle’s waystone count, but not specific Wind Colours at distance (Chapter 14).

description:6775403bc414c3e6040e03e8.name: Nature’s Whisper
description:6775403bc414c3e6040e03e8.text: Touch a river or tree to speak telepathically with its minor spirit. Rivers generally know events within 1 mile upstream/downstream from the last 24 hours; forest trees have similar reach and years of memory, but take at least 5 minutes per answer. Complex questions may receive vague answers. Spirits may demand help, need not like you, and this grants no advantage communicating with animated spirits such as Naiads or Dryads.

description:48ee7cfa9005dc2bebd54420.name: Paranoth’s Pathway
description:48ee7cfa9005dc2bebd54420.text: Everyone in the area gains Striding Gait (Woodlands) (WFRP p. 145). Existing holders may gain one temporary level plus another per +2 SL. At +4 SL the party leaves no trackable traces. Crossing another path or harming a living tree ends the spell.

description:6b567268dc7ba0f8533b69f5.name: Spiral Stair
description:6b567268dc7ba0f8533b69f5.text: Rise on a staircase to Willpower yards high, plus Willpower yards per +2 SL, maximum 200 yards. While on it, gain 3 AP everywhere and add its height to incoming missiles’ travel distance. Other Jade Wizards knowing this spell may climb with Challenging (+0 SL) Lore (Magic); it is insubstantial to everyone else.

description:219dd6935e4bc028cc9b1146.name: Vaunted Transmogrification of Colchis
description:219dd6935e4bc028cc9b1146.text: All initially affected characters and surfaces become non-flammable and immune to fire Damage. Extinguish fires and remove Ablaze in the area. Portable fires can enter, but cannot harm protected targets. A character leaving the area loses immunity.

description:0ca01c22505d3cab164bd8ca.name: Verdant Apotheosis
description:0ca01c22505d3cab164bd8ca.text: Revive targets slain within the last minute. Each must Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Critical Wounds and lost limbs are not healed; decapitation prevents revival.

description:e10d622c4abda242a86ebe3f.name: Vital Growth
description:e10d622c4abda242a86ebe3f.text: Grow one plant or tree to its natural maximum height. Doubling it requires +2 SL and one additional round concentrating on casting; tripling requires +4 SL and two rounds; quadrupling requires +6 SL and three rounds.

description:3d1acd70513b0146d9dd5e7b.name: Wood Shape
description:3d1acd70513b0146d9dd5e7b.text: Turn yourself or another target into an oak. Unwilling targets resist with Average (+2 SL) Willpower. The tree retains sight and hearing and can be harmed by axes, fire and other tree-damaging attacks.

description:2243ac94426451e452212147.name: Azure Blades
description:2243ac94426451e452212147.text: On each melee opponent’s turn each round, they suffer three unavoidable 8 Damage hits to random locations. Very Long or Massive weapons reach past the blades; Long weapons attack simultaneously; shorter weapons attack only after the wielder takes these hits.

description:353ee4145a93856e36f8a134.name: Curse of Fate
description:353ee4145a93856e36f8a134.text: With line of sight, give a target −10 on all Tests for the duration, with only one such curse per target. At +6 SL use Fate of Doom instead: Range becomes 1 mile and the target permanently loses 1 Fate point. If it has none, its next Critical Hit received during the duration uses 00 on the appropriate table.

description:c993aa3845cbac2af40ee1e8.name: Divination
description:c993aa3845cbac2af40ee1e8.text: Choose one effect: learn an auspicious time for a future action, with accuracy set by the GM’s secret Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence Test for you; locate a previously seen lost or stolen object by direction but not distance; or modify one specifically defined future die roll by +10 or −10. Only one effect of the last kind can affect you at once.

description:7ed56f603ce0535e387d7e2b.name: Enemy Foreseen
description:7ed56f603ce0535e387d7e2b.text: You cannot be Surprised. The GM must warn you of an ambush or comparable danger Initiative Bonus rounds before it occurs, giving time to prepare or escape.

description:949434742a8efed65d709945.name: Fantastic Foresight
description:949434742a8efed65d709945.text: Allied wizards in the area, excluding you, may reroll their first failure on every Channelling, Casting and Dispel Test. Alternatively cast Solmann’s Discombobulation: enemy wizards roll each such Test twice and take the worse result.

description:b10f0fe2a00ddc5efc422485.name: Fate Illuminated
description:b10f0fe2a00ddc5efc422485.text: Ask the GM one yes/no question about the target’s intentions within the next hour, plus another per +2 Casting SL. Questions must concern intent. Alternatively, touching the target reveals its Dooming (WFRP p. 136), curses and portents, including active and reversed symbols (p. 45).

description:cb6bfc0a75e3c3c9f271388a.name: Lens on the Sky
description:cb6bfc0a75e3c3c9f271388a.text: A floating crystal lens follows you, clearly showing creatures and objects up to 3 miles away. Gain +2 SL to long-distance Perception and ignore fog/cloud penalties, but not darkness. Using it to observe stars gives +2 SL on your next Navigation Test.

description:26f866c7f381b994b1130200.name: Let the Four Winds Blow!
description:26f866c7f381b994b1130200.text: Choose four random vortex spells (p. 20) or enemy groups in range. Push each directly away by Willpower Bonus yards, plus that distance per +2 Casting SL. An enemy hitting a solid obstacle or character stops and takes 7 Damage, reduced by Toughness Bonus and AP. Every target gains Prone when it stops.

description:44ea02ca154696e96929f6ef.name: Mistral From the Stratosphere
description:44ea02ca154696e96929f6ef.text: Choose a direction; targets in range that way take 12 Damage ignoring AP but allowing Toughness Bonus, and must pass Hard (−2 SL) Endurance or suffer first-stage Cold Exposure (WFRP p. 181). Water freezes 1 inch thick per round. In later rounds you may redirect the blast or keep freezing those targets. Damage occurs only in the first round, but Cold Exposure Tests repeat each round. Lost Characteristics recover 10 points per hour. You may move while casting.

description:08bc01549bece64184e8d0f8.name: Mystic Mirror
description:08bc01549bece64184e8d0f8.text: Communicate both ways through mirrors or reflective surfaces with someone you have met or whose name you know. Your image and voice appear in their surface, and theirs in yours. Casting fails without a reflective surface in their line of sight.

description:8d7c146e6b3e00b7e70eeee5.name: Polish and Glean
description:8d7c146e6b3e00b7e70eeee5.text: Clean glass perfectly. At +2 SL a lens or window may grant +20 Lore (Astronomy); at +4 SL it may grant +20 visual Perception using Second Sight.

description:ed79df8a7e6a732d4af50e5e.name: Project Spirit
description:ed79df8a7e6a732d4af50e5e.text: Your body sleeps while your invisible spirit moves normally, sees, hears and passes solid barriers. It cannot speak, cast or manipulate physical objects. If it has not returned before expiry, you wake suddenly and Test Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182).

description:db0b3e9b64adb6bea8dddaa7.name: Sapphire Arch
description:db0b3e9b64adb6bea8dddaa7.text: Create an arch 4 yards wide and 3 yards high. Anything passing through enters limbo. The arch vanishes at the end of your next round. Your next casting releases the previous occupants without them experiencing elapsed time. If you die first, they return at their original entry point with Stunned and Prone.

description:93f6570acd1fee03cbce9f70.name: Starshine
description:93f6570acd1fee03cbce9f70.text: A moving area of starlight around you dispels ordinary and magical darkness and reveals invisible or concealed creatures and hidden doors.

description:e3657a85003f8e3b95b5d1b7.name: Storm of Shemtek
description:e3657a85003f8e3b95b5d1b7.text: Fire 2 × Initiative Bonus Damage +6 magic missiles at separate targets in front of you and immediately gain Stunned. Observers without Arcane Magic (Heavens) must Test Fear (1) (WFRP p. 190). No open sky is needed. Alternatively summon only Initiative Bonus bolts into an area 2 × Willpower Bonus yards across, without Stunned or Fear.

description:8c32414ebbd04ad538f98feb.name: T’Essla’s Arc
description:8c32414ebbd04ad538f98feb.text: A Damage +10 magic missile causes 1 Blinded Condition.

description:5995f65e787c7cfb513b1828.name: Thorsen’s Thunderstorm
description:5995f65e787c7cfb513b1828.text: A tornado deals a Damage +8 magic missile to targets in its area, then pushes them randomly using Let the Four Winds Blow! (p. 100). It moves with random vortex rules (p. 20).

description:d12a3fa5eb3f6c3adae721c6.name: Bewilder
description:d12a3fa5eb3f6c3adae721c6.text: A target failing Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower rolls 1d10 for behaviour throughout the duration: 1–2 needs Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower to act; 3–4 acts normally but moves randomly; 5–6 charges and attacks the nearest target; 7–8 can only stand still and Dodge; 9–10 gains Prone and becomes Helpless (WFRP p. 162).

description:7d4dedfdc384a9a0a6426ec8.name: Black Horrors
description:7d4dedfdc384a9a0a6426ec8.text: Haunt a shadow with a non-attacking shade causing Fear (1), increased by 1 per +2 Casting SL to a maximum of Fear (4). The shadow becomes magical and persists even under illumination.

description:d9c5785b612d964de6d8b9ed.name: Bridge of Shadows
description:d9c5785b612d964de6d8b9ed.text: Carry willing targets through the air to a chosen visible destination within Willpower yards of their starting point. You may travel with them if in the area. Solid objects block passage, but obstacles up to Willpower yards high can be crossed. Arrival occurs when the spell ends.

description:ed255122d72b48200fbec98d.name: Dance of Despair
description:ed255122d72b48200fbec98d.text: Enemies failing Willpower must dance. Moving or acting then requires Hard (−2 SL) Athletics or Challenging Perform (Dance). They gain Fatigued when the spell ends. Allies and neutral characters are unaffected.

description:646a6ac8fef634f4f68d9de2.name: Deep Pockets
description:646a6ac8fef634f4f68d9de2.text: Store one object in a weightless, invisible pocket dimension. A filled container counts as one object. Its permitted Encumbrance is 1 +1 per +2 Casting SL. Perception cannot locate it; an Action retrieves it. If not retrieved before expiry, it is lost.

description:fcaec3cd28a96d194613b57e.name: Grand Illusion
description:fcaec3cd28a96d194613b57e.text: Use Illusion’s rules, but include sight, sound, smell, taste and touch, with movement allowed. Describe the illusion fully at casting. For believers it functions physically, allowing passage over an illusory bridge, for example. Recognising the illusion removes that reality for the observer immediately.

description:061b3238749e78e9e4910083.name: Grey Wings
description:061b3238749e78e9e4910083.text: Teleport yourself or one other target up to 100 yards from its starting position.

description:132c7a2b1e09ab4d883e87b1.name: Horn of Andar
description:132c7a2b1e09ab4d883e87b1.text: Allies in range gain +2 SL Cool and Leadership; enemies take −2 SL on those Tests and must immediately Test Fear (1). Neutral targets are unaffected.

description:cc6dfa85641c2539a588c594.name: Hush
description:cc6dfa85641c2539a588c594.text: A sound-dampening area follows a willing target; an enchanted object may be picked up after casting. Choose one: prevent sound leaving while allowing sound in; prevent sound entering while treating internal sounds normally; or prevent sound being produced inside.

description:ab205acd6fda3be97959eaed.name: Mutable Visage
description:ab205acd6fda3be97959eaed.text: An unwilling target resists with Opposed Willpower. Choose one appearance change: adjust attractiveness and Fellowship by +10 or −10; appear dead even under close inspection, retaining senses but unable to move or speak; or become unrecognisable to acquaintances. Willpower Tests can restore recognition for people the target wishes to reconnect with.

description:6543b12e577ac78b6d39ce8b.name: Pit of Tarnus
description:6543b12e577ac78b6d39ce8b.text: Open a pit whose diameter and depth equal the area. Those on or beside it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge to avoid falling; Marginal Failure permits grabbing the edge. At expiry it closes, dealing 20 Damage and burying trapped victims alive with Suffocation (WFRP p. 181).

description:633951b81880d7e730ba1d8a.name: Ribauld’s Retroactive Illusion
description:633951b81880d7e730ba1d8a.text: Teleport a terrain feature up to Willpower yards, including its occupants. It must be house-sized or smaller, separate from the ground, and not a famous landmark. Buildings, trees, boulders, streams and pools qualify; hills do not. The destination must make sense for the feature. The GM decides fame and suitability.

description:2440ff6825e513d5e69b4160.name: Shadow Grove
description:2440ff6825e513d5e69b4160.text: Reveal shadows cast by invisible creatures and aethyric manifestations. Invisible targets can be spotted normally but attacks against them take −10. Possessed creatures cast one shadow for themselves and one per possessing spirit or Daemon. Natural or artificial light is required; total darkness prevents the spell working.

description:9d9aad6b7a28cd7bad2681b1.name: Substance of Shadow
description:9d9aad6b7a28cd7bad2681b1.text: An object or creature entirely inside a shadow cast by an object blocking visible light becomes invisible and partly insubstantial; total darkness does not qualify. Physical attacks, pushing and touch cannot affect it, but magic works normally. It may affect physical things without penalties. Any part leaving the shadow ends the spell.

description:022534d6ffa5c1d9d6601a07.name: Traitor of Tarn
description:022534d6ffa5c1d9d6601a07.text: An enemy losing Opposed Willpower sees you as an ally and former allies as enemies. It cannot be ordered into obvious suicide. Each order to attack a former ally permits Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to break the effect. On neutral targets, instead gain +2 SL on Fellowship-based Tests involving them. Friendly targets are unaffected.

description:39aa2a749c93132022f0c788.name: Wandering Shadow
description:39aa2a749c93132022f0c788.text: Detach your shadow and use Actions to direct it at your Movement rate; without direction it stays still. See, hear and smell from its location, but cannot cast through it. It causes Fear (1) and cannot attack. Direct sunlight or distance beyond 48 yards from a light source destroys it.

description:458356dcb16a1ffe1d80c832.name: Acceptance of Fate
description:458356dcb16a1ffe1d80c832.text: Allies ignore Fear, treat Terror as Fear for the duration, and permanently lose grief-based Psychology. Alternatively, nearby enemies failing Challenging (+0 SL) Cool cannot flee combat for the duration.

description:3b77e010ed06e9aded8a1e2b.name: Amaranth
description:3b77e010ed06e9aded8a1e2b.text: Reduce Critical Hit table rolls against you by 10 and gain Resistant (Poison, Disease, and Chaos). Existing relevant Talents gain +1 level per +2 SL.

description:c40a2fe304fa16f36977e68c.name: Animus Imprisoned
description:c40a2fe304fa16f36977e68c.text: Trap a soul in a bottle, vial or pouch, leaving its body comatose until an Amethyst wizard or Morr priest opens the vessel beside it. The body needs food and water; awakening requires Moderate Source of Corruption exposure (WFRP p. 182). You may speak telepathically with the soul. Incorrect opening or opening far from the body kills it and creates a Ghost (p. 331). As a Telepathy ingredient (p. 125), the soul enables unlimited-range contact with an Amethyst wizard it previously met. A Miscast breaks the vessel and releases the soul under those same rules.

description:88ee6dbe988607dd92c0dcc5.name: Ashes and Dust
description:88ee6dbe988607dd92c0dcc5.text: A cloud deals 8 Damage ignoring Armour and causes Suffocation until targets leave (WFRP p. 181), moving under random vortex rules (p. 20). At +4 SL you may also create a Purple Sun of Xereus at its centre: a 1-yard globe causing Fear (2). A creature touched must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or die; walls, doors and other obstacles disintegrate automatically.

description:7fbdcf0658a7d9bdab99b0ef.name: Compel Spirits
description:7fbdcf0658a7d9bdab99b0ef.text: For creatures with both Undead and Ethereal, choose: command all targets losing Opposed Willpower, including orders to fight or flee, though only Death’s Release can lay them to rest; or summon Ghosts equal to SL (WFRP p. 331), uncontrolled unless you cast again. The Amethyst College forbids summoning.

description:ec39559426066fca685e8dcf.name: Crystal Maze
description:ec39559426066fca685e8dcf.text: Targets vanish into the maze and cannot be harmed or affected. At the end of each subsequent round roll 1d10: 1–3 returns them to their departure point; 4–6 requires another roll next round; 7–9 loses them for 1d10 hours, then requires Moderate Exposure to Corruption on return (WFRP p. 182); 10 loses them forever in Tzeentch’s Realm.

description:37db4e8295ef759666900f4d.name: Death’s Release
description:37db4e8295ef759666900f4d.text: Each round, targets with both Undead and Ethereal must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain Stunned. Accumulating 3 Stunned releases a spirit from the mortal world.

description:3a2c174106fb40b7ce7fab83.name: Fate of Bjuna
description:3a2c174106fb40b7ce7fab83.text: Each round, targets failing Challenging (+0 SL) Cool gain Stunned and take their own Strength Bonus + 6 Damage ignoring Armour, with 50% chance each of head or body. Each +2 SL may additionally surround one target with energy: failure on Challenging (+0 SL) Willpower causes immediate Suffocation damage and continued Suffocation for the duration (WFRP p. 181).

description:64ca4c066186dd8aea215770.name: Iyrtu’s Embrace
description:64ca4c066186dd8aea215770.text: Gain +10 Strength per +1 SL. Grapple attacks automatically succeed; a rolled miss becomes +0 SL.

description:ffeacb16336f1a2e9514ee78.name: Limbwither
description:ffeacb16336f1a2e9514ee78.text: Choose a limb to render useless for Willpower Bonus minutes, treating it as amputated (WFRP p. 180). Alternatively ward a grave: the first person to desecrate it within one year suffers a randomly chosen deadened limb for Willpower Bonus days.

description:92f8c0dd12af9276d2dced24.name: Shyish Uncovered
description:92f8c0dd12af9276d2dced24.text: Learn the number, species and time of deaths in the area during the past month, plus another month per +1 SL. Names and causes are not revealed. For a deceased person whose name you know, each additional +2 SL permits one question answerable through knocks, including yes/no or numbers.

description:2741098c856f341c628d450b.name: Speed of Lykos
description:2741098c856f341c628d450b.text: You or another target may move 100 yards next round and still act, with normal terrain and obstacles applying. A target killed during the spell may perform one immediate action before dying.

description:9e861622697b839cfd0f9cce.name: Taste of Death
description:9e861622697b839cfd0f9cce.text: The primary living enemy Tests Minor Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182), then Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to avoid Unconscious. Other enemies within Initiative Bonus yards of it must pass Average (+2 SL) Cool or gain Stunned. Each Cool failure also requires Easy (+4 SL) Cool to avoid Fatigued and Psychology (Despair). Despair victims gain Fatigued on waking every morning for the next week.

description:e235a436e940a344de59d8db.name: Telepathy
description:e235a436e940a344de59d8db.text: Send a telepathic message to another Amethyst wizard; Animus Imprisoned removes Range limits. Other recipients need Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition to understand. Alternatively read another Amethyst wizard’s surface thoughts. They may detect this with Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence, then block it by winning Opposed Willpower.

description:905d1afc99a22a7f71a0cc5b.name: Tide of Years
description:905d1afc99a22a7f71a0cc5b.text: Destroy a non-magical object by aging it to dust, up to 2 Enc plus 1 per +2 Casting SL. Durable items instead lose all Qualities. At 4 or more SL you may target a living creature: failing Average (+2 SL) Cool permanently reduces Strength and Toughness by 1d10 each through aging. Daemons, Undead and plant creatures are immune.

description:ed13b6ff73585b76900106ed.name: Wild Kin of Zandox
description:ed13b6ff73585b76900106ed.text: Summon two hounds visible only fleetingly with Hard (−2 SL) Perception. On your turn they may attack enemies within 4 yards, each with WS 50 and Weapon (Bite) +8. They cannot be attacked and gain no Momentum.

description:a6a5adc01dd4ff6f3c8ac882.name: Body of Fire
description:a6a5adc01dd4ff6f3c8ac882.text: Anyone grabbing or Grappling you takes 8 + SL Damage and must pass Hard (−2 SL) Cool every round to maintain the hold. Each round you Grapple someone, they take an additional 8 + SL Damage and 1 Ablaze. An attacker wounding you in melee must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or take a Damage +3 magic missile ignoring Armour. Your clothing and belongings are fireproof; you remain vulnerable to fire.

description:4c15c9b613784a6ea2d24498.name: Boiling Blood
description:4c15c9b613784a6ea2d24498.text: A target failing Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance immediately gains 2 Blinded and takes 10 + SL Damage at each of its rounds’ starts, ignoring Armour but allowing Toughness Bonus. A slain target explodes, dealing a Damage +1 magic missile to everyone within 2 yards.

description:f4cc82b667e446ff8f2d5cd9.name: Burning Head
description:f4cc82b667e446ff8f2d5cd9.text: A flaming head about two feet across travels straight to maximum Range, striking everything in its path with a Damage +4 magic missile, reduced to +0 by Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge. Every struck target gains 1 Ablaze. Those losing at least 1 Wound treat you as causing Fear (1).

description:65fa875591c1af8b8e7079c4.name: Captivating Flame
description:65fa875591c1af8b8e7079c4.text: Enchant a fire no larger than a torch. One random observer looking towards it must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or gain 3 Stunned, ignoring everything else until those Conditions are removed. Attacking an affected target immediately removes all spell-caused Stunned. At +2 Casting SL, a brazier/campfire-sized fire affects two random observers; +4 SL permits a pyre/building-sized fire affecting every observer.

description:43b066ee9dbfcaec7add3d73.name: Choleric
description:43b066ee9dbfcaec7add3d73.text: Name or point out a person to become the target’s Prejudice for Willpower Bonus hours (WFRP p. 190). Friendship with that person permits Average (+2 SL) Cool to resist. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead impose Animosity for Willpower Bonus days; at +8 SL, Hatred for Willpower Bonus weeks. Normal resistance to the chosen Psychology still applies until expiry or dispelling.

description:7931dfb5977c2a485572fa46.name: Flamestorm
description:7931dfb5977c2a485572fa46.text: Create a fire pillar 2 yards across and 2 yards high. Each +2 Casting SL adds 1 yard diameter and 2 yards height. Those initially inside take a Damage +8 magic missile and 3 Ablaze, are thrown clear and gain Prone. Only creatures immune to magical fire can enter. It lasts until dispelled or next sunrise.

description:c31c4135293e97f2f0e757ac.name: Forge of Tarnus
description:c31c4135293e97f2f0e757ac.text: Touch unlit forge coals to ignite them. Trade (Smith) Tests during the spell gain +1 SL, including magical item crafting (Archives II).

description:4c0e15f895bffb044e5672af.name: Ignite
description:4c0e15f895bffb044e5672af.text: Give an object or person 2 Ablaze. If already Ablaze, you may instead distribute 3 new Ablaze Conditions among others within 2 yards.

description:1434c0deba7222ae86124f31.name: Inextinguishable Flame
description:1434c0deba7222ae86124f31.text: Make an ordinary fire up to campfire size impossible to extinguish for Willpower Bonus hours. +2 Casting SL extends the unit to days, +4 SL to weeks, or +6 SL to months.

description:725d3c43bdd0db458849a4a3.name: Kindleflame
description:725d3c43bdd0db458849a4a3.text: Normally non-flammable things in the area, including water and stone, can burn. Already flammable targets take additional fire Damage equal to SL and gain one extra Ablaze whenever they receive that Condition.

description:1a26940beba5f4fe5e86c1f1.name: Kindred of the Hearth
description:1a26940beba5f4fe5e86c1f1.text: Put your hands into a bonfire, taking 6 Damage minus Toughness Bonus, to summon an elemental with Movement 3, WS equal to your Willpower, Damage +6 and Fear (1). It must stay within 12 yards of the fire and follows spoken instructions. Casting another spell or speaking to anyone else makes it stop. It can only move or attack, gains no Momentum, and gives 1 Ablaze whenever it deals Damage. Only dousing it with at least a pint of water can harm it, destroying it.

description:baa5135f0af2e813e56624ef.name: Magma Storm
description:baa5135f0af2e813e56624ef.text: Targets in the molten-rock vortex gain 2 Ablaze and take a Damage +12 magic missile.

description:59d88c65fe1351a648624ae6.name: Sanguine Swords
description:59d88c65fe1351a648624ae6.text: Summon one sword plus another per additional +2 Casting SL, maximum six. In subsequent rounds, spend your Action directing them at visible targets in range, with at most one sword attacking each target at once. Each has Fly (20), WS 60 and 8 Damage, returning to you afterwards. Normal defence applies. They gain no Momentum and cannot be destroyed except by dispelling.

description:ad45db8dd4f319017ad9d7b0.name: Taste of Fire
description:ad45db8dd4f319017ad9d7b0.text: Choose one: make a pot of food very spicy, requiring Easy (+4 SL) Endurance when eaten to avoid digestive trouble; turn a quart-jug of any liquid into strong spirits retaining some original flavour; or turn a pint-flask of liquid into flammable lantern oil.

description:7167f30bf9827a018955efd6.name: Withering Heat
description:7167f30bf9827a018955efd6.text: Enemies in the area gain Fatigued each round they run, charge or flee. Removing armour and clothing removes one Fatigued gained this way. Contact with any fire automatically gives them Ablaze, and every fire source deals extra Damage equal to Casting SL.

description:f34136c9a020a0c7b0eded01.name: Ygethmor’s Flaming Blizzard
description:f34136c9a020a0c7b0eded01.text: Each Round, targets in the area take 8 + SL Damage and must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or gain Prone. Each flammable object or terrain feature has a 25% ignition chance per round. Only hard cover shelters against these effects.

description:ab7a61f4b41b74144cbd6c7c.name: Amber Trance
description:ab7a61f4b41b74144cbd6c7c.text: A target failing Hard (−2 SL) Cool becomes an immovable, indestructible amber statue, unaffected even by poison and disease but able to heal naturally or magically. Attacking ends the spell, with the first blow harmless. The target remembers nothing from the trance. A willing target can hibernate for a full 3-month season until equinox or solstice. If self-cast, it cannot end early except through an attack or dispelling.

description:207720e86ed307a029bd4c7e.name: Awakening of the Wood
description:207720e86ed307a029bd4c7e.text: Forest targets take a Damage +4 magic missile. Failing Average (+2 SL) Dodge also causes one Bleeding and one Entangled at Strength 30.

description:83681a58b016a36671ee3fa3.name: Beast Unbroken
description:83681a58b016a36671ee3fa3.text: A domestic animal becomes wild until dispelled, fleeing or turning on its former owner as the GM decides. Charm Animal can deter attacks but cannot tame it. Riders need Hard (−2 SL) Ride to avoid being thrown. At +4 Casting SL, you may instead transform a Human who fails Difficult (−1 SL) Willpower: it grows thick hair, cannot speak, and rolls 1d10 each round. 1–3: scratches, defecates or picks its nose; 4–6: moves randomly, colliding with obstacles or attacking creatures in its path; 7–9: laughs and crawls or dances towards the nearest character; 10: screams, causing Fear (1) to listeners without Arcane Magic (Beasts). Both versions last until dispelled.

description:9520a62dbec11a538bd53968.name: Curse of Anraheir
description:9520a62dbec11a538bd53968.text: Invulnerable spirits visible only to the targets impose −2 Movement and −20 WS, BS and Agility on enemies in the area, without Damage. They follow departing targets with reduced penalties of −1 Movement and −10 to those Characteristics. Mounts must pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool or flee until calmed with Challenging (+0 SL) Ride.

description:5d4688c0d81fc82d6f3c050e.name: Eyes of the Pack
description:5d4688c0d81fc82d6f3c050e.text: The target may switch between its own sight and yours at will, at any distance. Your view may satisfy line of sight for some spells, including teleportation, but it cannot cast through your body.

description:70761ecb8d18b635bbcec636.name: Follow Scent
description:70761ecb8d18b635bbcec636.text: Gain +20 on smell-based Track and Perception, including Second Sight to smell magic. Detect Corruption and mutation by scent in plants, animals and animal dung.

description:847f563801a64014db9156b7.name: Hunter’s Moons
description:847f563801a64014db9156b7.text: Allies in the area gain +1 Movement, +10 Strength and +10 Toughness.

description:cac1f61649cd8cad9f7a6994.name: Merciw’s Monstrous Regiment
description:cac1f61649cd8cad9f7a6994.text: Allies in the area, excluding you, gain +30 Strength and Toughness, each capped at 100.

description:1a037d29dd4cbc255d93a776.name: Musk Spray
description:1a037d29dd4cbc255d93a776.text: Mark a creature or object with a distinctive smell, giving +2 SL on Tests to locate it.

description:a0324c5aff0367d7594b764c.name: Quick Passage
description:a0324c5aff0367d7594b764c.text: Gain +1 Movement, Scale Sheer Surface and Striding Gait (Any 1) (WFRP pp. 144–145). Existing Talents may gain one temporary level plus another per +2 Casting SL. Tests to avoid Entangled gain +10.

description:00df271dbbd38f16712ebd6f.name: Summon Mount
description:00df271dbbd38f16712ebd6f.text: The GM chooses an ordinary, non-monstrous animal native to the terrain, such as a stag, boar or bear, to serve as your mount. Gain its Ride Skill at your Language (Magick) value temporarily. It fights for you but retains self-preservation.

description:b25b2c7f830be5b43a182474.name: The Ox Stands
description:b25b2c7f830be5b43a182474.text: Immediately remove SL + 1 Broken Conditions from allies in the area. They need no further Fear or Terror Tests for the duration.

description:bfbcb0ab3d465eb2460573df.name: Transformation of Kadon
description:bfbcb0ab3d465eb2460573df.text: Become a Large or Enormous monster chosen by the GM. Amber/Elven examples: Demigryph, Dragon, Hippogryph, Great Eagle, Griffon; Beastman Shaman/Witch/Chaos Sorcerer examples: Manticore, Hydra, Jabberslythe, Wyvern. Retain Intelligence and Willpower; replace all other Characteristics with its profile and all Skills/Talents with its Skills/Creature Traits. You cannot cast. Each +4 Casting SL permits one Optional Trait or casting on someone else by Touch instead; unwilling targets resist with Opposed Willpower.

description:96a5eaa1c3170f55c3055ef0.name: Vengeful Hood
description:96a5eaa1c3170f55c3055ef0.text: Against a non-magical attack that would hit, pass Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to reduce Damage by Willpower Bonus + SL. Reducing it to 0 instead deflects it: a ranged attack strikes a random target within 2 yards as its original target; a melee attack hits its attacker, who cannot Oppose it.

description:7d5c7c0ea32e02ffc415b50d.name: Winter Coat
description:7d5c7c0ea32e02ffc415b50d.text: Ignore Cold Exposure and reduce Critical Hit table rolls against you by 10. Take −10 Agility and Fellowship.

description:0c6ffc7b935218e8ac37579b.name: Writhing Worm
description:0c6ffc7b935218e8ac37579b.text: The target is automatically Grappled and gains Entangled (WFRP p. 163). The invulnerable worm uses Strength 50. Each won Opposed Strength Test either adds another Entangled or dissolves 1 AP of leather/similar armour at every location, also destroying leather belongings such as bags. It cannot deal Grapple Damage. Escape ends the spell.

description:2cf37d539d7e451809da04f9.name: Bind Monstrous Beast
description:2cf37d539d7e451809da04f9.text: CN: Beast’s Wounds Type: Lore of Beasts Learning XP: 400. Requires a skull or hide of the beast’s species and its occupied lair within Willpower yards. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: the beast senses the attempted enslavement and considers it a threat. Win Opposed Willpower to control it for Willpower Bonus days, during which it follows clear orders. Failure almost always provokes an attack. At expiry it regains its will and may resent its treatment.

description:c388323fd34021e6aba1189b.name: Bind Spirit Within Power Stone
description:c388323fd34021e6aba1189b.text: CN: 32 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 600. Requires a Power Stone and Minor Elemental or similar spirit, with no ingredients, sacrifice or failure consequences. A Leyline Junction (p. 197) or Arcane Fulcrum (p. 198) halves CN. Bind the minor spirit into the stone for the benefits on p. 167. The GM may define variants for other spirits, such as Spites, Ghosts, Spectres, Daemons or Incarnate Elementals, considering their greater will and resentment.

description:fac121514ff77f5a478d81e4.name: Carve Ogham Stone
description:fac121514ff77f5a478d81e4.text: CN: 50 Type: Any Learning XP: 450. Requires quartz-veined granite at least about six feet high and one foot wide, but no ingredients. Before casting, inscribe appropriate attracting or warding symbols; Read/Write, Difficult (−1 SL) Language Magick and Average (+2 SL) Art (Engraving) are required, both Tests successful. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Create an Ogham stone with Attraction, Containment or Dampening; stones can form a druidic circle (p. 195), though not fully replace Elven or Dwarf waystones.

description:83e017f0c12b0bbd37078cfe.name: Create Power Stone
description:83e017f0c12b0bbd37078cfe.text: CN: 64 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 400. No ingredients. At least two apprentices must assist in triangulating the Wind. A Leyline Junction (p. 197) or Arcane Fulcrum (p. 198) halves CN. You and the apprentices spend d10 hours preparing. No failure consequences. Create one Power Stone matching your Lore; this ritual is taught only to selected master wizards and wizard lords.

description:25057b044636e17685a0ee78.name: Conjuration of the Bloody Hidesman
description:25057b044636e17685a0ee78.text: CN: 85 Type: Lore of Beasts Learning XP: 500. Requires a totem of bones and freshly flensed pelts from eight or more large animals, and Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, takes a Damage +12 freezing Ghur attack ignoring leather and fur armour. The totem becomes an Incarnate Elemental of Beasts (p. 176).

description:df892c6a375fdee62a02eb59.name: Conjuration of the Incarnate Elemental of Death
description:df892c6a375fdee62a02eb59.text: CN: 90 Type: Lore of Death Learning XP: 500. Requires an hourglass of powdered monarch’s bones; it becomes part of the Elemental rather than being consumed. Conditions: Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, takes magical Damage equal to your Willpower Bonus ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP, and gains Prone. An Incarnate Elemental of Death emerges from the hourglass (p. 175).

description:c0f7bc484055f5f39e1c4ce1.name: Conjuration of Jack o’ Cinders
description:c0f7bc484055f5f39e1c4ce1.text: CN: 85 Type: Lore of Fire Learning XP: 500. Build a huge pyre and keep it burning throughout the ritual. Conditions: Extreme Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic (Chapter 14). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: everyone within Willpower Bonus yards, including you, gains 4 Ablaze. Summon an Incarnate Elemental of Fire from the pyre (p. 174).

description:87619636f167585ff73cf6a7.name: Corrupt Waystone
description:87619636f167585ff73cf6a7.text: CN: 60 Type: Any Dark Lore Learning XP: 450. Access to a waystone is required, with no ingredients or other conditions. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Corrupt the waystone (p. 194). In a planned leyline, this stops the flow; magic stagnates at the nearest uncorrupted upstream stone, and the next stone becomes the new gathering stone from which flow resumes. Saphery’s High Elf Mages notice quickly and prioritise investigating and hunting those responsible.

description:060602c3053ecfb41b6e7835.name: Create Construct
description:060602c3053ecfb41b6e7835.text:
CN: 60 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 400. Requires a suitable body, with no other conditions. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 Strength or Toughness. Consequences: failure. Animate the body as a magical Construct using p. 30’s default profile and optional Traits.

Generating and managing the creature remain deferred.

description:10b3b2beffa332bf0023fdf2.name: Create Familiar
description:10b3b2beffa332bf0023fdf2.text: CN: 45 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 250. Prepare a vessel (examples and details on p. 180); an idea or concept doubles CN. No conditions apply. Permanently sacrifice one Wound, Fate point or point of maximum Fortune. Failure destroys the vessel. Create a Power Familiar assisting magic, a Spell Familiar with its own wizardry, or a Combat Familiar guarding you. It is an independent Character bound to obey and protect you regardless of affection, can improve, and may be played by another Player (p. 184). A second familiar requires CN 80 and two Wounds, Fate Points or points of maximum Fortune. Humanoid form is assumed; the GM assigns abilities, drawbacks and CN adjustments for different or more complex forms using the printed familiar table.

description:6d7d18efdf28e401fc0b7b9a.name: Create Waystone Property
description:6d7d18efdf28e401fc0b7b9a.text: CN: 40 Type: Any Learning XP: 300. Requires a waystone active in a planned leyline (p. 193), with no ingredients. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or Fatigued. Consequences: failure. Give it Amplification, Containment, Dampening or Refraction (p. 194 onwards). Disrupting the flow to the Great Vortex may eventually bring investigation and punishment from Saphery’s High Elf Mages.

description:b2500ee5b5fe26948238cbfd.name: Cursecraft
description:b2500ee5b5fe26948238cbfd.text: CN: 50 (25) Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 200 (100). Parenthesised costs apply to Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy and all Chaos Lores. Requires access to the item, but no ingredients or other conditions. Permanently sacrifice 1 Wound that never heals and undergo Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Failure destroys the ingredients. Give the item a boon with a deliberate ironic or dangerous bane, agreed by player and GM; examples are on p. 170.

description:d946062a4a71a3c722def130.name: Imbue Staff
description:d946062a4a71a3c722def130.text:
CN: 35 Type: Any Lore of the Eight Winds Learning XP: 100. Requires a quarterstaff or similar-length metal rod and Lore-appropriate decorations, but no ingredients or other conditions. Spend 1 Fortune, recoverable normally. Failure destroys the ingredients. The result is an Enchanted Staff (p. 152).

The printed Resolve sacrifice is converted to Fortune by Appendix I.

description:ab5b9ce4d37f7f3173b2f312.name: Invocate Daemon
description:ab5b9ce4d37f7f3173b2f312.text: CN: Daemon’s Willpower Type: Lore of Daemonology Learning XP: 400. Know at least one name the Daemon uses and cause significant mayhem, suffering or death during the ritual. Cast Octagram first (WFRP p. 256). Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 randomly chosen Strength or Toughness. Consequences: the Daemon notices your attempt, usually taking offence. It manifests in the Octagram for Intelligence Bonus days, then returns to Chaos. You can communicate, but it need not answer or obey. The player and GM decide further bargains, sacrifices and services.

description:97b2f1579d712bac2e1c5abb.name: Materialise the Living Swamp
description:97b2f1579d712bac2e1c5abb.text: CN: 40 Type: Lore of Death, Life, Shadows, Hedgecraft or Witchcraft Learning XP: 400. Requires a heartstone (p. 179) and organic matter, but no ingredients. Conditions: Heavy, Extreme or Corrupted Saturation, an Arcane Fulcrum or a Storm of Magic. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or permanent loss of 1 randomly chosen Strength or Toughness. Consequences: failure. Form an obedient Fenbeast (p. 179) lasting Willpower Bonus days; Extreme Saturation extends its lifespan while it remains there. Dismiss it at will into sludge.

description:fe5d0e6aa5dfe1b2f597a212.name: Remove Curse
description:fe5d0e6aa5dfe1b2f597a212.text: CN: 40 Type: Any Lore Learning XP: 200. Requires the cursed item, confirmed by successful Decipher Curse (p. 26), but no ingredients. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Cool or Moderate Exposure to Corruption (WFRP p. 182). Consequences: failure. You may remove all the item’s boons and banes; a weapon retains Magical.

description:4a956bc72b7807420bba88f9.name: The Crossed Scythes
description:4a956bc72b7807420bba88f9.text: CN: Entity’s Willpower Type: Lore of Death Learning XP: 400. Requires engraving tools, but no ingredients. Before casting, carve crossed downward-pointing scythes above an entrance with an Extended Challenging (+0 SL) Art (Engraving) Test totalling 20 SL; an Undead creature to suppress must be beyond it. Each Channelling Round requires Average (+2 SL) Cool or 1 Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Failure alerts the entity. After completion, non-Construct Undead crossing must pass Very Difficult (−30) Cool or be blocked and gain one Fatigued per −SL, even if normally immune. They may retry next turn, accumulating Fatigued until successful; only a full night’s rest removes these Conditions. Construct Undead instead Test Very Difficult (−30) Endurance; failure blocks passage and causes 1 Wound per −SL.

description:0d6cb66e3750d866569c258b.name: Blessing of Battle
description:0d6cb66e3750d866569c258b.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Weapon Skill.

description:b94b99de3369063bbd6178d0.name: Blessing of Breath
description:b94b99de3369063bbd6178d0.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target needs no air and ignores Suffocation.

description:f209043b0ceacd0f848136c0.name: Blessing of Charisma
description:f209043b0ceacd0f848136c0.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Fellowship.

description:6768c04f4bab8369f2694afd.name: Blessing of Conscience
description:6768c04f4bab8369f2694afd.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Breaking any stricture of your deity requires Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure prevents that action through shame.

description:8a7fbd98dbc68fcdc42d8bce.name: Blessing of Courage
description:8a7fbd98dbc68fcdc42d8bce.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Willpower.

description:0f461d7fd381b4e5bd47edcf.name: Blessing of Finesse
description:0f461d7fd381b4e5bd47edcf.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Dexterity.

description:70c547005935de57e3e783a2.name: Blessing of Fortune
description:70c547005935de57e3e783a2.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target may reroll its next failed Test and must accept the new result.

description:61567f34b92d1df2bab4a148.name: Blessing of Grace
description:61567f34b92d1df2bab4a148.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Agility.

description:3777cd0d6c4ddacccc2c740a.name: Blessing of Hardiness
description:3777cd0d6c4ddacccc2c740a.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Toughness.

description:f51a5e9db2968d4f9ce7e9c9.name: Blessing of Healing
description:f51a5e9db2968d4f9ce7e9c9.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Restore 1 Wound to the target.

description:7b8e91306d4a409339cb2c9a.name: Blessing of The Hunt
description:7b8e91306d4a409339cb2c9a.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Ballistic Skill.

description:a1aaf6e777bf0b15f3a663d7.name: Blessing of Might
description:a1aaf6e777bf0b15f3a663d7.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Strength.

description:286d79e47bdd144c7b78b092.name: Blessing of Protection
description:286d79e47bdd144c7b78b092.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Before attacking the target, enemies must pass Average (+2 SL) Cool. Failure forces a different target or Action.

description:9295abbe5593d7c105dd9be7.name: Blessing of Recuperation
description:9295abbe5593d7c105dd9be7.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Reduce one disease’s duration by 1 day. Only one attempt is allowed for each instance of disease in each person.

description:946f0ba2ead94972d13083a8.name: Blessing of Righteousness
description:946f0ba2ead94972d13083a8.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

The target’s weapon becomes Magical.

description:836d0483c63cd7cf81ae720e.name: Blessing of Savagery
description:836d0483c63cd7cf81ae720e.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

For the target’s next Critical Wound inflicted, roll twice and use the better result.

description:6af496237bb7660dbb8f0a8e.name: Blessing of Tenacity
description:6af496237bb7660dbb8f0a8e.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Remove one Condition other than Besmirched from the target.

description:6d61dc54a5b297d3b87faa3e.name: Blessing of Wisdom
description:6d61dc54a5b297d3b87faa3e.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Intelligence.

description:9a5180d16f87ad30add38af5.name: Blessing of Wit
description:9a5180d16f87ad30add38af5.text:
Range: 6 yards Target: 1 Duration: 6 rounds

Give the target +10 Initiative. Cults may use different names and wording for the same Blessing without changing its effect.

description:cfd50ba56120b608f17c7a61.name: Becalm
description:cfd50ba56120b608f17c7a61.text:
Range: Fellowship Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

Remove a sailing vessel’s wind and surround it with calm water and weather out to Fellowship yards, even in a storm. The calm moves with it if oars or another means propel it.

description:31cf12956f8d0bdc3e434551.name: Drowned Man’s Face
description:31cf12956f8d0bdc3e434551.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains Fatigued and drowns for the duration (p. 169), including Daemons and Undead. When it ends, gain Stunned for 1 Round while expelling saltwater.

description:c9b5f2695e60b86aa01bb495.name: Fair Winds
description:c9b5f2695e60b86aa01bb495.text:
Range: Initiative Bonus miles Target: 1 sailing vessel within line of sight Duration: 1 hour

The vessel travels at top speed regardless of wind, tide or current. Sail Tests to control it gain +1 SL.

description:e76855fc21c59c45761f83d2.name: Manalt’s Bounty
description:e76855fc21c59c45761f83d2.text:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Reach into water to catch fish feeding one person, or two if it is seawater. Each +2 SL feeds another person.

description:0eb9f288584303ee7d975ef0.name: Sea Legs
description:0eb9f288584303ee7d975ef0.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

The target gains one each of Blinded, Deafened and Fatigued. To use its Move, it must Test Average (+2 SL) Athletics; failure also causes Prone.

description:9d498ab304e30e26fd4fd939.name: Waterwalk
description:9d498ab304e30e26fd4fd939.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus minutes

Walk on water as on solid ground, but only on bodies at least 10 yards wide.

description:4e604a132e52397f232358b2.name: Death Mask
description:4e604a132e52397f232358b2.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Gain Fear. Undead remain vulnerable to it despite any Talents, Traits, including Construct, or other effects.

description:bc15ffb68ae612370e6de4ca.name: Destroy Undead
description:bc15ffb68ae612370e6de4ca.text:
Range: Yo Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Instant

Undead in the area lose 1d10 Wounds plus 1 per SL, ignoring Toughness Bonus and AP. Under normal circumstances, those destroyed can never again be raised through Necromancy.

description:22531d56290056205218a497.name: Dooming
description:22531d56290056205218a497.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Instant

See a vision of the target’s Doom, almost always concerning its death. Each character may receive this Miracle only once; afterwards it may purchase Doomed with XP as a Career Talent.

description:a082d7407b558daba7801a12.name: Last Rites
description:a082d7407b558daba7801a12.text:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Send a corpse’s soul to Morr and permanently protect the body from Necromantic spells. A foe with both Construct and Undead is destroyed.

description:7ea60b4e6122313c64b2a0f5.name: Portal’s Threshold
description:7ea60b4e6122313c64b2a0f5.text:
Range: Touch Target: Special Duration: Until sunrise

Draw a line up to 8 yards long. Undead need Challenging (+0 SL) Cool to cross; those also having Construct cannot cross at all.

description:5d51e272698c020ed930d038.name: Stay Morr’s Hand
description:5d51e272698c020ed930d038.text:
Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Fellowship Bonus hours

A willing target at 0 Wounds becomes Unconscious and stops deteriorating for the duration, suspending diseases, Critical Wounds, poison and similar effects. Appropriate healing ends the Miracle. You may also end it with last rites taking about a minute, ensuring passage to Morr at death and permanently preventing Necromancy on the corpse.

description:b8d7bf58df19bf6dd922ab20.name: Blazing Sun
description:b8d7bf58df19bf6dd922ab20.text:
Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant

Non-Myrmidians looking towards you gain 1 Blinded, plus another per +2 SL.

description:cd4aed298d7acc0b19334caa.name: Eagle’s Eye
description:cd4aed298d7acc0b19334caa.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Create an invulnerable spectral eagle that cannot physically affect the world. Control its flight and replace your own sight with its Perception 55, Acute Sense (Sight) and Fly 80. While using its eyes you cannot see through yours.

description:d4f782936a0fac49dc4a5c5f.name: Fury’s Call
description:d4f782936a0fac49dc4a5c5f.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain Frenzy (p. 358).

description:9585d06a9699667a285e7614.name: Inspiring
description:9585d06a9699667a285e7614.text:
Range: You Target: AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies in the area gain +1 Drilled.

description:6a8afcc4b4d4699d2284f714.name: Shield of Myrmidia
description:6a8afcc4b4d4699d2284f714.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: Fellowship Bonus Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Allies gain +1 AP at every Hit Location.

description:dd87b41eb2f3e85d73c70ff0.name: Spear of Myrmidia
description:dd87b41eb2f3e85d73c70ff0.text:
Range: You Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

A spear you wield gains Impact and becomes Magical.

description:9ab1b6105e9a9cb1d273b63a.name: An Invitation
description:9ab1b6105e9a9cb1d273b63a.text:
Range: 1 yard Target: 1 Duration: Instant

Undo one fastening on a chosen door, window or hatch, such as a lock, latch or rope. Each +2 SL undoes one additional fastening.

description:c62eed39fde88929c6cf43b4.name: Cat’s Eyes
description:c62eed39fde88929c6cf43b4.text:
Range: Fellowship yards Target: You Duration: Fellowship Bonus Rounds

Control an invulnerable cat with normal cat abilities and share all its senses, replacing your own. Your own sense-enhancing Talents, including Night Vision, do not apply, and you cannot perceive through your body.
