description:8c7e17789e5606c25bcd0e0b.text: Once per Round after hitting in melee, lose Momentum to make an immediate extra attack.

description:c42ab4394b9debeec238b154.name: Gregarious
description:c42ab4394b9debeec238b154.text: Gain Advantage on Gossip Tests and usually recognise a settlement’s likely places for gossip.

description:c060469a4996b801681c2a38.name: Gunner
description:c060469a4996b801681c2a38.text: Ignore Dangerous on Blackpowder, Engineering and Explosive weapons you use.

description:3b72870b15c137b5753b2c88.name: Hardy
description:3b72870b15c137b5753b2c88.text: Add Toughness Bonus once more when calculating Wounds.

description:fc8569ae40308e64d39191e5.name: Hatred (Group)
description:fc8569ae40308e64d39191e5.text: Choose a group to Hate, such as beastmen, goblins, orcs, monsters, outlaws, Sigmarites, undead or witches. On encountering it, pass a Psychology Test or immediately seek its destruction by the fastest, deadliest means. Against it, gain +1 SL on Melee and Ranged Tests and immunity to its Intimidate and Fear, but not Terror. Full Hatred rules: p. 184.

description:f2b8dd8d7cf6e76c2a6e2b9e.name: Holy Hatred
description:f2b8dd8d7cf6e76c2a6e2b9e.text: When a Miracle causes Wounds, you may add +2 Wounds.

description:6845571ab4325c53c29069d2.name: Holy Visions
description:6845571ab4325c53c29069d2.text: Automatically recognise holy ground on entering it, perceive Blessings, Miracles and Chaos Magic cast in sight, and sense an object’s divine power by touching it.

description:14d56d51a72df96003da31a6.name: Hunter’s Eye
description:14d56d51a72df96003da31a6.text: With sufficient time, proper equipment and well-stocked hunting land, automatically obtain enough game for yourself and Initiative Bonus others. Normal foraging can provide more (p. 152).

description:ee03c68c9a8363e208c176c4.name: Impassioned Zeal (Cause)
description:ee03c68c9a8363e208c176c4.text: Choose a political, religious or philosophical cause. Charm Tests advocating it gain Advantage; lying about or denouncing it causes Disadvantage.

description:66c00c5ec9a3673f1869fa78.name: Implacable
description:66c00c5ec9a3673f1869fa78.text: Whenever you would gain Bleeding Conditions, gain one fewer.

description:7a1448c79570bc07dd255482.name: In-fighter
description:7a1448c79570bc07dd255482.text: As an Action, make an Opposed Melee Test to close inside the enemy’s reach. The winner chooses normal combat or in-fighting. In-fighting makes weapons longer than Short count as Improvised. An opponent can end it at their Turn’s start by losing Momentum.

description:6100d0233318b2b835dd08db.name: Inspiring
description:6100d0233318b2b835dd08db.text: Gain Advantage on Leadership Tests in combat.

description:c958214f92f7d433436c5d60.name: Instinctive Diction
description:c958214f92f7d433436c5d60.text: You may subtract 20 from a Minor Miscast table result; below 01, no Miscast occurs. Major Miscasts are unaffected.

description:9075108439232666841ae3e2.name: Invoke (Deity)
description:9075108439232666841ae3e2.text: Gain one chosen Miracle of your deity and access to memorise further available Miracles at their listed XP costs. Normally only one Invoke (Deity) is allowed. Invoke is incompatible, in either direction, with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Chaos Magic, Magic Resistance, Petty Magic and Witch! Unlearning costs 100 XP, removes all its Miracles and incurs extreme divine displeasure determined by the GM.

description:0566668925eb2466dc72cec1.name: Iron Jaw
description:0566668925eb2466dc72cec1.text: The first time each encounter that you would gain Stunned Conditions, gain one fewer.

description:7f758200944f38a031b4cbf0.name: Iron Will
description:7f758200944f38a031b4cbf0.text: Gain Advantage on Cool Tests against others’ influence, including Fellowship Tests and magic.

description:ea7ac3c03f32a50d9bb061e4.name: Jump Up
description:ea7ac3c03f32a50d9bb061e4.text: Gain Advantage on Perform (Acrobatics) Tests to entertain or move quickly outside combat. Upon gaining Prone, immediately attempt a Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics or Perform (Acrobatics) Test to stand.

description:c516743f81df4650a400970e.name: Kingpin
description:c516743f81df4650a400970e.text: Criminal no longer makes law enforcers suspicious or restricts Career access. Other criminals usually respect you, except prepared rivals seeking your position.

description:c96fef493cc8eec32e13e369.name: Lightning Reflexes
description:c96fef493cc8eec32e13e369.text: Gain +5 Agility. This does not count toward Advances.

description:55ece8e18fdef2bf9f556049.name: Linguistics
description:55ece8e18fdef2bf9f556049.text: Gain Advantage on Language Tests. Every Advance in a Language specialisation costs 50 XP regardless of previous Advances. Language (Magick) is excluded: this applies only to languages used for communication.

description:9c8848c2e3795891eec194a5.name: Lip Reading
description:9c8848c2e3795891eec194a5.text: With a clear view of a speaker’s mouth, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition Test to read their words.

description:a6b894b88da1de863726c08c.name: Luck
description:a6b894b88da1de863726c08c.text: Increase maximum Fortune by 1. May be purchased three times, for a total +3.

description:6e65fc6de97cd577524a071b.name: Magic Resistance
description:6e65fc6de97cd577524a071b.text: Reduce the SL of every spell affecting you by 3. This Talent is mutually exclusive with Channelling, Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch!

description:d11f272cf5f467effbe4aca8.name: Magical Sense
description:d11f272cf5f467effbe4aca8.text: Automatically notice spellcasting within Perception yards and its rough direction, but not its nature. With Second Sight or another way to perceive the Winds, gain Advantage on Tests to interpret their behaviour or movement.

description:3404925e01c522fe30df1c51.name: Magnum Opus
description:3404925e01c522fe30df1c51.text: Each purchase lets you create one extraordinary masterwork using an Art or Trade Skill. It grants GM-determined bonuses, usually to Fellowship Tests involving people who have seen it. Selling it yields at least ten times normal value. Further purchases create additional masterworks.

description:886c83f16045d2e6226de510.name: Marksman
description:886c83f16045d2e6226de510.text: Gain +5 Ballistic Skill. This does not count toward Advances.

description:d65af8e7c26fe7c7aa0d05aa.name: Master of Disguise
description:d65af8e7c26fe7c7aa0d05aa.text: Change posture, facial expression and suitable clothing to disguise your appearance. On successful Entertain (Acting) Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

description:5951e25013b5f1bfeea8162a.name: Master Orator
description:5951e25013b5f1bfeea8162a.text: Gain Advantage on Lore (Law) Tests to plead before a magistrate and equivalent Lore Tests to argue academic, religious or political matters before an audience.

description:5e5721ea9cae8504c41d2b81.name: Master Tradesman (Trade)
description:5e5721ea9cae8504c41d2b81.text: Choose a Trade specialisation. On successful Tests with it, use either rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Further purchases choose different Trades.

description:42f75b548bb84d662695efde.name: Menacing
description:42f75b548bb84d662695efde.text: Gain Advantage on Intimidation Tests. Sensible thieves, bandits and pickpockets usually choose another available target.

description:ebfc533528534a815e0c1737.name: Mimic
description:ebfc533528534a815e0c1737.text: Gain Advantage on Entertain (Acting, Comedy) and Perform (Clowning). After hearing an accent for a day, reproduce it, with any local benefits set by the GM. Recognise attempts to conceal or imitate familiar accents unless the speaker also has Mimic.

description:dca46466b4b4cf13ff8d8f71.name: Night Vision
description:dca46466b4b4cf13ff8d8f71.text: With even faint light, see clearly for 20 yards and extend light sources’ effective illumination by 20 yards.

description:a0eb49cc47f25c3a8d4b016d.name: Nimble-fingered
description:a0eb49cc47f25c3a8d4b016d.text: Gain +5 Dexterity. This does not count toward Advances.

description:6722f5c187d00ca863b858b6.name: Noble Blood
description:6722f5c187d00ca863b858b6.text: When appropriately dressed, count as at least one Status Tier above anyone without Noble Blood. Against others with it, compare Status normally. Enter Noble as though it shared your current Class.

description:67f564aedafac7ef5866c658.name: Nose for Trouble
description:67f564aedafac7ef5866c658.text: Gain Advantage on Intuition Tests and usually locate opportunities for gambling, fighting or heavy drinking in a settlement.

description:c5a418739d60c9841cc929e3.name: Numismatics
description:c5a418739d60c9841cc929e3.text: Gain Advantage on Lore (Heraldry) Tests identifying the origin of coins, medals and flags. After a successful Evaluate Test to value an item, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

description:0b20ce0a5e3339ee43cb0d41.name: Old Salt
description:0b20ce0a5e3339ee43cb0d41.text: On successful ocean Row or Sail Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Count as two boatmen towards an ocean-going vessel’s minimum crew.

description:6a33f25720c8baaa9862a036.name: Orientation
description:6a33f25720c8baaa9862a036.text: Gain Advantage on Navigation Tests. A glimpse of familiar signs, such as stars or trees, automatically reveals north.

description:f1553273702cf3f8238bcd37.name: Panhandle
description:f1553273702cf3f8238bcd37.text: Gain Advantage on begging Charm Tests, including Income Endeavours. Usually find safe but uncomfortable urban sleeping places, such as beneath bridges or near middens.

description:a6df2a29f2db480121d1ab10.name: Perfect Pitch
description:a6df2a29f2db480121d1ab10.text: Learn music after hearing it once. Gain Advantage on Entertain (Singing) and Play (Any) Tests.

description:aa9dbe58a79e6beb70a03418.name: Petty Magic
description:aa9dbe58a79e6beb70a03418.text:
Gain Willpower Bonus Petty spells on learning this Talent. Additional spells use the prices below; see Chapter 8: Magic. Unlearning costs 100 XP and immediately removes every spell linked to it.

| Spells already known | XP for next spell |
| --- | --- |
| Up to 5 | 50 |
| 6–10 | 100 |
| 11–15 | 150 |
| 16–20 | 200 |
| 21+ | 250 |

description:3205cce437254ee3c3ab302c.name: Pharmacist
description:3205cce437254ee3c3ab302c.text: Creating an alchemical remedy produces one additional dose (p. 154).

description:5ac4072c79e2a8239182c6ac.name: Pilot
description:5ac4072c79e2a8239182c6ac.text: Gain Advantage on Row and Sail Tests.

description:b0c6cc960779e2a7eef18cc3.name: Public Speaker
description:b0c6cc960779e2a7eef18cc3.text: Easily gather a crowd and usually judge its mood and motivations. Gain Advantage on Charm Tests to influence groups. Once Charmed, the group can be influenced through Leadership, including urging action or removing Broken (p. 169).

description:77bd93c27481af74b1d05342.name: Pure Soul
description:77bd93c27481af74b1d05342.text: Double the normal Corruption Point threshold before testing against mutation (p. 188).

description:a26b6588e576e6c34d04eeef.name: Rapid Reload
description:a26b6588e576e6c34d04eeef.text: Reduce your weapon’s Reload Rating by 1.

description:21bd658579003f1d3e218cca.name: Reaction Strike
description:21bd658579003f1d3e218cca.text: When Charged, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Initiative Test to make one immediate free attack against the charger, outside turn order, using your primary-hand weapon. Limit: once per round.

description:e99fbae1cd78bce34be1daad.name: Read/Write
description:e99fbae1cd78bce34be1daad.text: Read and write every language you speak.

description:cca3c2d4ba9cf2e46e05ca98.name: Relentless
description:cca3c2d4ba9cf2e46e05ca98.text: After an opponent Disengages, test Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics, Drive or Ride at their Turn’s end. Success gives an extra Move to follow and free Disengagement from other opponents. As Pursuer in a Pursuit, gain +1 SL on chase Tests.

description:691d455bcc0ffb01ac0d7239.name: Resistant (Threat)
description:691d455bcc0ffb01ac0d7239.text: Choose a Threat, such as Disease, Magic, Corruption or Poison. Once per session, before rolling against that Threat, choose automatic success; further Tests against it gain Advantage. Further purchases select different Threats.

description:0f00bfcafabd7e37a1c5c851.name: Resolute
description:0f00bfcafabd7e37a1c5c851.text: When gaining a Condition, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Cool Test to keep Momentum.

description:46722ea22c71df632b1a4d72.name: Reversal
description:46722ea22c71df632b1a4d72.text: In an Opposed Melee Test, retain Momentum if struck despite your own Test succeeding.

description:b047bf7428500642f40f7a3e.name: Riposte
description:b047bf7428500642f40f7a3e.text: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee lets you deal Damage as the attacker.

description:2220fc07576282777fa6eb84.name: River Guide
description:2220fc07576282777fa6eb84.text: Navigate dangerous river water without a Test unless Difficulty is Difficult (−1 SL) or harder. With the matching Lore (Local), no navigation Test is required: you know a safe route.

description:ab87f126bad7b1f816b6e133.name: Robust
description:ab87f126bad7b1f816b6e133.text: When testing to heal Wounds, you may recover 2 extra Wounds.

description:f5749eccc14bf6b1763882f8.name: Roughrider
description:f5749eccc14bf6b1763882f8.text: With Ride, direct your mount to take an Action as well as a Move without a Ride Test. Required Ride Tests gain Advantage. Mounted Pursuits add +1 to the animal’s Movement.

description:974c9771caf8943a4dc88f15.name: Rover
description:974c9771caf8943a4dc88f15.text: Gain Advantage on Stealth (Rural). Usually identify easy routes through wilderness and sources of game, water and shelter.

description:f907abc05bbbc1172b242fcc.name: Savant (Lore Specialisation)
description:f907abc05bbbc1172b242fcc.text: Choose a Lore specialisation you possess and gain Advantage on its Tests. Each further purchase selects a different Lore.

description:d453f5d5f4155d561c9c44fd.name: Savvy
description:d453f5d5f4155d561c9c44fd.text: Gain +5 Intelligence. This does not count toward Advances.

description:c4c027c615495d2fcf5e5f96.name: Scale Sheer Surface
description:c4c027c615495d2fcf5e5f96.text: Gain Advantage on Climb Tests. You may attempt apparently impossible surfaces, including sheer walls, ice and greased poles, with no imposed Difficulty harder than Very Hard (−3 SL).

description:a8acee716f549819dbe00168.name: Schemer
description:a8acee716f549819dbe00168.text: After successful Gossip or Lore (Politics) Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

description:600d2e9fe12fddc079cc2843.name: Sea Legs
description:600d2e9fe12fddc079cc2843.text: Normal sea conditions require no seasickness Test. When the GM does require one, gain Advantage.

description:528a9e1041f42361dbf153f4.name: Seasoned Traveller
description:528a9e1041f42361dbf153f4.text: While in a region, you may always Advance its Lore (Local), regardless of Career.

description:860c99dcae9b1b7b0447a3ce.name: Secret Identity
description:860c99dcae9b1b7b0447a3ce.text: Adopt a persona with a chosen Career for an encounter, day, adventure or other set period without testing to maintain it. Use that Career’s Class and Status, including for Banking or Income Endeavours. Income requires a Challenging (+0 SL) Earning Test with Entertain (Acting) or the assumed Career’s Earning Skill, rather than your real Career’s. With Embezzle, Bribery or Evaluate may replace it when embezzling. Failure exposes the deception, with GM-determined consequences.

description:15e3513e4349637ea254c713.name: Shadow
description:15e3513e4349637ea254c713.text: If someone you follow passes a Perception Test to detect you, choose to remain unseen and lose them, or keep following and be spotted.

description:b54b0d1aaa2a2e3b6daf99b1.name: Sharp
description:b54b0d1aaa2a2e3b6daf99b1.text: Gain +5 Initiative. This does not count toward Advances.

description:faf478a0d85d4e6267817c8a.name: Sharpshooter
description:faf478a0d85d4e6267817c8a.text: Ignore Ranged penalties from Prone targets and cover. Extraordinary accuracy feats remain possible with a successful Ranged Test at GM-set Difficulty.

description:0a17a8c4f963c017182bcdba.name: Shieldsman
description:0a17a8c4f963c017182bcdba.text: Once per Round while carrying a shield, lose Momentum either to grant its AP bonus to an adjacent ally without a shield or, after winning an attacking or defending Opposed Melee Test, to push the opponent up to 2 yards directly away and end engagement.

description:668baf94a2d0f4b3d0547b70.name: Sixth Sense
description:668baf94a2d0f4b3d0547b70.text: Just before triggering a trap or suffering hidden danger, pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Intuition Test to notice it at the final moment.

description:5b7d8bae393f2868c5a898c6.name: Slayer
description:5b7d8bae393f2868c5a898c6.text: Charging a creature larger than you automatically grants Momentum.

description:4a2c4f8b9a2eb10bf3dd54bf.name: Small
description:4a2c4f8b9a2eb10bf3dd54bf.text: Gain Size (Small); full Size rules are on p. 360 in Chapter 12: Bestiary.

description:4c0ba83930d064090e369476.name: Sniper
description:4c0ba83930d064090e369476.text: Ignore Long Range shooting penalties. Extreme Range shots suffer only −1 SL.

description:66633e985bdc988c32d26e9c.name: Speedreader
description:66633e985bdc988c32d26e9c.text: Read a full page at a glance and even a long book in a day. Double SL from successful Tests in an Extended Research Test.

description:590e49a939f4d37b65910cf7.name: Sprinter
description:590e49a939f4d37b65910cf7.text: Gain Advantage on Athletics Tests to run or jump.

description:22a28206dbedb5862938b2e3.name: Step Aside
description:22a28206dbedb5862938b2e3.text: After successfully Dodging an attack, move up to 2 yards and end engagement without granting opponents free attacks.

description:34e22b3b2c9c8d5c18d3c8a9.name: Stone Soup
description:34e22b3b2c9c8d5c18d3c8a9.text: A party member’s Foraging Test automatically finds enough extra food for you, even on failure, beyond whoever the result normally feeds (p. 152).

description:a2e4834c2654f63de66c820f.name: Stout-hearted
description:a2e4834c2654f63de66c820f.text: The first time each encounter you gain Broken Conditions, gain one fewer.

description:2509a6e4f3883b7df7644c75.name: Striding Gait (Terrain)
description:2509a6e4f3883b7df7644c75.text: Choose terrain, such as Coastal, Desert, Rocky, Tundra, Wetland or Woodland. Ignore its movement penalties and gain +2 SL to all Pursuit-related Tests there. Further purchases select different terrain.

description:d0f7f368ca6584391f0eb5cd.name: Strike Mighty Blow
description:d0f7f368ca6584391f0eb5cd.text: Melee weapons deal +1 Damage, or +2 when the attack has Advantage.

description:b9951f9c710fa535466d8869.name: Strike to Injure
description:b9951f9c710fa535466d8869.text: Roll twice on Critical Wound tables and choose either result. Silent Takedowns also ignore the Called Shot penalty (p. 135).

description:b3b9a28a9d3608fc9484487e.name: Strike to Stun
description:b3b9a28a9d3608fc9484487e.text: Improvised Weapons gain Pummel. With a Pummel weapon, ignore the Silent Takedown Called Shot penalty (p. 135).

description:04e1ac0683163fb3cf2e59a0.name: Strong Back
description:04e1ac0683163fb3cf2e59a0.text: Gain +1 SL on Opposed Strength Tests and carry +1 Encumbrance. A second purchase raises both totals to +3.

description:ff30a48ca759b5060f38675a.name: Strong Legs
description:ff30a48ca759b5060f38675a.text: On successful Athletics Tests to sprint or leap, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

description:8f281c756016e7ec4a6a9a3b.name: Strong-minded
description:8f281c756016e7ec4a6a9a3b.text: Once per session, before a Test, choose to ignore all its negative modifiers.

description:83bd286506da569bf2e64dba.name: Strong Swimmer
description:83bd286506da569bf2e64dba.text: Gain Advantage on Swim Tests and +2 SL in swimming Pursuits.

description:83d97c61913fb0cd9bd3e0d0.name: Sturdy
description:83d97c61913fb0cd9bd3e0d0.text: Count Strength Bonus twice when calculating carrying capacity in Encumbrance Points.

description:671347e02e66c381aa18a7eb.name: Suave
description:671347e02e66c381aa18a7eb.text: Gain +5 Fellowship. This does not count toward Advances.

description:177d43f52467ec2c2d360c47.name: Super Numerate
description:177d43f52467ec2c2d360c47.text: Calculate most mathematical problems without tools. Gain Advantage on Evaluate Tests and accurately track elapsed time while conscious.

description:49f976c1f0133c2aeabc59c0.name: Supportive
description:49f976c1f0133c2aeabc59c0.text: Ignore penalties for Charming higher Status Tiers, and gain Advantage on Charm Tests to ingratiate yourself with higher-Status people.

description:4d42c43765789b4804df7b5e.name: Sure Shot
description:4d42c43765789b4804df7b5e.text: Ranged Attacks deal +1 Damage and may ignore Partial armour. Impale weapons may also ignore Weakpoints armour.

description:678bd97954ab9d94f1bcafb7.name: Surgery
description:678bd97954ab9d94f1bcafb7.text: On successful Heal Tests outside combat, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Treat Critical Wounds requiring Surgery; see pp. 172–179 for effects.

description:20d731810b6dfe4620231386.name: Tenacious
description:20d731810b6dfe4620231386.text: The first time each encounter you would gain Fatigued Conditions, gain one fewer.

description:867c49a783009920a65b5726.name: Tinker
description:867c49a783009920a65b5726.text: For repairs, treat every Trade as Basic. With at least one Advance in the relevant Trade, repair Tests gain Advantage and take half normal time.

description:598d22082e1aad5c517965af.name: Tower of Memories
description:598d22082e1aad5c517965af.text: Store facts in an imagined tower to recall them precisely. On successful Lore Tests, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL.

description:c70381f9dac20e97a89c4b3e.name: Trapper
description:c70381f9dac20e97a89c4b3e.text: Gain Advantage on Set Trap Tests. With one hour of preparation, build a small animal trap or covered pit from available materials (p. 136).

description:d5ce4074f8f0793c2d96fb27.name: Trick Rider
description:d5ce4074f8f0793c2d96fb27.text: While mounted, use any Perform Skill and Dodge without modification.

description:0f2f82d440cbfb92d1949aa9.name: Tunnel Fighter
description:0f2f82d440cbfb92d1949aa9.text: Gain Advantage on Stealth (Underground). Easily estimate distance travelled underground and depth below ground.

description:3816bdd6ced9ec4d46331b8c.name: Unshakeable
description:3816bdd6ced9ec4d46331b8c.text: Being shot at with a Blackpowder weapon requires no Test to resist Broken.

description:fb03ad2d20fa6aa7f5252ef3.name: Very Resilient
description:fb03ad2d20fa6aa7f5252ef3.text: Gain +5 Toughness. This does not count toward Advances.

description:b4e49b61e3c9e935f383c637.name: Very Strong
description:b4e49b61e3c9e935f383c637.text: Gain +5 Strength. This does not count toward Advances.

description:60da8169475f3871d6202ebc.name: War Leader
description:60da8169475f3871d6202ebc.text: Allies affected by your battlefield Leadership may use it instead of Cool against Fear until the battle ends (p. 169). This ends if you die and is suspended while you have Broken, Unconscious or Fear Conditions.

description:50bcf1f22d0b69fd0c7d9b87.name: Warrior Born
description:50bcf1f22d0b69fd0c7d9b87.text: Gain +5 Weapon Skill. This does not count toward Advances.

description:e9de59dcce065f653910bd96.name: War Wizard
description:e9de59dcce065f653910bd96.text: On your Turn, cast one spell of CN 5 or less without using your Action. You cannot cast another spell that Turn.

description:310ca8cb7e526eb601e1fa43.name: Waterman
description:310ca8cb7e526eb601e1fa43.text: On successful Row or Sail Tests on rivers or lakes, choose rolled SL or the units-die result as SL. Count as two crew towards a river vessel’s minimum crew.

description:ae3be00df755e66e41d87215.name: Wealthy
description:ae3be00df755e66e41d87215.text: Earning through your Career in play or through Income provides +1 gold crown. A second purchase increases the total bonus to +3 gold crowns.

description:88d30efb2c545afc9f56c0c8.name: Well-prepared
description:88d30efb2c545afc9f56c0c8.text: Once per session, produce a needed Encumbrance 0 Trapping that you could plausibly have bought recently. Deduct its price as an earlier purchase; without money, you cannot use this Talent. Further uses that session cost Fortune.

description:063453848bcf4fc3ed3224a5.name: Witch!
description:063453848bcf4fc3ed3224a5.text: Gain one chosen Colour Lore or Witchcraft spell without needing the matching Arcane Magic, and treat its Channelling Skill as Basic. Another spell with the same benefits costs 150 XP, with each later spell costing 50 XP more. Witch hunters may take interest and established magical orders may present difficulties. Pay 100 XP to remove this Talent and every linked spell.

description:415c4d8c805124fa76b2f0af.name: Hand Weapon
description:415c4d8c805124fa76b2f0af.text: Weapon +7; the source does not identify a specific weapon.

description:0f552c0ee2f0728fe7694956.name: Arboreal
description:0f552c0ee2f0728fe7694956.text: In woodlands, increase Stealth and Climb Test SL by the creature’s Agility Bonus.

description:1741f19d3f45096777ea1762.name: Horns (Tusks)
description:1741f19d3f45096777ea1762.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:ce09f39770d1e5beb6cc052b.name: 8 Tentacles
description:ce09f39770d1e5beb6cc052b.text: May make 8 Free Attacks; each attack that causes Damage may also inflict an Entangled Condition on its target.

description:65706f904d08ca3e6c246b4c.name: Bite
description:65706f904d08ca3e6c246b4c.text: This Free Attack costs Momentum and has Penetrating.

description:87b6d78917a6d48c111425e0.name: Bite
description:87b6d78917a6d48c111425e0.text: This Free Attack costs Momentum and has Penetrating.

description:2b5b0b7087d34fa7361aba11.name: Tail
description:2b5b0b7087d34fa7361aba11.text: This Free Attack costs Momentum; wounding a smaller target also inflicts a Prone Condition.

description:c460ec63dbdbcdfd721db8f4.name: Breath (Any One)
description:c460ec63dbdbcdfd721db8f4.text: See page 357 for details of breath attacks

description:e159634dc0207a849f55d114.name: Bite
description:e159634dc0207a849f55d114.text: This Free Attack costs Momentum and has Penetrating.

description:d15c2d0bd44717418951c834.name: Tail
description:d15c2d0bd44717418951c834.text: This Free Attack costs Momentum; wounding a smaller target also inflicts a Prone Condition.

description:9102668a5d51fe0e081541ef.name: Vomit
description:9102668a5d51fe0e081541ef.text: Requires starting the turn Engaged and giving up both Move and Action. All targets within 2 yards oppose with Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge. A hit inflicts a Stunned Condition and 1 Damage to the victim’s weapons and armour. After use, wait 12 hours before using it again.

description:7126838b8316e6bdc52daf8f.name: Chill Grasp
description:7126838b8316e6bdc52daf8f.text: Costs Momentum and an Action. An Engaged target opposes with Dodge or Melee; if the attacker wins, the target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armour Points. Magical.

description:387205a1a57f39e3acc0f3be.name: Ghostly Howl
description:387205a1a57f39e3acc0f3be.text: A Magical Free Attack costing Momentum. Every living target within 30 yards takes 3 Deafened Conditions and loses 1d10 Wounds, ignoring Toughness Bonus and Armour Points. Each also gains a Broken Condition unless it passes Average (+2 SL) Cool.

description:6a3eb9520468fdd61ecb7dd3.name: Horns
description:6a3eb9520468fdd61ecb7dd3.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:bd64a615adde4e83153b9218.name: Horns
description:bd64a615adde4e83153b9218.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:52a6bf0547887d8b1c243859.name: Horns
description:52a6bf0547887d8b1c243859.text: Magical; only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:9d74edc68c723db6d609a371.name: Horns
description:9d74edc68c723db6d609a371.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:65b1e539f0423df880f08214.name: Horns
description:65b1e539f0423df880f08214.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:e8477ccad94c2fb0a6b45eeb.name: Horns
description:e8477ccad94c2fb0a6b45eeb.text: Only available as a Free Attack when Charging.

description:64d3aef1944334c8adc98b6c.name: Afraid
description:64d3aef1944334c8adc98b6c.text: Make an Extended Psychology Test against the target’s Fear. Until accumulated SL equal or exceed its rating, gain no Momentum; its melee attacks against you have Advantage (p. 183).

description:c6eb4dc9e9674c53db1d0cb0.name: Amphibious
description:c6eb4dc9e9674c53db1d0cb0.text: Has Swim; +1 SL to Swim Tests. Full Movement in water.

description:0e9720262d991f1101ecbb66.name: Animosity
description:0e9720262d991f1101ecbb66.text: On encountering the listed target, make a Psychology Test. Failure: attack socially or physically as appropriate; +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or disparage them (p. 183).

description:798ea638078b3f981eb41e09.name: Belligerent
description:798ea638078b3f981eb41e09.text: Immune to Fear while possessing Momentum.

description:c992ed2b2fbed7d3dab27cba.name: Bestial
description:c992ed2b2fbed7d3dab27cba.text: No rational thought/language; defends only with Dodge. Shies from fire; fire Wounds inflict Broken. Flees after losing over half Wounds; enters Frenzy instead if cornered, protecting young or Territorial.

description:b569b2f12514655b95f05678.name: Bite
description:b569b2f12514655b95f05678.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at Rating Damage (SB already included); uses WS/BS without spending the turn’s Action.

description:598d077a1a4df4a290dffee9.name: Blessed
description:598d077a1a4df4a290dffee9.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Blessings; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

description:34a556ea7691efaa5726af19.name: Bounce
description:34a556ea7691efaa5726af19.text: When Charging, Leaping or Sprinting, double Movement and leap over intervening terrain and creatures.

description:0db82cc4350b790bd29b25e1.name: Breath
description:0db82cc4350b790bd29b25e1.text: Magical ranged Free Attack: choose a visible creature within 20 + TB yards; it and every creature within SB yards of it oppose a single Ballistic Skill roll with their own Dodge Tests. Use BS 30 if the attacker has no BS. Losing targets suffer Rating Damage. Apply any listed Breath type: Acid — TB +4 Damage, and all weapons and armour carried by targets take 1 Damage. Cold — SB +2 Damage and a Fatigued Condition; affected weapons have Slow until that Condition ends. Electricity — SB +2 Damage, ignoring metal armour, and a Stunned Condition. Fire — SB +3 Damage and an Ablaze Condition. Poison — TB +2 Damage and a Poisoned Condition. Smoke — fills the area, blocks line of sight and causes Suffocation (p. 169) for TB Rounds. The attacker is immune to its own Breath.

description:3ba635a2c868ba894617389a.name: Champion
description:3ba635a2c868ba894617389a.text: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee deals Damage as if attacking.

description:e6affcbd0cb77d2b22469b2f.name: Chill Grasp
description:e6affcbd0cb77d2b22469b2f.text: Lose Momentum and use an Action: Opposed WS against Dodge or Melee. Win: target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring TB and AP. Magical.

description:637de196b8d7edade99ea388.name: Cold-blooded
description:637de196b8d7edade99ea388.text: Advantage on Cool Tests. Surprised is not removed the first time it normally would be.

description:1289b0e7ee33c7a330ee6eba.name: Constrictor
description:1289b0e7ee33c7a330ee6eba.text: Every successful hit inflicts Entangled; may then initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

description:5c1cff945f1fb0249402b051.name: Construct
description:5c1cff945f1fb0249402b051.text: No Int, WP or Fel; never Tests them, except use T for required WP Tests. Use SB instead of WPB for Wounds. All attacks Magical. Without a controlling spellcaster, or without Territorial, wanders mindlessly.

description:f50d11d905beb092db6be0a0.name: Corrosive Blood
description:f50d11d905beb092db6be0a0.text: Whenever wounded, all Engaged targets take 1d10 Damage (one roll for all).

description:5a6d59a8703c2086627b63cd.name: Corruption
description:5a6d59a8703c2086627b63cd.text: A Corrupting Influence of the listed strength (p. 187).

description:f0fb3678501473b6d9fd341d.name: Dark Vision
description:f0fb3678501473b6d9fd341d.text: Sees in darkness as in daylight.

description:14ff4474ed23c89b8d3c6166.name: Daemonic
description:14ff4474ed23c89b8d3c6166.text: No food, water or air; all attacks Magical. Non-Magical blow: 1d10, Rating+ ignores it and any Critical. Cannot ignore Magical blows this way. At 0 Wounds, returns to Chaos and leaves play.

description:57153fdc001228707f7e9b93.name: Disease
description:57153fdc001228707f7e9b93.text: Carries the listed disease; others Test for Contraction as appropriate (p. 179). Whether the carrier suffers its effects is the GM’s choice.

description:0cf4942df0263f90cac12e94.name: Distracting
description:0cf4942df0263f90cac12e94.text: Living targets within TB yards suffer −2 SL to all Tests. Does not stack with other Distracting creatures.

description:f0fb42b59c5c8f9e46abb69f.name: Ethereal
description:f0fb42b59c5c8f9e46abb69f.text: Passes through solid objects. Only Magical attacks can harm it; all its attacks are Magical.

description:9d09c1a34f1d9734531358cc.name: Fear
description:9d09c1a34f1d9734531358cc.text: Extended Psychology Test. Until accumulated SL exceed Rating (default 1): no Momentum; attackers gain Advantage in melee (p. 183).

description:acb0ac9450be114235e09930.name: Fly
description:acb0ac9450be114235e09930.text: As its Move, fly up to Rating yards, ignoring intervening terrain, obstacles and creatures; may Charge. End landed or airborne; if starting a turn airborne, must Fly or fall (GM decides distance). Against it, measure horizontal range then increase one range step (Extreme becomes unreachable). While flying, −20 to its Ranged Attacks.

description:317705a7bac97eee4b6109e7.name: Frenzy
description:317705a7bac97eee4b6109e7.text: WP Test to enter: Free Attack each Round, +1 Damage, immune to Psychology. Only attack or move to attack nearest visible enemy; no fleeing/retreat. Ends with no visible enemies or if Stunned or Unconscious; then Fatigued.

description:13a6fd145917b0d5ab26b026.name: Ghostly Howl
description:13a6fd145917b0d5ab26b026.text: Once per turn, lose Momentum for a Magical Free Attack. Living hearers within Strength yards gain 3 Deafened and lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/AP; Average (+2 SL) Cool or also Broken.

description:3da32c31b10b1b9a55cb82b6.name: Grim
description:3da32c31b10b1b9a55cb82b6.text: At the end of its turn, gains Momentum if it has none.

description:8a526e375341825531715961.name: Hatred
description:8a526e375341825531715961.text: On meeting target: Psychology Test; failure activates Hatred. Attack by fastest, deadliest means; +1 SL Melee/Ranged against them. Immune to their Intimidate/Fear, not Terror (p. 184).

description:72a23b5518666f906a103015.name: Horns
description:72a23b5518666f906a103015.text: When Charging into combat, may make a Free Attack at SB +4 Damage.

description:1414f2b69b101482bfdc5f44.name: Hungry
description:1414f2b69b101482bfdc5f44.text: After killing/incapacitating living prey or finding a fresh corpse: Average (+2 SL) Cool or feast; lose next Move and Action.

description:e0c3448121fbb0e338392ddb.name: Immunity
description:e0c3448121fbb0e338392ddb.text: Ignores all harm of the listed type, including Critical Wounds.

description:62c9148c8c91ec572903e92b.name: Infected
description:62c9148c8c91ec572903e92b.text: On causing a living opponent to lose Wounds: Easy (+4 SL) Endurance or contract a Festering Wound (p. 180).

description:c736b36c3f915886dbb836d0.name: Infestation
description:c736b36c3f915886dbb836d0.text: Opponents suffer −1 SL to hit it in melee.

description:58033dcee5fb978e5474b4d4.name: Many Heads
description:58033dcee5fb978e5474b4d4.text: Head Criticals stun, kill or render unconscious only when all heads are disabled or similarly affected. With Bite, Horns or Tongue, make as many Free Attacks as healthy heads. With 2+ healthy heads, +2 SL to Perception.

description:444fa9933b9f1a8aa9ae53ac.name: Mark of Chaos
description:444fa9933b9f1a8aa9ae53ac.text: Khorne: Frenzy; Etiquette (Followers of Khorne). Animosity towards overt Slaanesh followers (reciprocal while Mark visible). Language (Magick)/Channelling: dispelling only. Career Talents at normal XP: Berserk Charge, Combat Aware, Combat Reflexes, Furious Assault, Implacable, Magic Resistance, Resistance (Magic), Resolute, Strike Mighty Blow, Warrior Born. Nurgle: +10 Toughness; Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle). Animosity towards overt Tzeentch followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Frightening, Hardy, Implacable, Iron Jaw, Menacing, Resistance (Poison), Resistance (Disease), Robust, Tenacious, Very Resilient. Slaanesh: Fearless (Everything); Etiquette (Followers of Slaanesh). Animosity towards overt Khorne followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Attractive, Blather, Careful Strike, Combat Master, Gregarious, Inspiring, Lightning Reflexes, Nimblefingered, Resistant (Poison), Sharp. Tzeentch: Roll 1d10/3 Mutations, rounding up, alternating Mental and Physical. Etiquette (Followers of Tzeentch). Animosity towards overt Nurgle followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Aethyric Attunement, Arcane Magic (Any), Chaos Magic (Tzeentch), Fast Hands, Instinctive Diction, Magical Sense, Petty Magic, Second Sight, War Wizard, Witch!.

description:3088d7fda80f764f418318f3.name: Magical
description:3088d7fda80f764f418318f3.text: All attacks are Magical and can harm creatures vulnerable only to Magical attacks.

description:e4e87d6bd5da0ecb672dbb23.name: Magic Resistance
description:e4e87d6bd5da0ecb672dbb23.text: Casting Tests for spells affecting it suffer −3 SL. Incompatible with Channelling or Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch! Talents (in either direction).

description:263fccd972c2e7014aad330c.name: Mental Corruption
description:263fccd972c2e7014aad330c.text: Roll on the Mental Corruption table (p. 189).

description:c91124b381a8a67f4a28146a.name: Miracles
description:c91124b381a8a67f4a28146a.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Miracles; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

description:acb18818536432761da06a58.name: Mutation
description:acb18818536432761da06a58.text: Roll on the Physical Corruption table (p. 189).

description:ec95f5d4f5ac8f7fa4a34ce5.name: Night Vision
description:ec95f5d4f5ac8f7fa4a34ce5.text: See clearly in natural darkness for 20 yards; extend the illumination distance of light sources by 20 yards.

description:598a8a6324d19bb0c929d620.name: Painless
description:598a8a6324d19bb0c929d620.text: Ignores non-amputation Critical Wound penalties; Conditions still apply.

description:2ac53998897f3cc3563bab95.name: Petrifying Gaze
description:2ac53998897f3cc3563bab95.text: Lose Momentum and an Action against one visible living target: Opposed BS/Initiative (spellcasters may defend with Language (Magick)). Win: 1 Stunned, +1 per SL after the first. Win by 6+ SL: permanently turn target to stone.

description:86871e6c8c1055c05814eb63.name: Regeneration
description:86871e6c8c1055c05814eb63.text: Round start: above 0 Wounds, heal 1d10; at 0, heal 1 on 1d10 of 8+. A roll of 10 fully heals one Critical and its penalties/Conditions. Cannot regenerate fire-caused Wounds/Criticals.

description:1ecfe947d6bd3d55ae429a36.name: Size
description:1ecfe947d6bd3d55ae429a36.text: Size determines Wounds, primary melee Damage and combat interactions. Small: Wounds 2 × TB; no added Damage; counts as 1 when outnumbered. Average: Wounds SB + 2 × TB + WPB; no added Damage; counts as 1. Large: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×2; add SB Damage; counts as 2. Enormous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×4; add SB Damage; counts as 3. Monstrous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×8; add 2 × SB Damage; counts as 4. These Damage bonuses are already included in NPC profiles and do not apply to ranged or extra attacks. Tiny has no supplied Wounds formula, Damage modifier or outnumbering count; retain its baseline or set Wounds manually. Melee defence against a larger creature suffers −2 SL. Aggressive creatures cause Fear in smaller creatures. Creatures may leave melee with smaller opponents without Disengaging. In Opposed Strength or similar Tests, a creature at least 2 Size steps larger wins automatically; with a 1-step difference, the smaller creature must roll a Critical to compare SL normally, otherwise it loses. The outnumbering counts above apply only when determining whether the larger creature is outnumbered; it counts as 1 for its own outnumbering bonus. Against a smaller opponent, lose Momentum for one Stomp as a Free Attack using Melee (Brawling), with SB Damage. Each upward Size adjustment gives +10 Strength, +10 Toughness and −5 Agility; reverse these changes when shrinking. Ignore Size rules while Swarm applies (p. 362).

description:c6d398579226dec943622dbd.name: Skittish
description:c6d398579226dec943622dbd.text: Spectacular visible magic, thunderclaps or explosions inflict 3 Broken Conditions.

description:426e6f77c402d1bbb74e0774.name: Spellcaster
description:426e6f77c402d1bbb74e0774.text: Casts the listed Lore(s). Add Spellcaster/Spellcaster Lord template, or grant Channelling (chosen Wind) at WP +10 and Language (Magick) at Int +10 as Basic Skills (GM may increase).

description:4ceaf57070e5212ad7c57371.name: Striding Gait
description:4ceaf57070e5212ad7c57371.text: No movement penalties in the listed terrain; +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth there.

description:b4191277da18e9519fc5bbf8.name: Stupid
description:b4191277da18e9519fc5bbf8.text: If no nearby ally lacks Stupid, make Easy (+4 SL) Intelligence at each Round’s start. Failure: lose that turn’s Move and Action. Nearby non-Stupid allies prevent this.

description:2060f9f3726689c87cfd8723.name: Swarm
description:2060f9f3726689c87cfd8723.text: Acts as one creature; ignores Psychology, Engaged restrictions on moving and all Size rules. Each Engaged opponent loses 1 Wound at Round end. Has ×5 normal Wounds and +10 WS; shooting at it gains +40 to hit.

description:da58344e63ddae99a3263fd9.name: Tail
description:da58344e63ddae99a3263fd9.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at SB +2 Damage; smaller targets losing any Wounds also become Prone.

description:e9f8df3ab86a013551ecc85d.name: Tentacles
description:e9f8df3ab86a013551ecc85d.text: One Free Attack per tentacle at SB +0 Damage. Causing Damage may inflict Entangled and initiate a Grapple with that tentacle. Resolve its Grapple with the tentacle’s Free Attack, not the creature’s Action (p. 167).

description:2958e951bd1751e9df77d114.name: Territorial
description:2958e951bd1751e9df77d114.text: Fights to the death defending its area; normally does not pursue enemies beyond it.

description:71d1933e5c7da8f4dac417a8.name: Terror
description:71d1933e5c7da8f4dac417a8.text: First encounter: Psychology Test; failure gives Broken equal to Rating +1 per negative SL. Causes Fear of same Rating regardless of result (p. 183).

description:262bbdecdeb1034e9f8de625.name: Tongue
description:262bbdecdeb1034e9f8de625.text: Lose Momentum for a ranged Free Attack at SB +0 Damage. GM sets range (default 3 yards at Small–Large; 12 for larger). Hit: 1 Entangled; smaller targets dragged into melee. Then release, make a Weapon-Trait Free Attack, or keep wrapped and initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

description:f3acf6420d6fadc2b70e4cc9.name: Trained
description:f3acf6420d6fadc2b70e4cc9.text: Animal Training teaches the options listed in parentheses; additional training options may be created. Broken: ignore Bestial and gain +2d10 Fellowship. Drive: pull carts, coaches, ploughs, buggies or similar loads. Entertain: +10 to appropriate Entertain, Perform or Play Tests. Fetch: retrieve objects, normally for dogs and similar animals. Guard: remain at or patrol a guarded place; gain Territorial. Home: return home when released or lost. Magic: ignore Skittish caused by magic, as required for most spellcasters’ mounts. Mount: accept a rider; belligerent animals may require a specific Ride specialisation, such as Ride (Griffon) for a griffon. War: +10 Weapon Skill and ignore Skittish caused by loud noises.

description:6500d167ec956b0f4358c9d9.name: Undead
description:6500d167ec956b0f4358c9d9.text: Needs no air, food, water or other life necessities; counts as Undead for spells, Miracles and abilities.

description:cd6c678fc36dccab3e6c6756.name: Unstable
description:cd6c678fc36dccab3e6c6756.text: Round end: Engaged opponent has Momentum and creature has none → driven back; lose 2 Wounds. Destroyed or banished at 0 Wounds.

description:018d1b2883966bfe926a7df8.name: Vampiric
description:018d1b2883966bfe926a7df8.text: Successful Bite against suitable prey: heal Wounds equal to target’s loss. Blood-drinking is its only healing method.

description:b343dfd2ea28f8c4f7f31e7b.name: Venom
description:b343dfd2ea28f8c4f7f31e7b.text: Causing Wounds inflicts Poisoned. The listed Difficulty applies to Tests to recover from Poisoned, not to avoid it (p. 186).

description:ef475e7ac355c11f930fc738.name: Vomit
description:ef475e7ac355c11f930fc738.text: If starting the turn Engaged, spend Move and Action: one BS roll opposed by each target’s Dodge within 2 yards. Attacker Easy (+4 SL), defenders Challenging (+0 SL). Losing targets take TB +4 Damage and Stunned; all their carried weapons/armour take 1 Damage. Once per 12 hours.

description:869e66f9879a53881a7ec366.name: Ward
description:869e66f9879a53881a7ec366.text: After any blow, roll 1d10: Rating+ ignores the blow, including Criticals.

description:3f6da9b175079907f8b7f48e.name: Wallcrawler
description:3f6da9b175079907f8b7f48e.text: Full Movement on suitable vertical surfaces and ceilings; automatically passes Climb Tests.

description:d9ccaed094a84b68c132e372.name: Web
description:d9ccaed094a84b68c132e372.text: Each successful hit inflicts 1 Entangled, with Strength equal to Rating (p. 186).

description:f4a2593151171e9297fdd946.name: Extra Mouth
description:f4a2593151171e9297fdd946.text: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

description:23df65e7cd6beb734f285ef9.name: Glowing Skin
description:23df65e7cd6beb734f285ef9.text: Provides as much light as a candle.

description:c670592281aa8c50d21c76d2.name: Patchy Feathers
description:c670592281aa8c50d21c76d2.text: Roll twice on the Hit Locations table to determine the affected locations.

description:34cceca80beb1c3abd2c382a.name: Spiny Protrusions
description:34cceca80beb1c3abd2c382a.text: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

description:64685c4a63c51071e8ea45b7.name: Uneven Horns
description:64685c4a63c51071e8ea45b7.text: +1 Armour Point to Head; gain Horns

description:0ec2d4d598063dab32ab2716.name: Whiskered Snout
description:0ec2d4d598063dab32ab2716.text: Gain Acute Sense (Smell); +2 SL to Track Tests

description:d93d7d155926c3d86f06dcb2.name: Chaotic Dreams
description:d93d7d155926c3d86f06dcb2.text: Suffer Fatigued during each day’s first two hours.

description:d149610441d5964686b5747a.name: Hateful Impulses
description:d149610441d5964686b5747a.text: Animosity applies to every other Species.

description:74ea845e8bee068ec9755caa.name: Lonely Spirit
description:74ea845e8bee068ec9755caa.text: While alone, suffer −10 to every Test.

description:dc516f3f6753c1146e78e73b.name: Shaky Morale
description:dc516f3f6753c1146e78e73b.text: Failing a Fear Test also inflicts Broken.

description:c4772aa9bec60e91e25bab81.name: Unending Malice
description:c4772aa9bec60e91e25bab81.text: Tests to hurt receive +1 SL; all other Tests suffer −1 SL.

description:a43db74cc8d2f81a7b8061f8.name: Telepathy
description:a43db74cc8d2f81a7b8061f8.text: Transmit/read thoughts without speech. To resist thought-reading: Average (+2 SL) Cool.

description:4d061abd280ed6c1d4172fa2.name: Chameleon
description:4d061abd280ed6c1d4172fa2.text: Perception to spot it: −4 SL (−2 while moving). Ranged Tests to shoot it: −2 SL.

description:acefa6bfc40dac1ebfe97cc0.name: Flammable
description:acefa6bfc40dac1ebfe97cc0.text: Tests to avoid Ablaze suffer the printed −20 penalty. Ablaze causes twice the normal Wounds.

description:821409a1a77f0a58ba4d8808.name: Stationary Attacker
description:821409a1a77f0a58ba4d8808.text: Immune to Psychology; cannot pursue, manoeuvre, Charge, Flee, Leap, Run or Climb. May only take attack/Trait actions. Unsuspecting prey entering reach becomes Engaged; its sprung attack inflicts Surprised. Detect with Challenging (+0 SL) Perception, then suitable Lore; either failure leaves the threat unrecognised. Reach: Tiny/Little Very Short; Small Short; Average Medium; Large Long; Enormous Very Long; Monstrous Massive.

description:95d6a176fa1bd1bb6ac481e7.name: Auger and Scryer
description:95d6a176fa1bd1bb6ac481e7.text: May use the supplied Psychometry/Augury rules; Psychometry counts as Basic. Ignores the prohibition against being both magician and Scryer.

description:89d8a065382249e7e5c7287c.name: Contemplation
description:89d8a065382249e7e5c7287c.text: When unattended and surroundings change, Difficult (−1 SL) Perception. +2 SL or more: alert; 0 to +1: Stupid for the encounter, then alert or meditating as circumstances dictate; −0 to −3: 2 Fatigued, only Move or Action each turn; −4 or less: unresponsive. If unresponsive, stimuli allow a new Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test; weapons/magic attacks make it Easy (+4 SL). Telepathic warning from a Slann or Skink magic-user makes it alert.

description:016361e82b6a51c353b50df0.name: Knack for Total Power
description:016361e82b6a51c353b50df0.text: Successful Casting Tests are Criticals on doubles or a units die of 0. In Lustria, may reroll Tests to perceive the Winds of Magic.

description:bf6809d547dabfe5f7ffb8f4.name: Master of Magical Mishaps
description:bf6809d547dabfe5f7ffb8f4.text: Major Miscasts become Minor, except when casting through another spellcaster via Telepathy.

description:cdfd5759ac9d986bc0484369.name: Emergency Teleportation
description:cdfd5759ac9d986bc0484369.text: At 10 Wounds or fewer, or a Critical causing broken bones/torn muscles or worse, may immediately cast Teleport as a free action. Success sends the Slann to the nearest temple-city’s star chamber (a neighbouring one if unsafe). Only Slann are known to survive these Geomantic Web amulets.

description:fa73b7ee3b185fb62602df9a.name: Relic Priest
description:fa73b7ee3b185fb62602df9a.text: Spirit stays within WPB yards of its body; both have equal Wounds. Destroying the body destroys the spirit; damage to either may trigger Emergency Teleportation. Spirit may possess the body to direct a palanquin; otherwise body cannot move/act and is always Prone. Spirit may cast with Move and Action (up to 2 spells/turn); melee ability is defence only and deals no damage.

description:3b8399d9753185c35ff6c458.name: Slann Telepathy
description:3b8399d9753185c35ff6c458.text: Network: Slann and Skink Priests within Willpower yards; if within Willpower yards of a Geomantic Web flow, also Slann within that distance of another flow. Spend Action or Move and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence: exchange up to 5 minutes’ conversation in one turn, or cast through a networked Skink Priest using the Slann’s Characteristics/Skills/Talents. Miscasts affect the Skink.

description:1ecec3a7edcc83869ba18e5d.name: Palanquin
description:1ecec3a7edcc83869ba18e5d.text: Grants Fly (16) and Ward (8+); hard cover against missiles from rear/sides, soft cover from the front.

description:3f60e532ec5e2b345f083f5e.name: Chariots of the Asur
description:3f60e532ec5e2b345f083f5e.text: Swiftfeather Rocs are the only willing Skycutter draught animals. Safe, effective flight requires an Elf’s reflexes.

description:3be559085eee8a04b0505987.name: Blood Hungry Spore Cloud
description:3be559085eee8a04b0505987.text: Movement by Human-sized or larger warm-blooded creatures within 1 yard triggers a spore cloud: 5-yard radius, 3 yards high, lasting 2d10 Rounds. Warm-blooded creatures caught inside: Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Bleeding.

description:845e0b91b2f4fc740fc5e793.name: Impale Attack
description:845e0b91b2f4fc740fc5e793.text: Always strikes legs without the usual −20 called-shot penalty. Ignores leather armour; has Impale.

description:a4215eedb7c3a5e25520896c.name: Entangled Attack
description:a4215eedb7c3a5e25520896c.text: Only attacks warm-blooded prey. Cannot use Weapon until the target is Entangled; then strikes once per turn until it escapes or dies.

description:0fc1b366befe252be14e6c79.name: Magical Snack
description:0fc1b366befe252be14e6c79.text: Eating an Itxi Grub grants a spellcaster +1 SL to Casting and Channelling for 3d10 Rounds. Does not stack.

description:01840ffcea099ad510befea2.name: Posterior Flame
description:01840ffcea099ad510befea2.text: Rough handling or sudden disturbance by warm-blooded creatures triggers flames for 1d10 Rounds. Any character or flammable item touching it gains Ablaze.

description:f99718248ffd5155fa71ac88.name: Use as Ammunition
description:f99718248ffd5155fa71ac88.text: Handle with Animal Care: Very Easy (+6 SL) for cold-blooded, Hard (−2 SL) for warm-blooded. Damp leather pouch holds up to 6 Fireleeches docile for 24 hours if not badly jostled. A second Animal Care Test readies one to throw or sling; failure inflicts Ablaze on the handler.

description:25945770ba6b70a6bcd4d016.name: Brain Rot
description:25945770ba6b70a6bcd4d016.text: A head Critical against warm-blooded prey burrows into its skull and inflicts Brain Rot in addition to Damage (p. 186).

description:43a12d0b6ebe89b03f871eb2.name: Excruciating Sting
description:43a12d0b6ebe89b03f871eb2.text: While Poisoned by the sting, test Difficult (−1 SL) Cool at each turn’s start; failure adds Stunned.

description:7f55eb80d718932717443f71.name: Odour Attack
description:7f55eb80d718932717443f71.text: When harassed, odour spreads 1d10 yards. Cold-blooded targets: Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Nausea for 1d10 hours. Warm-blooded creatures suffer no symptom.

description:43ae7cb416c0a25a410dff94.name: Blue-Ringed Asp Venomous Bite
description:43ae7cb416c0a25a410dff94.text: Venom also inflicts Bleeding, lasting until Poisoned is resolved.

description:615ed160fa78eaf8aa963fd1.name: Shooting Spine Attack
description:615ed160fa78eaf8aa963fd1.text: May fire spines singly or en masse; they regenerate in 1 day.

description:47531b76c2dd8f31b4cc7589.name: Ramming Attack
description:47531b76c2dd8f31b4cc7589.text: Healthy Pliodons have Collision Rating 14 when ramming vessels.

description:b59f306a8975b7444303439f.name: Blood Frenzy
description:b59f306a8975b7444303439f.text: On causing a combat Wound, immediately becomes Frenzied until all foes within its senses are slain.

description:2b0ca1e91a9a3c60fa429539.name: Toxic Bile
description:2b0ca1e91a9a3c60fa429539.text: Projects bile up to 15 yards; any character hit gains Ablaze.

description:f97d38152db8ca7dbd7d764b.name: Fearsome Roar
description:f97d38152db8ca7dbd7d764b.text: Enormous/Monstrous predators: Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or suffer Fear and leave immediately. Prey and smaller creatures: Hard (−2 SL) Cool or flee in Fear.

description:99102b604a8803e3c86b51aa.name: Vigor Mortis
description:99102b604a8803e3c86b51aa.text: Undead within 8 of the Corpse Cart ignore Unstable, except for the Cart itself. Necromancy spells cast within 8 gain +20. Destroying the Cart ends both effects.

description:9e92dc81ca5ac50b558536cb.name: Balefire Brazier
description:9e92dc81ca5ac50b558536cb.text: Replace Vigor Mortis’s Necromancy casting bonus with −20 to every Lore (Magic) check within 8. Nearby Undead retain its protection from Unstable.

description:312d164ea7083d3745bbd53f.name: Sword
description:312d164ea7083d3745bbd53f.text: Choose Sword or Spear as the source allows, using the corresponding Melee specialisation.

description:eca8bd3443d8987a4843b7b9.name: Spear
description:eca8bd3443d8987a4843b7b9.text: Choose Sword or Spear as the source allows, using the corresponding Melee specialisation.

description:f7c871c0e2e4bb9acc000116.name: Shortbow
description:f7c871c0e2e4bb9acc000116.text: May replace Spear and Shield; includes a Quiver and 10 arrows.

description:5bbaec2bf729ad7dcf83d6d1.name: Dooming
description:5bbaec2bf729ad7dcf83d6d1.text: Innate Blessed (Morr)-like access to the Dooming Miracle. Uses Willpower, not Invoke; owes no allegiance to a Human god.

description:2ecc21fb222a3d767e5a0b6c.name: Ranged (Own Body)
description:2ecc21fb222a3d767e5a0b6c.text: Range 20 yards; the projectile is the creature’s own body.

description:6af840866da99e8815ec4b2d.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
description:6af840866da99e8815ec4b2d.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the lure. On failure, Easy (+4 SL) Cool or become beguiled: may only move towards the light, effectively Unconscious.

description:beb4bd09a94e849734a768f7.name: Slimy
description:beb4bd09a94e849734a768f7.text: When Grappled, pass a Toughness Test for +4 SL to subsequent escape Tests. Opponent makes Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics; failure: release the Latch-eel or suffer Suffocation.

description:5d29e6ccf9b3dd67b1e01abe.name: Love the Light
description:5d29e6ccf9b3dd67b1e01abe.text: Attracted to light; fire encourages rather than deters it. Despite Bestial, does not shy from fire or gain Broken from flaming attacks.

description:5888186e830bc89aca91e31c.name: Immersion
description:5888186e830bc89aca91e31c.text: Grapple; inflicting Entangled draws the victim inside, causing Suffocation. Escape Entangled as a Grapple with Opposed Strength against 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, may act freely and does not count as Engaged by the immersed victim.

description:dbf5547133b1a249c1450d72.name: Fire Resistant
description:dbf5547133b1a249c1450d72.text: Sea Elementals are immune to Ablaze Conditions.

description:1c00e6792f81735d53dd7eb9.name: Mindless Spellcaster
description:1c00e6792f81735d53dd7eb9.text: A Sea Elemental may cast spells and channel using Strength.

description:d921758e000aa3780ee3d7d6.name: Boat Crusher
description:d921758e000aa3780ee3d7d6.text: Constrict vessels of Size Large or smaller: spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size. Then Extended Opposed Strength/vessel Toughness; accumulated SL equal to vessel Wounds shatters it. Crew may attack or lever it off: a hit causing over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool or release. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL stops squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.

description:dc20e8cbd1968a7347877ec0.name: Electrical Discharge
description:dc20e8cbd1968a7347877ec0.text: After Grappling, spend 1 Momentum at the start of a subsequent turn: 10 Damage ignoring non-magical metal armour; if wounded, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or Stunned. Each use requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain Fatigued; while Fatigued, shock Damage drops to 6. Against a Grappled boat, damages no hull but hits every crew member for 6 Damage (3 if Fatigued).

description:fecb27194c5cd9572c0b4033.name: Whale Bane
description:fecb27194c5cd9572c0b4033.text: Fanged Maw attacks use core Venom: inflicting Wounds gives Poisoned, with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery Tests. This Difficulty governs recovery.

description:2cb9cfbbe1ac6dbf1dfadaaa.name: Syreen’s Call
description:2cb9cfbbe1ac6dbf1dfadaaa.text: Action: sing. Characters within Initiative yards: Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or beguiled, effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards the Syreen.

description:f42e98c90e79a80ac6eabef8.name: Resistant to Cold
description:f42e98c90e79a80ac6eabef8.text: May make an Endurance Test to ignore ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other effects.

description:dfb518a11748e746d6a6220c.name: Lure of the Leviathan
description:dfb518a11748e746d6a6220c.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) identifies the lure and allows looking away. Failure: Easy (+4 SL) Cool or Stunned.

description:8401c15b7fc0bed67f573ff6.name: Devastating Assault
description:8401c15b7fc0bed67f573ff6.text: A Black Leviathan charging a ship causes a CR 50 collision.

description:11a80bb05195a3d83e8498e3.name: On a Different Scale
description:11a80bb05195a3d83e8498e3.text: Bestial, but only fire at least as large/intense as a large bonfire frightens it. GM judges Fear/Terror sources by whether their size merits its respect; smaller ordinary threats do not concern it.

description:909877e859f8ce794a1ad0c8.name: Marine Creature
description:909877e859f8ce794a1ad0c8.text: Full Movement in water; printed profile assumes aquatic conditions. On land: Movement 1 and −2 SL to all Tests. Must be regularly doused or begin Suffocating.

description:f652e2314929b2fdad8a7133.name: Die Hard
description:f652e2314929b2fdad8a7133.text: Any Critical Wound may heal. During the TB Rounds immediately after death, test Endurance at Challenging (+0 SL) at each Round’s start; success restores life with 1 Wound.

description:47ca70c833e2310d9d7a85f4.name: Prejudice
description:47ca70c833e2310d9d7a85f4.text: Prejudice (Thin People) is a reference entry: the source supplies no Fifth Edition mechanics or Test modifiers.

description:148fe1b0bed28877c3942659.name: Corrupting Vomit
description:148fe1b0bed28877c3942659.text: A hit from Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to a risk of Corruption (Moderate).

description:323d977232ebe98844ddda50.name: Rotten Regeneration
description:323d977232ebe98844ddda50.text: Apply core Regeneration, restoring 1d10 ÷ 2 Wounds, rounded down, instead (Tribes and Tribulations, p. 88).

description:c343d88ee1ba66f9f0e3f771.name: Bileful Vomit
description:c343d88ee1ba66f9f0e3f771.text: Vomit uses Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; instant): Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack, a magic missile at TB Damage ignoring AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds: Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Blood Rot (core pp. 179, 357).

description:c850dcb800524b14f31175fb.name: That’s No Mound
description:c850dcb800524b14f31175fb.text: Stealthy applies only while the Troll has neither moved nor taken an Action.

description:355253b8f09db27ec3e2e138.name: Sated
description:355253b8f09db27ec3e2e138.text: The Hungry Troll template ends after the Troll eats an Average-sized or larger creature undisturbed.

description:38295ff9b9e86355e1cbf2e0.name: Starving
description:38295ff9b9e86355e1cbf2e0.text: The Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation after 24 hours without food.

description:2e3dd3f3e0a55fd8bc7d7b4d.name: Water Wise
description:2e3dd3f3e0a55fd8bc7d7b4d.text: A River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; Stupid applies elsewhere.

description:a9503955eacee5f4ca9b286e.name: Purple Skullback Bite
description:a9503955eacee5f4ca9b286e.text: If wounded and Poisoned by the bite: Average (+2 SL) Cool or gain 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still take damage/poison; for 2d10 hours gain printed +2d10 to Channelling/Language (Magick) and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. Bonuses are temporary.

description:fa043cae28dc3d214e6511c9.name: Shock Cavalry
description:fa043cae28dc3d214e6511c9.text: Requires Trained (War). A Charging rider may pass through smaller creatures to reach the target. Each makes Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or takes 4 + the mount’s SB Damage; every creature damaged removes 2 yards of remaining Movement. A creature at least the mount’s Size stops the Charge. At the Charge’s end, enemies in melee range are Engaged; resolve the Charge as if one of them were its target. A smaller creature that has not acted this Round may replace its Dodge attempt with one attack using a held weapon against the mount or rider. The Charge continues unless that attack kills or disables the mount.

description:033efb70580ca36965ce6f1e.name: Injuries
description:033efb70580ca36965ce6f1e.text: Injuries are lasting effects of Critical Wounds and need specialist treatment or another stated remedy. The Critical Wound remains unhealed while its Injury persists.

description:3176c6b24e2c5f3197e7719f.name: Broken Bone (Minor)
description:3176c6b24e2c5f3197e7719f.text:
### Effects

The affected location cannot be used until healed. For an arm or leg, use the corresponding Lost Arm or Lost Leg rules. A head fracture requires a liquid diet and gives -3 SL to all Language Tests. A body fracture gives Disadvantage on Strength- and Agility-based Tests and halves Movement.

### Healing

Recovery takes 30 + 1d10 days. Then pass Average (+2 SL) Endurance to avoid lasting damage. Failure causes -1 SL to Agility Tests using an injured arm; permanent -1 Movement and -10 Agility for a body or leg fracture; or -1 SL to spoken Language Tests for a head fracture.

An Average (+2 SL) Heal Test within one week removes the need for that Endurance Test, provided the location remains bound and immobilised until healed. If the binding comes undone, another Average (+2 SL) Heal Test within a day is required to retain that benefit.

description:7f65a166082d05c215751752.name: Broken Bone (Major)
description:7f65a166082d05c215751752.text:
### Effects

Use Broken Bone (Minor), including the unusable location and its location-specific effects.

### Healing

Recovery takes 10 days longer than Broken Bone (Minor). All associated Tests are Challenging (+0 SL). A failed healing Test causes -2 SL to Agility Tests using an injured arm; permanent -2 Movement and -20 Agility for a body or leg fracture; or -2 SL to spoken Language Tests for a head fracture. The binding and early Heal rules of Broken Bone (Minor) still apply.

description:44d84c747d74f1daa30422e3.name: Torn Muscle (Minor)
description:44d84c747d74f1daa30422e3.text:
### Effects

Tests involving the injured location suffer -1 SL. A leg injury also halves Movement.

### Healing

The muscle partially heals after 30 - Toughness Bonus days. Successful Heal reduces this time once by 1 day, plus 1 further day per SL after the first.

description:de5635b6319f8f0e38247cd6.name: Torn Muscle (Major)
description:de5635b6319f8f0e38247cd6.text:
### Effects

Use Torn Muscle (Minor), but the penalty is -2 SL to all Tests. A leg injury also halves Movement.

### Healing

After 30 - Toughness Bonus days, the penalty for using the limb falls to -1 SL on relevant Tests. Complete healing takes another 30 - Toughness Bonus days. Heal can diagnose the damage but does not shorten recovery.

description:aac6aa3f77f88a30f8347e66.name: Amputated Parts
description:aac6aa3f77f88a30f8347e66.text:
When a Critical Wound specifies Amputation (Difficulty), pass Endurance at that Difficulty or gain Prone. Failure at -1 SL or worse also gives Stunned; at -4 SL or worse, gain Unconscious as well. All amputations need Surgery, and the associated Critical Wound remains unhealed until surgical treatment (p. 172).

The lasting effects are listed under Lost Arm, Lost Ear, Lost Eye, Lost Fingers, Lost Foot, Lost Hand, Lost Leg, Lost Nose, Lost Teeth, Lost Toes and Lost Tongue.

description:e30a02331f55d5a388a81c4b.name: Lost Arm
description:e30a02331f55d5a388a81c4b.text: Use Lost Hand, but a shield cannot be strapped to the missing arm.

description:faf5805386b7bfd33bdeab5f.name: Lost Ear
description:faf5805386b7bfd33bdeab5f.text: One lost ear has no measurable penalty. Losing both ears gives Disadvantage on hearing-based Perception Tests.

description:d32a6b1fe5d23929d8c818ab.name: Lost Eye
description:d32a6b1fe5d23929d8c818ab.text: If both eyes are lost, all sight-influenced Tests have Disadvantage, and opponents gain Advantage on melee Tests to hit you.

description:e65dd043833c56d74ec8d385.name: Lost Fingers
description:e65dd043833c56d74ec8d385.text: Each lost finger gives -1 SL to all Tests using that hand. Once four or more fingers on a hand are lost, use Lost Hand.

description:4ecacd8d545822505617144c.name: Lost Foot
description:4ecacd8d545822505617144c.text: Permanently halve Movement, rounding up, and lose 10 Weapon Skill and 10 Agility. Dodge and Athletics Tests have Disadvantage. Losing a second foot sets Movement to 1 and costs another 5 Weapon Skill and 5 Agility. Reduce the lost-foot Characteristic penalty by the number of toes previously lost from that foot.

description:067763e97bb9113d98c773b3.name: Lost Hand
description:067763e97bb9113d98c773b3.text: Tests normally needing two hands have Disadvantage, and two-handed weapons cannot be wielded. A shield can be strapped to the injured arm. If the primary hand is lost, off-hand weapon Melee Tests suffer -2 SL; reduce this penalty by 1 SL for each 100 XP spent relearning use of the other hand. Losing both hands requires prosthetics to manipulate objects.

description:d6d09ad75f4f5e37faf9022d.name: Lost Leg
description:d6d09ad75f4f5e37faf9022d.text: Use Lost Foot, and the Dodge Skill cannot be used at all.

description:7eb48885bbbdb3294d207c9b.name: Lost Nose
description:7eb48885bbbdb3294d207c9b.text: This always counts as an Impressive Scar, with +2 SL to Intimidate and -2 SL to Charm instead of the usual modifiers. Smell-based Tests have Disadvantage.

description:e2e11b795ae832c11d7d8606.name: Lost Teeth
description:e2e11b795ae832c11d7d8606.text: Every two lost teeth permanently reduce Fellowship by 1. Losing more than half the teeth (Humans: 16; Elves: 18; Halflings and Dwarfs: 20) doubles eating times and makes some foods almost impossible to eat.

description:1e2a770a3b831206359058de.name: Lost Toes
description:1e2a770a3b831206359058de.text: Each lost toe permanently reduces Weapon Skill and Agility by 1.

description:d87d91c256ebe0b13c872747.name: Lost Tongue
description:d87d91c256ebe0b13c872747.text: All Language Tests involving speech automatically fail. Communication must rely on other methods, such as sign language.

description:fe4453a30aa87d91f3e6e764.name: Impressive Scars
description:fe4453a30aa87d91f3e6e764.text: With enough visible scars, lost parts or other marks, and the GM’s agreement, gain permanent +1 SL to Intimidate Tests and -1 SL to Charm Tests.

description:2dfe3050a8334edc0bb4b86c.name: Black Plague
description:2dfe3050a8334edc0bb4b86c.text:
### Contraction

Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance for each hour or part-hour in an area with infected fleas, or when exposed to infected fluids. Previous survivors instead Test once daily with Advantage.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 hours
Duration: 3d10 days
Symptoms: Blight, Buboes, Fever

description:0f6bccd196093be0a35ba436.name: Blood Rot
description:0f6bccd196093be0a35ba436.text:
### Contraction

Develops from another disease or a Critical Wound.

### Progression

Incubation: Instant
Duration: 1d10 days
Symptoms: Blight, Fever, Malaise

description:cb885661b7c4da6626c2c826.name: Bloody Flux
description:cb885661b7c4da6626c2c826.text:
### Contraction

Fail Easy (+4 SL) Endurance after an infected source enters the mouth.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 hours
Duration: 1d10 days
Symptoms: Fever, Flux, Malaise

description:17d0c14106819200ab7a7d75.name: Festering Wound
description:17d0c14106819200ab7a7d75.text:
### Contraction

Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance after fighting a creature with the Infected Trait. It can also develop from Infection.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 days; instant if it develops from another disease or Infection
Duration: 1d10 days
Symptoms: Fever, Malaise

description:f215f0d626d633ae5846afb0.name: Galloping Trots
description:f215f0d626d633ae5846afb0.text:
### Contraction

Fail Easy (+4 SL) Endurance after an infected source enters the mouth.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 hours
Duration: 1d10 days
Symptoms: Flux, Malaise, Nausea

description:e93cb92a9ffd08f119f0a3dd.name: Itching Pox
description:e93cb92a9ffd08f119f0a3dd.text:
### Contraction

Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance after contact with an infected individual.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 days
Duration: 1d10 + 7 days
Symptoms: Pox

Permanent: Contracting Itching Pox makes you immune to catching it again.

description:9664e216d3bdfdb779e56a31.name: Packer’s Pox
description:9664e216d3bdfdb779e56a31.text:
### Contraction

Fail Easy (+4 SL) Endurance after contact with infected animals, hides or bodies.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 days
Duration: 5d10 days
Symptoms: Pox, Infection

description:38dadc13f15f9caafac47409.name: Ratte Fever
description:38dadc13f15f9caafac47409.text:
### Contraction

Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance after combat in which infected rodents, including skaven with the Infected Trait, wounded you; or fail Easy (+4 SL) Endurance after an infected source enters your mouth.

### Progression

Incubation: 3d10 + 5 days
Duration: 3d10 + 10 days
Symptoms: Fever, Malaise, Pox

description:5596c7915e852bb2466f9ccc.name: Sea Sickness
description:5596c7915e852bb2466f9ccc.text:
### Contraction

Elves are immune. On a susceptible character’s first sea journey, fail Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance to become seasick. In rough weather, the Test is Average (+2 SL).

### Progression

Duration: For first-time seafarers, Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance after each day travelling at sea; success prevents this form of Sea Sickness permanently. For rough seas or other temporary causes, Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance hourly.
Symptoms: Nausea

description:206e119cdd808d3832198e66.name: Weevil Cough
description:206e119cdd808d3832198e66.text:
### Contraction

Fail Average (+2 SL) Endurance after contact with infected hay, wheat or flour, or when an infected person coughs nearby. Test about once per hour of exposure.

### Progression

Incubation: 1d10 days
Duration: 1d10 days
Symptoms: Coughs and Sneezes, Malaise

There is no reliable cure for Weevil Cough.

description:3d2991bbb45b49b67b9f745a.name: Blight
description:3d2991bbb45b49b67b9f745a.text: Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance daily, normally when sleeping. The first failure causes Unconscious, which cannot be removed while Blight persists. The second failure is fatal.

description:f413ae757d8693725f1784b5.name: Buboes
description:f413ae757d8693725f1784b5.text: All physical Tests suffer -1 SL; Fellowship Tests also suffer -1 SL if the swellings can be seen or smelled. A Heal Test by someone with Surgery can lance them and remove the penalty; failure causes a Festering Wound. Once lanced, Test Difficult (-1 SL) Endurance daily or the swellings return.

description:7851483e2895fa865378f98b.name: Coughs and Sneezes
description:7851483e2895fa865378f98b.text: At the start of a session, secretly roll 1d10: the GM may trigger the urge that many times at most during the session. Resist with Average (+2 SL) Endurance or spend your next Action coughing or sneezing. If not resisted, creatures within 3 yards are exposed and must Test for Contraction.

description:29999bc8c79d0094427da37a.name: Fever
description:29999bc8c79d0094427da37a.text: Agility, Dexterity and Psychology Tests suffer -2 SL.

description:9682171c1612a9f4628d5c33.name: Flux
description:9682171c1612a9f4628d5c33.text: Take opportunities for toilet breaks. Once per session, the GM can require an urgent visit: reach a suitable place within Toughness Bonus Rounds or gain Besmirched.

description:c4c8485c9c25c92409db4dc0.name: Gangrene
description:c4c8485c9c25c92409db4dc0.text: Roll percentile dice for a Hit Location (p. 164): Head affects the nose, Arm a finger, Leg a toe, and Body causes a Festering Wound. For an affected nose, finger or toe, Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance daily. Failure worsens it; after more failures than Toughness Bonus, that location loses all function and uses the Amputated Parts rules. While Gangrene persists, all Fellowship Tests suffer -1 SL.

description:ae21c7e98fd9cf9f4b175803.name: Infection
description:ae21c7e98fd9cf9f4b175803.text: Each Infection prevents recovery of 1 Wound. Test Very Easy (+6 SL) Endurance once daily or gain a Festering Wound. If you already have a Festering Wound, Test Easy (+4 SL) instead; failure causes Blood Rot. An Infection from lost Wounds ends when it causes a Festering Wound or receives treatment. A disease-caused Infection lasts until its disease is cured.

description:a951d384ef522daf0fefa526.name: Malaise
description:a951d384ef522daf0fefa526.text: Acute Sense Talents cannot be used. Language and Perception Tests suffer -2 SL.

description:80f06033a3417a212f178f48.name: Nausea
description:80f06033a3417a212f178f48.text: Whenever a Turn involves strenuous activity, such as running, climbing or fighting, Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance. Failure gives 1 Stunned and may cause Besmirched from vomiting; an empty stomach instead produces dry heaving.

description:21484cbefeab41fbb3263384.name: Pox
description:21484cbefeab41fbb3263384.text:
Fellowship Tests suffer -1 SL. Up to twice per session, the GM may trigger an urge to scratch. Resist with Average (+2 SL) Endurance; failure gives Fatigued, removable only by spending your next 1d10 Actions scratching.

When Pox ends, Test Average (+2 SL) Endurance. On failure, reverse those Test dice to find the Hit Location for permanent scarring (p. 164). A Head result permanently reduces Fellowship by 1.

description:25f056ffd9e404050fc1c0e3.name: Disease and Infection
description:25f056ffd9e404050fc1c0e3.text: Heal can diagnose a disease. The Test Difficulty depends on how rare it is and whether the diagnosing character has encountered it before.

description:4dbf004f1b09ee1d2e39eb6b.name: Disease Format
description:4dbf004f1b09ee1d2e39eb6b.text: Contraction explains how infection occurs. Incubation is the delay before Symptoms appear. Duration is how long untreated Symptoms last, after which the disease ends. Symptoms list its effects; Permanent lists lasting consequences when applicable.

description:cbb6340ff46f41173bc842d0.name: Treatment of Disease
description:cbb6340ff46f41173bc842d0.text: A carer needs at least one Heal Advance. Each day a patient rests under their care removes 1 additional day from the disease’s duration. Successful Challenging (+0 SL) Heal protects the carer from catching it that day; each SL after the first protects one other character. The GM may modify the Heal Test for the disease, conditions, supplies or stress.

description:420e4f2593f009df2c9a012e.name: Cures and Tonics
description:420e4f2593f009df2c9a012e.text: Pre-prepared cures usually require an Endurance Test at the Difficulty shown for that cure and Symptom in Effect Of Pre-Prepared Cures. Success suppresses the Symptom for 1 day. An Astounding Failure (-6 SL) causes Galloping Trots. See the Consumer Guide for purchasing medicines.
